items.name: .223 Remington
items.description: .223 Remington ammunition with 36gr JHP bullets.  The .223 round has been very popular with civilian shooters for almost a century, finding use in a wide variety of weapons.  It generates lower pressure than 5.56 NATO leading to slightly decreased accuracy and recoil.

items.name: .223 casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .223 round.

items.name: LW-5 speedloader
items.description: This speedloader, made by Leadworks for use with L2037 Backup revolver, can hold 5 rounds of .223 and quickly reload a compatible revolver.

items.name: .22 LR casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .22 LR round.  These can't be hand-reloaded.

items.name: unused .22 casing
items.description: An unfired, like-new .22 round casing, with the primer still intact.

items.name: .22 CB
items.description: The .22 Conical Ball is a variety of .22 ammunition that propels its bullet using a primer instead of gunpowder.  The end result is a subsonic round that is so weak as to be nearly useless given your predicament.

items.name: .22 CPHP
items.description: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with 30gr copper-plated, hollow-point bullets.  Has a higher velocity and slightly more stopping power than lead round-nose ammunition, but armor will have a magnified effect on its already-low penetration.

items.name: .22 LR
items.description: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with 40gr unjacketed bullets.  The .22LR round is extremely weak with very low stopping power, short range, and negligible recoil.  It is most useful for rifle training, and hunting small animals.

items.name: .22 rat-shot
items.description: A .22 caliber cartridge loaded with very small pieces of shot contained within a fragmenting plastic capsule.  It has an extremely short range and penetration ability, but it can hit targets with greater ease.

items.name: .22 8-round speedloader
items.description: This speedloader can hold 8 rounds of .22 and quickly reload a compatible revolver.

items.name: .270 Winchester casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .270 Winchester round.

items.name: .270 Winchester JSP
items.description: .270 Winchester ammunition with 130gr soft point bullets.  The .270 round was not initially successful, but over a few decades it became one of the most popular rifle cartridges for hunting and silhouette shooting.  It is a powerful round capable of taking down large targets with ease.

items.name: 2 Shot Special
items.description: A crudely made double barrel pistol firing 38 special ammo.  Unfortunately, the name is less about the double barrels and more about the number of shots you'll get before it breaks down on you.

items.name: pair of 2-by-arm guards
items.description: A pair of improvised arm guards made from broken pieces of a two by four that are tied to your arms with rags and string.  They offer good protection, but are really uncomfortable to wear.

items.name: pair of 2-by-shin guards
items.description: A pair of improvised shin guards made from broken pieces of a two by four that are tied to your shins with rags and string.  They offer good protection, but are really hard to run with.

items.name: war flail
items.description: This is a stout pole with a large steel flanged mace head on a short chain attached to it, based on the peasant flail agricultural tool except now with a metal head and made to thresh people in metal armor rather than grain.

items.name: peasant flail
items.description: This is a stout pole with a wooden club on a leather cord attached to it, this is a tool used to thresh wheat and occasionally people when the peasants got angry at their feudal lords.

items.name: 2.5L canteen
items.description: A large plastic water canteen, with a 2.5 liter capacity and carrying strap.

items.name: plank
items.description: A narrow, thick plank of wood, like a 2 by 4 or similar piece of dimensional lumber.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and can be used for all kinds construction.

items.name: .30-06 Springfield
items.description: .30-06 Springfield rounds with 165gr soft point bullets.  The .30-06 cartridge has excellent accuracy, range, and stopping power making it popular with hunters and snipers for well over a century.

items.name: .30-06 casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .30-06 round.

items.name: .30-06 clip
items.description: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load a bolt-action rifle.

items.name: .30-06 M14A1 tracer
items.description: Armor piercing incendiary .30-06 M14A1 ammunition containing tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.  It penetrates all but the strongest body armor with ease.

items.name: .30-06 M2 AP
items.description: Armor piercing .30-06 M2 ammunition with 168gr FMJ bullets.  It is an extremely powerful and accurate cartridge but pays for its armor penetration abilities with lowered damage.

items.name: .300 Win Mag casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .300 Winchester Magnum round.

items.name: .300 Winchester Magnum
items.description: .300 Winchester Magnum rounds with 220gr JHP bullets.  The 300WM round is an extremely powerful and accurate rifle round introduced in 1963.  It has proven popular with hunters and snipers, although it is not as common as .308 or .30-06.

items.name: .300 AAC Blackout
items.description: A .300 AAC Blackout round with a 125gr open tip match bullet.  300 BLK is an intermediate cartridge necked up from 5.56x45mm, designed to achieve similar ballistics to 7.62x39mm.  It is compatible with standard AR-15 lower receivers and will feed from STANAG magazines.

items.name: .300BLK casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .300 AAC Blackout round.

items.name: .300 AAC Blackout, subsonic
items.description: A subsonic .300 AAC Blackout round with a 220gr open tip match bullet.  300 BLK is an intermediate cartridge necked up from 5.56x45mm, designed to achieve similar ballistics to 7.62x39mm.  It is compatible with standard AR-15 lower receivers and will feed from STANAG magazines.

items.name: .308 Winchester
items.description: .308 Winchester ammunition with 168gr hollow point bullets.  The .308 round is one of the most popular hunting cartridges in the world due to its accuracy and power.

items.name: .308 casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .308 round.

items.name: 30 gallon barrel
items.description: A huge plastic barrel with a resealable lid.

items.name: steel drum (100L)
items.description: A huge steel barrel with a resealable lid.

items.name: fire barrel (100L)
items.description: A large metal barrel used to contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in its walls for air supply.  Fires set in a fire barrel will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.

items.name: .32 ACP
items.description: The .32 ACP was a popular handgun cartridge in the 20th century.  Not so powerful as the .38 or the 9x19mm though.

items.name: .32 ACP casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .32 ACP round.

items.name: .357 magnum casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .357 magnum round.

items.name: .357 magnum FMJ
items.description: Jacketed .357 magnum ammunition.  The .357 magnum round is derived from the earlier .38 special, with a marginally longer case and generating greater pressure.

items.name: .357 magnum JHP
items.description: Jacketed hollow point .357 magnum ammunition.  The .357 magnum round is derived from the earlier .38 special, with a marginally longer case and generating greater pressure.

items.name: .357 SIG casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .357 SIG round.

items.name: .357 SIG FMJ
items.description: Jacketed .357 SIG ammunition.  The .357 SIG round is a high velocity pistol cartridge, giving it a flatter trajectory than many handgun rounds.

items.name: .357 SIG JHP
items.description: Jacketed hollow point .357 SIG ammunition.  The .357 SIG round is a high velocity pistol cartridge, giving it a flatter trajectory than many handgun rounds.

items.name: .36 paper cartridge
items.description: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of black powder and a .36 projectile.  Used by the Colt M1861 Navy.

items.name: .380 ACP FMJ
items.description: .380 ACP ammunition with a brass jacketed 95gr bullet.  Popular in pocket pistols for over a century, it is often considered the weakest caliber to consider carrying.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.

items.name: .380 ACP JHP
items.description: .380 ACP ammunition with a 95gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  It is a popular round for small concealable backup pistols, and often the weakest recommended defensive caliber.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.

items.name: .380 ACP casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .380 ACP round.

items.name: .380 ACP +P
items.description: Overpressure .380 ACP ammunition with a 90gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  These defensive loadings are designed to maximize performance and tend to be more accurate than practice ammo.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.

items.name: .38 Special casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .38 Special round.

items.name: .38 FMJ
items.description: .38 Special ammunition with brass jacketed 130gr bullets.  The .38 Special round has been known from its inception for its accuracy and low recoil.

items.name: .38 Special
items.description: .38 Special ammunition with 130gr FMJ bullets.  The .38 Special round was extremely common among US police forces during the 20th century.

items.name: .38/.357 7-round speedloader
items.description: This speedloader can hold 7 rounds of .357 Magnum or .38 Special and quickly reload a compatible revolver.

items.name: .38/.357 5-round speedloader
items.description: This speedloader can hold 5 rounds of .357 Magnum or .38 Special and quickly reload a compatible revolver.

items.name: .38/.357 6-round speedloader
items.description: This speedloader can hold 6 rounds of .357 Magnum or .38 Special and quickly reload a compatible revolver.

items.name: .38 Super
items.description: .38 Super ammunition with 90gr JHP bullets.  Designed in 1929, the .38 super cartridge was designed to penetrate body armor and vehicles.

items.name: .38 Super casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .38 Super round.

items.name: .38 Super FMJ
items.description: .38 Super ammunition with 147gr FMJ bullets.  The .38 Super round was developed from .38 ACP in the 1920s, designed to penetrate the body armor of the era.

items.name: .40 S&W casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .40 S&W round.

items.name: .40 6-round speedloader
items.description: This speedloader can hold 6 rounds of .40 S&W or 10mm Auto and quickly reload a compatible revolver.

items.name: .40 S&W FMJ
items.description: .40 S&W ammunition with 180gr FMJ bullets.  Designed to retain the 10mm Auto cartridge's power with lower recoil, the .40 S&W round became popular for law enforcement and personal defense.

items.name: 40mm flare
items.description: A 40mm signal flare.  It will burn brightly for up to a minute, and will also leave a streak of smoke cover in its wake.

items.name: 40x46mm
items.description: A 40mm grenade with a flashbang load.  It will detonate with a blast of light and sound, designed to blind, deafen, and disorient anyone nearby.

items.name: 40mm incendiary
items.description: A 40mm grenade with a small napalm load, designed to create a burst of flame.

items.name: 40mm slug
items.description: A 40mm shell loaded with a massive bullet.  Say goodbye to your shoulder, I guess.

items.name: 40mm smoke cover
items.description: A 40mm grenade designed to provide smoke cover.

items.name: .40 S&W JHP
items.description: .40 S&W ammunition with 135gr JHP bullets.  The .40 S&W round is a descended from the 10mm Auto cartridge and maintains most of its predecessor's strengths while reducing recoil.

items.name: improvised 40x46mm buckshot
items.description: An improvised 40x46mm buckshot load somewhat resembling M576.  Aside from using the M118 casing normally used by HEDP shells, it performs as well as buckshot loads using the intended M199 casing.

items.name: improvised 40x46mm flechette
items.description: An improvised 40x46mm flechette load containing 70 steel darts.  Aside from using the M118 casing normally used by HEDP shells, it performs as well as flechette shells using the M199 casing.

items.name: improvised 40x46mm flechette
items.description: An improvised 40x46mm flechette load containing 70 steel darts, loaded into the M199 casing used by M576 buckshot shells.

items.name: 40x46mm M1006 stun
items.description: A low velocity less-lethal 40x46mm round with a foam and plastic projectile intended to cause pain and disorientation to the target.  May still injure or kill.

items.name: 40x46mm M118 casing
items.description: A large canister from a spent 40mm cartridge, used by M433 HEDP rounds.  It could be repurposed for makeshift buckshot and other handloads.

items.name: 40x46mm M195 casing
items.description: A large canister from a spent 40mm cartridge, used by M651 teargas rounds.  Not very useful now that the world has ended; less-lethal rounds aren't very useful against undead, and it likely won't tolerate higher pressures.

items.name: 40x46mm M199 casing
items.description: A large canister from a spent 40mm cartridge, used by M576 buckshot rounds.  It could be reused to make new buckshot or other makeshift handloads.

items.name: 40x46mm M212 casing
items.description: A large canister from a spent 40mm cartridge, used by M1006 stun rounds.  Not very useful now that the world has ended; less-lethal rounds aren't very useful against undead, and it likely won't tolerate higher pressures.

items.name: 40x46mm M433 HEDP
items.description: A low velocity 40x46mm HEDP grenade.  It can penetrate 2 inches of steel armor and fragmentation of the projectile body also makes it suitable for use against infantry.

items.name: 40x46mm M576 buckshot
items.description: A 40x46mm buckshot load, designed for use in thick vegetation or room clearing.

items.name: 40x46mm M651 teargas
items.description: A low velocity 40mm tear gas canister.  It is effective for riot control and driving infantry from entrenched positions

items.name: improvised 40x46mm slug
items.description: An improvised 40x46mm load resembling an oversized shotgun slug.  Aside from using the M118 casing normally used by HEDP shells, it performs as well as slugs using the M199 casing.

items.name: improvised 40x46mm slug
items.description: An improvised 40x46mm load resembling an oversized shotgun slug, loaded into the M199 casing used by M576 buckshot shells.

items.name: improvised 40x53mm buckshot
items.description: An improvised 40x53mm buckshot load somewhat resembling M576.

items.name: 40x53mm M1001 flechette
items.description: 40x53mm canister shot loaded with 17 grain flechettes.

items.name: 40x53mm M169 casing
items.description: A large canister from a spent 40mm cartridge.

items.name: 40x53mm M430A1 HEDP
items.description: A high velocity 40x53mm HEDP grenade.  It can penetrate 3 inches of steel armor and fragmentation of the projectile body also makes it suitable for use against infantry.

items.name: improvised 40x53mm slug
items.description: An improvised 40x53mm load resembling an oversized shotgun slug.

items.name: .410 000 shot
items.description: A .410 shell with 5 000 pellets.  Good for a hunting or combat load.

items.name: .410 hull
items.description: An empty hull from a .410 shotgun shell.

items.name: .44 Magnum casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .44 Magnum round.

items.name: .44 6-round speedloader
items.description: This speedloader can hold 6 rounds of .44 and quickly reload a compatible revolver.

items.name: .44 paper cartridge
items.description: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of black powder and a .44 projectile.  Used by the Colt M1860 Army.

items.name: .44 Magnum FMJ
items.description: A brass-jacketed variant of the .44 Magnum round.  This increases penetration at the cost of reduced damage from expansion.

items.name: .44 Magnum
items.description: .44 magnum ammunition with 240gr JHP bullets.  The .44 magnum round is one of the most powerful handgun cartridges available.  It has excellent stopping power but suffers from extremely high recoil for a handgun round.

items.name: .454 Casull
items.description: .454 Casull ammunition with 300gr jacketed soft point bullets.  The .454 Casull round is derived from .45 Long Colt with a stronger, lengthened case.  It is an exceptionally powerful cartridge with higher stopping power than many rifle rounds, although it suffers from extreme recoil making it unsuitable for most purposes.

items.name: .454 Casull casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .454 Casull round.

items.name: .454 5-round speedloader
items.description: This speedloader can hold 5 rounds of .454, .45 Colt or .410 bore and quickly reload a compatible revolver.

items.name: .454 6-round speedloader
items.description: This speedloader can hold 5 rounds of .454, .45 Colt or .410 bore and quickly reload a compatible revolver.

items.name: .45-70 casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .45-70 Government round.

items.name: .45-70 LFN cowboy
items.description: .45-70 Government ammunition loaded with a 405 grain lead flat nose bullet to original specifications for safe use in antique firearms.  Quite a bit less powerful than modern ammo, but still packs a punch.

items.name: .45-70 +P penetrator
items.description: .45-70 Government +P ammunition loaded with a 305 grain solid copper penetrator projectile.  Designed for maximum penetration through thick hide and bone while maintaining ideal wounding characteristics.

items.name: .45-70 SP
items.description: .45-70 Government ammunition loaded with a 305 grain soft point round.  One of the oldest cartridges still in use, it is still a favorite for large game hunting at short ranges.

items.name: .45 ACP FMJ
items.description: .45 ACP ammunition with 230gr FMJ bullets.  Noted for its stopping power, the .45 ACP round has been common for almost 150 years.

items.name: .45 ACP casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .45 ACP round.

items.name: .45 ACP JHP
items.description: .45 ACP ammunition with 185gr JHP bullets.  The .45 ACP round was developed to replace the .38 Long Colt cartridge in the early 20th century.  It has good stopping power but above average recoil.

items.name: .45 ACP +P
items.description: Overpressure .45 ACP ammunition with 200gr JHP bullets.  This +P ammunition has higher muzzle energy than typical loads leading to greater damage, accuracy and recoil.

items.name: .45 Colt casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .45 Colt round.

items.name: .45 Colt JHP
items.description: .45 Colt ammunition with 250gr jacketed hollow point bullets.  Originally designed for the Colt Single Action Army, and still used for modern reproduction revolvers.  Originally a black powder cartridge, modern loads can make this round competitive in the new era.

items.name: .460 Rowland casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .460 Rowland round.  It looks deceptively like a .45ACP casing.

items.name: .460 Rowland HCFN
items.description: A plated, hard cast flat nosed variant of the .460 Rowland round.  This increases penetration slightly at the cost of reduced damage from expansion.

items.name: .460 Rowland
items.description: .460 Rowland ammunition with 185gr JHP bullets.  The .460 Rowland round is designed to emulate hard-hitting .44 magnum in common autoloading pistols.  Like the .44, .460 Rowland has exceptional power - and recoil.  It is almost dimensionally identical to .45ACP, save for having a longer case and deeper seated bullets to prevent ammunition mix-ups.

items.name: 4.6x30mm
items.description: 4.6x30mm ammunition with 31gr copper plated steel bullets.  The 4.6x30mm round was developed by H&K to compete with FN Herstal's 5.7x28mm cartridge.  It has low recoil and excellent armor penetration.

items.name: 4.6x30mm casing
items.description: An empty casing from a 4.6x30mm round.

items.name: .500 S&W Magnum
items.description: .500 S&W Magnum ammunition with 500gr bullets.  The .500 S&W Magnum round is a colossally powerful handgun cartridge capable of killing almost any target with one hit.  It has extremely high damage and recoil to match.

items.name: .500 S&W Magnum casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .500 S&W Magnum round.

items.name: .500 5-round speedloader
items.description: This speedloader can hold 5 rounds of .500 and quickly reload a compatible revolver.

items.name: .50 BMG casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .50 BMG round.  These are rare, so you might want to hold onto these.

items.name: .50 BMG M17 tracer
items.description: A tracer variant of the powerful .50 BMG round.  Tracer rounds help to keep the weapon they are fired from on target at the risk of igniting flammable substances.

items.name: .50 BMG Raufoss Mk 211
items.description: This variant of the .50 BMG round makes the most of the caliber's potential payload delivery: the tip is loaded with an incendiary mix, which ignites on impact, detonating the RDX or PETN charge.  This also ignites a secondary zirconium powder incendiary charge that surrounds a tungsten carbide penetrator, both encased by a mild steel cup.  Fragments from the cup and burning metallic powder follow the penetrator through armored targets, increasing lethality.  These rare, complicated, and expensive rounds are not likely to be manufactured again; use them wisely.

items.name: .50 BMG M33 Ball
items.description: .50 BMG ammunition with mild steel cored 661gr FMJ bullets.  The .50 BMG is a very powerful rifle round designed for anti-aircraft use, later adapted to anti-vehicular and anti-personnel roles.  Its stupendous energy and armor piercing capabilities make it one of the most deadly rounds available, offset only by its drastic recoil and noise.

items.name: .50 BMG Match
items.description: .50 BMG FMJ lead core ammunition manufactured with tighter tolerances for long-range competition shooting or other precision rifle use.

items.name: .50 BMG M2 AP
items.description: Variant of the .50 BMG round that uses a core of very dense, hardened tungsten steel.  Penetration is increased, but damage is reduced.

items.name: 5.45x39mm 7N10
items.description: 5.45x39mm 7N10 ammunition with 56gr FMJ bullets.  The 5.45x39mm round was introduced along with the AK-74 in 1974.  It has superior wounding potential to the older 7.62x39mm round and quickly replaced it in Soviet military use.

items.name: 5.45x39mm 7N22
items.description: Armor piercing 5.45x39mm ammunition with 57gr bullets containing a steel penetrator.  Developed in 1998 by the Russian military.

items.name: 5.45x39mm casing
items.description: An empty casing from a 5.45x39mm round.

items.name: 5.56 NATO M855A1
items.description: 5.56x45mm ammunition with a 62gr FMJ bullet containing a steel penetrator.  Its light weight, high accuracy, and manageable recoil lead to widespread use in the 20th century and it remains popular among militaries and civilians.

items.name: 5.56 NATO tracer
items.description: This ammunition is a one-in-five mix of M855A1 and M856 tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.

items.name: steel drum (200L)
items.description: A massive steel barrel with a resealable lid.

items.name: fire barrel (200L)
items.description: A large metal barrel used to contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in its walls for air supply.  Fires set in a fire barrel will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.

items.name: 5.7x28mm SS190
items.description: 5.7x28mm ammunition with 31gr AP FMJ bullets.  The 5.7x28mm cartridge was designed by FN Herstal to replace the 9x19mm round in NATO use.  Although the project to replace 9x19mm Parabellum was effectively canceled the 5.7x28mm round has seen action in many conflicts and has proven to be reliable.  It has very low recoil and its armor penetration is a defining feature.

items.name: 5.7x28mm casing
items.description: An empty casing from a 5.7x28mm round.

items.name: RMFB100 5x50mm extended magazine
items.description: A 100 round box magazine for use with 5x50mm flechette firearms.

items.name: RMFB50 5x50mm magazine
items.description: A 50 round box magazine for use with 5x50mm flechette firearms.

items.name: 5x50mm hull
items.description: An empty plastic hull from a 5x50mm flechette round.

items.name: RA110 5x50mm flechette
items.description: Designed to defeat modern body armor, the Rivtech 5x50mm flechette round features a biodegradable sabot and a single, fin-stabilized penetrator.

items.name: RA119 5x50mm penetrator
items.description: Designed to defeat modern body armor, the Rivtech 5x50mm RA119 penetrator round features a biodegradable sabot and a single, fin-stabilized tungsten alloy projectile.

items.name: 66mm HEAT
items.description: A 66mm high-explosive anti-tank round.  It could blow through up to two feet of concrete.

items.name: .700 NX
items.description: The .700 Nitro Express is a very powerful rifle round designed for long-range use.  Its stupendous accuracy and armor piercing capabilities make it one of the most deadly rounds available, offset only by its drastic recoil and noise.

items.name: .700 NX casing
items.description: An empty casing from a .700 NX round.  These are rare, so you might want to hold onto these.

items.name: 7.62x54mmR casing
items.description: An empty casing from a 7.62x54mmR round.

items.name: 7.62x54mmR clip
items.description: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load a bolt-action rifle.

items.name: 7.62x25mm FMJ
items.description: A commercial version of the 7.62x25mm cartridge created for the armed forces of Soviet Russia.  It was derived from the 7.63x25mm cartridge used by the C96 pistol.

items.name: 7.62x25mm casing
items.description: An empty casing from a 7.62x25mm round.

items.name: 7.62x25mm JHP hot load
items.description: A high-pressure commercial version of the 7.62x25mm cartridge, loaded with an 85 gr. FMJ bullet.  It is more powerful than the original.

items.name: 7.62x25mm Type P
items.description: A subsonic cartridge derived from the 7.62x25mm, designed for silenced firearms.  It offers good armor penetration at the cost of slightly less damage.

items.name: 7.62x51mm M80
items.description: A 7.62x51mm NATO round with a 147gr FMJ bullet.  It is a powerful rifle cartridge commonly used by hunters and military snipers because of its high accuracy and long range.

items.name: 7.62x51mm casing
items.description: An empty casing from a 7.62x51mm M80 round.

items.name: 7.62x51mm NATO tracer
items.description: This ammunition is a one-in-five mix of M80 and M62 tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.

items.name: 7.62x54mmR
items.description: 7.62x54mmR ammunition with 150gr FMJ bullets.  The 7.62x54mmR round is one of the oldest still in common use, primarily due to the popularity of the Mosin-Nagant rifle.  Although it has not been used by militaries for several decades it remains popular with civilians.  It is a powerful cartridge capable of killing most targets with one shot.

items.name: 7.62x39mm casing
items.description: An empty casing from a 7.62x39mm round.

items.name: 7.62x39mm 57-N-231
items.description: 7.62x39mm 57-N-231 ammunition with 121.9gr steel core FMJ bullets.  Developed in WW2 by the Soviet Union the 7.62x39mm round rapidly became extremely popular all over the world.  The bullet has poor wounding potential due to its stability, only beginning to yaw after 26cm.

items.name: 7.62x39mm M67
items.description: 7.62x39mm M67 rounds with 123gr bullets.  The inadequate terminal ballistics of the M43 round led to the development of the M67 round in Yugoslavia in the 1960s.  It destabilizes much faster than M43 after hitting a target leading to greater damage.

items.name: 7.62x39mm clip
items.description: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load a bolt-action rifle.

items.name: 84x246mm HE rocket
items.description: A 84x246mm High Explosive anti-personnel round for the Carl Gustav M3 recoilless rifle.  Designed to be highly effective against personnel.

items.name: 84x246mm HEDP rocket
items.description: A 84x246mm High Explosive Dual Purpose anti-materiel round for the Carl Gustav M3 recoilless rifle.  Designed to be highly effective against vehicles and structures.

items.name: 84x246mm smoke rocket
items.description: A 84x246mm smoke marker round for the Carl Gustav M3 recoilless rifle.  Commonly used for signaling, target designation, and for screening troop movements.

items.name: bootleg 8x40mm JHP
items.description: Bootleg duplicates of Rivtech 8x40mm caseless rounds.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

items.name: 8x40mm caseless
items.description: 8x40mm caseless rounds.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech firearms.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

items.name: 8x40mm sporting
items.description: 8x40mm caseless rounds, light sporting load sold for civilian use.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech firearms.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

items.name: 8x40mm HVP
items.description: 8x40mm caseless rounds, saboted high-velocity penetrator type.  Advanced military grade, armor-piercing ammunition that fires a single depleted uranium flechette.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

items.name: 8x40mm tracer
items.description: 8x40mm caseless rounds with tracers to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target at the risk of igniting flammable substances.  Military grade ammunition for Rivtech firearms.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

items.name: 8x40mm JHP
items.description: 8x40mm caseless rounds, jacketed hollowpoint.  Military grade ammunition for Rivtech firearms.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

items.name: RMGB100 8x40mm magazine
items.description: A 100 round box magazine for use with Rivtech 8x40mm caseless firearms.

items.name: RMGP10 8x40mm stick magazine
items.description: A 10 round stick magazine for use with Rivtech 8x40mm caseless firearms.

items.name: RMGD250 8x40mm drum magazine
items.description: A 250 round drum magazine for use with Rivtech 8x40mm caseless firearms.

items.name: RMGP25 8x40mm stick magazine
items.description: A 25 round stick magazine for use with Rivtech 8x40mm caseless firearms.

items.name: RMGB500 8x40mm drum magazine
items.description: A 500 round drum magazine for use with Rivtech 8x40mm caseless firearms.

items.name: RMGB50 8x40mm magazine
items.description: A 50 round box magazine for use with Rivtech 8x40mm caseless firearms.

items.name: RMGS5 8x40mm speedloader
items.description: This speedloader, made by Rivtech for use with RM99 revolver, can hold 5 rounds of 8x40mm caseless rounds and quickly reload a compatible revolver.

items.name: Beretta 90-two
items.description: A more modern version of Beretta's popular 92 series of handguns, the 90-two performs largely the same.  The main difference is a sleeker, almost futuristic-looking design owed in large parts to the polymer underbarrel rail cover.

items.name: Beretta 90-two .40 S&W
items.description: A more modern version of Beretta's popular 92 series of handguns, the 90-two performs largely the same.  The main difference is a sleeker, almost futuristic-looking design owed in large parts to the polymer underbarrel rail cover.  This one is chambered in .40 S&W.

items.name: 90two .40 S&W magazine
items.description: A magazine for the 92 and 96 series of Beretta handguns, this one is for .40 S&W and can hold 12 rounds.

items.name: 9x19mm JHP
items.description: 9x19mm ammunition with a 116gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  JHP rounds have inferior penetration to FMJ rounds but their expansion slightly increases stopping power against unarmored targets and reduces overpenetration.

items.name: 9x19mm +P
items.description: Overpressure 9x19mm ammunition.  The round's increased velocity results in superior accuracy and stopping power at the cost of higher recoil.

items.name: 9x19mm +P+
items.description: A step beyond the high-pressure 9x19mm +P round, the +P+ has even higher internal pressure offering superior damage, accuracy, and penetration.

items.name: 9x19mm casing
items.description: An empty casing from a 9x19mm round.

items.name: 9x19mm FMJ
items.description: 9x19mm ammunition with a brass jacketed 115gr bullet.  It is a popular round for military, law enforcement, and civilian use even after almost 150 years.

items.name: 9x18mm 57-N-181S
items.description: 9x18mm Makarov ammunition with 93gr steel core FMJ bullets.  The 9x18mm round was very common in the Eastern Bloc during the 20th century and remained in Russian military service into the 21st century.

items.name: 9x18mm SP-7
items.description: 9x18mm Makarov SP-7 ammunition.  The 9x18mm round was very common in the Eastern Bloc during the 20th century and remained in Russian military service into the 21st century.

items.name: 9x18mm casing
items.description: An empty casing from a 9x18mm round.

items.name: 9x18mm RG028
items.description: 9x18mm Makarov RG028 ammunition.  The RG028 round uses bullets with a hardened steel core to improve armor penetration.

items.name: Alarm System CBM installation data
items.description: Precise step-by-step instructions and other required data for installation of Alarm System CBM, stored on a data card of proprietary form-factor, designed to be used extensively by an Autodoc, and allowing bionic installation with minimal failure chance.  Integrated security subroutine renders it unusable after installation.

items.name: AT4
items.description: Mil-Spec rocket launcher.  An 84-mm unguided, portable, single-shot recoilless smoothbore weapon used primarily by the US military.

items.name: EMP bomb
items.description: This substantial device is a bomb that generates an electromagnetic pulse.  When this magnetic field is fed into the antenna, it creates a strong electro-magnetic pulse.  It will also create a sizable explosion, so stay clear of it.

items.name: active EMP bomb
items.description: This EMP bomb is active, and will shortly detonate, creating a large EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy.  You may not want to be holding it much longer.  It will also create an explosion, which may hurt you.

items.name: Merch
items.description: The Free Merchant Certified Note, also known by names such as a 'c-note' or 'merch', is a currency based on old American bills.  Fifty dollar bills and larger are printed with a promissory note signed by the treasurer of the Free Merchants, along with a complex design.  The note explains that this can be exchanged for food, water, and other services through the Free Merchants in the Refugee Center.

items.name: FlatCoin
items.description: This is a coin that has been flattened in a novelty coin flattening machine.  The machine has been somewhat crudely altered so that the design - which appears to once have been Mickey Mouse - is overlaid with a handwritten emblem of a book.  There is some text that faintly reads 'Campus Exchange Token'.

items.name: HAADF MICROGRAPH: T-SUBSTRATE
items.description: A white piece of paper, with the logo of XEDRA printed on its upper left corner.  It seems to be an internal report of some kind.

items.name: M72 LAW
items.description: A disposable light anti-tank rocket launcher.  Once fired, it cannot be reloaded and must be disposed of.

items.name: packed M72 LAW
items.description: This is a M72 LAW, packed in its storage form.  Use it to pop it out and make it ready to fire.  Once it is activated, it cannot be repacked.

items.name: M24
items.description: The M24 Sniper is the military and police version of the Remington Model 700 rifle, M24 being the model name assigned by the United States Army after adoption as their standard sniper rifle in 1988.  The M24 is referred to as a 'weapon system' because it consists of not only a rifle, but also a detachable telescopic sight and other accessories.

items.name: M6 Survival Gun shotgun
items.description: The integrated 12 gauge shotgun barrel of the Chiappa M6 Survival Gun.  It's irremovable.

items.name: PR-24 baton (extended)
items.description: The Monadnock PR-24 baton is a collapsible, lightweight, side-handle baton used by law enforcement all over the world.  The PR designation is rumored to mean Public Relations.  Activate to retract.

items.name: PR-24 baton (retracted)
items.description: The Monadnock PR-24 baton is a collapsible, lightweight, side-handle baton used by law enforcement all over the world.  The PR designation is rumored to mean Public Relations.  Activate to extend.

items.name: RAM
items.description: A stick of memory.  Useful in advanced electronics crafting.

items.name: RPG-7
items.description: The emblematic RPG-7 launcher.  Its simple, inexpensive, and reliable design made it a popular choice among armies and insurgent groups worldwide.

items.name: PG-7VL 93mm rocket
items.description: 93mm single-stage high-explosive ammunition for the RPG-7.

items.name: OG-7V 40mm rocket
items.description: 40mm high-explosive fragmentation antipersonnel ammunition for the RPG-7.

items.name: PG-7VR 64mm/105mm rocket
items.description: 64mm/105mm high-explosive tandem ammunition for the RPG-7.

items.name: TBG-7V 105mm rocket
items.description: 105mm thermobaric ammunition for the RPG-7.

items.name: RPG die
items.description: A die used to play various role-playing games.

items.name: radioisotope thermoelectric generator
items.description: Did your neighbors brag about their cool beta-decay powered nightlights?  Do them one better!  The CuppaTech 4 radioisotope thermoelectric generator is a three kilogram chunk of metal - mostly lead - with a slug of curium-244 encased within.  It is capable of generating somewhere between 100-150 Watts of thermal energy, although its electrical generation capacity is minimal at only 2 Watts.  Careful!  Curium is great at making heat, and also releases deadly gamma radiation.  Keep away from cellular life forms.

items.name: Hub 01 Gold Coin
items.description: This is a small but surprisingly heavy gold coin.  One side is etched with circuitry and the other side reads 'Hub 01 exchange currency'.

items.name: SICP
items.description: A classic text, "The Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs." Written with examples in LISP, but applicable to any language.

items.name: Franchi SPAS-12
items.description: Mean and intimidating looking, the SPAS 12 has the dubious honor of being declared a destructive device and being banned from import by name, adding to its already considerable appeal.  It is a combination pump-action and semi-automatic firearm, with an arm stabilizing hook for one handed shooting.

items.name: Tankbot Main Gun
items.description: The 120mm cannon from a tankbot.  If you have this, you'd best be debugging!

items.name: TDI Vector
items.description: The TDI Vector is a submachine gun with a unique, in-line design that makes recoil very manageable, even in the powerful .45 caliber.

items.name: UPS
items.description: This is a unified power supply, or UPS.  It is a civilian evolution of a military project.  Designed to power advanced weapons and armor, the civilian version serves as a portable power bank and inverter for many household electronics.

items.name: USAS-12 box magazine
items.description: A removable plastic magazine for the USAS-12 shotgun.  Holds 10 rounds.

items.name: USAS-12 drum magazine
items.description: A removable plastic magazine for the USAS-12 shotgun.  Holds 20 rounds.

items.name: USAS 12
items.description: The USAS 12 looks like a boxy upsized caricature of the M16A2.  Like its Auto Assault-12 predecessor, it is a select-fire shotgun fed from large box or drum magazines.  The in-line recoil system and sheer weight make for pleasant shooting.

items.name: V8
items.description: Contains up to eight vegetables!  Nutritious and tasty.

items.name: XL holster
items.description: A belt holster consisting of a loop and strap intended for use with larger firearms.  Slightly more cumbersome than a standard holster due to the straps that hold it flat against your leg, Activate to holster/draw a gun.

items.name: Zombie Survival Guide
items.description: While this seems like it would be very useful in this situation, the sheer amount of misinformation present makes it practically useless.

items.name: A-180 magazine
items.description: An unusually shaped pan magazine for the American-180.

items.name: acetylene
items.description: A flammable gas that explodes under pressure.  Combined with oxygen, acetylene makes a great welding gas.

items.name: acetylene-gas machine
items.description: This bulky device takes water and calcium carbide and yields unpressurised acetylene.

items.name: concentrated acid
items.description: Concentrated acid.  Don't drink it.

items.name: acid spit gun
items.description: Fake gun that fires acid globs.

items.name: acid bomb
items.description: This is a fragile container filled with acid.  Throw it to spill out a pool of potent acid.

items.name: biosilicified chitin medium quadruped armor
items.description: A makeshift assembly of criniere, peytral and croupiere made from biosilicified chitin fitted to a thin mesh.  You could put this on a friendly medium quadruped.

items.name: biosilicified chitin small quadruped armor
items.description: A makeshift assembly of criniere, peytral and croupiere made from biosilicified chitin fitted to a thin mesh.  You could put this on a friendly small quadruped.

items.name: chunk of biosilicified chitin
items.description: A lump of exoskeleton that has undergone biosilicification.  It is acid-resistant and remarkably sturdy.

items.name: biosilicified chitin armor kit
items.description: Durable silica-coated chitin plating made for a vehicle.

items.name: ACOG scope
items.description: A 4x32 TA01 Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight with a tritium illuminated crosshair.

items.name: modified ACOG scope
items.description: A 4x32 TA01 Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight with a tritium illuminated crosshair.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols, if you so want.

items.name: roasted acorns
items.description: A handful roasted nuts from an oak tree.

items.name: acorns
items.description: A handful of acorns, still in their shells.  Squirrels like them, but they're not very good for you to eat in this state.

items.name: cooked acorn meal
items.description: A serving of acorns that have been hulled, chopped, and boiled in water before being thoroughly toasted until dry.  Filling and nutritious.

items.name: acoustic guitar
items.description: A simple wooden acoustic guitar with a strap so you can wear it around, even when not playing.

items.name: Remington ACR
items.description: This carbine was developed for military use in the early 21st century.  It is damaging and accurate, though its rate of fire is a bit slower than competing .223 carbines.

items.name: Remington ACR .300BLK
items.description: This carbine was developed for military use in the early 21st century.  It is damaging and accurate, though its rate of fire is a bit slower than competing carbines.  This version is chambered for the .300 AAC Blackout round.

items.name: Adderall
items.description: Medical grade amphetamine salts mixed with Dextroamphetamine salts, commonly prescribed to treat hyperactive attention deficits.  It suppresses the appetite, and is quite addictive.

items.name: adjustable stock
items.description: An adjustable replacement stock improving both recoil and accuracy.

items.name: adobe brick
items.description: A compacted mass of soil and natural fibers, baked dry enough to harden into a brick.

items.name: pallet of dry adobe bricks
items.description: A pallet of humble mud bricks that have dried for a week, while you were out risking your life.  Disassemble it to retrieve your frame and building supplies.

items.name: pallet of wet adobe bricks
items.description: A pallet full of heavy mud bricks which need to dry slowly to be usable.

items.name: syringe of adrenaline
items.description: A syringe filled with a shot of adrenaline.  It serves as a powerful stimulant when you inject yourself with it.  Asthmatics can use it in an emergency to clear their asthma.

items.name: advanced UPS
items.description: This is an advanced version of the unified power supply, or UPS.  Designed for military use to power advanced weapons, it uses plutonium fuel cells which provide better efficiency, but are not rechargeable.  It can power many household electronics as well.

items.name: Advanced Physical Chemistry
items.description: A university-level textbook on advanced principles of chemistry, both organic and inorganic.

items.name: advanced electronic cigarette
items.description: An advanced version of the electronic cigarette.  A less harmful way to get your nicotine fix than regular cigarettes, but still addictive.  It needs batteries and nicotine liquid to function.

items.name: Advanced Electronics
items.description: A college textbook on circuit design.

items.name: AEP suit
items.description: An armored environmental protection suit.  Custom-built from a cleansuit and body armor, it provides excellent protection against both physical harm and ambient radiation.

items.name: AF2011A1 .38 Super
items.description: A double-barrel semi-automatic pistol of Italian origin, firing two bullets per shot, a derivative of the M1911 pistol.

items.name: AF2011A1 magazine
items.description: Two .38 Super 8-round box magazines attached to a single base plate, holding up to 16 rounds in total, used by AF2011A1 double-barrel pistol.

items.name: Dopamine Stimulators CBM
items.description: A set of tiny bionic nerve stimulators that install into the reward center of your brain.  When run with bionic power, it periodically releases a hit of dopamine and other reward chemicals, inducing a state of euphoria and suppressing fear.

items.name: Linguistic Coprocessor CBM
items.description: A microcomputer installed into the left hemisphere of your brain to increase the speed that it processes language.  When installed, it provides a passive boost to reading speed.

items.name: Deployable Grenade Launcher CBM
items.description: Your right hand can fold inward to reveal a mechanism capable of igniting and firing 40mm grenades across medium distances with great accuracy due built in ballistic calculator.

items.name: deployed grenade launcher
items.description: A grenade launcher mounted onto your right-hand wrist.  It contains integrated ballistic calculator and quick load mechanism.  Adaptive caliber allow to load most types grenades.

items.name: AI core
items.description: This module is responsible for decision-making, it basically runs the AI of the robot.

items.name: advanced AI core
items.description: An advanced AI core with impressive cognitive abilities.

items.name: basic AI core
items.description: A very basic AI core with minimal cognitive abilities.

items.name: compressed air horn
items.description: This is a small can of compressed air attached to a plastic horn.  Pressing the button on top causes it to emit a loud honking sound.

items.name: pneumatic speargun
items.description: A sophisticated underwater fishing implement designed to fire a specialized type of spear using a hand-pump pressure system.  While highly effective when used underwater, it is nearly useless on dry land.

items.name: AKM
items.description: One of the most recognizable assault rifles ever made, the AKM is renowned for its durability even under the worst conditions.

items.name: AK-74M
items.description: The successor to the well-known AK-47 rifle.  It combines the reliability of the AK series with the high-velocity, lightweight 5.45x39mm cartridge.

items.name: AK-74M magazine
items.description: A standard magazine made for the AK-74M rifle, made of steel-reinforced polymer.  Holds 30 rounds.

items.name: AK 75-round drum magazine
items.description: A bulky 75-round drum magazine for 7.62x39 AK-pattern rifles, made of stamped sheet metal.

items.name: AK 10-round magazine
items.description: A compact 10-round magazine for 7.62x39 AK-pattern rifles, made of stamped sheet metal.  Made for restricted civilian use.

items.name: AK 20-round magazine
items.description: A compact 20-round magazine for 7.62x39 AK-pattern rifles, made of stamped sheet metal.  Originally designed for tank crews.

items.name: AK 30-round magazine
items.description: A standard 30-round magazine for 7.62x39 AK-pattern rifles, made of stamped sheet metal.

items.name: AK 40-round magazine
items.description: An extended 40-round magazine for 7.62x39 AK-pattern rifles, made of stamped sheet metal.

items.name: AK-47
items.description: Civilian-legal clones of the iconic Kalashnikov, like this one, were manufactured and imported by many different firms.  Even without full-auto function, their solid firepower and reliability in harsh conditions make them valuable weapons in this new world.

items.name: alarm clock
items.description: A wind-up alarm clock.  Though the noise it makes is unpleasant to wake up to, it's always good to get an early start to your day.  Can also be disassembled into some useful parts.

items.name: alexandrite
