items.description: A bulky 100-round double drum magazine for use with the Steyr AUG assault rifle.

items.name: AUG 10-round magazine
items.description: A compact 10-round box magazine for use with the Steyr AUG assault rifle.

items.name: AUG 30-round magazine
items.description: A standard capacity 30-round box magazine for use with the Steyr AUG assault rifle.

items.name: AUG 42-round magazine
items.description: An increased-capacity 42-round box magazine for use with the Steyr AUG assault rifle.

items.name: autoclave
items.description: This is an autoclave.  It's useful for sterilizing things like CBMs.  It requires a massive amount of power, so standard batteries will not power it sufficiently.  Examine a non-sterile CBM and mend it to sterilize.

items.name: Autodoc Mk. XI
items.description: A surgical apparatus used for installation and removal of bionics.  It's only as skilled as its operator.

items.name: Autodoc operation couch
items.description: A plush red sofa made less comfortable by the medical machinery directly above it.  It has a single leather strap on the right armrest.

items.name: auto-fire mechanism
items.description: A simple mechanism that converts a pistol to a selective fire weapon with a burst size of three rounds.  However it reduces accuracy and increases noise.

items.name: handmade auto-fire mechanism
items.description: Mechanism that allows your CW-24 rifle to fire in fully automatic mode.  It is handmade.

items.name: aux flamethrower
items.description: This custom-built miniature flamethrower is made to be attached to almost any sort of firearm, greatly expanding its lethality.

items.name: small pressurized fuel tank
items.description: A pressurized 0.5L canister built for use with a small auxiliary flamethrower.

items.name: avgas fuel
items.description: A specialized type of petroleum-based fuel used to power aircraft.

items.name: bone sewing awl
items.description: This is a crude sharpened bone awl; those were used for leatherworking before metal was discovered.  It can also serve as an improvised stabbing weapon, but will break quickly.

items.name: steel sewing awl
items.description: This is a steel awl with a wooden grip, usually used for leatherworking.  It can also serve as an improvised stabbing weapon, but will break quickly.

items.name: wood axe
items.description: This is a large, two-handed wood axe.  It makes a good melee weapon, but is a bit slow to recover between swings.

items.name: axe ring holster
items.description: A combination of leather and a metal ring to hold an axe on your waist.

items.name: blue paint
items.description: A can of blue paint.

items.name: basketball shorts
items.description: A pair of basketball shorts.  Comfortable and light.

items.name: back holster
items.description: A leather holster, big enough for a rifle or other large gun.  Designed to be strapped to the back.  Whilst initially cumbersome it becomes much easier to use with practice.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

items.name: backpack
items.description: A small backpack.  Good storage for a little encumbrance.

items.name: giant novelty backpack
items.description: A huge fabric backpack made mostly as a joke before the Cataclysm.  Now, it's still rather silly, but it can store a lot of stuff.

items.name: hiking backpack
items.description: A large sized hiking backpack with plenty of storage space.

items.name: leather backpack
items.description: A small leather backpack.  Good storage for a little encumbrance.

items.name: large tactical backpack
items.description: A large tactical multi-compartment backpack that has great lower back support.

items.name: bacon
items.description: A thick slab of salty cured bacon.  Shelf stable, precooked and ready-to-eat, it tastes better when reheated.

items.name: cybercop badge
items.description: A chromed silver shield identifies the wearer as an authority even the cop-killers couldn't kill.

items.name: deputy badge
items.description: A tarnished silver star gives an air of authority to the wearer.

items.name: detective badge
items.description: A tarnished golden shield gives an air of authority to the wearer.

items.name: doctor badge
items.description: A plastic name tag marking the wearer as a real doctor of the medical kind.

items.name: Foodkid badge
items.description: A star shaped badge.  On it, you can read "Foodkid" in bold letters.  This is Foodperson's trusty sidekick's badge.

items.name: marshal badge
items.description: A bright silver star strikes fear into the eyes of ne'er-do-wells.

items.name: SWAT badge
items.description: A matte-finish silver shield identifies the wearer as an authority who goes in when the bots just aren't enough.

items.name: body bag
items.description: A large, human size, rectangular bag made of strong plastic, with a zipper in the middle.  Used to hold a dead body.

items.name: canvas sack
items.description: A large and sturdy canvas sack.  Smells faintly of earth and hard work.

items.name: canvas bag
items.description: Small bag made of canvas.  Looks fine to store dried herbs in.

items.name: IV bag
items.description: A small, sealed plastic bag for liquids used in intravenous therapy.

items.name: plastic bag
items.description: A small, open plastic bag.  Essentially trash.

items.name: zipper bag
items.description: An inexpensive flexible rectangular storage bag on its typical small size.  Transparent and made of plastic, it can be sealed and opened by a slider which works in a similar way to a zip fastener.

items.name: tiger claws
items.description: Also called bagh nakha or iron paw, this is a small claw-like bladed weapon from India designed to be concealed under and against the palm.

items.name: bagpipes
items.description: A traditional musical instrument using enclosed reeds fed from a reservoir of air contained within a leather bag.  It has a strap so you can wear it around, even when not playing.

items.name: The Baker's Companion
items.description: This book promises to teach you the ways of baking, from cakes to souffles.

items.name: small weight scale
items.description: This is a simple scale that uses a set of steel weights on sliding bars to measure a sample's mass quite accurately.

items.name: balaclava
items.description: A warm covering that protects the head and face from the cold.

items.name: baldric
items.description: A leather scabbard, big enough for anything up to a longsword, or even a bit larger than that.  Designed to be worn at the waist, secured by a shoulder belt.  Activate to sheath/draw a sword.

items.name: empty ballistic vest
items.description: Ballistic armor without any armor inserts.  The soft armor plate carrier is still protective but it won't stop high energy projectiles.

items.name: ESAPI ballistic vest
items.description: Ballistic armor with ESAPI ceramic armor plates.

items.name: balloon
items.description: A child's balloon.  This could be used as a makeshift water container.

items.name: banana
items.description: A long, curved yellow fruit in a peel.  Some people like using them in desserts.  Those people are probably dead.

items.name: bandage
items.description: Simple cloth bandages.  Used for healing small amounts of damage.

items.name: makeshift bandage
items.description: Simple cloth bandages.  Better than nothing.

items.name: bleached makeshift bandage
items.description: Simple cloth bandages.  It is white, as real bandages should be.

items.name: boiled makeshift bandage
items.description: Simple cloth bandages.  It was boiled to make it more sterile.

items.name: bandana
items.description: A cotton bandana, worn over the mouth for warmth and minor protection from dust and other contaminants.

items.name: pistol bandolier
items.description: An embroidered leather bandolier for keeping pistol cartridges close to hand.  If this doesn't make you feel like a cowboy, nothing will.

items.name: rifle bandolier
items.description: A leather bandolier for keeping rifle cartridges close to hand.

items.name: waist shotgun bandolier
items.description: A leather bandolier worn around the waist for keeping shotgun shells close to hand.

items.name: wrist bandolier
items.description: A small fabric bandolier for rifle cartridges designed to be worn around the wrist.

items.name: banjo
items.description: A standard factory-made banjo.  Looks to be in working condition.

items.name: barb launching organ
items.description: A mutated organ capable of launching bony barbs at great speed.

items.name: paralyzing barb
items.description: Tiny droplets of venom trickle out of the sponge-like tissue of this sharp barb.

items.name: barley
items.description: Grainy cereal used for malting.  A staple of brewing everywhere.  It can also be ground into flour.

items.name: barometer
items.description: A plastic barometer that can read the atmospheric pressure.

items.name: barrel extension
items.description: A longer barrel increases the muzzle velocity of a firearm, contributing to both accuracy and damage but reduces portability and slows aiming.

items.name: ported barrel
items.description: A ported barrel redirects exhaust gases to compensate for muzzle climb, improves recoil but increases noise and reduces accuracy slightly.

items.name: rifled barrel
items.description: Rifling a shotgun barrel is mainly done in order to improve its accuracy when firing slugs.  The rifling makes the gun less suitable for shot, however.

items.name: shortened barrel
items.description: A shortened barrel results in markedly reduced accuracy, and a minor increase in noise, but also greatly improves the ease with which the weapon can be carried and wielded.

items.name: barrette
items.description: A barrette with lots of ornaments.

items.name: generic dish
items.description: generic item template

items.name: generic cook pot
items.description: generic item template

items.name: generic dish
items.description: generic item template

items.name: generic kitchen knife
items.description: generic item template

items.name: generic dish
items.description: generic item template

items.name: generic silverware
items.description: generic item template

items.name: generic silverware
items.description: generic item template

items.name: generic dish
items.description: generic item template

items.name: generic grooming
items.description: generic item template

items.name: generic utensil
items.description: generic item template

items.name: baseball
items.description: A baseball, good for throwing at enemies.  Getting hit with one of these hurts a lot more than you might think.

items.name: wire basket
items.description: A large wire basket from a shopping cart.

items.name: laundry basket
items.description: A plastic basket meant for storing and hauling clothing.

items.name: basketball
items.description: A high-quality indoor basketball.  You may throw it at zombies.

items.name: pair of cord sandals
items.description: Lightweight sandals made from wound cord.  They offer little in the way of protection, but keep you cool during warmer months.

items.name: baseball bat
items.description: A sturdy wood bat.  Makes a great melee weapon.

items.name: aluminum bat
items.description: An aluminum baseball bat, lighter than a wooden bat and a little easier to swing as a result.

items.name: foam rubber bat
items.description: A baseball bat made out of foam rubber with a plastic handle.  Light, well-balanced, and easy to wield, but almost completely ineffective.

items.name: bathroom scale
items.description: This is a small bathroom scale, meant to weigh a person while naked.

items.name: expandable baton
items.description: A telescoping baton that collapses for easy storage.  Makes an excellent melee weapon.  Activate to expand.

items.name: expandable baton (extended)
items.description: A telescoping baton that collapses for easy storage.  Makes an excellent melee weapon.  Activate to collapse.

items.name: battery
items.description: Some free-floating battery charge.  This can be reloaded into rechargable battery cells, but can never be unloaded.

items.name: car battery
items.description: A 12v lead-acid battery used to power car electrical systems.

items.name: battery charger
items.description: A small device for recharging batteries, given a source of electricty.  It could easily be wired into a vehicle with power.  It will slowly charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.  It can only be installed onto existing storage compartments.

items.name: motorbike battery
items.description: A 12v lead-acid battery used to power smaller vehicles' electrical systems.

items.name: small motorbike battery
items.description: A miniature 12v lead-acid battery used to power smaller vehicles' electrical systems.

items.name: test battery
items.description: This is a testing item for the BATTERY item type.  If you found one in game, it's a bug.

items.name: UPS conversion mod
items.description: This device replaces conventional battery connections with a connector port that can plug into a UPS.  Any device modified with this can be used without a battery as long as you have a charged UPS with you.

items.name: battle axe
items.description: This is a huge axe designed for warfare.  Though intended for use as a weapon, it can also be pressed into service as a rather clumsy woodcutting tool.

items.name: battle axe fake
items.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a massive axe designed for warfare.

items.name: battle axe replica
items.description: This is a huge axe designed for warfare.  You notice that the axe heads aren't seated properly at all.

items.name: Louisville Slaughterer
items.description: This is sturdy wood bat, wrapped in gasoline-soaked rags and flame-resistant Nomex fabric.  Light it, and the ball game will REALLY heat up.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.

items.name: burnt out Louisville Slaughterer
items.description: A sturdy wood bat, wrapped in flame-resistant Nomex fabric.  Makes a good melee weapon but better be disassembled to recycle the baseball bat and some Nomex patches.

items.name: Louisville Slaughterer
items.description: This is a sturdy wood bat, wrapped in gasoline-soaked rags and flame-resistant Nomex fabric.  It is burning brightly, and makes it much easier to see the baselines at night games (It also makes the umpire FAR more likely to call a ball instead of a strike).

items.name: BB
items.description: A box of small steel balls.  They deal virtually no damage.

items.name: BB gun
items.description: Popular among children.  It's fairly accurate, but BBs deal nearly no damage.

items.name: beach volleyball
items.description: A brightly colored beach volleyball.  It is slightly larger than a regular white one.

items.name: beaded bracelet
items.description: A simple bracelet of string and wooden beads.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.  Also doubles as a set of prayer beads, if you're so inclined.

items.name: pair of beaded earrings
items.description: A simple pair of earrings made of string and wooden beads.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: beaded necklace
items.description: A simple necklace made of string and wooden beads.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.  Also doubles as a set of prayer beads, if you're so inclined.

items.name: beaker
items.description: A 250ml laboratory beaker.  Basically a cup with delusions of grandeur.

items.name: beam scatterer
items.description: A set of optics made to fit on laser weapons, which will diffract the laser beam into several lower powered beams.  This increases point-blank damage, but greatly reduces range.

items.name: cooked beans
items.description: A hearty serving of cooked great northern beans.

items.name: beans and rice
items.description: A serving of beans and rice that has been cooked together.  Delicious and healthy!

items.name: bearings
items.description: A box of ball bearings, useful as ammunition for slings or slingshots.

items.name: bear trap
items.description: This is a spring-loaded pair of steel jaws connected to a sensitive pressure plate.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will ensnare and damage anything that steps on it.  If you are carrying a shovel, you will have the option of burying it.

items.name: bee balm
items.description: A snow-white flower also known as wild bergamot.  Smells faintly of mint.

items.name: bee balm tea
items.description: A healthy beverage made from bee balm steeped in boiling water.  Can be used to reduce negative effects of common cold or flu.

items.name: bee sting
items.description: A six-inch stinger from a giant bee.  Makes a mediocre melee weapon.

items.name: beech nuts
items.description: A handful of hard pointy nuts from a beech tree.

items.name: pair of beekeeping gloves
items.description: A pair of white beekeeping gloves made out of smooth leather.

items.name: beekeeping hood
items.description: A beekeeping hood.  Keeps the bees out, but lets fresh air in.  Rather cumbersome to wear, as it is rather bulky and hinders vision.

items.name: beekeeping suit
items.description: A white suit commonly worn by professional beekeepers with straps on your ankles and wrists to prevent bees from flying in.  It's not a very tough fabric, but it's lightweight and has plenty of storage thanks to a chest pocket.

items.name: back-up beeper
items.description: This is a safety device intended to warn passersby of a vehicle moving in reverse, but the usage of it now seems terribly unwise.

items.name: beer
items.description: A grain alcohol flavored with hops.  It's best served cold, in a glass, and with a lime - but you're not that lucky.

items.name: sugar beet syrup
items.description: A thick syrup produced from shredded sugar beets.  Useful in cooking as a sweetener.

items.name: Belgian ale
items.description: A flavorful and filling beer brewed by monks in Belgium.  Best served in a goblet.

items.name: 5.56x45mm ammo belt
items.description: An ammo belt consisting of metal linkages which disintegrate upon firing.

items.name: 7.62x51mm ammo belt
items.description: An ammo belt consisting of metal linkages which disintegrate upon firing.

items.name: grenade belt
items.description: An ammo belt consisting of metal linkages which disintegrate upon firing.  This one holds 40mm grenades and is too bulky to be worn like other ammo belts.

items.name: .50 BMG ammo belt
items.description: An ammo belt consisting of metal linkages which disintegrate upon firing.

items.name: belt clip
items.description: This is a belt clip that attaches to the grip or slide of a pistol so as to facilitate 'Mexican carry', the practice of carrying without a holster.  It does not offer any protection for the trigger, so users are strongly advised to carry with the chamber empty or select a firearm with a very heavy trigger pull.

items.name: belt feed adapter
items.description: A kit providing the necessary parts for permanently converting a firearm from magazine to belt-feed.  Guaranteed to void your warranty.

items.name: beret
items.description: A soft cotton hat.  Commonly worn by armed forces and existentialists.

items.name: wool beret
items.description: A soft wool hat.  Commonly worn by armed forces and existentialists.

items.name: betavoltaic cell
items.description: Harness the power of radiation in your own home!  This looks similar to a D-cell battery, but actually contains folded layers of radioactive material inside.  It can produce electricity for several years at a steady voltage… but it's barely enough to power a small LED, and these batteries were worth hundreds of dollars.  Mostly they're a good way to brag to your neighbors that you have a nuclear power source in your house.

items.name: Serbu BFG-50
items.description: A single-shot, bolt-action rifle made by Serbu Firearms, the BFG-50 is a very affordable firearm for those wishing to shoot .50 BMG.

items.name: antiseptic powder
items.description: A powdered form of chemical antiseptic, this bismuth formic iodide cleans wounds quickly and painlessly.

items.name: Magnum Research BFR
items.description: A massive single-action revolver.  While the .45-70 rifle round loses significant velocity in its short pistol barrel, it still competes with other large magnum handguns in terms of power.

items.name: Big Horn Model 89
items.description: Built in the image of the venerable Winchester Model 1886, Big Horn Armory's Model 89 rifle packs all the power of the .500 S&W Magnum cartridge in to a package less likely to break one's wrist.

items.name: deep concealment holster
items.description: An elastic band with numerous provisions for concealing a very small pistol close to the body.  It is awkward to use without practice.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

items.name: Hi-Power .40 S&W magazine
items.description: A 10 round steel box magazine for the Browning Hi-Power .40 S&W.

items.name: Hi-Power 9x19mm 13-round magazine
items.description: A 13 round steel box magazine for the Browning Hi-Power 9x19mm.

items.name: Hi-Power 9x19mm 15-round magazine
items.description: A 15 round steel box magazine for the Browning Hi-Power 9x19mm.

items.name: high-volume rucksack
items.description: Also known as a "bigpack", this rucksack is prized by pack rats but may lead to a bad back.

items.name: 12-gauge gatling gun
items.description: An electrically driven six barrel gatling shotgun, fed from handmade cloth belts.  Even properly mounted, this seems like an unwieldy beast, and the six separate barrels make for difficult zeroing.  The externally driven action means this is much less likely to jam.

items.name: bike basket
items.description: A simple bike basket.  It is small and foldable.

items.name: bike rack
items.description: A collection of pipes, cams, and straps, mounted on the edge of a vehicle and used to support another vehicle for transport.  It must be mounted on a vehicle to be used.

items.name: bikini bottom
items.description: A simple bikini bottom.

items.name: bikini top
items.description: A simple bikini top.

items.name: fur bikini top
items.description: A simple fur bikini top.

items.name: leather bikini top
items.description: A simple leather bikini top.

items.name: bindle
items.description: You're ready for a trip down some train tracks.  Also known as a hobo stick.

items.name: pair of binoculars
items.description: A pair of optics with a neck strap attached.  Useful for seeing long distances.  Wearing this item or carrying it in your inventory will double the distance around you that is mapped during your travels.  You could also use them to focus the sunlight.

items.name: Adrenaline Pump CBM
items.description: A stimulator system that is implanted alongside the adrenal glands, allowing the user to trigger their body's adrenaline response at the cost of some bionic power.

items.name: Active Defense System CBM
items.description: This bionic charges a forcefield around your body that deflects incoming attacks.  Bullets are heavily deflected, piercing well deflected, slashing moderately deflected and bashing barely deflected.  This bionic charges at half speed for 3 turns after being hit, and doesn't consume power when fully charged.

items.name: Advanced Microreactor CBM
items.description: This module upgrades a pre-installed microreactor with enhanced maximum yield and limited automatic radiation scrubbing capabilities.

items.name: Alarm System CBM
items.description: A motion-detecting alarm system will notice almost all movement within a fifteen-foot radius, and will silently alert the user.  This is very useful during sleep, or if the user suspects a cloaked pursuer.

items.name: Squeaky Ankles
items.description: A pair of defective bionics that make squeaking noises.

items.name: Arms Alloy Plating CBM
items.description: Alloy plating that replaces the flesh on the user's arms.  Provides passive protection and can be used in conjunction with bionic martial arts.

items.name: Protective Lenses CBM
items.description: A bionic package that seals the user's eye sockets with highly protective mirrored lenses and re-routes their tear ducts to their mouth.  When the user cries, they must spit out or swallow their tears.

items.name: Head Alloy Plating CBM
items.description: Alloy plating that replaces the flesh on the user's head, protecting both their head and jaw regions.

items.name: Legs Alloy Plating CBM
items.description: Alloy plating that replaces the flesh on the user's legs.  Provides passive protection and can be used in conjunction with bionic martial arts.

items.name: Torso Alloy Plating CBM
items.description: Alloy plating that replaces the flesh on the user's torso, protecting it from physical trauma.

items.name: Battery System CBM
items.description: A battery draining attachment to make use of the energy contained in normal, everyday batteries.

items.name: Monomolecular Blade CBM
items.description: A deadly foot-long blade made of advanced material that is installed inside the forearm, capable of being extended through the back of the user's wrist at the cost of a small amount of power.  Though exceptionally sharp, it will prevent the user from holding anything else while extended.

items.name: monomolecular blade
items.description: A foot-long blade made from high-tech alloy and edged with bonded nanocrystals.

items.name: Fusion Blaster Arm CBM
items.description: Heavy-duty fusion blaster was integrated into your left arm!  You may use your energy banks to fire a damaging heat ray.

items.name: fusion blaster
items.description: this a pseudo item

items.name: Blood Analysis CBM
items.description: Small sensors that are implanted in the user's heart, allowing them to analyze their blood.  This will detect many illnesses, drugs, and other conditions.

items.name: Blood Filter CBM
items.description: A filtration system that is installed in the heart and can actively filter out chemical impurities, primarily drugs, with limited impact on viruses.  Note that it is not a targeted filter; ALL drugs in the system will be affected.

items.name: Cable Charger System CBM
items.description: A complex port that is mounted above the hip.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a battery via jumper cable.

items.name: Subdermal Carbon Filament CBM
items.description: A thin armor made of carbon nanotubes, implanted just beneath the skin.  This reduces bashing damage by 2 and cutting damage by 4.

items.name: Chain Lightning CBM
items.description: A chain lightning generator that emits a blast of lightning at a target, leaving a trail of lightning in its wake and jumping to additional targets within 4 tiles of the previous target.

items.name: Bionic Claws CBM
items.description: Vicious, retractable claws that are implanted inside the user's fingers.  These do considerable cutting damage, but prevent the user from holding anything else while extended.

items.name: bionic claws
items.description: Short and sharp claws made from a high-tech metal.

items.name: Internal Climate Control CBM
items.description: A network of thermal piping which eases the effects of high and low ambient temperatures once activated.

items.name: Cloaking System CBM
items.description: This high-power system uses a set of cameras and LEDs to make the user blend into their surroundings, rendering them fully invisible to eyes and optical sensors.  However, this doesn't prevent detection from other means such as infrared, sonar, etc.

items.name: Close Quarters Battle CBM
items.description: A set of bionic processors and databanks, loaded with martial arts combat programs.  Whilst active, the CQB module will improve the user's hand-to-hand combat skills, but prevents them from improving them through combat experience.

items.name: Pieces Of Junk
items.description: A jumble of broken metal pieces that were removed during reconstructive surgery.

items.name: Wired Reflexes CBM
items.description: Bionic nerve stimulators that greatly enhance reaction times, granting a +2 bonus to dexterity.

items.name: Expanded Digestive System CBM
items.description: This module contains three synthetic stomachs and industrial-grade intestines.  Not only will these extract much more nutrition from food, but also make the user immune to foodborne illness, parasites, and even allow the digestion of rotten food.

items.name: Acidic Leaking CBM
items.description: This CBM has been breached in several places and some acid is leaking from it.

items.name: Faulty Electric System
items.description: This CBM is a mess of naked wire and burnt resistors.

items.name: Electrical Drain
items.description: This CBM was wired incorrectly and would drain power from any system connected to it.

items.name: Enhanced Hearing CBM
items.description: While this bionic is active, the user's hearing will be drastically improved, allowing them to hear ten times better than the average person.  Additionally, high-intensity sounds will be automatically dampened before they can damage their hearing.

items.name: Directional EMP CBM
items.description: Small parabolic EMP field generators that are mounted in the palm of the user's right hand.  These can be used to instantly fire a wide, but short-ranged blast which will disable electronics and robots.

items.name: EMP Projector CBM
items.description: A ranged EMP generator system that is implanted in the user's right arm and hand.  The system fires precise, single-target pulses that require time to aim.  Extremely effective against electronic targets but mostly useless otherwise.

items.name: EMP Projector
items.description: this a pseudo item

items.name: Ethanol Burner CBM
items.description: A reactor that burns alcohol as fuel in an extremely efficient reaction.  It can store up to 500ml and accepts ethanol, methanol and denatured alcohol as fuel.

items.name: Aero-Evaporator CBM
items.description: This unit draws moisture from the surrounding air, which slowly trickles directly into your blood stream.  It may fail in very dry environments.

items.name: Diamond Cornea CBM
items.description: A set of diamond corneas which greatly enhance the user's vision, granting a +2 bonus to perception.

items.name: Telescopic Lenses CBM
items.description: An array of high-powered, auto-focusing lenses that replaces your natural lenses.  This fixes any mundane vision problems and allows for an increased vision range akin to binoculars.  Once installed they will be impossible to remove, having replaced part of your eyes.

items.name: Facial Distortion CBM
items.description: Through controlled application of electrochemical impulses, this bionic module lets the user alter their facial structure so as to subtly affect the reactions of others.  This grants a bonus to all social interactions.

items.name: Dielectric Capacitance System CBM
items.description: A network of miniature piezoelectric capacitors, implanted throughout the body to protect from external electrical discharge.

items.name: Fingerhack CBM
items.description: A miniature electrohack, surgically embedded in a finger of the right hand.  This is an all-purpose hacking unit used to override control panels and the like, but not computers.  Computer proficiency is important, and a failed use may cause damage.

items.name: Flashbang Generator CBM
items.description: A combination of LEDs and speakers that create a flash and sound comparable to a flashbang grenade, deafening and blinding nearby enemies.

items.name: Cranial Flashlight CBM
items.description: A small, but powerful LED flashlight that is mounted between the eyes.

items.name: Gasoline Fuel Cell CBM
items.description: A small gasoline fuel cell able to convert gasoline to bionic power.  It's connected to a diffuse network of bio-plastic bladders able to hold up to 500 ml of gasoline.

items.name: Internal Furnace CBM
items.description: When this bionic is active, you can burn nearly any organic material as fuel (use 'E'), recharging your power level.  Some materials will burn better than others.

items.name: Integrated Dosimeter CBM
items.description: Small radiation sensors that are implanted throughout the body, allowing the user to analyze their level of absorbed radiation.  They will also alert the user whenever exposed to environmental radiation.

items.name: Respirator CBM
items.description: A complex respiration augmentation system that increases the user's maximal oxygen uptake and allows for underwater breathing akin to gills.  Will automatically activate if the user is drowning.

items.name: Glowy Thing
items.description: It's a… thing?  And it glows, at least it did when it was plugged in.

items.name: Terranian Sonar CBM
items.description: Precision sonar equipment, implanted in the feet to allow the detection of below-ground movement, buried traps, and unstable terrain.

items.name: Heat Drain CBM
items.description: While fighting unarmed against a warm-blooded opponent, there is a chance that a successful hit will drain body heat, inflicting a small amount of extra damage, and recharging the user's bionic power reserves slightly.

items.name: Thermal Dissipation CBM
items.description: Powerful heatsinks and supermaterials are woven into the user's flesh.  While powered, this system will prevent external heat damage up to 2000 degrees Fahrenheit.  Note that this does not affect the internal body temperature.

items.name: Hydraulic Muscles CBM
items.description: A hydraulic muscle support system that when active, increases strength by 20.

items.name: Infrared Vision CBM
items.description: A bionic module that extends the range of vision into the infrared, allowing the user to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark and through smoke.

items.name: Cerebral Booster CBM
items.description: Bionic coprocessors that are implanted in the brain, granting a +2 bonus to intelligence.

items.name: Itchy Metal Thing
items.description: You can't recognize what this is supposed to be, but it's a very awkward thing to have in one's body.

items.name: Joint Servo CBM
items.description: A set of servomotors that get installed on leg joints to provide power-assisted movement.  They are optimized for running, but walking also requires less effort while this bionic is active.  However, when it's offline it will hamper the user's movement.

items.name: Finger-Mounted Laser CBM
items.description: A small, high-powered laser that is embedded in the fingertip.  This long range weapon is not incredibly damaging, but is very accurate, and has the potential to start fires.

items.name: laser finger
items.description: this a pseudo item

items.name: Leaky Bionic
items.description: A mess of pierced pipes and broken seals, something unpleasant is leaking from it.

items.name: Leukocyte Breeder System CBM
items.description: Bionic stimulators which augment the user's haematopoiesis system, allowing them to accelerate white blood cell production using bionic power.  It is designed for continuous use and may cause unpleasant side effects when turned off.

items.name: Finger Lighter CBM
items.description: Powerful fire starters which extend from the tip of both hands' index fingers.

items.name: Chain Lightning
items.description: this a pseudo item

items.name: Fingerpick CBM
items.description: An electronic lockpick that is embedded in a fingertip.  This automatic system will quickly unlock all but the most advanced key locks without any skill required on the part of the user.

items.name: Electromagnetic Unit CBM
items.description: A powerful electromagnet that is implanted into the user's right hand, allowing them to indiscriminately pull all nearby magnetic objects towards them.  Unlucky bystanders might be injured or killed by flying objects.

items.name: Nictating Membrane CBM
items.description: A thin membrane that closes over the eyes while underwater, negating any vision penalties.

items.name: Enhanced Memory Banks CBM
items.description: A set of highly-advanced quantum storage drives used to enhance memory.  While active, they increase the rate that the user learns skills, and give them near-perfect memory of skills and terrain.

items.name: Metabolic Interchange CBM
items.description: This module interconnects the user's digestive system and power supply, letting them replenish bionic energy by burning calories.

items.name: Weather Reader CBM
items.description: A multitude of scientific instruments and sensors collect environmental data.  The data is compiled and presented as a simple readout of the current weather.  It also passively tells the user their external temperature.

items.name: Repair Nanobots CBM
items.description: A fleet of tiny dormant robots.  While activated they will flit about your body, randomly recovering 1 HP every 15s, consuming power and calories only on a success.  It will also slow and eventually stop any bleeding on your body.

items.name: Artificial Night Generator CBM
items.description: When active, this bionic eliminates all light within a 15 tile radius through destructive interference.

items.name: Implanted Night Vision CBM
items.description: This bionic module modifies the user's eyes to amplify existing light, allowing them to see in the dark.

items.name: Noisemaker
items.description: A malfunctioning bionic.  When powered, it occasionally emits a loud burst of noise.

items.name: Bionic Nostril
items.description: This thing was up someone's nose, they're probably glad to be rid of it.

items.name: Offensive Defense System CBM
items.description: A thin forcefield gets projected around the user's body, continually draining power.  This field does not deflect attacks, but rather delivers a strong shock, damaging unarmed attackers and those with a conductive weapon.

items.name: Sensory Dulling CBM
items.description: This module lets the user's nervous system inhibit pain signals, allowing them to dull their senses at will.  However, the use of this system may cause delayed reaction times and drowsiness.

items.name: Perpetual Generator CBM
items.description: Installed within you is a perpetual generator powered by nonsensoleum.  When activated it's power gen doubles.  If you are seeing this, you'd better be debugging.

items.name: Plutonium Filter CBM
items.description: A system of tanks and filters that are connected to a microreactor to extract plutonium from radioactive slurry.

items.name: Bionic Visual Impairment
items.description: A defective bionic that impairs vision.

items.name: Power Armor Interface CBM
items.description: Interfaces the user's bionic power system with the internal charging port on suits of power armor, allowing them to draw from the user's bionic power banks.  Twice as efficient as using a UPS.

items.name: Power Armor Mk. II Interface CBM
items.description: Interfaces the user's bionic power system with the internal charging port on suits of power armor, allowing them to draw from the user's bionic power banks.  Four times as efficient as using a UPS, the Mk. II was designed by DoubleTech Inc., to meet the popularity of the Mk. II power armor series.

items.name: Power Storage CBM
items.description: A Compact Bionics Module that upgrades the user's power capacity by 100 units.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  The user will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.

items.name: Power Storage CBM Mk. II
items.description: A Compact Bionics Module developed at DoubleTech Industries as a replacement for the highly successful Power Storage CBM.  Increases the user's power capacity by 250 units.

items.name: Power Overload
items.description: A bunch of defective power circuits that are prone to short-circuiting.

items.name: Power shot
items.description: This is a pseudo item -- the builtin part of a fusion blaster for the maximum power firing mode.

items.name: Probability Travel CBM
items.description: Increases the body's wavelength, allowing the user to quantum tunnel through walls, reappearing on the other side.  Once installed, activate and select a direction to use.  Tunneling costs 100 bionic power per tile traveled through.

items.name: Air Filtration System CBM
items.description: An advanced filtration system that is implanted in the trachea.  If toxins, or airborne diseases find their way into the windpipe, the filter will attempt to remove them.

items.name: Radiation Scrubber System CBM
items.description: A system of advanced piezomechanical blood filters that are implanted throughout your body, allowing the user to purge themself of absorbed radiation at the cost of some bionic power.

items.name: Railgun CBM
items.description: EM field generators in the user's arms increase the range and damage of thrown magnetic objects at a cost of 1 bionic power per throw.  They will create a trail of electricity that can cause additional damage.

items.name: Fingertip Razors CBM
items.description: A set of ten double-edged, four centimeter long razor-sharp claws that are implanted underneath the fingernails.  These will deal a small amount of unarmed slashing damage whenever the user's fingertips are uncovered.

items.name: Internal Microreactor CBM
items.description: This stripped down mini-reactor will generate impressive amounts of bionic power, but may not be the safest thing to install.  Once active, it cannot be shut down and will slowly contaminate the user's body with radiation.

items.name: Microreactor Upgrade CBM
items.description: A kit for upgrading a pre-installed microreactor with enhanced maximum yield and limited automatic radiation scrubbing capabilities.

items.name: Recycler Unit CBM
items.description: A series of filters and processors that is implanted in the user's digestive system, allowing them to reclaim waste liquid and, to a lesser degree, nutrients.  The net effect is a greatly reduced need to eat and drink.

items.name: Remote Controller CBM
items.description: A small module that connects to the user's brain and allows them to interface with nearby devices with wireless capabilities.

items.name: Sonic Resonator CBM
items.description: This bionic module allows the user's entire body to resonate at very high power, creating a short-range shockwave.  While it will not do much damage to creatures, solid objects such as walls and doors will be damaged.

items.name: autonomous surgical scalpels
items.description: A system of surgical grade scalpels.  They allow you to make precise cuts and can also be used as a high-quality butchering tool.

items.name: Olfactory Mask CBM
items.description: While this system is powered, the user's body will produce very little odor, making it nearly impossible for creatures to track them by scent.

items.name: Scent Vision CBM
items.description: This system lets the user visually sense their own scent, making it possible for them to recognize their surroundings even in complete darkness.

items.name: Bionic Short Circuit
items.description: This bionic is poorly wired and occasionally short-circuits.

items.name: Electroshock Unit CBM
items.description: While fighting unarmed, or with a weapon that conducts electricity, there is a chance that a successful hit will shock the user's opponent, inflicting extra damage and disabling them temporarily at the cost of some energy.

items.name: Kinetic Shock Absorbers CBM
items.description: A set of hydraulic springs and foldable padding that replaces most of the flesh in the limbs and upper torso.  While active, these absorbers will negate damage from severe impacts such as falling, at the cost of reducing the user's ability to move effectively.

items.name: Shockwave Generator CBM
items.description: This bionic module generates a powerful shockwave, knocking back all nearby creatures.  Targets are stunned briefly, take damage and additional stun upon impact with impassable terrain, and knock back any creatures they collide with.

items.name: Shotgun Arm CBM
items.description: A concealed, single shot 12 gauge shotgun that is implanted inside the left forearm.  Perfect in a pinch.

items.name: bionic shotgun
items.description: Bionic retracting shotgun integrated with your arm.

items.name: Endocrine Enervator
items.description: This malfunctioning bionic causes fatigue by altering the unfortunate user's brain chemistry.

items.name: Soporific Induction CBM
items.description: A microscopic electrode designed to gently stimulate a particular cluster of neurons in the hypothalamus, helping the user to fall asleep.

items.name: Motor Control Overstimulator
items.description: The result of poor configuration, this bionic module frequently causes debilitating muscle spasms.

items.name: Synaptic Accelerator CBM
items.description: Bionic stimulators that enhance the nervous system, granting a 10% boost to your speed.

items.name: Wire-Induced Stiffness
items.description: A length of poorly installed wiring that would cause stiffness.

items.name: Internal Storage CBM
items.description: Space inside your chest cavity has been converted into a storage area.  You may carry an extra 2 liters of volume.

items.name: Muscle Augmentation CBM
items.description: Myomer fibers that enhance the muscular system, granting a +2 bonus to strength.

items.name: Anti-Glare Compensators CBM
items.description: A set of quick-reacting transition lenses that are installed over the user's eyes.  They negate glare penalties, partially protect from bright flashes, and protect the eyes when welding.

items.name: Autonomous Surgical Scalpels CBM
items.description: A system of surgical grade scalpels that is implanted in the user's fingers.  They allow for automated precise cuts and can be used as a high-quality butchering tool.

items.name: Synaptic Regeneration System CBM
items.description: An electromagnetic stimulator has been surgically implanted on the back of your head and along your spine, continually draining power.  As long as it's active, you won't become sleep deprived; and if you're sleep deprived already, it will boost the rate of recovery.

items.name: Intravenous Needletip CBM
items.description: A small tube with a retractable needle that terminates in a net of tiny hoses instead of a plunger.  Installed, it allows the user to draw substances directly into their bloodstream akin to a regular syringe.

items.name: Targeting System CBM
items.description: This bionic module contains range finders and synchronizes the movement of the user's eyes with their arms, to a degree.  Shots they fire will be much more accurate, particularly at long ranges.

items.name: Taste Modifier CBM
items.description: A set of highly sensitive sensors implanted in the user's mouth, combined with a sophisticated analyzer.  While active, it will block all unpleasant taste and texture at the cost of bionic energy.

items.name: LED Tattoo
items.description: An LED display implanted beneath the epidermis that can display patterns or pictures through the skin.  When active it glows dimly, providing a very small amount of light.

items.name: Teleportation Unit CBM
items.description: This highly experimental unit folds space over short distances, instantly transporting the user's body up to 25 feet in a random duration at the cost of much power.  Note that prolonged or frequent use may have dangerous side effects.

items.name: Self-Locking Thumbs
items.description: A pair of faulty, self-locking thumb bionics.

items.name: Time Dilation CBM
items.description: At the cost of all stored bionic power, the user may increase their body speed and reactions dramatically, essentially freezing time.  Violent or rapid movements may cause damage due to friction.

items.name: Integrated Toolset CBM
items.description: A surgically implanted set of tools - screwdriver, hammer, wrench, hacksaw, drill, welder and heating elements.  These can be used in place of many tools when crafting.

items.name: Joint Torsion Ratchet CBM
items.description: Torsion ratchets that replace the user's joints to slowly generate power when they move.  These can be toggled to generate more power, but movement will require more effort.

items.name: Visual Disruptor
items.description: A pair of defective ocular bionics that cause visual distortion and pixelation.

items.name: Uncanny Dodge CBM
items.description: Bionic processors that augment the user's nervous system, allowing them to dodge attacks beyond normal human capability, including bullets.

items.name: Unified Power System CBM
items.description: A Unified Power System that is wired into the user's bionic power banks.  Objects that run on a UPS can now directly draw power from the bionic power supply.

items.name: Voice Remodulator
items.description: Part of the autodoc's 'Cyborg Identity Package', this bionic gives the user a creepy robot voice.

items.name: Internal Chronometer CBM
items.description: This bionic module contains an atomic clock, complete with silent alarm clock function.

items.name: Water Extraction Unit CBM
items.description: This module contains nanotubes that are embedded in the palm of the hand to pump any available fluid out of a dead body, cleanse it of impurities and convert it into potable water.  Water container not included.

items.name: Titanium Skeletal Bracing CBM
items.description: A set of hinges, springs, and other synthetic augments for the skeletal structure.  These artificial enhancers strengthen the knees and elbows, allowing the user to carry more weight.

items.name: biodiesel
items.description: Vegetable oil- or animal fat-based diesel fuel consisting of long-chain alkyl (methyl, ethyl, or propyl) esters.

items.name: biollante bud
items.description: An unopened biollante flower, brilliant purple in color.  It may still have its sap-producing organ intact.

items.name: bionic scanner
items.description: A small metal scanner specialized in detecting bionic hardware.  Activate to start scanning nearby corpses for bionics.

items.name: bionic scanner (on)
items.description: A small metal scanner specialized in detecting bionic hardware.  Used automatically whenever you look at corpses that might contain bionics.  Consumes power proportional to number of bionics identified this way.

items.name: bipod
items.description: Bipods are commonly used on rifles and machine guns to provide a forward rest and reduce motion.  Although they greatly improve handling of recoil they are usable only on certain surfaces and are slow to equip.

items.name: modified bipod
items.description: Bipods are commonly used on rifles and machine guns to provide a forward rest and reduce motion.  Although they greatly improve handling of recoil they are usable only on certain surfaces and are slow to equip.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon, if you so want.

items.name: birchbark
items.description: A sheet of tough, water-resistant bark taken from a birch tree.

items.name: birchbark funnel
items.description: This is a small birchbark funnel.  Place it above an outdoor container to collect rainwater.

items.name: bird food
items.description: What birds eat.  Mainly made of seeds, silage or legumes.  It's perfect for small birds.

items.name: biscuit
items.description: Wholesome and filling, this home made biscuit is pretty good!

items.name: bismuth
items.description: A dense but brittle metal often used as an alternative to lead.

items.name: military black box
items.description: This is a black box, seemingly pulled from some sort of military vehicle wreckage.  If you can find a system to analyze this, you may find something of interest.

items.name: black box transcript
items.description: A full flight log for a military aircraft.  Nothing of interest stands out.

items.name: black eyed susan bud
items.description: A black eyed susan bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a black eyed susan flower.

items.name: black eyed susan
items.description: A black eyed susan stalk with some petals.

items.name: blackberries
items.description: A darker cousin of raspberry.

items.name: blackjack
items.description: This is a short, easily concealed bludgeoning weapon consisting of a weight embedded at the end of a short leather shaft.  Formerly used by law enforcement, this weapon is meant to stun or knock out the subject, although head strikes have a high risk of causing a permanent, disabling brain injury or being fatal.

items.name: blade
items.description: A large, relatively sharp blade.  Could be used to make bladed weaponry, or attached to a car.

items.name: scythe blade
items.description: A large, curved blade.  Could be used to assemble a scythe, or make an improvised polearm.

items.name: blade trap
items.description: This is a machete attached laterally to a motor, with a tripwire controlling its throttle.  When the tripwire is pulled, the blade is swung around with great force.  The trap forms a 3x3 area of effect.

items.name: blanket
items.description: Hiding under here will not protect you from the monsters.

items.name: blazer
items.description: A professional-looking wool blazer.  Quite cumbersome.

items.name: bleach
items.description: This is sodium hypochlorite, a common household cleaning agent.  It is highly unsafe to drink.

items.name: blindfold
items.description: A simple fabric covering tied over the eyes to block sight.  Useful for sleeping in bright areas.

items.name: blood
items.description: Blood, possibly that of a human.  Disgusting!

items.name: rapid blowback
items.description: An improved blowback mechanism makes your firearm's automatic fire faster, at the cost of reduced accuracy and increased noise.

items.name: Browning BLR magazine
items.description: A compact 4-round box magazine for the Browning BLR.

items.name: BLT
items.description: A bacon, lettuce, and tomato sandwich on toasted bread.

items.name: topaz
items.description: A sparkling blue topaz.

items.name: blue topaz dental grill
items.description: Fake teeth inlaid with blue topaz, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.

items.name: blue topaz and gold bracelet
items.description: A gold bracelet with sparkling blue topaz.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: blue topaz and gold cufflinks
items.description: A pair of cufflinks with inset blue topaz.

items.name: pair of blue topaz and gold earrings
items.description: A pair of shiny blue topaz and gold earrings.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: blue topaz and gold pendant necklace
items.description: A shiny, gold necklace adorned with a blue topaz pendant.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: blue topaz and gold ring
items.description: A gold ring with a blue topaz mounted on top of it.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: blue topaz and gold tiara
items.description: A shiny, gold tiara adorned with blue topaz.

items.name: blue topaz and platinum bracelet
items.description: A platinum bracelet with sparkling blue topaz.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: blue topaz and platinum cufflinks
items.description: A pair of cufflinks with inset blue topaz.

items.name: pair of blue topaz and platinum earrings
items.description: A pair of shiny blue topaz and platinum earrings.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: blue topaz and platinum pendant necklace
items.description: A shiny, platinum necklace adorned with a blue topaz pendant.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: blue topaz and platinum ring
items.description: A platinum ring with a blue topaz mounted on top of it.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: blue topaz and platinum tiara
items.description: A shiny, platinum tiara adorned with blue topaz.

items.name: blue topaz and silver bracelet
items.description: A silver bracelet with sparkling blue topaz.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: blue topaz and silver cufflinks
items.description: A pair of cufflinks with inset blue topaz.

items.name: pair of blue topaz and silver earrings
items.description: A pair of shiny blue topaz and silver earrings.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: blue topaz and silver pendant necklace
items.description: A shiny, silver necklace adorned with a blue topaz pendant.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: blue topaz and silver ring
items.description: A silver ring with a blue topaz mounted on top of it.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: blue topaz and silver tiara
items.description: A shiny, silver tiara adorned with blue topaz.

items.name: bluebell bud
items.description: A bluebell bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a bluebell flower.

items.name: bluebell
items.description: A bluebell stalk with some petals.

items.name: blueberries
items.description: They're blue, but that doesn't mean they're sad.

items.name: cooked blueberry
items.description: It's like blueberry jam, only without sugar.

items.name: blunderbuss flechette
items.description: A prepared blunderbuss shot of homemade flechette made out of nails.  Shreds armor.

items.name: blunderbuss shot
items.description: A prepared blunderbuss shot of marbles, pebbles, bearings, basically whatever is at hand.  The homemade pellet spread and number makes up for the shoddy quality.

items.name: blunderbuss slug
items.description: A prepared blunderbuss shot of a large hunk of metal.  Better for distance.

items.name: blunderbuss
items.description: A homemade version of a crude precursor to the shotgun.  Able to fire just about anything you put down the barrel, but it will degrade pretty quick.

items.name: Solar Panels CBM
items.description: Installed on your back is a set of retractable solar panels.  When in direct sunlight, they will automatically deploy and slowly recharge your power level.

items.name: nailboard trap
items.description: These are several pieces of wood nailed together, with some nails sticking straight up.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on it, they'll get nails through the foot.

items.name: wood boat hull
items.description: A wooden board that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats.  Then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.

items.name: body pillow
items.description: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of an anime character on the front and their scantily clad version on the back.

items.name: boiled egg
items.description: A hard-boiled egg, still in its shell.  Portable and nutritious!

items.name: bokken
items.description: This is a solid wood 'training' katana, exactingly crafted to mimic the weight and balance of the real thing.  Despite its lack of a sharp metal edge, it's still quite capable of inflicting deadly wounds.

items.name: bokken fake
items.description: This is a solid wood 'training' katana, but feels far too light to make an effective weapon.

items.name: bokken replica
items.description: This is a solid wood 'training' katana, but it looks to be mass-produced, and not quite as effective as the real deal.

items.name: bolas
items.description: Some ropes with weights, designed to tangle the legs of a target when thrown, usually at an animal.  Used by the Gauchos of Argentina.

items.name: bologna
items.description: Formally known as Bologna sausage, this is a finely ground preserved meat that comes in circular slices.  Its first name isn't Oscar.  You can eat it cold.

items.name: carbon fiber hunting bolt
items.description: A fletched carbon fiber crossbow bolt shaft with an expanding broadhead tip.  Deals impressive damage to targets.  Stands a good chance of remaining intact once fired.

items.name: crude wooden bolt
items.description: A crude pointed wooden crossbow bolt with a notch at the back.  Stands a very low chance of remaining intact once fired.

items.name: explosive crossbow bolt
items.description: A lightweight, sharpened bolt made from some kind of metal.  It is fairly unwieldy and only provides moderate accuracy, due to being filled with explosives and fitted with an impact trigger.

items.name: makeshift field point bolt
items.description: A simple fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a makeshift head.  Stands a low chance of remaining intact once fired.

items.name: simple metal bolt
items.description: A simple fletched steel crossbow bolt with a flattened and sharpened tip.  Stands a somewhat low chance of remaining intact once fired.

items.name: simple wooden small game bolt
items.description: A simple fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a blunted tip.  Useful for hunting small woodland creatures without splattering them all over the ground.  Stands a low chance of remaining intact once fired.

items.name: simple fire-hardened bolt
items.description: A simple fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a fire-hardened and sharpened tip.  Stands a low chance of remaining intact once fired.

items.name: aluminum broadhead bolt
items.description: A fletched aluminum crossbow bolt with a bladed tip.  Useful for maximising damage to the target.  Stands a good chance of remaining intact once fired.

items.name: aluminum field point bolt
items.description: A fletched aluminum crossbow bolt with a pointed tip.  Useful for piercing armor.  Stands a good chance of remaining intact once fired.

items.name: aluminum small game bolt
items.description: A fletched aluminum crossbow bolt with a blunt tip.  Useful for hunting small woodland creatures without splattering them all over the ground.  Stands a good chance of remaining intact once fired.

items.name: wooden broadhead bolt
items.description: A fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a bladed tip.  Useful for maximising damage to the target.  Stands a decent chance of remaining intact once fired.

items.name: wooden bodkin bolt
items.description: A fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a pointed tip.  Useful for piercing armor.  Stands a decent chance of remaining intact once fired.

items.name: wooden small game bolt
items.description: A fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a blunt tip.  Useful for hunting small woodland creatures without splattering them all over the ground.  Stands a decent chance of remaining intact once fired.

items.name: pair of bolt cutters
items.description: This is a large pair of bolt cutters.  You could use them to cut padlocks or heavy gauge wire.

items.name: Bond Arms Derringer
items.description: The Bond Arms Derringer is a series of multi-barrel compact pistols.  Most commonly chambered for .45 Colt, with chambers long enough to accept .410 shotgun shells.

items.name: bondage mask
items.description: A tight mask made of black leather.  The eyes and mouth can be closed using zippers.

items.name: bondage mask (zipped)
items.description: A tight mask made of black leather.  The eyes and mouth have been zipped closed.

items.name: bondage suit
items.description: A suit of snug, black leather.  Has no pockets, but does feature an abundance of unusually located zippers.

items.name: bone
items.description: A bone from some creature or other.  Could be used to make some stuff, like needles.

items.name: bone flute
items.description: A polished bone flute with five finger holes.

items.name: bone glue
items.description: Glue made from boiling animal bones.  The adhesive isn't strong enough for heavy-duty usages, but it can be used as a varnish or holding together small items.

items.name: human bone
items.description: A bone from a human being.  Could be used to make some stuff, if you're feeling sufficiently ghoulish.

items.name: bone shiv
items.description: A femur or other bone, at least 30 cm long, which has been broken at one end and sharpened into a cutting tool.  Its jagged edge is wicked but fragile.

items.name: bone armor kit
items.description: Bone plating made for a vehicle.

items.name: tainted bone
items.description: A rotten and brittle bone from some unnatural creature or other.  Could be used to make some stuff, like charcoal or glue.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.

items.name: bone meal tablet
items.description: Homemade calcium supplement made out of bone meal.  Tastes horrible and is hard to swallow but it does its job.

items.name: booby trap
items.description: This is a crude explosive device triggered by a piece of string.  Use it to set up and watch some poor bastard trigger it.

items.name: Lessons for the Novice Bowhunter
items.description: This hefty paperback book contains all the information needed for novice archers to get started hunting with a variety of bows and crossbows.

items.name: inactive EMP hack
items.description: This is an inactive EMP hack.  EMP hacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains an EMP grenade and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use this item to reprogram and release the EMP hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

items.name: inactive M2HB autonomous CROWS II
items.description: This is an inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded .50 BMG rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever .50 BMG rounds you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its M2HB.

items.name: inactive broken cyborg
items.description: This is a deactivated broken cyborg, the last shreds of its humanity still rotting away.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and reactivating its mechanical body.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the cyborg will then follow you and attack enemies.  You monster.

items.name: soda bottle silencer
items.description: This is a 'silencer' made from a 2 liter soda bottle, some smaller bottles for baffles, and a generous length of duct tape.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection and you can be certain that this will not save your ears whatsoever.  What it might do is allow you to get a shot or two off with a slightly quieter report.  This simple suppressor is large and, when attached, will interfere with your ability to aim down the base sights of the gun.

items.description: It's a two-liter plastic bottle that can hold a lot of soda, or, nowadays, boiled water.

items.name: boulder anvil
items.description: Dummy item.  If you see this, then something went wrong.

items.name: bow scope
items.description: A single magnifying scope mounted on an adjustable bracket, with accompanying clarifier peep sight.  Designed for extra long shots, but easily adjusted for short range.  Spectacularly accurate.

items.name: five pin bow sight
items.description: A set of adjustable optic fiber aiming pins with a bracket to mount on modern bows.  Improves accuracy substantially, but takes a bit longer to line up.

items.name: single pin bow sight
items.description: A single aluminum pin with a bracket to mount on modern bows.  Quick to use, but not very accurate.

items.name: bow dampening kit
items.description: A set of simple pads and strips of fur or rubber with adhesive backing, designed to stick on the limbs and string of a bow to absorb vibrations.  This substantially reduces noise during firing and can help with accuracy.

items.name: bow sling
items.description: A somewhat complicated set of straps and fabric to keep your bow close to hand and (mostly) out of harms way.  Activate to holster/draw your bow.

items.name: bow stabilizer
items.description: A counterweight placed forward of the bow's grip allows for greater accuracy.  Aside from increased weight and size, there are no drawbacks.

items.name: bow stabilizer system
items.description: A set of three stabilizing, dampened rods with a spring-loaded bracket to mount on modern bows.  Takes extra time to set up when wielding, but doesn't take much extra space.

items.name: bowling ball

items.name: bowling pin

items.name: small cardboard box
items.description: A small cardboard box.  No bigger than a foot in dimension.

items.name: boxer briefs

items.name: boxer shorts
items.description: Men's boxer shorts.  More fashionable than briefs and just as comfortable.

items.name: pair of boxing gloves
items.description: A pair of big, red, 8 oz. boxing gloves.  They make dexterous tasks near impossible, but provide ample protection.

items.name: box backpack
items.description: A makeshift backpack comprised of a wooden box and a pair of ropes.

items.name: boy shorts
items.description: Female underwear similar to men's boxer shorts, but much more close-fitting.

items.name: 10mm Auto FMJ, black powder
items.description: A jacketed 10mm Auto round.  The 10mm Auto cartridge is a rather powerful handgun round and the progenitor to the more popular .40 S&W.

items.name: .223 Remington, black powder
items.description: .223 Remington ammunition with 36gr JHP bullets.  The .223 round has been very popular with civilian shooters for almost a century, finding use in a wide variety of weapons.  It generates lower pressure than 5.56 NATO leading to slightly decreased accuracy and recoil.

items.name: .22 LR CPHP, black powder
items.description: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with 30gr copper-plated, hollow-point bullets.  Has a higher velocity and slightly more stopping power than lead round-nose ammunition, but armor will have a magnified effect on its already-low penetration.

items.name: .22 LR, black powder
items.description: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with 40gr unjacketed bullets.  The .22LR round is extremely weak with very low stopping power, short range, and negligible recoil.  It is most useful for rifle training, and hunting small animals.

items.name: .270 Winchester JSP, black powder
items.description: .270 Winchester ammunition with 130gr soft point bullets.  The .270 round was not initially successful, but over a few decades it became one of the most popular rifle cartridges for hunting and silhouette shooting.  It is a powerful round capable of taking down large targets with ease.

items.name: .30-06 Springfield, black powder
items.description: .30-06 Springfield rounds with 165gr soft point bullets.  The .30-06 cartridge has excellent accuracy, range, and stopping power making it popular with hunters and snipers for well over a century.

items.name: .30-06 Springfield tracer, black powder
items.description: Armor piercing incendiary .30-06 M14A1 ammunition containing tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.  It penetrates all but the strongest body armor with ease.

items.name: .30-06 M2 AP, black powder
items.description: Armor piercing .30-06 M2 ammunition with 168gr FMJ bullets.  It is an extremely powerful and accurate cartridge but pays for its armor penetration abilities with lowered damage.

items.name: .300 Winchester Magnum, black powder
items.description: .300 Winchester Magnum rounds with 220gr JHP bullets.  The 300WM round is an extremely powerful and accurate rifle round introduced in 1963.  It has proven popular with hunters and snipers, although it is not as common as .308 or .30-06.

items.name: .300 AAC Blackout, black powder
items.description: A .300 AAC Blackout round with a 125gr open tip match bullet.  300 BLK is an intermediate cartridge necked up from 5.56x45mm, designed to achieve similar ballistics to 7.62x39mm.  It is compatible with standard AR-15 lower receivers and will feed from STANAG magazines.

items.name: .308 Winchester, black powder
items.description: .308 Winchester ammunition with 168gr hollow point bullets.  The .308 round is one of the most popular hunting cartridges in the world due to its accuracy and power.

items.name: .32 ACP, black powder
items.description: The .32 ACP was a popular handgun cartridge in the 20th century.  Not so powerful as the .38 or the 9x19mm though.

items.name: .357 Magnum FMJ, black powder
items.description: Jacketed .357 magnum ammunition.  The .357 magnum round is derived from the earlier .38 special, with a marginally longer case and generating greater pressure.

items.name: .357 Magnum JHP, black powder
items.description: Jacketed hollow point .357 magnum ammunition.  The .357 magnum round is derived from the earlier .38 special, with a marginally longer case and generating greater pressure.

items.name: .380 ACP FMJ, black powder
items.description: .380 ACP ammunition with a brass jacketed 95gr bullet.  Popular in pocket pistols for over a century, it is often considered the weakest caliber to consider carrying.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.

items.name: .380 ACP JHP, black powder
items.description: .380 ACP ammunition with a 95gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  It is a popular round for small concealable backup pistols, and often the weakest recommended defensive caliber.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.

items.name: .38 FMJ, black powder
items.description: .38 Special ammunition with brass jacketed 130gr bullets.  The .38 Special round has been known from its inception for its accuracy and low recoil.

items.name: .38 Special, black powder
items.description: .38 Special ammunition with 130gr FMJ bullets.  The .38 Special round was extremely common among US police forces during the 20th century.

items.name: .40 S&W FMJ, black powder
items.description: .40 S&W ammunition with 180gr FMJ bullets.  Designed to retain the 10mm Auto cartridge's power with lower recoil, the .40 S&W round became popular for law enforcement and personal defense.

items.name: .40 S&W JHP, black powder
items.description: .40 S&W ammunition with 135gr JHP bullets.  The .40 S&W round is a descended from the 10mm Auto cartridge and maintains most of its predecessor's strengths while reducing recoil.

items.name: .44 Magnum FMJ, black powder
items.description: A brass-jacketed variant of the .44 Magnum round.  This increases penetration at the cost of reduced damage from expansion.

items.name: .44 Magnum, black powder
items.description: .44 magnum ammunition with 240gr JHP bullets.  The .44 magnum round is one of the most powerful handgun cartridges available.  It has excellent stopping power but suffers from extremely high recoil for a handgun round.

items.name: .454 Casull, black powder
items.description: .454 Casull ammunition with 300gr jacketed soft point bullets.  The .454 Casull round is derived from .45 Long Colt with a stronger, lengthened case.  It is an exceptionally powerful cartridge with higher stopping power than many rifle rounds, although it suffers from extreme recoil making it unsuitable for most purposes.

items.name: .45 ACP FMJ, black powder
items.description: .45 ACP ammunition with 230gr FMJ bullets.  Noted for its stopping power, the .45 ACP round has been common for almost 150 years.

items.name: .45 ACP JHP, black powder
items.description: .45 ACP ammunition with 185gr JHP bullets.  The .45 ACP round was developed to replace the .38 Long Colt cartridge in the early 20th century.  It has good stopping power but above average recoil.

items.name: .45 Colt JHP, black powder
items.description: .45 Colt ammunition with 250gr jacketed hollow point bullets.  Originally designed for the Colt Single Action Army, and still used for modern reproduction revolvers.  Originally a black powder cartridge, modern loads can make this round competitive in the new era.

items.name: .460 Rowland FMJ, black powder
items.description: A plated, hard cast flat nosed variant of the .460 Rowland round.  This increases penetration slightly at the cost of reduced damage from expansion.

items.name: .460 Rowland, black powder
items.description: .460 Rowland ammunition with 185gr JHP bullets.  The .460 Rowland round is designed to emulate hard-hitting .44 magnum in common autoloading pistols.  Like the .44, .460 Rowland has exceptional power - and recoil.  It is almost dimensionally identical to .45ACP, save for having a longer case and deeper seated bullets to prevent ammunition mix-ups.

items.name: 4.6x30mm, black powder
items.description: 4.6x30mm ammunition with 31gr copper plated lead bullets.  The 4.6x30mm round was developed by H&K to compete with FN Herstal's 5.7x28mm cartridge.  It has low recoil, but no usual armor penetration due to using simple lead bullets rather than proper factory-made penetrator projectiles.

items.name: .500 S&W Magnum, black powder
items.description: .500 S&W Magnum ammunition with 500gr bullets.  The .500 S&W Magnum round is a colossally powerful handgun cartridge capable of killing almost any target with one hit.  It has extremely high damage and recoil to match.

items.name: 5.56 NATO, black powder
items.description: 5.56x45mm ammunition with a 62gr FMJ bullet containing a steel penetrator.  Its light weight, high accuracy, and manageable recoil lead to widespread use in the 20th century and it remains popular among militaries and civilians.

items.name: 5.56 NATO tracer, black powder
items.description: This ammunition is a one-in-five mix of M855A1 and M856 tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.

items.name: 5.7x28mm, black powder
items.description: 5.7x28mm ammunition with 31gr AP FMJ bullets.  The 5.7x28mm cartridge was designed by FN Herstal to replace the 9x19mm round in NATO use.  Although the project to replace 9x19mm Parabellum was effectively canceled the 5.7x28mm round has seen action in many conflicts and has proven to be reliable.  It has very low recoil but no usual armor penetration due to using simple lead bullets rather than proper factory-made penetrator projectiles.

items.name: 7.62x25mm FMJ, black powder
items.description: A high-pressure commercial version of the 7.62x25mm cartridge, loaded with an 85 gr. FMJ bullet.  It is more powerful than the original.

items.name: 7.62x51mm, black powder
items.description: A 7.62x51mm NATO round with a 147gr FMJ bullet.  It is a powerful rifle cartridge commonly used by hunters and military snipers because of its high accuracy and long range.

items.name: 7.62x51mm tracer, black powder
items.description: This ammunition is a one-in-five mix of M80 and M62 tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.

items.name: 9x19mm JHP, black powder
items.description: 9x19mm ammunition with a 116gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  JHP rounds have inferior penetration to FMJ rounds but their expansion slightly increases stopping power against unarmored targets and reduces overpenetration.

items.name: 9x19mm FMJ, black powder
items.description: 9x19mm ammunition with a brass jacketed 115gr bullet.  It is a popular round for military, law enforcement, and civilian use even after almost 150 years.

items.name: 9x18mm, black powder
items.description: 9x18mm Makarov ammunition with 93gr steel core FMJ bullets.  The 9x18mm round was very common in the Eastern Bloc during the 20th century and remained in Russian military service into the 21st century.

items.name: 9x18mm FMJ, black powder
items.description: 9x18mm Makarov RG028 ammunition.  The RG028 round uses bullets with a hardened steel core to improve armor penetration.

items.name: 00 shot, black powder
items.description: A shell filled with metal pellets.  Extremely damaging, plus the spread makes it very accurate at short range.  Favored by SWAT forces.

items.name: birdshot, black powder
