items.description: A pretty stalk of canola.  Its seeds can be pressed into oil.

items.name: plastic canteen
items.description: A military-style water canteen with a 1.5 liter capacity.  Commonly worn at the hip.

items.name: wooden canteen
items.description: A water canteen made from wood, secured by metal bands and sealed with wax or pitch.  Holds 1.5 liters and has a simple carry strap.

items.name: steel boom
items.description: A large rigid steel boom.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 20 metric tonnes.

items.name: telescopic cantilever
items.description: A small steel telescoping cantilever.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 3.5 metric tonnes.

items.name: Foodperson's cape
items.description: A brightly-colored cape emblazoned with the "Fp" symbol.

items.name: car headlight
items.description: A vehicle headlight to light up the way.

items.name: wide-angle car headlight
items.description: A wide-angle vehicle headlight to light up the way.

items.name: flintlock carbine
items.description: This short rifle design once dominated the battlefields of ancient Europe, and may yet re-earn its feared status due to its ease of handling and ability to use easily-crafted ammunition.

items.name: handmade double-barrel flintlock
items.description: This is a compact muzzle-loading rifle combining a pair of rudimentary flintlock actions and two barrels.  Whereas an antique multiple-barrel flintlock is an intricate work of gunsmithing, this weapon is simpler yet still serviceable.

items.name: carbon fiber boat hull
items.description: A carbon fiber sheet that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats.  Then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.

items.name: cardboard
items.description: A piece of cardboard.

items.name: carding paddles
items.description: A pair of toothy wooden paddles used to clean fibers for use in textile production.

items.name: floor trunk
items.description: A section of flooring with a cargo-space beneath, and a hinged door for access.

items.name: cargo lock set
items.description: A set of locks designed to be installed on a vehicle.

items.name: cargo carrier
items.description: A heavy frame outfitted with tie-downs and attachment points for carrying cargo.

items.name: The Complete Home Repair Guide
items.description: A massive book that details virtually every aspect of remodeling and repairing a home, with concise terminology aimed at experienced carpenters.

items.name: carrot
items.description: A healthy root vegetable.  Rich in vitamin A!

items.name: wild root
items.description: A weed with a cluster of tiny white flowers.  These are often wild carrots, but beware of poisonous lookalikes.

items.name: paper carton
items.description: A half gallon carton constructed of a paper, aluminum and plastic laminate.  It has a threaded cap for easy resealing.

items.name: opened paper carton
items.description: A half gallon carton constructed of a paper, aluminum and plastic laminate.  This one is open and its contents will spoil.

items.name: electric carver (off)
items.description: An electric meat carver powered by batteries.  Two serrated blades that vibrate together to slice just about anything from turkey to ham… even zombies!

items.name: electric carver (on)
items.description: This carver is on and the blades are buzzing.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: carving fork
items.description: It's like a tiny pitchfork, or a very large dinner fork.  You use it to hold meat still while you slice it.

items.name: violin case
items.description: Useful to carry your precious musical instrument around protected from any harm.

items.name: cash card
items.description: A yellow plastic card used to store money.  These became popular once the government officially moved to all electronic money.  It holds up to 2 million dollars.

items.name: cashews
items.description: A handful of salty cashews.

items.name: casserole
items.description: A ceramic pot made for both cooking and serving, particularly one-pot dinners.

items.name: cassock
items.description: A piece of clerical clothing, usually worn by Christian priests.

items.name: cat food
items.description: This is food for cats.  It smells strange, but cats seem to love it.

items.name: cattail jelly
items.description: Clear jelly harvested from cattail, has antiseptic properties and works as a painkiller.

items.name: cattail rhizome
items.description: A stout branching rhizome from a cattail plant.  Its crisp white flesh is very starchy and fibrous, but you really ought to cook it before you attempt to eat it.

items.name: cattail stalk
items.description: A stiff green stalk from a cattail plant.  It is starchy and fibrous, but it would be much better if you cooked it.

items.name: cattle fodder
items.description: What cattle eat.  Mainly made of grass, silage or legumes.  It's perfect for ruminants.

items.name: cavalry saber
items.description: This is a curved sword associated with cavalry from the Early Modern period onwards.  Lightweight but a deadly slashing weapon.

items.name: cavalry saber fake
items.description: This is a dull, cheap replica of a curved sword associated with cavalry, from the Early Modern period onwards.

items.name: CCP magazine
items.description: An 8-round steel box magazine for use with the Walther CCP.

items.name: celery
items.description: Neither tasty nor very nutritious, but it goes well with salad.

items.name: cellphone
items.description: This is a cellphone, an older cousin of a smartphone but still popular in certain circles due to its reliability, sturdiness and the ability to run on common batteries.  Using this cellphone will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is sufficiently charged.  It also has a clock app that includes an alarm.

items.name: cellphone - Screenlight
items.description: This is a cellphone, an older cousin of a smartphone but still popular in certain circles due to its reliability, sturdiness and the ability to run on common batteries.  Using this cellphone will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is sufficiently charged.  It also has a clock app that includes an alarm.

items.name: ceramic armor plate
items.description: A ceramic armor plate, specifically engineered for use in a bullet resistant vest.

items.name: ceramic bowl
items.description: A perfectly ordinary ceramic soup bowl.

items.name: ceramic cup
items.description: A light ceramic teacup.  Quite classy.

items.name: coffee mug
items.description: A ceramic coffee cup with a logo on the side.

items.name: ceramic plate
items.description: A ceramic dinner plate, unremarkable in every way.

items.name: ceramic shard
items.description: A broken ceramic shard.  It is heavy and has a somewhat sharp edge, but it's too irregular to cut properly.

items.name: set of 100 ceramic disk
items.description: A set of small slightly elongated disks, made of high-grade ceramic.  They remind you of scales.

items.name: TX-5LR Laser Cannon
items.description: A laser cannon stripped from the barrel of a TX-5LR Cerberus laser turret.  Unusable as a weapon on its own without the necessary parts.

items.name: sugary cereal
items.description: Sugary breakfast cereal with marshmallows.  It takes you back to your childhood.

items.name: wheat cereal
items.description: Whole-grain wheat cereal.  It's surprisingly good, and allegedly good for your heart.

items.name: corn cereal
items.description: Plain cornflake cereal.  They're not that good, but it beats nothing.

items.name: cestus
items.description: A leather hand and arm wrap incorporating metal plates over the knuckles to improve punching power and defence.

items.name: chai tea
items.description: A traditional south Asian mixed-spice tea with milk.

items.name: steel chain
items.description: A heavy steel chain.  Useful as a weapon, or for crafting.  It has a chance to wrap around your target, allowing for a bonus unarmed attack.

items.name: chain link
items.description: Small metal rings, suitable for constructing chainmail.

items.name: chainmail medium quadruped armor
items.description: A heavy covering of chainmail, suitably made for medium quadrupeds as protection.  You could put this on a friendly medium quadruped.

items.name: chainmail small quadruped armor
items.description: Protecteth yon hund fram ful daemons!  A heavy covering of chainmail, suitably made for small quadrupeds as protection.  You could put this on a friendly small quadruped.

items.name: pair of chainmail sleeves
items.description: Customized chainmail arms.  Each sleeve has straps to connect them with each other.  The lack of fingers makes them less cumbersome and allows them to be used with gloves.

items.name: pair of chainmail chausses
items.description: Customized chainmail chausses that cover the feet, like booties made of chainmail.

items.name: pair of chainmail gloves
items.description: Customized chainmail gloves.  They fully enclose the fingers and provide excellent protection, but are somewhat cumbersome.

items.name: chainmail hauberk
items.description: A fully customized chainmail outfit, leaving the head uncovered.  The shirt, arms, and leggings have been modified with straps and combined with a gambeson to deal with uneven weight distribution, cold environments and to allow them to be used separately.

items.name: chainmail coif
items.description: A customized chainmail hood.  Can be worn comfortably under helmets.

items.name: chainmail leggings
items.description: Customized chainmail legs.  Their straps keep everything in place, and the lack of toes and heels allows them to work perfectly well with footwear.

items.name: chainmail armor
items.description: A fully customized chainmail suit.  The coif, shirt, arms, and leggings have been modified with straps and combined with a gambeson to deal with uneven weight distribution, cold environments and to allow them to be used separately.

items.name: faraday chainmail suit
items.description: A fully customized chainmail suit that can be worn over your normal clothing.  The suit is conductively interconnected, protecting against electricity.

items.name: chainmail vest
items.description: A customized chainmail vest.  It's a sleeveless piece of chainmail with small straps designed to better distribute the weight.

items.name: chainsaw (off)
items.description: This is a lumbering tool moonlighting as weapon of opportunity.  If loaded with gas, using this item will cause it to turn on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon.

items.name: chainsaw (on)
items.description: This chainsaw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: chamomile flowers
items.description: White chamomile flowers, used as a herbal remedy since the ancient times.

items.name: chamomile tea
items.description: A healthy beverage made from chamomile flowers steeped in boiling water.  Can be used to treat insomnia.

items.name: leather chaps
items.description: A pair of black leather chaps.  Very tough and light, but doesn't offer any storage.

items.name: charcoal forge
items.description: This is a portable, charcoal fired, metalworking forge.  If combined with the right tools, you could use this for metalworking, or it could be used to repair metal items.

items.name: charcoal kiln
items.description: A stout metal box used for producing charcoal via pyrolysis; the incomplete burning of organic materials in the absence of oxygen.

items.name: charcoal water purifier
items.description: Using this item on a container full of water will purify the water using layered charcoal.  Once the charcoal has purified enough water, it will become unusable and can be disassembled and recycled.  Water taken from uncertain sources like a river may be dirty.

items.name: charcoal smoker
items.description: This is a portable charcoal smoker.  Good for weekend barbecuing and preserving meat with smoke.

items.name: character sheet
items.description: A Dungeons & Dragons character sheet.

items.name: charcoal
items.description: A flammable carbon-based material produced by slowly burning wood.  Utilized in recipes requiring a pure, hot flame.  Can also be used in filters to remove contaminants out of air and water.

items.name: charcoal cooker
items.description: This is a little metal tank for holding charcoal with a pilot light attached.  You could use it for cooking food.

items.name: chewing tobacco
items.description: Mint flavored chewing tobacco.  While still absolutely terrible for your health, it was once a favorite amongst baseball players, cowboys, and other macho types.

items.name: cheap whiskey
items.description: Really cheap blended whiskey.

items.name: cheek pad
items.description: A stock accessory for sniper rifles and even DMRs considerably improving eye relief efficiency, prevents slipping, and reduces recoil to the neck and cheek.

items.name: cheese
items.description: A block of yellow processed cheese.

items.name: fresh cheese
items.description: A type of soft fresh cheese, like paneer or cottage cheese.  Also known as farmer's cheese.  It won't last very long, but can be preserved through smoking.

items.name: cheese fries
items.description: Fried potatoes with delicious cheese smothered on top.

items.name: hard cheese
items.description: Hard, dry cheese made to last, unlike modern processed cheese.  Will make you thirsty though.

items.name: cheeseburger
items.description: A sandwich of minced meat and cheese with condiments.  The apex of pre-Cataclysm culinary achievement.

items.name: dimethyl sulfoxide
items.description: Dimethyl sulfoxide, or DMSO, is a common and important aprotic solvent, capable of dissolving a huge range of things.  It can help many chemical agents diffuse more quickly through the skin, and has a mild analgesic effect on its own.

items.name: acetic acid
items.description: Concentrated acetic acid, typically used as a chemical reagent and antifungal agent.  Despite its horrid smell, it was used to prepare several types of perfumes, but would making perfume not be too fancy for postapocalyptic New England?

items.name: acetone
items.description: Acetone, best known as the primary constituent of most nail polish removers.  Flammable and can be easily used for potent home-made explosives.

items.name: acrylamide
items.description: This highly carcinogenic white powder can be readily polymerized into a whole bunch of useful water-soluble gels.

items.name: agar
items.description: These clear cubes of processed seaweed can be dissolved in boiling water to create a very sturdy, temperature resistant gel.  Not only is it good for making gels to separate molecules by size, but it's a great cheat ingredient to make sure your jellies set properly.

items.name: aluminum powder
items.description: A handful of finely ground aluminum powder.  This strong reducing agent was used in combination with various oxidants for chemical welding and explosives alike.  Just before the Cataclysm, however, it was the basis of virtually all commercial metallic-hued paints and anti-corrosive coatings.

items.name: aluminum sulfate
items.description: Several crystals of aluminum sulfate.  Historically, an agent for purifying water and as molluscicide, due to the fact that it degenerates their slime.  Just before the Cataclysm, its main uses were for adjusting the acidity of the soil and as an additive to baking powder.  If mixed with a strong acid, it could be used to saturate the soil with aluminum, causing all but the most resistant of plants to wither and die.

items.name: ammonium nitrate
items.description: Some ammonium nitrate.  This white, crystalline powder is commonly used as a component of fertilizers and explosives.  Could also be dissolved in water to sharply lower its temperature, but is there any use for this quality in this new world?

items.name: ammonium nitrate pellets
items.description: Some ammonium nitrate pellets.  These pellets are commonly used as a component of fertilizers and explosives.  Could also be dissolved in water to sharply lower its temperature, but is there any use for this quality in this new world?

items.name: ANFO
items.description: Several brownish pellets that were made by absorbing organic fuel on ammonium nitrate.  This ammonium nitrate-fuel oil or ANFO, as it is called, mixture is a common industrial explosive due to its stability and low price.  Burns fast, but needs an explosive primer to detonate.

items.name: black gunpowder
items.description: A handful of black gunpowder, made by mixing charcoal and sulfur with saltpeter.  Pretty useless for making modern cartridges, as the soot produced when it burns will quickly clog any firearm, but it could be used to make some vicious bombs.

items.name: calcium carbide
items.description: A handful of calcium carbide, giving off a faint, garlic-like smell.  Commercially, calcium carbide was used for on-the-spot manufacture of acetylene and historically to power acetylene lamps.  If mixed with water and sealed, it will explode with little strength, but with relatively loud noise and could maybe be used as a decoy.

items.name: chloroform
items.description: Famous for its abilities as an illicit sedative, this substance is also a very good solvent.  In particular, it's used a lot in nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy.

items.name: chromium oxide
items.description: A handful of chromium oxide.  This substance, typically known as the only stable green pigment for paints, is also a mild oxidizer, which can be mixed with aluminum powder to make thermite for welding.  If one had access to a CVD machine and a laboratory worth of reagents, they might be able to produce very durable ceramic layers.

items.name: composition b
items.description: Composition B is an explosive consisting of castable mixtures of RDX and TNT.  It is used as the main explosive filling in artillery projectiles, rockets, land mines, hand grenades and various other munitions.

items.name: ethanol
items.description: Extremely pure alcohol suitable for use as a component in chemical reactions.  You could also water it down and drink it, or use it as fuel in alcohol-burning stoves.

items.name: formaldehyde
items.description: Formaldehyde, here dissolved in water, was widely used before the Cataclysm as a precursor to production of many chemicals and materials and as an embalming agent.  Easily identifiable by its pungent odor.  Terribly toxic, carcinogenic, and volatile.

items.name: glycerol
items.description: This innocent, sweet, colorless liquid can be used for all kinds of things, from sweetening food to manufacturing medicine to making potent explosives.

items.name: hexamine
items.description: A handful of waxy hexamine tablets.  This ubiquitous fuel was used to start up almost every garden grill and no 'real' camping trip could do its cooking without it, until the Cataclysm.  Nowadays, it is even more valuable than before, being the key component in the preparation of several military-grade explosives.

items.name: HMTD
items.description: Hexamine peroxide: this fine, yellowish powder is a powerful primary explosive, used to initiate detonation of more stable explosives, such as RDX.  Relatively stable, but best not store it for too long.

items.name: hydrogen peroxide
items.description: Dilute hydrogen peroxide, for use as an antiseptic and for bleaching hair or textiles.  Foams a little when in contact with organic matter, but otherwise harmless.

items.name: hydrogen peroxide (concentrated)
items.description: Concentrated hydrogen peroxide is a powerful oxidant, violently decomposing in contact with most reducing agents.  Can be used as rocket fuel or to make high explosives.  Causes severe burns to any organic matter and may ignite it on contact.

items.name: manganese dioxide
items.description: A handful of manganese dioxide powder.  Occurring naturally in the mineral pyrolusite, it is used commercially in the production of alkaline and zinc-carbon batteries.

items.name: match head powder
items.description: Some match head powder from match heads, similar to black gunpowder but a bit weaker.  It can be used in crafting explosives and fuses when other more suitable candidates are less available.

items.name: methanol
items.description: High purity methanol suitable for use in chemical reactions.  Could be used in alcohol-burning stoves.  Very toxic.

items.name: hydrochloric acid
items.description: Hydrochloric acid, also known as muriatic acid.  It is a strong acid that has a distinctive smell, important and frequently used ever since its discovery.  It still has a vast multitude of uses.

items.name: nitric acid
items.description: Nitric acid, a strong oxidant and extremely corrosive material.  Mainly used in the production of synthetic fertilizers, for etching of circuit boards and in woodworking.  Remains quite useful both for making a vast array of pyrotechnic and explosive agents and as a direct weapon: not many beings enjoy being doused in nitric acid.

items.name: peptone broth powder
items.description: This is a pre-mixed salty solution of protein and sugar.  It's meant for bacteria to eat, but if you were desperate you could eat it too; it's not much different from cup noodle stock.

items.name: phenol
items.description: This useful stuff is a potent solvent and has a wide range of reactive applications.  It can be used to make a huge number of plastics and polymers, it can be an antiseptic, it can strip paint and break down epoxy, and it can burn your skin away like tissue paper under a heat gun.  Wear gloves.

items.name: potassium alum
items.description: Small water-soluble white crystals with watery metallic odor, historically used for many different purposes.  Also known as potash alum and potassium aluminum sulfate; often called simply alum, as it's the most important member of the generic class of compounds called alums.

items.name: potassium chloride
items.description: A handful of potassium chloride.  Although it occurs naturally in the mineral sylvite, it can be produced as a byproduct of the reaction of saltpeter and hydrochloric acid.  It can be used for making fertilizer, or potassium hydroxide by way of electrolysis.

items.name: potassium hydroxide
items.description: A handful of potassium hydroxide.  Commonly called caustic potash, it was mainly used industrially for its caustic nature.  It can be used as an electrolyte in alkaline batteries, among other applications.

items.name: RDX
items.description: Several off-white crystals of RDX or hexogen: a military-grade, shelf-stable high explosive.  Can be cast into shaped charges or mixed with scrap to pepper the blast area with high-velocity shrapnel.

items.name: improvised rocket fuel
items.description: A chunk of a zinc powder and sulfur mixture, bound together by superglue, that can be used as an impromptu rocket fuel.

items.name: saltpeter
items.description: A handful of saltpeter.  Sometimes used as a fertilizer, this ubiquitous nitrate is the principal constituent of black gunpowder and simple rocket propellants, such as rocket candy.

items.name: sulfur
items.description: A handful of pure sulfur.  Primarily used to make battery acid, sulfur is sometimes used as fuel for explosives.  Can be burned to produce acidic smoke, that is deadly to bacteria and humans alike, or oxidized to make paper-bleaching agents.

items.name: sulfuric acid
items.description: Sulfuric acid: viscous, foul-smelling and extremely corrosive, particularly to organic matter and evil clowns.  Although used to prepare a number of chemicals, it is mostly known as battery acid, due to its widest commercial application.

items.name: thermite
items.description: A handful of silvery-greenish powder, produced by mixing aluminum and chromium oxide.  This mixture, burning at a constant pace and at extremely high temperature, was once used for on-the-spot welding.  Can be used as an incendiary material in a pinch.

items.name: zinc oxide
items.description: A handful of zinc oxide.  It can be reduced into zinc, or used for some other reactions of its own.

items.name: zinc powder
items.description: A handful of zinc powder.  While commercially used mostly in cosmetics and for paints, hobbyists used to mix it with sulfur to make basic rocket fuel / smokescreen.  When treated with a strong acid, it will produce hydrogen.

items.name: makeshift chemical thrower
items.description: A bulky, self-made chemical sprayer with an internal conversion mechanism that allows all sorts of chemicals to be dispersed to your surroundings.

items.name: chemistry set
items.description: This is a chemistry set stored in a box.  The contents include glass containers, hoses, metal wire, a hotplate, and safety glasses.  It might be used to craft some chemistry projects if you're so inclined.

items.name: basic chemistry set
items.description: This is a basic chemistry set which includes glass containers, hoses and safety glasses.  It might be used to craft some chemistry projects if you're so inclined, but you'll need a source of heat.

items.name: onboard chemistry lab
items.description: Assembled from a chemistry set attached to a complex wiring harness, it is well suited to most any chemistry project you could imagine.  Unable to utilize standard batteries, it requires an external supply of electricity to operate.

items.name: cherries
items.description: A red, sweet fruit that grows in trees.

items.name: hard chest guard
items.description: A plastron of interlocking plastic plate protecting your torso.

items.name: chestnuts
items.description: A handful of raw hard nuts from a chestnut tree.

items.name: roasted chestnuts
items.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a chestnut tree.

items.name: chest ammo pouch
items.description: A fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to your chest which is capable of holding a single magazine or speedloader close at hand.

items.name: chest rig
items.description: Popularized during the Vietnam War, chest rigs like these are typically plain, barebones affairs consisting of three or more pouches in a row, with straps to secure them on your chest.  This one can hold four magazines or speedloaders in its pouches.

items.name: chestwrap
items.description: Rags wrapped around the chest.  Preserves your modesty and keeps things out of the way, but not good for much else.

items.name: fur chestwrap
items.description: Fur pelts wrapped around the chest.  Preserves your modesty and keeps things out of the way, but not good for much else.

items.name: leather chestwrap
items.description: Leather patches wrapped around the chest.  Preserves your modesty and keeps things out of the way, but not good for much else.

items.name: wool chestwrap
items.description: Felt patches wrapped around the chest.  Preserves your modesty and keeps things out of the way, but not good for much else.

items.name: chicken cage
items.description: A wire container made for transporting chickens, but you can use it to hold any tiny animal.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.

items.name: chicken walker chassis
items.description: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the chicken walker.

items.name: chicory brew
items.description: Toasted, ground chicory root steeped in boiling water.  This bitter brew is used as a coffee substitute, though it tastes nothing like coffee.

items.name: chicory
items.description: A modest blue flower.  The flower's roots are very bitter and not meant to be eaten raw.

items.name: children's book
items.description: A little book for little readers.  The colorful cartoon characters and sweet stories contained herein belong to a different time, before the dead walked and the world moved on.

items.name: chili con carne
items.description: A spicy stew containing chili peppers, meat, tomatoes and beans.

items.name: chili pepper
items.description: Spicy chili pepper.

items.name: chili dogs
items.description: A hot dog, served with chili con carne as a topping.  Yum!

items.name: chili powder
items.description: Chilly P, Yo!  Not edible on its own, but it could be used to make seasoning.

items.name: chime loudspeakers
items.description: A stereo system with loudspeakers and a built-in set of simple melodies that it will play.  Commonly used by ice cream trucks to draw the attention of children in the days when children wanted ice cream more than brains.

items.name: paint chipper
items.description: A tool similar to a chisel, designed to remove paint.

items.name: potato chips
items.description: Betcha can't eat just one.

items.name: potato chips
items.description: Some plain, salted potato chips.

items.name: potato chips
items.description: Oh man, you love these chips!  Score!

items.name: metalworking chisel
items.description: This is a short, stout metalworking chisel.  It's used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.

items.name: chitin medium quadruped armor
items.description: A makeshift assembly of criniere, peytral and croupiere made from chitin fitted to a thin mesh.  You could put this on a friendly medium quadruped.

items.name: chitin small quadruped armor
items.description: A makeshift assembly of criniere, peytral and croupiere made from chitin fitted to a thin mesh.  You could put this on a friendly small quadruped.

items.name: chunk of chitin
items.description: A piece of an insect's exoskeleton.  It is light and very durable.

items.name: chitin armor kit
items.description: Light chitin plating made for a vehicle.

items.name: chloroform soaked rag
items.description: A debug item that lets you put NPCs (or yourself) to sleep.

items.name: chocolate drink
items.description: A chocolate flavored beverage made of artificial flavoring and milk byproducts.  Shelf stable and vaguely appetizing even when lukewarm.

items.name: chocolate pancake
items.description: Fluffy and delicious pancakes with real maple syrup, with delicious chocolate baked right in.

items.name: chocolate waffle
items.description: Crunchy and delicious waffles with real maple syrup, with delicious chocolate baked right in.

items.name: chocolate-covered coffee bean
items.description: Roasted coffee beans coated with dark chocolate, natural source of concentrated caffeine.

items.name: chocolate bar
items.description: Chocolate isn't very healthy, but it does make a delicious treat.

items.name: chocolate-covered pretzel
items.description: A salty treat of a snack, covered in chocolate.

items.name: cholla bud
items.description: Edible bud of a cholla cactus, with spines removed; the candy of the Mojave indigenous peoples.  Tastes similar to asparagus.

items.name: chopsticks
items.description: One of the most popular eating utensils in the world.  Does double duty as a way of dealing with especially fragile vampires.

items.name: chunk of rubber
items.description: A chunk of useful rubber, can be molded easily.

items.name: chunk of sulfur
items.description: A chunk of pure sulfur.  Break it up to use it.

items.name: folded butter churn
items.description: A large wooden container used to turn raw milk into butter and buttermilk.  This model uses a foot crank and holds three gallons of raw milk.

items.name: cigarette
items.description: A mixture of dried tobacco leaf, pesticides, and chemical additives, rolled into a filtered paper tube.  Stimulates mental acuity and reduces appetite.  Highly addictive and hazardous to health.

items.name: cigarette butt
items.description:
What was once a wonderfully addictive tube of dried tobacco leaf is now just a smelly piece of trash.  What a tragedy!
The leftover tobacco in a few of these could probably be used to roll another cigarette.  If you're willing to go that far…

items.name: cigarette
items.description: Smoke swirls from the lit end of this cigarette, filling the air with the thrilling smell of burning chemicals.

items.name: cigar
items.description:
Rolled, cured tobacco leaf, addictive and hazardous to health.
A gentleman's vice, cigars set the civil man apart from the savage.

items.name: cigar butt
items.description: A true gentleman always finishes his cigars.

items.name: cigar
items.description: The smoke billowing from this cigar has a sweet, musty odor.

items.name: cinnamon
items.description: Ground cinnamon bark with a sweet but slightly spicy aroma.

items.name: circular sawblade
items.description: An 8" circular sawblade.  You could make a saw with it, or throw it.  Wielding it without sturdy gloves is a bad idea.

items.name: circular saw (off)
items.description: A lightweight handheld cordless circular saw.  Spins a circular blade fast enough to cut wood, zombies, or in an emergency, pizza.  The blade, while effective in combat, is hard to hit with due to its small size.

items.name: circular saw (on)
items.description: A lightweight handheld cordless circular saw.  It is currently on and the blade is spinning; use this item to turn it off.

Unlike modern revolvers, the cylinder cannot swing out for loading, and spent brass must be ejected one at a time.

items.name: homemade suppressor
items.description: A homemade suppressor made from a pipe and improvised wipe media.  For as long as the wipes hold up, it will reduce the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection; a suppressor will bring the loudness of a report down to generally safe levels, as well as slightly reducing recoil and muzzle velocity.  This simple suppressor is large and, when attached, will interfere with your ability to aim down the base sights of the gun.

items.name: FOODCO kitchen buddy
items.description: Assembled from a set of instructions you found in an old book of DIY projects, the *FOODCO kitchen buddy* claims to be *the perfect solution to all your home-cooking needs!*.  While it is surprisingly handy for vacuum-sealing as well as dehydrating food, the cheery sales pitch neglected to mention A - how awkward the damn thing is, B - That you still need a normal kitchen and C - how it doesn't take batteries.  You're going to have to weld it to a vehicle, or something else with a supply of electricity, if you want to use it.  In addition to the food preservation features, it also has a food processor, a water-purification system, a drawer for holding extra tools, and for some insane reason, a press and die set for hand-loading ammunition.

items.description: A long wooden pole with chainsaws impractically attached to both ends.  The product of either genius or insanity, but not both; the weight ensures that only someone both strong and very skilled could possibly hope to use it.

items.name: chainsaw lajatang (on)
items.description: A long wooden pole with chainsaws impractically attached to both ends.  They are currently on and draining gasoline; use this item to turn them off.

items.name: copper tubing
items.description: A copper tube, too thin to be much use as a melee weapon, but will do if nothing else is available.  Useful in a few crafting recipes.

items.name: cucumber
items.description: Comes from the gourd family.  Not tasty but very juicy.

items.name: cudgel
items.description: A slender long rod of wood, while traditionally intended as a training tool for many dueling moves, it still makes a good melee weapon in a pinch.

items.name: pair of cufflinks
items.description: An unmarked, pair of silver cufflinks.  Cufflinks are used to secure the cuffs of dress shirts - a must-have for men in formal wear.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: pair of intricate cufflinks
items.description: An expensive pair of silver cufflinks, stylized with detailed overlays of gold gears and fractal patterns.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: cuirass
items.description: A steel breastplate, and a vital part of plate armor.  Even as full armor went into decline, cuirasses remained in use among cavalry in Europe.

items.name: scrap cuirass
items.description: A cuirass made from scraps of metal secured by simple strings; the loose collection of plates provides decent but not the most convenient protection.

items.name: plastic cup
items.description: A small, vacuum formed cup.

items.name: opened plastic cup
items.description: A small, vacuum formed cup, essentially trash.

items.name: cured hide
items.description: A rolled up animal hide which has been scraped of extraneous hair and flesh and treated to prevent decay.  It could be tanned and transformed into usable leather patches.

items.name: cured pelt
items.description: A rolled up animal hide which has been scraped of extraneous hair and flesh and treated to prevent decay.  It could be tanned and transformed into usable fur pelts.

items.name: hair curler
items.description: A soft plastic cylinder you can wrap a lock of your hair around to curl it.

items.name: curling iron
items.description: A wand made of heat-resistant ceramics.  When plugged into an outlet, it is hot enough to shape your hair into curls.  Too bad the power's out.

items.name: curry with meat
items.description: Spicy, and filled with bits of peppers and meat!  It's pretty good.

items.name: curry powder
items.description: A blend of spices meant to be used in some South Asian dishes.  Can't be eaten raw, why would you even try that?

items.name: curry
items.description: Spicy, and filled with bits of peppers.  It's pretty good.

items.name: currywurst
items.description: Sausage covered in a curry ketchup sauce.  Fairly spicy and impressive at the same time!

items.name: cutlass
items.description: This is a broad saber known for its use by sailors and pirates, as its short blade is easy to handle in close quarters.

items.name: cutlass fake
items.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a broad saber known for its use by sailors and pirates.

items.name: cutlass replica
items.description: This is a broad saber known for its use by sailors and pirates.  This sword appears to be made very poorly, but it should still stand up to a few swings.

items.name: cutting board
items.description: A large flat piece of wood for chopping vegetables on without ruining your knife or your countertop.

items.name: set of spectrometry cuvettes
items.description: This is a small box filled with precisely calibrated square plastic tubes for laboratory spectrometer use.

items.name: Cx4 Storm
items.description: A small pistol caliber carbine designed for police use and civilian self-defense, the Cx4 Storm uses magazines that are interchangeable with other Beretta 9x19mm handguns.

items.name: CZ-75
items.description: The CZ-75 is a semi-automatic pistol developed in Czechoslovakia, and is one of the original wonder nines.  Though designed for export to western countries, it was declared a state secret; lack of international patent protection meant that many clones and variants were produced and distributed around the world, with Česká zbrojovka only joining in the 90's.  This pistol remains wildly popular among competition shooters.

items.name: CZ 75 12-round magazine
items.description: A 12-round steel box magazine for use with the CZ 75.

items.name: CZ 75 20-round magazine
items.description: A 20-round steel box magazine for use with the CZ 75.

items.name: CZ 75 26-round magazine
items.description: A 26-round steel box magazine for use with the CZ 75.

items.name: dab pen
items.description: A battery operated dab pen used for smoking cannabis distillate cartridges.

items.name: dab pen (on)
items.description: This dab pen, for vaporizing cannabis, is turned on.  Now all you need is a distillate cartridge and you're ready to rock and roll.

items.name: baked dahlia root
items.description: Baking this dahlia root has broken down the starch, making it softer and sweeter.

items.name: dahlia bud
items.description: A dahlia bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a dahlia.

items.name: dahlia
items.description: A dahlia stalk with some petals.

items.name: dahlia root
items.description: The large, tuberous root of a dahlia flower.  It smells spicy, but is too starchy to eat without cooking.

items.name: Things to do with Milk
items.description: Whatever you want to do with milk, you will probably find it in this book.

items.name: damaged shelter kit
items.description: This is a small shelter, made of sticks and skins.  Use it to place.  This shelter has been damaged, and needs repairs.

items.name: pair of dance shoes
items.description: Expensive black dance shoes with large heels.

items.name: cooked dandelion greens
items.description: Cooked leaves from wild dandelions.  Tasty and nutritious.

items.name: fried dandelions
items.description: Wild dandelion flowers that have been battered and deep-fried.  Very tasty and nutritious.

items.name: dandelion tea
items.description: A healthy beverage made from dandelion roots steeped in boiling water.

items.name: dandelion wine
items.description: A light and delicious wine made from dandelion flowers.  Slightly effervescent, it is smooth and crisp.

items.name: fried dandelions and burdocks
items.description: Wild dandelions and burdocks that have been battered and deep-fried.  Very tasty and nutritious.

items.name: dandelion and burdock tea
items.description: A healthy beverage made from dandelion and burdock roots steeped in boiling water.  The additional ingredient makes it slightly healthier and fun.

items.name: dao
items.description: An ancient Chinese sword consisting of a curved blade and a guard with a cupped design.  Existing since the Shang dynasty, this one is made of bronze.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the jian sword, qiang spear, and gun staff.

items.name: data card
items.description: Some type of advanced data storage device.  Useful for storing very large amounts of information.

items.name: datura seeds
items.description: Small, dark seeds from the spiny pods of a datura plant.  Full of powerful psychoactive chemicals, these tiny seeds are a potent analgesic and deliriant, and can be deadly in cases of overdose.

items.name: daypack
items.description: An ultralight nylon backpack intended for one-day hiking trips.  Waterproof, slim, and spacious.

items.name: non-drowsy cough syrup
items.description: Daytime cold and flu medication.  Non-drowsy formula.  Will suppress coughing, aching, headaches and runny noses, but you'll still need lots of fluids and rest.

items.name: Desert Eagle .44
items.description: One of the most recognizable handguns due to its popularity in movies and video games, the Desert Eagle is better known for its menacing appearance than its performance.  It's a large pistol, but its heavy weight reduces recoil.

items.name: Desert Eagle magazine
items.description: A standard 7-round steel box magazine for use with the IMI Desert Eagle.

items.name: note
items.description: A scrap of paper.  Something's written on it, scrawled in bad handwriting.

items.name: Cube of Shame
items.description: This is a debug-only item for testing relic properties, powered by batteries.  Turn it on to lose intelligence and perception, but gain clairvoyance.

items.name: Cube of Shame (on)
items.description: This is a debug-only item for testing relic properties, powered by batteries.  Drop it or turn it off to retrieve your mind.

items.name: holy SPAM of debugging
items.description: A mysterious lump of SPAM that contains just enough calories and vitamins to feed you for a day.  For debug use only.

items.name: debug shrapnel
items.description: This item, which shouldn't exist, has shrapnel range larger than the reality itself.

items.name: Trapezohedron of Edginess
items.description: This is a debug-only item for testing enchantment mutations.  Wield it to stay up all night, become stealthy, and to see in the dark.

items.name: deck of cards
items.description: A deck of 52 playing cards.

items.name: yule wreath
items.description: This decorative wreath can be deployed as furniture to decorate for the winter holidays.

items.name: AAA Guide
items.description: A tourist-centric guide to points of interest throughout the country.  Though it focuses on the north-central US, the driving sections contain some practical tips on proper driving techniques.

items.name: standpipe maintenance log
items.description: This binder details the scheduled maintenance for several plumbing systems throughout the facility.

items.name: food dehydrator
items.description: This is a portable electric food dehydrator.  It's powered by batteries, and could be invaluable in preserving food.

items.name: delayed fuze
items.description: A complex mechanical fuze.  It seems it can be used to detonate stable explosives after a short time by triggering it.

items.name: baked beans
items.description: Slow-cooked beans with meat.  Tasty and very filling.

items.name: deluxe beans and rice
items.description: Slow-cooked beans and rice with meat and seasonings.  Tasty and very filling.

items.name: deluxe scrambled eggs
items.description: Fluffy and delicious scrambled eggs made more delicious with the addition of other tasty ingredients.

items.name: meat fried rice
items.description: Delicious fried rice with meat.  Tasty and very filling.

items.name: vegetarian baked beans
items.description: Slow-cooked beans with vegetables.  Tasty and very filling.

items.name: deluxe vegetarian beans and rice
items.description: Slow-cooked beans and rice with vegetables and seasonings.  Tasty and very filling.

items.name: fried rice
items.description: Delicious fried rice with vegetables.  Tasty and very filling.

items.name: denatured alcohol
items.description: A high-strength ethanol solution mixed with methanol to make it toxic to drink, so as to avoid pre-apocalyptic regulations on ethanol.  Intended for use in alcohol-burning stoves and as a solvent.

items.name: salvaged power armor
items.description: This used to be a powered exoskeleton with a set of heavy armor plates, made wearable by the assist of the servos.  Now it's just the armor plating and a stripped down chassis: as one might expect, it's a lot harder to wear.

items.name: salvaged power armor helmet
items.description: This used to be a military-grade full-head helmet with advanced optics and environmental filters.  It looks like it was decommissioned or otherwise stripped for parts; now it's a very expensive hat.  It's still quite durable, but quite hard to see out of.

items.name: detergent
items.description: A popular pre-Cataclysm washing powder.

items.name: deviled kidney
items.description: A delicious way to prepare kidneys.

items.name: diamond
items.description: A sparkling diamond.

items.name: diamond dental grill
items.description: Fake teeth inlaid with diamonds, worn over the teeth.  Fits horribly, but looks very shiny.  For that high-class gangsta rap look.

items.name: diamond and gold bracelet
items.description: A gold bracelet with sparkling diamonds.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: diamond and gold cufflinks
items.description: A pair of cufflinks with inset diamonds.

items.name: pair of diamond and gold earrings
items.description: A pair of shiny diamond and gold earrings.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: diamond and gold pendant necklace
items.description: A shiny, gold necklace adorned with a diamond pendant.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: diamond and gold tiara
items.description: A shiny, gold tiara adorned with diamonds.

items.name: diamond and platinum bracelet
items.description: A platinum bracelet with sparkling diamonds.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: diamond and platinum cufflinks
items.description: A pair of cufflinks with inset diamonds.

items.name: pair of diamond and platinum earrings
items.description: A pair of shiny diamond and platinum earrings.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: diamond and platinum pendant necklace
items.description: A shiny, platinum necklace adorned with a diamond pendant.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: diamond and platinum ring
items.description: A platinum ring with a diamond mounted on top of it.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: diamond and platinum tiara
items.description: A shiny, platinum tiara adorned with diamonds.

items.name: diamond and gold ring
items.description: A gold ring with a sparkling diamond mounted on top of it.  Back in the old days this could be worth a fortune.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: diamond and silver bracelet
items.description: A silver bracelet with sparkling diamonds.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: diamond and silver cufflinks
items.description: A pair of cufflinks with inset diamonds.

items.name: pair of diamond and silver earrings
items.description: A pair of shiny diamond and silver earrings.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: diamond and silver pendant necklace
items.description: A shiny, silver necklace adorned with a diamond pendant.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: diamond and silver ring
items.description: A silver ring with a diamond mounted on top of it.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: diamond and silver tiara
items.description: A shiny, silver tiara adorned with diamonds.

items.name: drop-in auto sear
items.description: This is a vaguely 'U' shaped piece of metal with a vaguely 'T' shaped flapper on a pin.  Once tucked into an AR-15's lower receiver, the rifle will become selective fire-capable.  The handcrafted-sear surface isn't as good as actual full-auto parts, so precision suffers slightly.

items.name: diazepam
items.description: A strong benzodiazepine drug used to treat muscle spasms, anxiety, seizures, and panic attacks.

items.name: diesel
items.description: Petroleum-based fuel made from a byproduct of the gasoline making process.

items.name: digging stick
items.description: This is a large stick, with the end carved into a broad blade for digging.  It could be used to dig shallow pits, but not deep ones.

items.name: 5-point anchor
items.description: A featureless, disc-shaped device mounted on a harness.  The words "X.E.D.R.A" and "5-point anchor" are inscribed on its front and back.

items.name: 5-point anchor (on)
items.description: The harness' shoulder mounted LED glows with a soft green hue.  There's no further indication of anything happening.

items.name: dinosaur suit
items.description: A full-body costume in the form of an anthropomorphic dinosaur.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.

items.name: directed floodlight
items.description: A large and heavy light designed to illuminate a wide area in a half-circular cone.

items.name: directional antenna
items.description: This is an antenna designed to pick up signals better when pointed at the source.  You could use this with a radio to receive faint signals.

items.name: disc
items.description: A plastic disc made for playing disc golf, it is smaller and denser then a normal frisbee.

items.name: dishwasher
items.description: A very small dishwasher designed for use in vehicles.

items.name: antiseptic soaked cotton balls
items.description: Fluffy balls of clean white cotton.  Now soaked with antiseptic, they are somewhat useful to disinfect a wound.

items.name: antiseptic
items.description: A powerful antiseptic commonly used for contaminated wounds.

items.name: makeshift antiseptic
items.description: Makeshift antiseptic made from ethanol.  Can be used to disinfect a wound.

items.name: antiseptic soaked rag
items.description: A rag soaked in antiseptic.  Useful for light wounds, probably won't help with deep bites.

items.name: distaff and spindle
items.description: A pair of specialized wooden rods used to spin fibers into thread and yarn.

items.name: Out of the Holler and into the Home: A guide to home distilation.
items.description: A book describing the history of at home distillation by liquor.  Each chapter contains a complete recipe for its namesake.

items.name: dive bag
items.description: A lightweight mesh backpack, commonly worn by swimmers and divers.

items.name: dive knife
items.description: This is a short, sturdy knife with a serrated edge for cutting lines and straps, and a blunt tip for prying.  Used primarily by divers, it is very light and takes up virtually no space in one's pockets.

items.name: diver's watch
items.description: A waterproof, self-winding watch on a stainless steel watchband.  Tells the time and current temperature.  Activate to check the digital thermometer.

items.name: Dungeon Master's Guide: 6th Edition
items.description: A thick, hardcover volume with everything needed to weave legendary stories.  It's full of information, but finding the things you're looking for can be a chore.

items.name: dog whistle
items.description: This is a small whistle.  When used, it produces a high tone that causes nearby friendly dogs to either follow you closely and stop attacking, or start attacking enemies if they are currently docile.

items.name: wooden dog whistle
items.description: This is a whistle carved out of hardwood.  When used, it produces a high tone that causes nearby friendly dogs to either follow you closely and stop attacking, or start attacking enemies if they are currently docile.

items.name: dogbane
items.description: A stalk of dogbane.  It has very fibrous stems and is mildly poisonous.

items.name: dog food
items.description: This is food for dogs.  It smells strange, but dogs seem to love it.

items.name: donut holes
items.description: These balls of dough have been cut into shape, covered with sugar, and cooked to a crisp.  A staple of fairgrounds everywhere.

items.name: reactor core expansion device
items.description: This is an expansion device for use on plutonium-powered equipment.  With enough electronics skill, you could attach this to an atomic tool to double the amount of plutonium it can hold.  Note that this device is incompatible with the atomic battery mod.

items.name: double speargun
items.description: A double-loading underwater fishing implement designed to fire a specialized type of spear using tension in a rubber band.  While highly effective when used underwater, it is nearly useless on dry land.

items.name: down-filled blanket
items.description: Hiding under here will not protect you from the monsters, but it'll keep you warm.

items.name: down feather
items.description: Fluffy down feathers from a bird.  Useful for making cozy bedclothes.

items.name: down mattress
items.description: This is a single, or twin, sized down filled mattress.

items.name: down-filled pillow
items.description: A fluffy pillow to rest your head on when sleeping.

items.name: Mini Draco
items.description: Essentially a semi-auto AK with a short barrel and no stock, this unwieldy "pistol" has seen some popularity with civilian shooters and gangbangers alike.

items.name: dragon skin vest
items.description: A state-of-the-art, lightweight, flexible, bullet resistant vest.  The ceramic disks used in its construction make it impossible to repair, only replace.

items.name: lamellar Kevlar vest
items.description: A lamellar Kevlar vest, there are intricately cut voids usually filled with stitched in ceramic disks, you could repair the stitching if needed

items.name: dress
items.description: A long cotton dress.  Though comfortable to wear, it lacks any storage space.

items.name: dress shirt
items.description: A white button-down shirt with long sleeves.  Looks professional!

items.name: pair of dress shoes
items.description: Fancy patent leather shoes.  Not designed for running in.

items.name: wedding dress
items.description: A beautiful white wedding dress.  What good will it be now?

items.name: dried salad
items.description: Dried salad packed in a box with mayonnaise and ketchup.  Add water to enjoy.

items.name: bee's knees
items.description: This cocktail dates from the Prohibition era.  Gin, honey and lemon in a delightful mix.

items.name: boozeberry
items.description: This fermented blueberry mixture is surprisingly hearty, though the soup-like consistency is slightly unsettling no matter how much you drink.

items.name: fancy hobo
items.description: This definitely tastes like a hobo drink.

items.name: kalimotxo
items.description: A mix of equal parts wine and cola.  It's not as bad as some might imagine, and pretty popular among young and/or poor people in some countries.

items.name: martini
items.description: This is a popular cocktail made with gin and dry vermouth, dating from the Prohibition era.

items.name: rum & cola
items.description: Suitable for tropical retreats and Canadian artists alike.

items.name: screwdriver cocktail
items.description: A mix of orange juice and vodka.  It's the surreptitious drunkard mechanic's drink of choice.

items.name: sewer brew
items.description: Improvised, uncontrolled mutagen.  It tastes horrible too!

items.name: strawberry surprise
items.description: Strawberries left to ferment with a few other choice ingredients offer up a surprisingly palatable mixture; you barely even have to force yourself to drink it after the first few gulps.

items.name: wild apple
items.description: Like apple cider, only with vodka.

items.name: whiskey sour
items.description: A mixed drink made of whiskey and lemon juice.

items.name: drinking hat
items.description: This is an improvised harness that can be worn over other headgear or bare head, made from two small liquid containers, a rubber hose, a bundle of steel wire, and some cordage.  A convenient and simple device for hands-free drinking, though the liquid inside would spill if you put it into your backpack.

items.name: drive by wire controls
items.description: Fully electronic vehicle control system.  You could control it remotely if you had proper tools.

items.name: drive belt
items.description: A synthetic rubber V-belt with steel reinforcement fibers commonly fitted to engines or other industrial equipment.

items.name: makeshift drive belt
items.description: An improvised belt useful for repairing engines or other industrial equipment when no better alternative is available.

items.name: dried beans
items.description: Dehydrated great northern beans.  Tasty and nutritious when cooked, virtually inedible when dry.

items.name: dehydrated fish
items.description: Dehydrated fish flakes.  With proper storage, this dried food will remain edible for an incredibly long time.

items.name: dehydrated fruit
items.description: Dehydrated fruit flakes.  With proper storage, this dried food will remain edible for an incredibly long time.  They are useful for several cooking recipes.

items.name: dried lentils
items.description: A humble but nutrient-rich legume.  Should be cooked prior to consumption.

items.name: dehydrated meat
items.description: Dehydrated meat flakes.  With proper storage, this dried food will remain edible for an incredibly long time.

items.name: dehydrated tainted meat
items.description: Pieces of poisonous meat that have been dried to prevent them from rotting away.  It will still poison you if you eat this.

items.name: dried mushroom
items.description: Dried mushrooms are a tasty and healthy addition to many meals.

items.name: dried rice
items.description: Dehydrated long-grain rice.  Tasty and nutritious when cooked, virtually inedible when dry.

items.name: dehydrated tofu
items.description: Dehydrated tofu, sealed and still extra firm to last a long time.

items.name: dehydrated vegetable
items.description: Dehydrated vegetable flakes.  With proper storage, this dried food will remain edible for an incredibly long time.

items.name: dehydrated alien fungus chunk
items.description: Pieces of alien mushroom that have been dried to prevent them from rotting away.  It will still poison you if you eat this.

items.name: duct tape
items.description: A roll of incredibly strong tape.  Its uses are innumerable.

items.name: duffel bag
items.description: A huge duffel bag.  Provides plenty of storage, but is severely encumbering.

items.name: tactical dump pouch
items.description: An expandable pouch secured with straps.  Provides a bit of extra storage with minimal encumbrance.

items.name: duster
items.description: A rugged full-length duster coat.  Has many pockets for storage.

items.name: faux fur duster
items.description: A thick faux fur duster, falling below your knees.  Has many pockets for storing things.

items.name: fur duster
items.description: A thick fur full-length duster.  Has many pockets for storage.

items.name: leather duster
items.description: A thick leather full-length duster.  Has many pockets for storage.

items.name: survivor duster
items.description: A Kevlar armored custom full-length duster, covered with pouches and pockets.  Comfortable, durable, and great for storage.

items.name: cloth dye powder
items.description: This is a powdered colorful cloth dye, which can be used to dye many fabrics if combined with water and some mordant.

items.name: dynamite
items.description: These are several sticks of explosives with a fuse attached.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  Shortly after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, so get away!

items.name: dynamite (lit)
items.description: The fuse on this dynamite is lit and hissing.  It'll explode any moment now.

items.name: dynamite bomb
items.description: These are several sticks of explosives surrounded by shrapnel stuffed inside a metal container.  The fuse is sticking out through a small hole.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  Shortly after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, so get away!

items.name: dynamite bomb (lit)
items.description: The fuse on this dynamite bomb is lit and hissing.  It'll explode any moment now.

items.name: electric combat chainsaw (off)
items.description: This is an electric chainsaw that has been lightened, tuned, and extensively modified to be a more effective weapon.  Unfortunately these modifications have rendered it much less effective as a woodcutting tool.

items.name: electric combat chainsaw (on)
items.description: This electric combat chainsaw is on, and is continuously draining power.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: electronic handcuffs
items.description:
A pair of electronic handcuffs, used by police and riot bots to detain captives.  Their continuous siren clearly identifies the wearer as an arrested criminal and alerts human police.  Wait for their arrival, don't try to escape or to remove the cuffs - they will administer an electric shock.
However, since the only police likely to respond are undead, you may have a long wait ahead, unless you get creative…

items.name: electronic scrap
items.description: A random collection of resistors, capacitors, and diodes which have been stripped from printed circuits.

items.name: entrenching tool
items.description: This is a stout collapsible spade.  It's commonly used by military forces and favored by hikers for digging.  This was a popular weapon during WW1.

items.name: pair of ear plugs
items.description: Industrial grade ear plugs.  They fit inside the ear.

items.name: plug
items.description: Those round things people plug into their earlobes as earrings, also called "ear plug" or "ear spool."  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: earthbag
items.description: This is a canvas sack filled with soil.  It can be used to construct simple barricades.

items.name: eboshi
items.description: A high, black cap with a very narrow top.  Traditionally worn by Shinto priests.

items.name: electronic cigarette
items.description: This battery-operated device vaporizes a liquid that contains flavorings and nicotine.  A less harmful alternative to traditional cigarettes, but it's still addictive.  It can't be reused once it's empty.

items.name: pair of eclipse glasses
items.description: A pair of cardboard-framed glasses with UV and IR-filtered lenses topped with a layer of aluminum coating.  They allow safe viewing of extremely bright and harmful sources of light, like the sun during a solar eclipse.

items.name: electric chainsaw lajatang (off)
items.description: A long wooden pole with electric chainsaws impractically attached to both ends.  The product of either genius or insanity, but not both; the weight ensures that only someone both strong and very skilled could possibly hope to use it.

items.name: electric chainsaw lajatang (on)
items.description: A long wooden pole with electric chainsaws impractically attached to both ends.  They are currently on and draining power; use this item to turn them off.

items.name: roasted edamame
items.description: Roasted edamame, a heart healthy snack.

items.name: effective emitter
items.description: A set of electronics to optimize emitter workcycle and increase overall energy efficiency.  Decreases power consumption.

items.name: bird egg
items.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

items.name: unfertilized bird egg
items.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.  This one is unfertilized and is probably from a farm.

items.name: chicken egg
items.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

items.name: cockatrice egg
items.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

items.name: crow egg
items.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

items.name: duck egg
items.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

items.name: roe
items.description: Common roe from an unknown fish.

items.name: goose egg
items.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

items.name: grouse egg
items.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

items.name: insect egg
items.description: A egg from a locust, a bit bigger than a chicken one.

items.name: pheasant egg
items.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

items.name: reptile egg
items.description: An egg belonging to one of reptile species found in New England.

items.name: eggnog
items.description: Smooth and rich, this spoon-coating mix of milk, cream, and eggs is a popular traditional holiday drink.  While often spiked, it is still delicious on its own.  Meant to be stored cold, it will spoil rapidly.

items.name: spiked eggnog
items.description: Smooth and rich, this spoon-coating mixture of milk, cream, eggs, and booze is a popular traditional holiday drink.  Having been fortified with alcohol, it will keep for a long time.

items.name: fermenting eggs jar
items.description: This jar contains a batch of eggs in a pickling solution.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

items.name: e-ink tablet PC
items.description: A tablet PC using an efficient color e-ink display.  Before the Cataclysm, these were nifty gadgets; now, it's an almost priceless resource.

items.name: pair of elbow pads
items.description: A pair of elbow pads made of stout plastic and cloth.

items.name: elderberries
items.description: Elderberries, toxic when eaten raw but great when cooked.

items.name: electric chainsaw (off)
items.description: This is a lumbering tool moonlighting as weapon of opportunity.  If loaded with batteries, using this item will cause it to turn on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon.

items.name: electric chainsaw (on)
items.description: This electric chainsaw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: electric hair trimmer
items.description: This is a pocket-sized electric trimmer made for cutting hair.  You can use it to cut your hair if it's supplied with batteries.  It requires 10 batteries per use.

items.name: electric jackhammer
items.description: This is a construction tool for drilling through hard rock or other surfaces.  It runs on a cell compatible with UPS.  Use it to blast a hole in adjacent solid terrain.

items.name: electric shears
items.description: These electric shears can be used to shear animals quicker.

items.name: electric blanket
items.description: A heated blanket made of polyester.  The most comfortable thing on Earth.  Its cost is usually negligible, but with the power out, it chews through batteries insanely quickly.

items.name: electric blanket (on)
items.description: A heated blanket made of polyster.  It's turned on, making it nice and toasty while it lasts.

items.name: electric lantern (off)
items.description: This is a battery-powered lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to turn it on.

items.name: electric lantern (on)
items.description: This is a battery-powered lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to turn it on.

items.name: electrohack
items.description: This device has many ports attached, allowing it to connect to almost any control panel or other electronic machine (but not computers).  With a little skill, it can be used to crack passwords and more.  It requires 25 charges of battery power per use.

items.name: electrolaser conversion
items.description: A set of high-tech electronics and optics.  These converts a laser pistol into a less-lethal electrolaser capable of stunning targets, at the cost of a decreased damage output and increased power consumption.

items.name: electrolysis kit
items.description: A set of wiring and electrodes for applying a direct current, usually to a liquid.  Useful for crafting.  Load with a storage battery or 12V vehicle battery to use.

items.name: electronics control unit
items.description: A vehicle instrument panel with various gauges and switches.  Useful for crafting.

items.name: heating element
items.description: A heating element, like the ones used in hotplates or kettles.

items.name: folded emergency blanket
items.description: A folded blanket made of space-age materials that covers your most important body parts.  Use it to unfold for use.

items.name: emergency blanket
items.description: A blanket made of space-age material that covers your most important body parts.  Use it to fold for storage.

items.description: A thick textbook for paramedics describing advanced lifesaving procedures and field-expedient care methods.

items.name: XM34 EMP projector

items.name: energy drink

items.name: atomic energy drink

items.description: The beginnings of a large gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.

items.name: entry suit
items.description: A flame-resistant whole-body garment worn by firefighters as protection against extreme heat.  Though very restrictive, wearing it will provide excellent protection against fire and smoke.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection.

items.name: ESAPI ballistic plate
items.description: A polygonal ceramic ballistic plate with a slightly concave profile.  Its inner surface is coated with Ultra High Molecular Weight Polyethylene, and is labelled "TOP", while its outer surface is labelled "STRIKE FACE".  This is intended to be worn in a ballistic vest and can withstand several high energy rifle rounds before breaking.

items.name: ESBI ballistic plate
items.description: A polygonal ceramic ballistic plate with a slightly concave profile.  "STRIKE FACE" is printed on its outer surface.  This is designed to be worn in the sides of a plate carrier and can withstand several high energy rifle rounds before breaking.

items.name: hexamine stove
items.description: Known as an Esbit stove, this is a lightweight, folding stove designed to use small hexamine tablets for cooking.

items.name: book of essays
items.description: A collection of essays by various authors from around the world, including works by Churchill, Mailer, Eco, and Voltaire.

items.name: estoc
items.description: This is a thin thrusting sword, a sort of predecessor to the rapier.  It requires a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.

items.name: estoc fake
items.description: This is a dull, cheaply-made replica of a thin thrusting sword predating the rapier.  It requires a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.

items.name: estoc replica
items.description: This is a thin thrusting sword, a sort of predecessor to the rapier.  It requires a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.  It seems a bit too bendy.

items.name: etched human skull
items.description: This is a human skull with strange etchings covering it.

items.name: ether
items.description: Diethyl ether largely supplanted the use of chloroform as a general anesthetic due to ether's more favorable therapeutic index, that is, a greater difference between an effective dose and a potentially toxic dose.

items.name: European pilsner
items.description: A lager beer imported from Europe.  Best served cold, in a glass - but you're not that lucky.

items.name: FEMA evacuation pamphlet
items.description:
Welcome to your Emergency Survival Shelter.  We hope your stay here will be short and comfortable.  Provided are an emergency blanket, high visibility jacket, gas mask, and food and water rations for one day, as well as an emergency lighter and flashlight.  There are further supplies in the communal cabinets should the facility be over its intended capacity.  These resources are checked and updated by FEMA on a regular basis, but if you find some items missing, please contact a FEMA supervisor at your earliest convenience.

Please wait in the shelter until an official evacuation transport arrives to take you to your homes or, in the event of a major disaster, to the nearest evacuation gathering point.

In the event that you have been evacuated under violent circumstances, FEMA recommends taking cover in the shelter's basement until help arrives.  Remember: if you leave the shelter, we cannot find you to take you to safety.
