items.name: MAS 223
items.description: A bullpup assault rifle that was used by French armed forces only until recently.  While the FAMAS was famous for its high fire rate, the MAS .223 is a semi-auto only variation imported to the US in the late eighties.  It retains the integral bipod, though.

items.name: MAS 223 magazine
items.description: A 25-round magazine for the MAS 223.  It resembles a STANAG magazine but is not compatible nor interchangeable.

items.name: family cookbook
items.description: A big binder full of somebody's family recipes.  The well-turned pages and creased corners speak volumes of the culinary knowledge contained within.  You could probably learn a lot about cooking from studying this domestic artifact.

items.name: family photo
items.description: A photo of a smiling family on a camping trip.  One of the parents looks like a cleaner, happier version of the person you know.

items.name: desk fan
items.description: A small fan, used to propel air around a room.

items.name: pair of stylish sunglasses
items.description: A pair of stylish sunglasses.  Look good while keeping the glare out of your eyes.

items.name: fanny pack
items.description: Provides a bit of extra storage, with minimal encumbrance.

items.name: chunk of fat
items.description: Freshly butchered fat.  You could eat it raw, but it is better used as an ingredient in other foods or projects.

items.name: tainted fat
items.description: A watery yellow glob of fat from some unnatural creature or other.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.

items.name: faux fur pelt
items.description: A small bolt of garishly colored faux fur.  Can be made into clothing.

items.name: pair of faux fur cat ears
items.description: A fuzzy pair of garishly colored cat ears on a headband.  It does nothing, but there's no reason not to look good even if no one's looking.

items.name: faux fur cat tail
items.description: A fuzzy garishly colored tail weighted down with tiny beads of plastic.  Sways behind you when you walk.

items.name: faux fur kitty collar
items.description: A decorative 'collar' made out of faux fur.  Complete with a little bell hanging from the front.  Don't worry, it's silent.

items.name: fancy hairpin
items.description: A pink hairpin with cute flower textures.

items.name: deep-fried chicken
items.description: Chicken cooked while submerged in oil.  It's greasy and delicious.

items.name: feather
items.description: Feathers from a bird.  Useful for fletching arrows.

items.name: bird litter
items.description: Bird dropping, feathers, and soiled bits of rubbish.

items.name: cow pie
items.description: A fresh cow pie, could probably be used to make some great fertilizer.

items.name: dog dung
items.description: Droppings from a canine.

items.name: manure
items.description: Common manure, could probably be used to make some great fertilizer.

items.name: roach dirt
items.description: Large black pellets of rotting material.

items.name: fedora
items.description: A high-crowned, wide-brimmed, sable colored fedora.  Its brim helps keep the sun out of your eyes.  The perfect hat for treasure hunting.

items.name: felt patch
items.description: A smallish patch of felt, could be disassembled for wool fiber.

items.name: fencing épée
items.description: A weapon used for fencing, the most noble of all sports.  The épée is the heaviest and stiffest of the fencing weapons, and therefore perhaps the most useful.

items.name: sharpened épée
items.description: This once mostly harmless fencing épée has had its electrical plunger assembly removed and has been crudely sharpened to a point.  Though it still lacks a cutting edge, it is now considerably more lethal, yet still familiar to the practiced fencer.

items.name: fencing foil
items.description: A weapon used for fencing, the most noble of all sports.  Unfortunately, a fencing foil is rather useless as a weapon, due to its flexible shaft and dull tip.

items.name: sharpened foil
items.description: This once mostly harmless fencing foil has had its electrical plunger assembly removed and has been crudely sharpened to a point.  Though it still lacks a cutting edge, it is now somewhat more lethal, yet still familiar to the practiced fencer.

items.name: fencing jacket
items.description: A padded jacket with the zipper on the back used by fencers to prevent accidents.  It doesn't have any storage room, but it is very comfortable.

items.name: fencing mask
items.description: A tough hood made of steel mesh used by fencers.

items.name: fencing pants
items.description: A pair of reinforced pants used by fencers to prevent injuries.

items.name: fencing saber
items.description: A weapon used for fencing, the most noble of all sports.  The fencing saber is marginally shorter than the foil and épée, but no less effective.

items.name: sharpened saber
items.description: This once mostly harmless fencing saber has had its rounded tip snapped off and has been crudely sharpened to a point.  Though it still lacks a cutting edge, it is now considerably more lethal, yet still familiar to the practiced fencer.

items.name: Fermenting Culture
items.description: Fermenting as a cooking practice only recently came back into vogue before the Cataclysm.  Here is a book with dozens of recipes, many of which you are unlikely to ever see the ingredients for again.

items.name: fertilizer
items.description: A token, representing fertilization of a plant.

items.name: commercial fertilizer
items.description: Nutrient rich granules for plants.

items.name: liquid fertilizer
items.description: A nutrient rich elixir for plants.

items.name: fetid goop
items.description: A foul smelling goop.  It has a disgusting texture and a powerful smell that overrides every other smell around it.

items.name: misshapen fetus
items.description: A deformed human fetus.  Eating this would be the most vile thing you can think of, and just might cause you to mutate.

items.name: fiber mat
items.description: A large mat woven from fibrous material that can be used instead of a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a butchery appliance.  Too thin to be used as a comfortable sleeping place.  It's rolled and ready for carrying.

items.name: boiled fiddleheads
items.description: Boiled fiddleheads.  Not bad, but would be better sauteed in butter.

items.name: fiddleheads
items.description: A handful of immature fern fronds, still curled up like the head of a fiddle.  Delicious when cooked, but consuming raw can cause food poisoning.

items.name: sauteed fiddleheads
items.description: Fiddleheads sauteed in fat.  Tender and delicious.

items.name: fungal fighter sting
items.description: A short dart from a fungal fighter.  Makes a poor melee weapon.

items.name: file
items.description: Several documents with all kinds of information, customer data and charts kept together, pretty useless now though.

items.name: air filter
items.description: A plastic box containing creped paper used to filter the air supply for combustion engines or other industrial equipment.

items.name: makeshift air filter
items.description: An improvised air filter useful for repairing engines or other industrial equipment when no better alternative is available.

items.name: automotive filter
items.description: A steel can containing filter paper designed for automotive use.

items.name: makeshift automotive filter
items.description: An improvised automotive filter useful for repairing engines or other industrial equipment when no better alternative is available.

items.name: qualitative filter paper
items.description: filter paper for seperating solids from liquids.  This filter paper has a rating of 2 microns, seperating more solids out than quantitative filter paper but the process takes longer.

items.name: quantitative filter paper
items.description: filter paper for seperating solids from liquids.  This filter paper has a rating of 20 microns, seperating less solids out than qualitative filter paper but the process is much faster.

items.name: 'solvent trap' suppressor
items.description: This is an automotive filter crudely adapted to mate up with a firearm's barrel, generating an illegal, unregistered suppressor.  Good thing there don't seem to be any ATF agents around to arrest you.  While close in design to a real suppressor, it was not designed for high pressures involved and will eventually lose effectiveness.  The installed filter is large and, when attached, will interfere with your ability to aim down the base sights of the gun.

items.name: nearby fire
items.description: seeing this is a bug

items.name: fire axe
items.description: This is a large, two-handed pickhead axe normally used by firefighters.  It makes a powerful melee weapon, but is a bit slow to recover between swings.

items.name: fire brick
items.description: A reinforced brick designed to withstand intense heat.

items.name: fire drill
items.description: This fire drill is a simple item for starting fires; it is made from two pieces of wood and some string.  Since it is constructed out of simple materials, it's slow and rather difficult to get a fire started using this tool.

items.name: camp fire drill
items.description: This stout fire drill is a simple item for starting fires; it is made from two pieces of wood and some string.  Since it is constructed out of simple materials, it's slow and rather difficult to get a fire started using this tool.

items.name: pair of fire gauntlets
items.description: A heavy pair of gloves, used by firefighters and metalworkers for heat protection.  Highly resistant to heat and flame, they provide excellent protection from injury.

items.name: firecracker
items.description: A solitary firecracker with a short fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Of course, you will need a lighter or some matches to do so.  Shortly after you light the fuse it will explode, so throw it quickly!

items.name: firecracker (lit)
items.description: A firecracker that has been lit; the fuse is hissing.  Throw it quickly before it explodes.

items.name: pack of firecrackers
items.description: This is a pack of 25 firecrackers with a starter fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Of course, you will need a lighter or some matches to do so.  Shortly after you light the fuse they will begin to explode, so throw them quickly!

items.name: pack of firecrackers (lit)
items.description: A pack of 25 firecrackers that has been lit; the fuse is hissing.  Throw them quickly before the start to explode.

items.name: firefighter helmet
items.description: A distinctive helmet worn by firefighters.  More than just a piece of firefighting equipment, it serves as a badge of honor and respect.

items.name: Rising Sun
items.description: This is a katana with a nozzle just behind the cutting edge of the blade.  People love fire, and people love katanas, so why not put them together?  The gas burners attached to this blade can really turn up the heat on your foes.  Use to ignite.

items.name: Rising Sun
items.description: This is a katana that glows with the fury and heat of the SUN!  Well, okay it's not THAT hot, but getting hit with it still stings like the dickens.  Use to shut off the gas.

items.name: No. 9
items.description: This huge steel knife has been modified with a fuel tank, insulated handguard, and ignition system.  When filled with gasoline, a system of torches heats the blade, burning your target.

items.name: No. 9
items.description: This huge steel knife has been modified with a fuel tank, insulated handguard, and ignition system.  The blade is glowing with heat, making it a great plant scorcher and nightlight.

items.name: firefighter belt
items.description: A stout firefighter's belt.  Useful for keeping your bunker gear up, it also doubles as an equipment belt with a reinforced loop for holding a large tool.

items.name: fillet of fish
items.description: Freshly caught fish.  Makes a passable meal raw.

items.name: fish and spinach bagel
items.description: A delicious fish bagel with spinach and eggs.

items.name: fish bait
items.description: A bait used in traps to lure fish.

items.name: fishbowl
items.description: A filled fishbowl, the tag says 'to Ed' and the fish's name, 'Hoss'.  The fish appears to have tiny antlers.

items.name: canned fish
items.description: Low-sodium preserved fish.  It was boiled and canned.  Contains most of the nutrition, but little of the savor of cooked fish.

items.name: cooked fish
items.description: Freshly cooked fish.  Very nutritious.

items.name: batter fried fish
items.description: A delicious golden brown serving of crispy fried fish.

items.name: pickled fish
items.description: This is a serving of crisply brined and canned fish.  Tasty and nutritious.

items.name: fish sandwich
items.description: A delicious fish sandwich.

items.name: smoked fish
items.description: Tasty fish that has been heavily smoked for long term preservation.  It could be further smoked to dehydrate it completely.

items.name: plastic fish trap
items.description: This is a makeshift fish trap made from plastic bottles.  It's simple, even primitive, but easy to use.  The principle of action: the fish swims inside for bait, but can't get out.  Not humane, prohibited by law, but there are no cops left to care.

items.name: fishing hook
items.description: A simple fishing hook.

items.name: improvised fishing hook
items.description: An improvised fishing hook carved from wood or bone.

items.name: basic fishing rod
items.description: 'Fishing rod' might be a bit too charitable of a description.  In truth, this is a stick with a piece of string and a hook.

items.name: pro fishing rod
items.description: A professional fishing rod with a matching set of weights.  With this you should be able to catch 'em all.

items.name: pair of fishing waders
items.description: Waterproof plastic fishing waders with a single large front pocket.

items.name: wooden fishing spear
items.description: An underwater fishing spear made from wood tipped with steel.  It's very light, but doesn't have much range.  Stands a below average chance of remaining intact once fired.

items.name: fitness band
items.description: A fitness band that can track your heartbeat, exercise level and also has a clock.  Activate to see your metrics.

items.name: pair of fit-over sunglasses
items.description: A pair of fit-over sunglasses designed to be worn over a pair of corrective glasses.  Good for keeping the glare out of your eyes.

items.name: flag shirt
items.description: A t-shirt embroidered with the pattern of an American flag.

items.name: flammable arrow
items.description: This arrow has a rag soaked in a flammable liquid wrapped around the shaft near the head.  You need to light it before shooting.

items.name: flamethrower
items.description: A large flamethrower with substantial gas reserves.  Very menacing and deadly.

items.name: spraycan flamethrower
items.description: A favorite of hooligans around the world, this lighter duct-taped to a spray can is probably as dangerous to the user as anyone else.  The nozzle has been crudely modified to disperse gasoline, and a small pump attached to the side allows for repressurization, though this process takes a few minutes.

items.name: flamethrower fuel

items.name: glass flask

items.name: flatbread

items.name: flute

items.name: flyer
items.description: A scrap of paper.

items.name: FN 1910 .380

items.name: FN Five-Seven
items.description: Designed to work with FN's proprietary 5.7x28mm round, the Five-Seven is a lightweight pistol with a very high capacity, best used against armored opponents.

items.name: FN-57 magazine
items.description: A standard capacity magazine for use with the FN Five-Seven.

items.name: foie gras

items.name: foldable-light frame
