items.description: A single white glove covered with hundreds of rhinestones.

items.name: pair of bag gloves
items.description: A pair of disposable plastic bags, adapted to be used as gloves.

items.name: pair of cut resistant gloves
items.description: A pair of cut resistant gloves, useful when rapidly breaking down carcasses.

items.name: pair of fingerless gloves
items.description: A pair of leather gloves with no fingers, allowing greater manual dexterity.

items.name: pair of armored fingerless gloves
items.description: A pair of leather gloves with no fingers, allowing greater manual dexterity.  These have been crudely reinforced with steel guards across the back.

items.name: pair of survivor firegloves
items.description: A pair of customized, Kevlar armored Nomex gloves, modified to be easy to wear while providing maximum protection under extreme conditions.

items.name: pair of fur gloves
items.description: A pair of warm fur gloves.  They are somewhat cumbersome.

items.name: pair of golfing gloves
items.description: A thin pair of black leather golfing gloves.

items.name: pair of survivor wetsuit gloves
items.description: A pair of customized, Kevlar armored neoprene gloves, modified to be easy to wear while providing maximum protection under extreme conditions.

items.name: pair of heavy survivor gloves
items.description: A pair of heavily customized, steel-backed armored Kevlar gloves, modified to be easy to wear while providing maximum protection under extreme conditions.

items.name: pair of leather gloves
items.description: A thin pair of black leather gloves.

items.name: pair of light gloves
items.description: A pair of cotton gloves.

items.name: pair of glove liners
items.description: A pair of thin cotton gloves.  Often used as a liner beneath other gloves.

items.name: pair of light survivor gloves
items.description: A pair of customized, Kevlar armored cloth gloves, modified to be easy to wear while providing maximum protection under extreme conditions.

items.name: pair of medical gloves
items.description: A pair of thin latex gloves, designed to limit the spread of disease.

items.name: pair of armored gauntlets
items.description: An extremely heavy set of armor-plated leather gloves.

items.name: pair of rubber gloves
items.description: A pair of rubber gloves, often used while cleaning with caustic materials.

items.name: pair of survivor gloves
items.description: A pair of customized, Kevlar armored leather gloves, modified to be easy to wear while providing maximum protection under extreme conditions.

items.name: pair of fingerless survivor gloves
items.description: A pair of customized, Kevlar armored cloth gloves with no fingers, modified to be easy to wear while providing maximum protection under extreme conditions.

items.name: pair of tactical gloves
items.description: A pair of reinforced Kevlar tactical gloves.  Commonly used by police and military units.

items.name: pair of winter gloves
items.description: A pair of padded gloves.  Cumbersome, but warm.

items.name: pair of wool gloves
items.description: A thick pair of wool gloves.  Cumbersome, but warm.

items.name: pair of work gloves
items.description: A tough pair of gloves, for tough everyday work.

items.name: pair of hand wraps
items.description: Long pieces of cloth that are meant to be wrapped around your hands.  Provide small amounts of protection while punching and performing other general mischief.

items.name: pair of fur hand wraps
items.description: Pieces of animal pelt that are meant to be wrapped around your hands.  Provide small amounts of protection while punching and performing other general mischief.

items.name: pair of leather hand wraps
items.description: Pieces of leather that are meant to be wrapped around your hands.  Provide small amounts of protection while punching and performing other general mischief.

items.name: pair of wool hand wraps
items.description: Long pieces of wool that are meant to be wrapped around your hands.  Provide small amounts of protection while punching and performing other general mischief.

items.name: pair of winter survivor gloves
items.description: A pair of customized, Kevlar armored fur gloves, modified to be easy to wear while providing maximum protection under extreme conditions.

items.name: pair of XL survivor gloves
items.description: A massive pair of customized, Kevlar armored leather gloves, modified to be easy to wear while providing maximum protection under extreme conditions.

items.name: glow plug
items.description: A cylindrical heating device designed to be screwed in to a diesel engine to aid starting in cold weather.

items.name: glowstick
items.description: This is a small blue light glowstick.  Use it to bend the plastic and break the glass cylinder inside to start the reaction.  It will produce a small amount of light.

items.name: dead glowstick
items.description: This is a spent glowstick.  It is essentially trash.

items.name: active glowstick
items.description: This is an active glowstick and is producing light.  It will last for a few hours before burning out.

items.name: go bag
items.description: A huge duffel bag with backpack attached, both packed to the gills.  Judging by the feel, a National Guard soldier could have packed this to be ready for deployment.  Activate to unpack and enjoy.

items.name: pair of infrared goggles
items.description: A pair of battery-powered goggles that grant infrared vision, allowing you to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark.  Use it to turn them on.

items.name: pair of infrared goggles (on)
items.description: A pair of battery-powered goggles that grant infrared vision, allowing you to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark.  Use it to turn them off.

items.name: pair of light amp goggles
items.description: A pair of battery-powered goggles that amplify ambient light, allowing you to see in the dark.  Use it to turn them on.

items.name: pair of light amp goggles (on)
items.description: A pair of battery-powered light amplifying goggles with an infrared illuminator, allowing you to see in the dark.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn them off.

items.name: pair of ski goggles
items.description: A large pair of goggles that completely seal off your eyes.  Provides excellent protection from environmental dangers.

items.name: pair of swim goggles
items.description: A small pair of goggles made for swimming.

items.name: pair of welding goggles
items.description: A dark pair of goggles.  They make seeing very difficult, but protect you from bright flashes.

items.name: gold bracelet
items.description: A fancy golden bracelet.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: gold dental grill
items.description: Fake golden teeth, worn over the teeth.  Fits horribly, but looks very shiny.

items.name: pair of gold earrings
items.description: A pair of shiny gold earrings.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: gold hairpin
items.description: A gold hairpin, designed by the rich, for the rich.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: gold locket
items.description: A heart-shaped, gold locket with a frame inside to store photographs or small objects.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: gold medal
items.description: A medal awarded for achieving first place in some event.  Before everything fell apart, this could be a source of pride for its owner.  Now it's just another shiny bauble.

items.name: gold necklace
items.description: A shiny, unadorned gold necklace.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: gold ring
items.description: A flashy gold ring.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: gold
items.description: A soft shiny metal.  Before the apocalypse this would've been worth a small fortune but now its value is greatly diminished.

items.name: gold watch
items.description: A gold-plated steel self-winding wristwatch, suitable for a retirement present.  Tells the time and looks good.

items.name: golf bag
items.description: A tall canvas and plastic bag with fold-out legs used for golfing.  It even has straps to be worn on the back.

items.name: golf ball
items.description: A small ball with round indentations on it.

items.name: golf club
items.description: A long handle with a big metal head, flat on one side, for driving golf balls.  Fore!

items.name: pair of golf shoes
items.description: Snug fit sport shoes with hard ridges on the bottom.

items.name: golf tee
items.description: A pin shaped piece of wood meant for holding a golf ball slightly off the ground.

items.name: evening gown
items.description: A luxurious evening gown.  It accentuates your curves, or lack thereof.

items.name: graduated cylinder
items.description: A tall, narrow glass cylinder with precise markings for measuring fluid quantities.  An important science tool, it is also useful for anal retentive chefs.

items.name: graham cracker
items.description: Dry and sugary, these crackers will leave you thirsty, but go good with some chocolate and marshmallows.

items.name: granola
items.description: A tasty and nutritious mixture of oats, honey, and other ingredients that has been baked until crisp.

items.name: grapefruit
items.description: A citrus fruit, whose taste ranges from sour to semi-sweet.

items.name: grapes
items.description: A cluster of juicy grapes.

items.name: grappling hook
items.description: A folding grappling hook attached to a stout 30-foot long piece of lightweight cord.  Useful for keeping yourself safe from falls.  Can be used in place of a long rope for butchering, in a pinch.

items.name: grass
items.description: Some grass, edible by grazers and ruminants only.  Seeing this item is a bug.

items.name: greatcoat
items.description: A heavy, full-length wool coat.  Cumbersome, but warm and with deep pockets.

items.name: grenade
items.description: This is a military-grade fragmentary hand grenade.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse.  You will then have five turns before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

items.name: active grenade
items.description: This is an active grenade, and will explode any second now.  Better throw it!

items.name: EMP grenade
items.description: This is a grenade that generates an electromagnetic pulse with a low-inductance capacitor bank discharged into a single-loop antenna.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active EMP grenade.  You will then have three turns before it detonates, creating an EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy.

items.name: active EMP grenade
items.description: This EMP grenade is active, and will shortly detonate, creating a large EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy.  You may not want to be holding it much longer.

items.name: incendiary grenade
items.description: This is a military-grade incendiary hand grenade.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse.  You will then have five turns before it explodes into a raging inferno; throwing it would be a good idea.

items.name: active incendiary grenade
items.description: This is an active incendiary grenade, likely to burst into an inferno any second now.  Better throw it!

items.name: grenade pouch
items.description: A small pouch for storing cartridge grenades with straps for attaching it to your belt or other webbing.

items.name: large grenade pouch
items.description: A pouch for holding up to four full-sized grenades of various types.

items.name: grid autoclave
items.description: Dummy item.  If you see this, then something went wrong.

items.name: grilled sweetbread
items.description: Not sweet, like the name would suggest, but delicious all the same!

items.name: grinder blade
items.description: A 125mm angle grinder blade.  You could make a powertool with it, or throw it.  Wielding it without sturdy gloves is a bad idea.

items.name: forward grip
items.description: A grip placed forward on the barrel allows for greater control.  Not as effective as a bipod but usable under all conditions.

items.name: grip hook
items.description: A simple steel meathook with a circular steel handle.

items.name: modified forward grip
items.description: A grip placed forward on the barrel allows for greater control.  Not as effective as a bipod but usable under all conditions.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon, if you so want.

items.name: replaceable furniture kit
items.description: This is a kit consisting of various steel and plastic parts; when installed, it would permanently modify and partially replace some of the weapon's furniture so that it could be easily changed if needed.  This allows installing any kind of more advanced grips or other furniture.

items.name: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Cataclysm
items.description: Inscribed on the cover in large, friendly letters, is the message "Don't Panic".

items.name: electric guitar
items.description: A standard factory-made electric guitar.  It's probably better at smashing heads than melting faces, these days.  Has a strap.

items.name: guitar stand
items.description: A small, oddly shaped piece of steel hardware with three legs.  When placed on the ground, this can support one guitar in an upright position.

items.name: chewing gum
items.description: Bright pink sugar-free chewing gum.

items.name: gummy vitamin
items.description: Essential dietary nutrients conveniently packaged in a fruit-flavored chewy candy form.  An option of last resort when a balanced diet is not possible.  Excess use can cause hypervitaminosis.

items.name: rail-mounted crossbow
items.description: A kit to attach a pair of crossbow arms and a firing rail to the barrel of a long firearm.  It allows crossbow bolts to be fired.

items.name: modified rail-mounted crossbow
items.description: A kit to attach a pair of crossbow arms and a firing rail to the barrel of a long firearm.  It allows crossbow bolts to be fired.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and SMGs, if you so want.

items.name: gun operating system
items.description: This system can operate most conventional weapons.

items.name: smokeless gunpowder
items.description: Firearm-quality gunpowder.

items.name: HK416 A5
items.description: Designed to replace the M4A1, the Heckler and Koch 416A5 features most of the former's strengths, while being considerably more durable.

items.name: survivor wetsuit
items.description: A lightweight, hand-built combination armor made from a cut-down bulletproof vest and a reinforced neoprene wetsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

items.name: hacksaw
items.description: This is a sturdy saw, useful for cutting through metal objects.

items.name: haggis
items.description: This traditional Scottish savory pudding is made of meat and offal mixed with oatmeal, which is sewn into an animal's stomach and boiled.  Surprisingly tasty and quite filling, it is best served with boiled root vegetables and strong whisky.

items.name: hair dryer
items.description: This tool dries your hair by pushing air through a coil of hot wires.  Without a functioning power grid, it is a motorized paper weight.

items.name: hairbrush
items.description: An instrument of hair torture.

items.name: hairpin
items.description: A plain hairpin to keep your hair in place.

items.name: hakama
items.description: A flowing, pleated garment which can be worn over a kimono.

items.name: hakama
items.description: Plain black hakama for use in kendo and other martial arts.

items.name: halberd
items.description: This is a versatile polearm with an axe blade, a spike, and other fun things attached to a long stick.

items.name: halberd fake
items.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a polearm with an axe blade, a spike, and other fun things attached to a long stick.

items.name: Halligan bar
items.description: This is a heavy multiple-use tool commonly carried by firefighters, law enforcement, and military rescue units.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to bash some heads in.

items.name: halter top
items.description: A short top made from cotton.  It is light and easy to wear.

items.name: hamburger
items.description: A sandwich of minced meat with condiments.

items.name: hammer
items.description: This is a demagnetized steel claw hammer with a wooden grip.  With a hammer, nails, and two by fours in your inventory, you could board up adjacent doors and windows.  It has myriad other uses as well.

items.name: sledge hammer
items.description: A large, heavy hammer.  Makes an acceptable melee weapon for the very strong, but is nearly useless in the hands of the weak.

items.name: engineer's hammer
items.description: A stout and hefty hammer, more akin to a sledge than a typical ball-peen.  Useful for portable demolition work, but is very unwieldy as a weapon.

items.name: heavy sledge hammer
items.description: A large sledge hammer with a massive, heavy head.  This unwieldy tool is meant to break concrete, rock, brick, anything really.

items.name: short sledge hammer
items.description: A shorter sledge hammer, still as weighty, however, due to the same steel head.  Worse as a melee weapon but is a more portable tool.

items.name: stone hand axe
items.description: This is a broad piece of stone with an edge narrow enough to roughly chop wood.

items.name: hand-crank charger
items.description: This is a hand-powered battery charger.  It has an adjustable receptacle designed to accept a wide variety of rechargeable battery cells.

items.name: pistol crossbow
items.description: A small concealable pistol-like crossbow.  It's weak due to its small size and draw, so it is best suited for hunting small game.  Bolts fired from this weapon have a good chance of remaining intact for re-use.

items.name: hand drill
items.description: A primitive manual drill with a single drill bit.  It is slow and it will exhaust you quickly.

items.name: oars
items.description: Oars for a boat.

items.name: hand pump
items.description: This pump is suitable for pumping air into inflatable objects.

items.name: set of hand rims
items.description: Hand rims for use on a wheelchair.

items.name: flare
items.description: This is a slow-burning magnesium flare.  Use it to strike the striker and light it.  It will produce a bright light for about a half hour.

items.name: dead flare
items.description: This is a spent magnesium flare.  It is essentially trash.

items.name: active flare
items.description: This burning magnesium flare is producing light.  It will last for about a half hour before burning out.

items.name: hand-rolled cigarette
items.description: A roll-your-own made from tobacco and rolling paper.  Stimulates mental acuity and reduces appetite.  Despite being hand crafted, it's still highly addictive and hazardous to health.

items.name: haori
items.description: A loose coat with wide sleeves that is worn unfastened over a kimono.  It is jet black with sparse, tasteful golden embroidery.

items.name: hard plating
items.description: A piece of very thick armor plating made of steel.

items.name: hard steel plate
items.description: An armor plating made of a very thick steel, specifically engineered for use in a bullet resistant vest.

items.name: hardtack
items.description: A dry and virtually tasteless bread product capable of remaining edible without spoilage for vast lengths of time.

items.name: harmonica with a holder
items.description: A harmonica with a holder, so that you can play it without a free hand.

items.name: baseball cap
items.description: A Red Sox cap.  It provides a little bit of warmth.

items.name: boonie hat
items.description: Also called a "bucket hat." Often used in the military.  Its wide brim helps keep the sun out of your eyes.

items.name: toque
items.description: A traditional chef's hat, standing tall and proud against the vulgarities of the world.

items.name: cotton hat
items.description: A snug-fitting cotton hat.  Quite warm.

items.name: faux fur hat
items.description: A stylish hat made of faux fur.  Like real fur, but without the suffering, if the tag is to be believed.  Very warm.

items.name: fur hat
items.description: A hat made from the pelts of animals.  Extremely warm.

items.name: golf cap
items.description: You're not actually sure if this is called a golf cap, but it's the stereotypical cap golfers wear.

items.name: hard hat
items.description: A hard plastic hat worn in construction sites.  Excellent protection from cuts and percussion.

items.name: hooded hard hat
items.description: A hard plastic hat worn in construction sites, with a cloth tucked in under it to serve as a makeshift hood.  Makes it a bit more comfortable to wear, and better protects the neck from sun and rain.

items.name: hunting cap
items.description: A red plaid hunting cap with ear flaps.  Notably warm.

items.name: knit hat
items.description: A snug-fitting wool hat.  Very warm.

items.name: newsboy cap
items.description: A slouching wool cap with a short front brim, traditionally associated with newspaper delivery boys.  Quite warm.

items.name: noise canceling headgear
items.description: Padding over your ears kept in place by some string.  Blocks incoming sounds.

items.name: sombrero
items.description: A felt orange sombrero with traditional white and yellow hand stitching.  The wide brim keeps the sun out of your eyes, and a thin strap hooks around your chin.

items.name: hatchet
items.description: A one-handed hatchet.  Makes a great melee weapon, and is useful both for chopping things and for use as a hammer.

items.name: hazelnuts
items.description: A handful of raw hard nuts from a hazelnut tree.

items.name: roasted hazelnuts
items.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a hazelnut tree.

items.name: hazmat suit
items.description: An impermeable whole-body garment worn as protection against hazardous materials.  Though very restrictive and fragile, wearing it will provide complete protection against ambient radiation.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection.

items.name: homebrew beer
items.description: Not the finest drink you've had, but hey, it's alcohol by the gallon.

items.name: large steel drum
items.description: A large cylinder fashioned out of thick plates of hardened steel, that is normally found on road rollers.  Numerous massive spokes, attached to a central axis, reinforce its structure even further, making it an unstoppable force once it starts rolling.

items.name: heavy duty tow cable
items.description: An extremely heavy duty tow cable made from thick steel wire.  If attached to a vehicle, it could be used to pull another vehicle of any weight.

items.name: heavy duty frame
items.description: A large, reinforced steel frame, used in military vehicle construction.

items.name: headgear
items.description: Lightweight sports headgear designed to protect the head while sparring.

items.name: reinforced headlight
items.description: A vehicle headlight with a cage built around it to protect it from damage without reducing its effectiveness.

items.name: headphones
items.description: Typical headphones that cover your ears.  A well-known brand that is very high quality, with a detachable 1/8" cable.  Comes with a 1/8" to 1/4" adaptor.

items.name: headscarf
items.description: A loose cloth worn over the head and around the neck.

items.name: heat pack
items.description: This is a chemical heat pack.  It's used to treat sports injuries and heat food.  It is usable only once.

items.name: used heat pack
items.description: This is a chemical heat pack.  It's used to treat sports injuries and heat food.  This one has been used and is chemically inert, rendering it useless.

items.name: heavy plutonium battery
items.description: This battery uses a thin plutonium-244 rod to stabilize an exotic nanocompound, manufactured from repurposed plutonium fission cells.  It is universally compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and large tools.  Although it stores a huge amount of power, it cannot be recharged.

items.name: heavy battery
items.description: This is a heavy battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and large tools.

items.name: heavy disposable battery
items.description: This is a heavy battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and large tools.  The battery's chemistry means that it has a very high capacity, but cannot be recharged.

items.name: heavy-duty military rotors
items.description: A set of four rotor blades from a military attack helicopter.

items.name: heavy duty flashlight (off)
items.description: This is a heavy duty tubular aluminum LED flashlight as often used by security guards.  Makes for a passable melee weapon.  Using this flashlight will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is charged with batteries.

items.name: heavy duty flashlight (on)
items.description: This is a heavy duty tubular aluminum LED flashlight as often used by security guards.  Makes for a passable melee weapon.  Using this flashlight will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is charged with batteries.

items.name: heavy battery (high-capacity)
items.description: This is a high-capacity heavy battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and large tools.

items.name: heavy rail rifle
items.description: This overpowered and overengineered variant of the ferromagnetic rail rifle was designed to deliver electromagnetically-driven obliteration right through whatever obstacles that lies in front of it, be it buildings, vehicles or hordes of walking dead.  However, the hefty bulk and weight of this weapon compared to most contemporary rifles makes it somewhat cumbersome to wield; not to mention that it consumes UPS charges at a tremendous rate, making it impractical for use in prolonged engagements.

items.name: pair of heels
items.description: A pair of high heels.  Difficult to even walk in.

items.name: biosilicified chitin helmet
items.description: A helmet crafted from the carefully cleaned and pruned biosilicified exoskeletons of acidic ants.  Covers the entire head; acid-resistant and very durable.

items.name: army helmet
items.description: A heavy helmet that provides excellent protection from all sorts of damage.  It is labeled as the advanced combat helmet.

items.name: baseball helmet
items.description: A hard plastic helmet that covers the head and ears.  Designed to protect against a baseball to the head.

items.name: barbute helm
items.description: A medieval helmet that provides excellent protection for the head, with a Y shaped opening for the face.

items.name: bike helmet
items.description: A thick foam helmet.  Designed to protect against concussion.

items.name: bone armor helmet
items.description: A grotesque, horned helmet carved from bone.  Covers the entire head; very light and strong.

items.name: chitinous helmet
items.description: A helmet made from the exoskeletons of insects.  Covers the entire head; very light and durable.

items.name: conical helm
items.description: A conical iron helm with additional protection for the neck, associated with the Mongol Empire.

items.name: Corinthian helm
items.description: An ancient Greek bronze helmet that provides excellent protection for the head, with slits for the eyes and mouth.

items.name: football helmet
items.description: A heavy plastic helmet normally worn by football players.

items.name: galea
items.description: An Imperial Roman helmet, with distinct projections protecting the sides of the head.

items.name: heavy survivor helmet
items.description: A customized, heavily armored steel and Kevlar helmet, modified to provide maximum comfort and protection from harm.  All the added material has made it rather heavy.

items.name: kabuto
items.description: A medieval Japanese helmet with a scowling facemask that provides excellent protection to the entire head and face.

items.name: leather armor helmet
items.description: A thick leather helmet that provides excellent protection for the head.

items.name: helmet liner
items.description: This goes inside a helmet to help keep your head warm in cold climates.

items.name: lobster helmet
items.description: A heavy helmet that provides excellent protection from all sorts of damage.  It has a tail coming off the back that provides protection to your neck.

items.name: motorcycle helmet
items.description: A helmet with covers for your head and chin, leaving space in-between for you to wear goggles.

items.name: nasal helm
items.description: An early medieval helmet with a projection guarding the nose, to better protect the face without obstructing vision.  Proper viking gear, unlike the stereotypical horned helm.

items.name: nomad cowl
items.description: A makeshift cowl with protection for the eyes from rain and sun, designed for long travels.

items.name: great helm
items.description: A medieval helmet that provides excellent protection to the entire head, at the cost of great encumbrance.

items.name: riot helmet
items.description: A helmet with a plastic shield that covers your entire face.  Activate to raise the face shield.

items.name: riot helmet (raised visor)
items.description: A riot helmet with a plastic face shield which is raised up.  Activate to lower the shield.

items.name: scavenger cowl
items.description: A sturdy protective cowl extending down to the neck, fitted with a respirator and eye protection.  For dangerous scavenging ventures.

items.name: scrap helmet
items.description: A helmet made from scraps of metal secured by simple strings; the loose collection of plates provides decent but not the most convenient protection.

items.name: skid lid
items.description: A small metal helmet that covers the head and protects against cuts and percussion.

items.name: large wolf skull
items.description: The top part of an unusually large wolf skull equiped with leather straps to secure it on your head.  Every inch of it has been carved with a maze of fine intertwined symbols that make your eyes water.

items.name: survivor helmet
items.description: A customized, heavily armored Kevlar helmet, modified with leather reinforcements to provide maximum comfort and protection from harm.

items.name: XL survivor helmet
items.description: A massive customized, heavily armored Kevlar helmet, modified with leather reinforcements to provide maximum comfort and protection from harm.

items.name: pneumatic bolt driver
items.description: An eight-shot, revolving barrel, pneumatic bolt driver handcrafted from scrap.  Be careful where you reload it, pumping air into the tank takes a few seconds.  It is pretty quiet and quite deadly.

items.name: Henry Big Boy .44
items.description: This fine lever action rifle is chambered in the powerful .44 magnum cartridge and features a sleek octagonal barrel with a tube fed magazine.  Go get 'em cowboy!

items.name: herbal tea
items.description: A healthy beverage made from herbs steeped in boiling water.

items.name: heroin
items.description: An extremely strong opioid narcotic derived from morphine.  Incredibly addictive, the risk of overdose is extreme, and the drug is contraindicated for nearly all medical purposes.

items.name: Browning Hi-Power .40 S&W
items.description: The Browning Hi-Power is a semi-automatic handgun developed shortly before the second world war.  Widely issued since then, it remains in use by India, Canada and Australia.  This is a commercial variant produced by Browning Arms in .40 S&W.

items.name: Browning Hi-Power 9x19mm
items.description: The Browning Hi-Power is a semi-automatic handgun developed shortly before the second world war.  Widely issued since then, it remains in use by India, Canada and Australia.  This is a commercial variant produced by Browning Arms in 9x19mm Parabellum.

items.name: high quality crude oil
items.description: This is high quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis.  It still has some residual solvents in it so it needs to be purged in a vacuum oven, whipped over a heated surface, or distilled before it is safe to consume.

items.name: (ethanol) high quality crude oil
items.description: This is high quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis thats been diluted in ethanol and heated over a hotplate.  The next step would be to filter it through a buchner flask.

items.name: (ethanol) filtered high quality crude oil
items.description: This is high quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis thats been diluted in ethanol, heated over a hotplate, and filtered through a buchner flask.  The next step would be to run it through a rotovap.

items.name: filtered high quality crude oil
items.description: This is high quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis thats been diluted in ethanol, heated over a hotplate, filtered through a buchner flask, and all the ethanol recovered using a rotary evaporator.  It is ready for the distillation.

items.name: high quality distillate
items.description: Concentrated cannabis extract.  This style of extract goes through the most processing, eliminating most if not all harmful ingredients.  Normal cannabis contains around 20%THC, this distillate should be around 88%THC.  Can be smoked in a bowl, used in a dab pen, or used to make distillate cartridges.

items.name: high quality distillate cartridge
items.description: A small cartridge containing concentrated cannabis extract thats used with dab pens.  This style of extract goes through the most processing, eliminating most if not all harmful ingredients.  Normal cannabis contains around 20%THC, this distillate should be around 70%THC after reintroducing terpenes for flavoring.

items.name: high quality distillate (heads)
items.description: Concentrated cannabis extract.  This is the 'heads' portion from a distilled batch of crude oil.  It still needs to be ran through a lab grade still one more time before its a finished product.

items.name: high quality distillate (tails)
items.description: Concentrated cannabis extract.  This material is the 'tails' portion from a distilled batch of crude oil.  It needs to be ran through a lab grade still another time.

items.name: high quality shatter
items.description: Concentrated cannabis extract, commonly known as dabs.  This particular style of concentrate in is a thin sheet and shatters like glass at room temperature.  Argueably its one of the better styles of concentrate compared to wax, crumble, or distilate.  Normal cannabis contains around 20%THC, this shatter should be around 55%THC.

items.name: high quality wax
items.description: Concentrated cannabis extract, commonly known as dabs.  This particular style of concentrate has the look and consistency of a yellow waxy substance at room temperature.  Normal cannabis contains around 20%THC, this wax should be around 45%THC.

items.name: hickory nuts
items.description: A handful of raw hard nuts from a hickory tree.

items.name: hickory nut ambrosia
items.description: Delicious hickory nut ambrosia.  A drink worthy of the gods.

items.name: roasted hickory nuts
items.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a hickory tree.

items.name: hickory root
items.description: A root from a hickory tree.  It has an earthy smell.

items.name: hide bag
items.description: The raw skin of an animal, quickly turned into a makeshift bag for storage.  It will still rot, and needs to be cured and tanned.

items.name: tainted hide bag
items.description: The raw skin of a monster, quickly turned into a makeshift bag for storage.  It will still rot, and needs to be cured and tanned.

items.name: high density capacitor
items.description: A capacitor with a higher energy density increases range and damage; at the cost of a markedly increased power consumption.

items.name: door hinge
items.description: A small metal hinge with two metal plates with screw holes.  Useful for making doors.

items.name: HK417 A2
items.description: A German battle rifle with a 13" barrel and telescopic stock.  It is a gas operated, rotating bolt rifle with a short-stroke piston design similar to that of the G36.

items.name: HK417 makeshift magazine
items.description: An improvised 5-round straight single-stack box magazine consisting of little more than a bent sheet of steel held together by duct tape and hope, for use with HK417 rifle.

items.name: HK417 compact magazine
items.description: A 10 round double stack box magazine for the HK417 rifle.

items.name: HK417 magazine
items.description: A 20 round double stack box magazine for the HK417 rifle.

items.name: H&K 4.6mm extended magazine
items.description: An extended 40-round magazine for use with H&K's proprietary 4.6x30mm round.

items.name: H&K 4.6mm magazine
items.description: A standard capacity 20-round magazine for use with H&K's proprietary 4.6x30mm round.

items.name: H&K operational briefcase (empty)
items.description: This is a plain, hard-sided black briefcase with a trigger in the handle and a concealed hole in the side.  Squeezing the trigger would currently do nothing, as it is empty.  Don't forget to put a suitable MP5 back inside before you try to pay any ransom fees with lead.

items.name: H&K G3
items.description: An early battle rifle developed after the end of WWII.  The G3 is designed to unload large amounts of deadly ammunition, but it is less suitable over long ranges.

items.name: H&K G36
items.description: Designed as a replacement for the early H&K G3 battle rifle, the G36 is more accurate, and uses the much-lighter .223 round, allowing for a higher ammo capacity.

items.name: H&K G80 railgun
items.description: Developed by Heckler & Koch, this railgun magnetically propels a ferromagnetic projectile using an alternating current.  Powered by UPS.

items.name: H&K G80 magazine
items.description: A magazine for H&K G80 railgun which can hold up to 20 ferromagnetic projectiles.

items.name: H&K MP5A2
items.description: The Heckler & Koch MP5 is one of the most widely-used submachine guns in the world, and has been adopted by special police forces and militaries alike.  Its high degree of accuracy and low recoil are universally praised.

items.name: PTR 603
items.description: The PTR 603 is a semi-automatic copy of the famous MP5 series, domestically produced for the US market on original Heckler and Koch tooling by PTR Industries.  Like the MP5, its roller delayed blowback action offers smooth shooting and precision, setting it apart from other submachine guns and pistol caliber carbines.  This model is configured as a pistol to avoid inconvenient and costly NFA regulations.  A welded on section of M1913 rail offers convenient mounting for aftermarket optics, but precludes the use of claw mounts.

items.name: H&K MP5K-PDW
items.description: The Heckler & Koch MP5 is one of the most widely-used submachine guns in the world, and has been adopted by special police forces and militaries alike.  Its high degree of accuracy and low recoil are universally praised.  The MP5K-PDW model features a shorter barrel, a built-in foregrip, and a side folding stock for vehicle or aircraft crew use.

items.name: H&K MP5SD
items.description: The H&K MP5SD offers subsonic performance in almost the same footprint as the H&K MP5, retaining its handiness.  The large suppressor cuts down on muzzle flash greatly, aiding in night operations.  It has also seen some popularity with SWAT teams, as it lowers the risk of fire and explosions in illegal laboratories.  With body armor in more common use, the MP5SD has waned in popularity among special forces due to its decreased terminal performance.

items.name: H&K MP7A2
items.description: Designed as a personal defense weapon, the MP7 fires the high-powered 4.6x30mm round while being lightweight, compact in size, and practically recoil free.

items.name: H&K UMP45
items.description: Developed as a successor to the MP5 submachine gun, the UMP45 retains the earlier model's supreme accuracy and low recoil, but in the higher .45 caliber.

items.name: hobo stove
items.description: This is a small improvised wood stove, made from a metal can or similar container of the right size.  It's too small to fit anything much larger than splintered wood.  Activate it to Deploy.

items.name: hobo stove (lit)
items.description: This is a small improvised wood stove, made from a metal can or similar container of the right size.  Useful for defrosting and reheating food, uses simple tinder.

items.name: hockey stick
items.description: A curved wooden stick with a wide and flat end.  Commonly used by hockey players.

items.name: hoe
items.description: This is a farming implement.  You can use it to turn tillable land into a slow-to-cross pile of dirt, or dig a shallow pit.

items.name: hollow cane
items.description: A cane designed to conceal blade.  This was a popular fashion accessory for the wealthy during the 18th and 19th centuries.

items.name: hologram cloak
items.description: A cloak woven with metallic fibers and covered with hexagonal sheets of reflective carbide.  When activated, it will create a holographic decoy of its wearer.

items.name: holographic sight
items.description: Used extensively by military forces, it increases accuracy and weight.  This is a step up from a red dot sight.

items.name: holster
items.description: A leather strap worn on the hip for holding pistol sized guns.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

items.name: holy symbol
items.description: A necklace made of fine gold chain bearing the symbol of a forgotten faith.

items.name: handmade holy symbol
items.description: A simple necklace representing a religious faith.

items.name: King James Bible
items.description: An English translation of the Christian Bible, which originated in England in the early 1600s.

items.name: Eastern Orthodox Bible
items.description: An English copy of the Eastern Orthodox translation of The Holy Bible.

items.name: Gideon Bible
items.description: An English translation of the Christian Bible, distributed free of charge by Gideons International.

items.name: The Guru Granth Sahib
items.description: A single-volume copy of the central religious texts of Sikhism.

items.name: Hadith
items.description: A Muslim religious text containing an account of the sayings and actions of the prophet Muhammad.

items.name: Hávamál
items.description: An English translation of several Old Norse poems.  The poems contain proverbs and stories attributed to the god Odin, many transcribed from oral history.

items.name: Principia Discordia
items.description: A book that embodies the main beliefs of Discordianism.  It seems to primarily concern chaos, and features a card in the back which informs you that you are now a 'genuine and authorized Pope of Discordia'.

items.name: The Kojiki
items.description: The oldest extant chronicle of Japan's myths and history, the stories contained in the Kojiki are part of the inspiration behind Shinto practices.

items.name: The Book of Mormon
items.description: The sacred text of the Latter Day Saint movement of Christianity, originally published in 1830 by Joseph Smith.

items.name: The Gospel of the Flying Spaghetti Monster
items.description: A book that embodies the main beliefs of the Church of the Flying Spaghetti Monster.  It seems to involve a lot of pirates and some sort of invisible drunken monster made of pasta.

items.name: Quran
items.description: An English translation of the Muslim book of holy scriptures, with explanatory notes and commentaries to aid in understanding.

items.name: The Satanic Bible
items.description: A collection of essays, observations, and rituals published by Anton LaVey in 1969.

items.name: Dianetics
items.description: This book is the canonical text of Scientology.  Written by a science fiction author, it contains self-improvement techniques and musings on psychology called Dianetics.

items.name: The Book of the SubGenius
items.description: A book about the Church of the SubGenius.  It seems to involve a salesman named J. R. "Bob" Dobbs and a concept called 'slack'.

items.name: The Sutras of the Buddha
items.description: A collection of discourses attributed to the Buddha and his close disciples.

items.name: Talmud
items.description: One of the central texts of Rabbinic Judaism, the Talmud expounds upon the Hebrew Bible with teachings and opinions of thousands of rabbis.

items.name: Tanakh
items.description: A single-volume book containing the complete canon of the Jewish Bible.

items.name: The Tripitaka
items.description: A collection of sacred Buddhist writings describing their canons of scriptures.

items.name: The Upanishads
items.description: A collection of sacred Hindu writings regarding the nature of reality and describing the character and form of human salvation.

items.name: The Four Vedas
items.description: A single volume containing all four Vedas, which are the oldest scriptures of Hinduism.

items.name: homemade burrito
items.description: A traditional Mexican dish of meat and vegetable stuffing put on a corn tortilla and rolled into a tube shape, like those you find in gas stations but homemade and delicious!

items.name: homemade hot dog
items.description: A heavily processed sausage, commonplace at baseball games before the Cataclysm.  It would taste much better prepared.

items.name: homewrecker
items.description: A long piece of wood with several chunks of steel firmly tied to it.  The resulting weapon is unwieldy and slow but very heavy hitting.

items.name: hominy
items.description: Corn kernels which have been cooked in an alkaline solution and then rinsed, making them better suited for eating or cooking.

items.name: honey ball
items.description: Droplet shaped ant food.  It's like a thick balloon the size of a baseball, filled with sticky liquid.  Unlike bee honey, this has mostly a sour taste, probably because ants feed upon a variety of things.

items.name: forest honey
items.description: Honey, that stuff bees make.  This one is "forest honey", a liquid form of honey.  This honey won't spoil and is good for your digestion.

items.name: candied honey
items.description: Honey, that stuff the bees make.  This variant is "candied honey", a variant of very thick consistence.  This honey won't spoil and is good for your digestion.

items.name: honeygold brew
items.description: A mixed drink containing all the advantages of its ingredients and none of their disadvantages.  It tastes great and it's a good source of nourishment.

items.name: honey scraper
items.description: A sharp, knife-like tool used in harvesting honey from beehives.  Makes a passable melee weapon.

items.name: honey comb
items.description: A large chunk of wax filled with honey.  Very tasty.

items.name: survivor firehood
items.description: A customized armored Nomex and Kevlar hood, very strong and durable.

items.name: survivor wetsuit hood
items.description: A customized armored neoprene and Kevlar hood, very strong and durable.

items.name: light survivor hood
items.description: A customized armored cloth and Kevlar hood, very light and durable.

items.name: rain hood
items.description: A waterproof hood made to be worn in bad weather.  Provides extra protection from rain.

items.name: survivor hood
items.description: A customized, heavily armored leather and Kevlar hood, designed to provide comfort and protection from harm.

items.name: winter survivor hood
items.description: A customized armored fur and Kevlar hood, very warm and durable.

items.name: XL survivor hood
items.description: A massive customized, heavily armored leather and Kevlar hood, designed to provide comfort and protection from harm.

items.name: hoodie
items.description: A sweatshirt with a hood and a "kangaroo pocket" in the front for storage.

items.name: hops flower
items.description: A cluster of small cone-like flowers, indispensable for brewing beer.

items.name: bicycle horn
items.description: This is a simple bulb horn, found on many bicycles.  Use to honk.  Honk honk.

items.name: truck horn
items.description: This is a very loud horn, usually found on large trucks like semis.

items.name: car horn
items.description: This is a car horn meant to be attached to a car's electrical system.

items.name: horse tack
items.description: A saddle, bridle, and associated tack that can be placed on a tamed animal that is capable of being ridden.

items.name: horseradish
items.description: A spicy grated root vegetable packed in vinegared brine.

items.name: horseradish greens
items.description: Leaves of a horseradish plant with a sharp, bitter and peppery taste.  They're edible, but not commonly eaten.

items.name: horseradish root
items.description: Large white tapered root of a horseradish plant.  Way too spicy in this form, but can be used for making condiments.

items.name: rubber hose
items.description: This is a flexible rubber hose.  It could be used for crafting, or siphoning fuel from a vehicle.

items.name: hot chocolate
items.description: Also known as hot cocoa, this heated chocolate beverage is perfect for a cold winter day.

items.name: hot pants
items.description: A simple pair of short shorts.

items.name: fur hot pants
items.description: A simple pair of fur short shorts.

items.name: leather hot pants
items.description: A simple pair of leather short shorts.

items.name: campfire hot dog
items.description: The simple hot dog, cooked over an open fire.  Would be better on a bun, but it's quite an improvement over eating it uncooked

items.name: cooked hot dog
items.description: Surprisingly, not made from dog.  Cooked, this hot dog now tastes much better, but will spoil.

items.name: uncooked hot dog
items.description: A heavily processed sausage, commonplace at baseball games before the Cataclysm.  It would taste much better prepared.

items.name: hotplate
items.description: This is a small heating element on a stand, powered by batteries.  It is indispensable for cooking and chemistry.  Try not to burn yourself.

items.name: bathrobe
items.description: An outer garment of absorbent, towel-like material traditionally worn to cover one's nakedness to and from the bath.  It makes you wish you had running water to bathe with.

items.name: How to Browse the Web
items.description: Very beginner-level information about computers.

items.name: How to Trap Anything
items.description: A worn manual that describes how to set and disarm a wide variety of traps.

items.name: Hi-Point C-9
items.description: The Hi-Point C-9 is a blowback operated semi-automatic pistol designed by Hi-Point Firearms, which is known for making inexpensive firearms, and for making said firearms bulky and uncomfortable.  Hi-Points have slides made with a zinc pot-metal which is relatively fragile compared to steel slides.

items.name: C-9 10-round magazine
items.description: A 10-round steel box magazine for use with the Hi-Point C-9.

items.name: C-9 15-round magazine
items.description: A 15-round steel box magazine for use with the Hi-Point C-9.

items.name: C-9 8-round magazine
items.description: An 8-round steel box magazine for use with the Hi-Point C-9.

items.name: Hi-Point CF-380
items.description: The Hi-Point CF-380 is a blowback operated semi-automatic pistol designed by Hi-Point Firearms, which is known for making inexpensive firearms, and for making said firearms bulky and uncomfortable.  Hi-Points have slides made with a zinc pot-metal which is relatively fragile compared to steel slides.

items.name: CF-380 10-round magazine
items.description: A 10-round steel box magazine for use with the Hi-Point CF-380.

items.name: CF-380 8-round magazine
items.description: An 8-round steel box magazine for use with the Hi-Point CF-380.

items.name: Hi-Point Model JCP
items.description: The Hi-Point Model JCP is a blowback operated semi-automatic pistol designed by Hi-Point Firearms, which is known for making inexpensive firearms, and for making said firearms bulky and uncomfortable.  Hi-Points have slides made with a zinc pot-metal which is relatively fragile compared to steel slides.

items.name: Model JCP magazine
items.description: A 10-round steel box magazine for use with the Hi-Point Model JCP.

items.name: Hi-Point Model JHP
items.description: The Hi-Point Model JHP is a blowback operated semi-automatic pistol designed by Hi-Point Firearms, which is known for making inexpensive firearms, and for making said firearms bulky and uncomfortable.  Hi-Points have slides made with a zinc pot-metal which is relatively fragile compared to steel slides.

items.name: Model JHP magazine
items.description: A 9-round steel box magazine for use with the Hi-Point Model JHP.

items.name: human stomach
items.description: The stomach of a human.  It is surprisingly durable.

items.name: boiled large human stomach
items.description: A boiled stomach from a large humanoid creature, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.

items.name: large human stomach
items.description: The stomach of a large humanoid creature.  It is surprisingly durable.

items.name: heavy survivor suit
items.description: A heavy, hand-built combination armor made from a reinforced bulletproof vest and a metal-plated leather jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

items.name: huckleberries
items.description: Huckleberries, often times confused for blueberries.

items.name: military plutonium fuel cell
items.description: This battery uses a huge plutonium-244 rod to stabilize an exotic nanocompound, manufactured from repurposed plutonium fission cells.  It was used in military mech-suits, was highly experimental, and had no civilian applications.  Although it stores a stupendous amount of power, it cannot be recharged.

items.name: heavy crossbow
items.description: A HUGE medieval crossbow from Germany with a very slow, difficult reloading process not suited for unskilled users.  Its tension is so powerful that you feel it shake after firing.  Bolts fired from this weapon have a good chance of remaining intact for re-use.

items.name: embalmed human brain
items.description: This is a human brain soaked in a solution of highly toxic formaldehyde.  Eating this would be a terrible idea.

items.name: cooked creep
items.description: A freshly cooked slice of some unpleasant person.  Tastes great.

items.name: chunk of human fat
items.description: Freshly harvested from a human body.

items.name: human flesh
items.description: Freshly butchered from a human body.

items.name: human lard
items.description: A smooth white block of dry-rendered human fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

items.name: human tallow
items.description: A smooth white block of cleaned and rendered human fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

items.name: humble pie
items.description: Also known as 'Umble' pie, made with chopped organ meats.  Not half bad, and really good for you!

items.name: hybrid longbow
items.description: A modernized, six-foot longbow that curves away from the archer at the tips for increased power.  It can be used effectively by those of somewhat above-average strength.  Designed for archers that appreciate the smoothness of a traditional longbow, but desire the superior power of a modern recurve.

items.name: hydrangea bud
items.description: A hydrangea bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a hydrangea flower.

items.name: hydrangea
items.description: A hydrangea stalk with some petals.

items.name: hydrogen tank
items.description: This is a tank of compressed hydrogen gas.  If you need to make water from scratch, or lift a zeppelin, it could come in handy.

items.name: hygrometer
items.description: A plastic hygrometer that can read the relative humidity in the air.

items.name: Inline-4 engine
items.description: A small, yet powerful 4-cylinder combustion engine.

items.name: I6 diesel engine
items.description: A powerful straight-6 diesel engine.

items.name: ironshod quarterstaff
items.description: A smooth and sturdy staff with a leather-wrapped grip, which has been reinforced with metal bands and caps.  Durable and well-balanced, it is surprisingly easy to handle.

items.name: ice axe
items.description: This is an ice axe with hammer on its head, a multi-purpose hiking and climbing tool used by mountaineers.  It is sturdy enough to pry open closed doors or lift manhole covers.

items.name: ice cream
items.description: A sweet, frozen food made of milk with liberal amounts of sugar.

items.name: dairy dessert
items.description: Government regulations dictate that since this isn't *technically* ice cream, it can be called a dairy dessert instead.  It still tastes good, but your body won't like you.

items.name: candy ice cream
items.description: Ice cream with bits of chocolate, caramel, or other flavoring mixed in.

items.name: frozen custard
items.description: Similar to ice cream, this treat made famous in Coney Island is made like ice cream, but with egg yolk added in.  Its storing temperature is warmer, and it lasts a little longer than regular ice cream.

items.name: fruity ice cream
items.description: Small bits of sweet fruit have been tossed into this ice cream, making it slightly less terrible for you.

items.name: gelato
items.description: Italian-style ice cream.  Less airy, and more dense, giving it a richer flavor and texture.

items.name: sorbet
items.description: A simple frozen dessert food made from water and fruit juice.

items.name: frozen yogurt
items.description: Tarter than ice cream, this is made with yogurt and other dairy products, and is generally low-fat compared to ice cream itself.

items.name: icon
items.description: This is a small picture, about the same size as an ID card, symbolizing a religious figure.  On the back, there is a text that faintly reads 'New England Church Community'.

items.name: industrial ID card
items.description: This ID card once belonged to a high level technician.  The reverse side describes protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.

items.name: military ID card
items.description: This ID card once belonged to a military officer.  The reverse side describes protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.

items.name: science ID card
items.description: This ID card once belonged to a scientist.  The reverse side describes protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.

items.name: identification module
items.description: This module continuously runs image recognition algorithms to identify friends from foe.

items.name: pair of snow goggles
items.description: Eyewear carved from wood or bone, with only a thin slit to see out of.  Helps reduce glare, traditionally used by the Inuit to protect against snow blindness.

items.name: impact fuze
items.description: A complex mechanical fuze.  It seems it can be used to detonate stable explosives upon a solid impact.

items.name: imperial stout
items.description: A very flavorful beer that has been aged in bourbon barrels.  It is as black as midnight on a moonless night and has the viscosity of oil.  While very tasty, it also has an alcohol content on the level with wine.

items.name: iron sights
items.description: A basic set of iron sights

items.name: improvised demolition charge
items.description: This is a improvised demolition charge.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  20 seconds after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, so get away!

items.name: improvised demolition charge (lit)
items.description: The fuse on this primitive demolition charge is lit and hissing.  It'll explode any moment now.

items.name: improvised grenade
items.description: A improvised explosive device cobbled together from parts.  Use this item light the fuse.  You will then have some amount of time before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

items.name: active improvised grenade
items.description: This is an active grenade, and will explode any second now.  Better throw it!

items.name: improvised pipe bomb
items.description: This is a section of a pipe filled with stable explosives and a primer.  Use this item to light the fuse, which gives you six seconds to get away from it before it detonates.  You'll need a lighter or some matches to use it.

items.name: active improvised pipe bomb
items.description: This pipe bomb's fuse is lit, and it will explode any second now.  Throw it immediately!

items.name: incendiary
items.description: Material from an incendiary round, useful in constructing incendiary ammunition.

items.name: incendiary homemade rocket
items.description: A hand built rocket, consisting of a container of flammable gel attached onto a pipe, filled with improvised rocket fuel.  Short-range incendiary - handle with care!

items.name: India pale ale
items.description: A very flavorful microbrewed beer.  Best served cold, in a glass - but you're not that lucky.

items.name: volleyball
items.description: A standard regulation volleyball.

items.name: inflatable airbag
items.description: An inflatable airbag.

items.name: inflatable boat
items.description: This rubber rowboat (oars included) is deflated for storage.  Activate it (having an air pump in inventory) to inflate and launch.

items.name: inflatable section
items.description: An inflatable boat section.

items.name: inhaler
items.description: Albuterol inhaler.  Used in the treatment of bronchospasm, it is a lifeline for people with asthma.  A mild stimulant, it may cause nervousness or tremors.

items.name: injectable iron
items.description: Small vials of dark yellow liquid containing soluble iron for injection.

items.name: injectable vitamin B
items.description: Small vials of pale yellow liquid containing soluble vitamin B for injection.

items.name: insecticidal gas grenade
items.description: This is a canister grenade filled with insecticidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active insecticidal grenade.  In five turns it will begin to expel a volatile spray that is highly toxic to insect life forms.

items.name: armed insecticidal gas canister
items.description: This insecticidal bomb has had its pin removed and is expelling highly toxic haze.

items.name: makeshift insecticidal gas grenade
items.description: This is a makeshift canister grenade filled with insecticidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active insecticidal grenade.  In five turns it will begin to expel a volatile spray that is highly toxic to insect life forms.

items.name: armed makeshift insecticidal gas canister
items.description: This makeshift insecticidal bomb has had its pin removed and is expelling highly toxic haze.

items.name: insecticide
items.description: Agricultural-grade chemical insecticide powder designed to eradicate insect pests.

items.name: insta-salad
items.description: Dried salad with water added, not very tasty but still a decent substitution for real salad.

items.name: integrated bayonet
items.description: This is the bayonet integrated in the firearm.

items.name: potassium iodide tablet
items.description: Potassium iodide tablets.  If taken prior to exposure, they help to mitigate injury caused by radiation absorption.

items.name: Irish coffee
items.description: Sweetened coffee and whiskey topped with milk.  Start your day the closeted alcoholic way!

items.name: cast-iron pot
items.description: This hefty black pot is made from cast iron and coated in a sturdy enamel.

items.name: irradiated apple
items.description: Mmm, irradiated.  Will remain edible nearly forever.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.

items.name: irradiated apricot

items.description: A super-concentrated mutagen.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

items.name: alpha serum
