items.name: IWI Tavor X95 .300BLK
items.description: The IWI Tavor X95 (also called Micro-Tavor or MTAR) is an Israeli bullpup assault rifle designed and produced by Israel Weapon Industries.  This is the civilian version chambered for .300 AAC Blackout.

items.name: Jennings J-22
items.description: One of the quintessential 'saturday night specials', the Jennings J-22 was very affordably priced with its injection molded zinc slide and frame.  Intended to fill the void left after small pocket pistols were banned from import, these were more commonly used by criminals unfazed by their glaring safety issues.

items.name: Jennings J-22 magazine
items.description: A cheap 6-round steel box magazine for the Jennings J-22.

items.name: putrid heart
items.description: A thick, hulking mass of flesh superficially resembling a mammalian heart, covered in ribbed grooves and easily the size of your head.  It's still full of, er, whatever passes for blood in jabberwocks, and is heavy in your hands.  After everything you've seen lately, you can't help but remember old sayings about eating the hearts of your enemies…

items.name: desiccated putrid heart
items.description: A huge strip of muscle - all that remains of a putrid heart that has been sliced open and drained of blood.  It could be eaten if you're hungry, but looks *disgusting*.

items.name: bottle jack
items.description: A portable hydraulic bottle jack used for lifting vehicles.

items.name: makeshift jack
items.description: A poorly constructed improvised scissor jack used for lifting vehicles if you're brave enough to use it.

items.name: scissor jack
items.description: A compact scissor jack used for lifting vehicles.

items.name: army jacket
items.description: A tough jacket with lots of pockets.  Favored by the military.

items.name: chef's jacket
items.description: This double-breasted uniform is unusually thick to protect against the heat of the kitchen.

items.name: emergency jacket
items.description: A bright & cheaply made FEMA-issue windbreaker jacket with a hood.  One size, fits none.  Helps keep you unfrozen & visible for rescuers.

items.name: flannel jacket
items.description: A jacket made from flannel-style denim, favored by outdoorsy types.  Provides decent protection from cuts.

items.name: jean jacket
items.description: A jacket made from denim.  Provides decent protection from cuts.

items.name: leather jacket
items.description: A jacket made from thick leather.  Cumbersome, but offers excellent protection from cuts.

items.name: occult bone armor
items.description: A black jacket made from thick leather and covered with intricately carved bones.  You've never seen patterns like those before, each time you look at them you spot a new one as if they were changing on their own.

items.name: armored leather jacket
items.description: An armored jacket made from thick leather and metal plates.  Cumbersome, but offers excellent protection from harm.

items.name: red leather jacket
items.description: A candy-apple-red leather jacket with black strips and shoulder protrusions.  It has a number of zippers and snaps in the front.

items.name: light jacket
items.description: A thin cotton jacket with a hood.  Good for brisk weather.

items.name: windbreaker
items.description: A light synthetic jacket with a hood.  Not very warm, but will keep out the rain.

items.name: jackhammer
items.description: This is a construction tool for drilling through hard rock or other surfaces.  It runs on gasoline.  Use it (if loaded) to blast a hole in adjacent solid terrain.

items.name: jade brooch
items.description: A hand-crafted jade brooch of Oriental origin.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: fruit jam
items.description: Fresh fruit, cooked with sugar to make them last longer.

items.name: 3L glass jar
items.description: A three-liter glass jar with a metal screw top lid, used for canning.

items.name: sealed 3L glass jar
items.description: A three-liter glass jar with a metal screw top lid, used for canning.  Sealed tightly to preserve contents from rot.

items.name: sealed jar of eggs
items.description: This is a sealed glass jar containing pickled eggs.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

items.name: glass jar
items.description: A half-liter glass jar with a metal screw top lid, used for canning.

items.name: sealed glass jar
items.description: A half-liter glass jar with a metal screw top lid, used for canning.  Sealed tightly and will preserve the contents from rot (assuming it was sterile before sealing).

items.name: sealed jar of pickles
items.description: This is a sealed glass jar containing pickles.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

items.name: sealed jar of sauerkraut
items.description: This is a sealed glass jar containing sauerkraut.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

items.name: sealed yeast culture
items.description: A sealed jar holding sanitized yeast wort.  You may harvest the yeast inside when it's done culturing.

items.name: wooden javelin
items.description: A fire-hardened wooden spear honed to a sharper point.  The grip area has been carved and covered for better grip.

items.name: javelin bag
items.description: An open medieval-looking bag, designed to store javelins for easy reach.

items.name: iron javelin
items.description: An iron-tipped wooden throwing spear.  The grip area has been carved and covered for better grip.

items.name: jeans
items.description: A pair of blue jeans with two deep pockets.

items.name: red jeans
items.description: A pair of tight-fitting candy-apple-red jeans with two deep pockets.

items.name: Jedi cloak
items.description: Long, flowing robes.  Simple and comfortable to wear.  Be sure to tear it off dramatically before fighting any foes!

items.name: meat jerky
items.description: Salty dried meat that lasts for a long time, but will make you thirsty.

items.name: plastic jerrycan
items.description: A bulky plastic jerrycan, meant to carry fuel, but can carry other liquids in a pinch.

items.name: steel jerrycan
items.description: A steel jerrycan, meant to carry fuel, but can carry other liquids in a pinch.

items.name: jerrypack
items.description: A jerrycan modified to be worn in a similar manner to a backpack.

items.name: sports jersey
items.description: A shirt made of thick material imprinted with the name and logo of a sports team.

items.name: Antique Adornments
items.description: A comprehensive and illustrated history of crown, bracelet, necklace and others.

items.name: ji
items.description: This is a bronze polearm that originated in the Shang dynasty of China, if not earlier.  It combines a spear head with the perpendicular blade of the earlier ge or dagger-axe.

items.name: jian
items.description: This is an ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword, with an ornate guard and a tassel attached to the pommel.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the dao sabre, qiang spear, and gun staff.

items.name: jian fake
items.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of an ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword, with an ornate guard.

items.name: jian replica
items.description: This is an ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword.  The sword is quite worn, and bent at an odd angle.

items.name: cake
items.description: Delicious sponge cake with buttercream icing, it says happy birthday on it.

items.name: johnnycake
items.description: A dense and tasty fried bread treat.

items.name: joint
items.description: Marijuana, cannabis, pot.  Whatever you want to call it, it's rolled up in a piece of paper and ready for smokin'.

items.name: joint
items.description: The smell of skunk permeates the air as a thin trail of smoke floats off of this joint.

items.name: joint roach
items.description:
The smoked-down butt of a joint, a reminder of some good times.  Pretty much trash now.  Bummer, man.
A few of these could probably be used to roll another joint.

items.name: JP8 fuel
items.description: A kerosene-based fuel used mainly by US military vehicles as a replacement for diesel and jet fuel, to simplify logistics.

items.name: black belt
items.description: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a master.

items.name: blue belt
items.description: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a strong intermediate.

items.name: brown belt
items.description: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a near-master.

items.name: green belt
items.description: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising an intermediate.

items.name: orange belt
items.description: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a fresh intermediate.

items.name: white belt
items.description: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a novice.

items.name: yellow belt
items.description: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a moderate novice.

items.name: judo gi
items.description: Plain white judo gi.  Thick and a little stiff, it gives minor protection from cuts and punches.

items.name: clay jug
items.description: A clay container with a lid, used to hold and pour liquids.

items.name: gallon jug
items.description: A standard plastic jug used for milk and household cleaning chemicals.

items.name: fruit juice
items.description: Freshly-squeezed from real fruit!  Tasty and nutritious.

items.name: juice pulp
items.description: Left-over from juicing the fruit.  Not very tasty, but contains a lot of healthy fiber.

items.name: jumper cable
items.description: A jumper cable, like you've seen many times before: it's a short multi-stranded copper cable with power leads on either end, whose main purpose is to share power between vehicles, but can also link other electrical systems.

items.name: shiny cable
items.description: This is the cable of the gods: 50 meters long, light as a feather and fits in a matchbook.  You're sure this wasn't supposed to exist, and the way it shimmers makes you uneasy.

items.name: heavy-duty cable
items.description: A long, thick, heavy-duty cable with power leads on either end.  It looks like you could use it to hook up two vehicles to each other.  Can also link other electrical systems.

items.name: jumpsuit
items.description: A thin, short-sleeved jumpsuit; similar to those worn by prisoners.  Provides decent storage and is not very encumbering.

items.name: XL jumpsuit
items.description: A thin, short-sleeved jumpsuit updated for the trans-human who needs full-body clothing.  Provides some storage and is adjustable to minimize encumbrance.

items.name: junipers
items.description: Junipers, for making gin and earthy flavors.  Spicy, tastes similar to rosemary.

items.name: microwave burrito
items.description: A small, microwaveable steak & cheese burrito, like those found at gas stations.

items.name: karate gi
items.description: Plain white karate gi.  Loose and flowing, it offers little protection, and little encumbrance.

items.name: kariginu
items.description: A traditional, ankle-length Shinto robe with several layers and very wide sleeves.

items.name: katana
items.description: This is a rare sword from Japan.  Deadly against unarmored targets, and still very effective against armor.

items.name: katana fake
items.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a rare sword from Japan.

items.name: katana replica
items.description: This is a rare sword from Japan.  While it's got the right edge and weight, the pommel just snaps off, and the blade seems pretty worn.

items.name: keffiyeh
items.description: A type of headdress traditionally used in the Middle East.  It can be used in different ways to protect the head and mouth from the elements.

items.name: aluminum keg
items.description: A reusable lightweight aluminum keg, used for shipping beer.  It has a capacity of 50 liters.

items.name: steel keg
items.description: A reusable heavy steel keg, used for shipping beer.  It has a capacity of 50 liters.

items.name: keikogi
items.description: Plain white keikogi for use in martial arts.

items.name: popcorn kernels
items.description: Dried kernels from a particular type of corn.  Practically inedible raw, they can be cooked to make a tasty snack.

items.name: ketchup
items.description: A viscous paste of tomato, salt, and vinegar.

items.name: kettle
items.description: A stovetop kettle for boiling water.

items.name: Kevlar vest
items.description: A lightweight, bullet resistant vest.  Suitable for wearing under clothing.

items.name: Kevlar-lined medium quadruped peto
items.description: A heavy mattress-like armor of cloth, leather and thick linings of Kevlar, originally used as protection in bullfighting.  You could put this on a friendly medium quadruped.

items.name: Kevlar-lined small quadruped peto
items.description: A heavy mattress-like armor of cloth, leather and thick linings of Kevlar, originally used as protection in bullfighting.  You could put this on a friendly small quadruped.

items.name: Kevlar plate
items.description: This is a plate of reinforced Kevlar.  It could be used to repair items made of Kevlar.

items.name: khopesh
items.description: This ancient bronze weapon features a curved, sickle-like blade sharpened on the outside edge.  Associated with the New Kingdom period of Ancient Egypt, it was designed mainly to hack through the light armor common to the region.

items.name: raw kidney
items.description: The kidney from an animal.  Preparing it for cooking is a challenge unless you want the kitchen to smell strongly of urine.

items.name: cooked kidney
items.description: No, this is not beans.

items.name: electric kiln
items.description: This is a portable electric kiln, powered by batteries.  It is designed for firing bricks, but you could use it to fire anything made of clay.  With a little mechanical know-how, you could probably even convert it to run directly off a vehicle's power system.

items.name: finished charcoal kiln
items.description: A charcoal kiln that has finished burning.  Disassemble it to retrieve the charcoal and kiln.

items.name: filled charcoal kiln
items.description: A kiln filled with wood which will become charcoal after a slow period of burning.

items.name: lit charcoal kiln
items.description: A kiln full of wood that has been lit; better drop it!

items.name: vehicle kiln
items.description: An electric kiln made to run off a vehicle's storage battery.

items.name: kilt
items.description: No true Scotsman would leave home without his kilt.

items.name: leather kilt
items.description: No true Scotsman would leave home without his kilt.

items.name: kimono
items.description: A traditional, ankle-length Japanese robe, wrapped around the body with a sash.

items.name: kippah
items.description: A thin, rounded skullcap.  A traditional headdress in Judaism.

items.name: kirpan
items.description: A ceremonial dagger carried by Sikh men.  This one is sharp and could be an effective weapon.

items.name: kirpan replica
items.description: A ceremonial dagger carried by Sikh men.  This one is not particularly well-made.

items.name: RV kitchen unit
items.description: A vehicle mountable electric range and sink unit with integrated tool storage for cooking utensils.

items.name: kittel
items.description: A white, knee-length cotton robe, traditionally worn by Jews on special occasions.

items.name: kiwi
items.description: A large, brown and fuzzy-skinned berry.  Its delicious insides are green.

items.name: pair of knee-high boots
items.description: Very long leather boots that cover the lower legs.  Difficult to wear but extremely durable.

items.name: pair of knee pads
items.description: A pair of knee pads made of stout plastic and cloth.

items.name: baselard
items.description: A medieval dagger forged from rough iron.  It is not the sharpest tool in the shed, but it is certainly one of the largest.

items.name: bread knife
items.description: This knife has quite a long blade with a scalloped edge for cutting bread.  It's not that sharp, but its length and heft mean it could do a bit of damage and cause some nasty tearing.

items.name: butcher knife
items.description: This is a sharp, heavy knife.  It makes a good melee weapon, and is an ideal item for butchering corpses.

items.name: butter knife
items.description: A dull knife, absolutely worthless in combat.  Excellent for spreading soft things on bread.

items.name: carving knife
items.description: This is a long-bladed kitchen knife with a thin, slightly curved blade for deftly slicing meat either in flat sheets or around the bone.  It would be a decent melee weapon, and excellent for butchery.

items.name: chef knife
items.description: This is a long-bladed kitchen knife.  The blade is wider than the handle, giving room for the wielder's knuckles, and it has a characteristic curve for a fast rocking action for chopping vegetables.  It makes a good melee weapon, but the wide blade is unwieldy for butchering.

items.name: combat knife
items.description: This is a military combat knife.  It is light and extremely sharp, and could be deadly in either the right hands or when attached as a bayonet.

items.name: modified combat knife
items.description: This is a military combat knife.  It is light and extremely sharp, and could be deadly in either the right hands or when attached as a bayonet.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols, if you so want.

items.name: folding knife
items.description: This is a small folding knife, with a locking blade and a pocket clip.  Not as good a weapon as a solid fixed-blade knife, but better than a penknife.

items.name: hunting knife
items.description: Commonly used by hunters, this single-edge sheath knife is designed for cutting and skinning game rather than combat.

items.name: meat cleaver
items.description: This is a menacing looking knife with a broad, square shaped blade.  Its heft and sharpness would make it a very effective melee weapon, and an excellent butchering tool.

items.name: paring knife
items.description: This is a short-bladed knife with a sharp blade, made for fine controlled cuts to vegetables without using a cutting board.

items.name: survival knife
items.description: This massive knife features a hollow handle with a compass built into the pommel and a row of fearsome looking saw teeth along the back of its blade.

items.name: RM42 fighting knife
items.description: This sturdy matte black Rivtech combat dagger features a long and slim double-edged blade with a spear-point and a distinctive slip-resistant grip which can also be used to affix it to a suitable firearm.  Originally manufactured for the military, it was very popular in films and among collectors due to its fearsome appearance.

items.name: steak knife
items.description: This is a sharp knife, designed for cutting meat.  It makes a poor melee weapon, but is decent at butchering corpses.

items.name: Swiss Army knife
items.description: An iconic pocket knife imported from Europe.  Its red plastic handle conceals many small tools.

items.name: trench knife
items.description: This stout combat knife features a steel guard to protect the user's knuckles.  The guard can also be used for striking or blocking, and the knife can also be used to butcher corpses.

items.name: vegetable cleaver
items.description: This is a menacing looking knife with a broad, square shaped blade, curved for fast vegetable chopping.  Its heft and sharpness would make it a decent weapon as well, although not as good as a meat cleaver.

items.name: knit scarf
items.description: A long knitted cotton scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  Use it to loosen it if you get too warm.

items.name: knit scarf (loose)
items.description: A long knitted cotton scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  Use it to wear it tighter if you get too cold.

items.name: knitting needles
items.description: A pair of stout wooden needles with round ends used to turn thread and yarn into cloth.

items.name: pair of brass knuckles
items.description: A metal weapon made of brass, designed to be gripped in the palm and cause punches to do extra damage.  A good, quick weapon - but you have to get within punching range to use it.

items.name: razorbar katar
items.description: Five pieces of rebar sharpened to cruel points and strapped to a brace fastened at wrist and forearm on both arms.  The next bub better watch out.

items.name: pair of nail knuckles
items.description: A pair of knuckles consisting of two small squares of wood with several nails coming through them.  Useful in nasty street fights.

items.name: pair of steel knuckles
items.description: A mass of scrap metal crudely beat into shape, with folded rags underneath to protect the wearers knuckles.  A good, quick weapon - but you have to get within punching range to use it.

items.name: kompot
items.description: Clear juice obtained by cooking fruit in a large volume of water.

items.name: Kel-Tec P32
items.description: One of Kel-tec's oldest designs, the P32 is a popular option for deep concealment and backup usage.  Despite its extreme light weight and small size, its .32 ACP chambering makes for good handling and recoil control.

items.name: Kel-Tec P32 magazine
items.description: A standard 7-round steel box magazine for the Kel-Tec P32.

items.name: Kel-Tec P3AT
items.description: Essentially a slightly scaled up Kel-tec P32 in .380 ACP, the ever popular P3AT offers better ballistics in a small, concealable lightweight package.  Handling leaves something to be desired due to snappier recoil and diminuitive controls.

items.name: Kel-Tec P3AT magazine
items.description: A standard 6-round steel box magazine for the Kel-Tec P3AT.

items.name: Kel-Tec PF-9
items.description: The Kel-Tec PF-9 remains one of the most popular backup pistols due to its history of reliability, affordability, and concealability.  Chambered in 9x19mm, recoil is best described as unpleasant, and follow-up shots are difficult to place quickly.

items.name: Kel-Tec PF-9 magazine
items.description: A standard 7-round steel box magazine for the Kel-Tec PF-9.

items.name: kris
items.description: This wavy bladed dagger comes from Southeast Asia.  The design of the blade causes it to make broad, painful wounds.

items.name: kris fake
items.description: This is a dull, cheap replica of a wavy bladed dagger that comes from Southeast Asia.

items.name: Kel-Tec KSG
items.description: A bullpup pump-action shotgun, the Kel-Tec KSG uses a pair of magazine tubes to increase its capacity.  Each tube has to be loaded separately, but this offers the option of loading different ammunition for different situations.

items.name: Kel-Tec KSG-25
items.description: A bullpup pump-action shotgun, the Kel-Tec KSG-25 uses a pair of magazine tubes to increase its capacity.  Each tube has to be loaded separately, but this offers the option of loading different ammunition for different situations.  The big brother of the KSG, it has a longer barrel and longer magazine tubes.

items.name: KSG-25 second magazine
items.description: The integrated second shotgun magazine of the Kel-Tec KSG-25 which holds 12 shots.  It's irremovable.

items.name: KSG second magazine
items.description: The integrated second shotgun magazine of the Kel-Tec KSG which holds 7 shots.  It's irremovable.

items.name: Kel-Tec SUB-2000
items.description: A uniquely designed pistol caliber carbine with an integral folding stock and that makes use of 9x19mm Glock magazines.

items.name: Kel-Tec SUB-2000
items.description: If you see it - it is bug!

items.name: kufi cap
items.description: A brimless, short and rounded cap.

items.name: kukri
items.description: This versatile implement is a modern take on a traditional weapon that originated in Nepal.  Featuring a heavy blade with an inwardly curved edge, it is used as both a tool and as a weapon.

items.name: L-stick (off)
items.description: Produced by the Light corporation, this stylish staff not only functions as a light source, but doubles as a light-weight weapon, due to the superalloy materials it is made of.  Due to proprietary efficiency improvements over standard light sources, the L-stick or light stick as it is commonly called, batteries last longer than other light sources.

items.name: L-stick (on)
items.description: Produced by the Light corporation, this stylish staff not only functions as a light source, but doubles as a light-weight weapon, due to the superalloy materials it is made of.  Due to proprietary efficiency improvements over standard light sources, the L-stick or light stick as it is commonly called, batteries last longer than other light sources.  The staff is glowing brightly, which is slowly draining the batteries.

items.name: L2037 Backup
items.description: The logical extension of Leadworks' autorevolver series, this massive 'sidearm' fires 5.56 NATO to share ammo with a soldier's rifle.  The muzzle flash and report of this 5-shot revolver are incredible, producing ballistics similar to .357 Magnum.  Similar to other Leadworks products it doesn't accept third-party modifications.

items.name: scientific operations map
items.description: A small, meticulously folded piece of paper, filled with tiny handwriting and some surprisingly precise diagrams of subway tunnels, access codes, ventilation shafts, and…guard shifts?  You have the feeling they weren't supposed to write any of this stuff down.

items.name: ladle
items.description: When you need to scoop some soup, this is the utensil for you.

items.name: lajatang
items.description: An exotic weapon comprised of a long pole of wood with curved blades on each end.  It can be deadly in skilled hands.

items.name: lamé (foil)
items.description: A thin, lightweight conductive vest with the zipper on the back used by fencers for electronic scoring.  Its outer layer is a woven mix of sturdy cotton and stainless steel strands.

items.name: lamé (saber)
items.description: A thin, lightweight conductive jacket used by fencers for electronic scoring.  Its outer layer is a woven mix of sturdy cotton and stainless steel strands.

items.name: lamp oil
items.description: A thin and clean-burning oil made for use in oil lamps.

items.name: land mine
items.description: This is a military anti-personnel mine that is triggered when stepped upon.

items.name: laptop computer
items.description: A laptop computer using UPS.

items.name: laptop computer - lit screen
items.description: A laptop computer using UPS.

items.name: lard
items.description: A smooth white block of dry-rendered animal fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

items.name: large LCD screen
items.description: A large backlit screen, used for displaying images.  Useful in some electronics recipes.

items.name: gunsmith repair kit
items.description: This is a complete toolkit made to repair damaged firearms.  Powered by standard batteries, it is a vital tool for long-term firearms maintenance.  It requires 25 charges of battery power per use.

items.name: large space heater
items.description: A portable electric heater that steadily emits warm air.  Raises temperature about 10 degrees C and fills a larger volume of air than the smaller version.

items.name: large space heater (on)
items.description: A portable electric heater that steadily emits warm air.  Raises temperature about 10 degrees C and fills a larger volume of air than the smaller version.

items.name: large sealed stomach
items.description: The stomach of a large creature, cleaned and sealed with strings.  It can hold 3 liters of water.

items.name: large storage battery
items.description: A huge storage battery containing many lithium-ion cells.  Holds a tremendous amount of energy.  Could be installed into a storage battery case for easy removal from a vehicle, or just welded straight in.

items.name: large tent
items.description: This is a family sized tent.  It provides a large amount of space, but is very bulky.

items.name: 6000 hp gas turbine engine
items.description: A massive gas turbine engine, used to power the V-22 Osprey.  Known for its high rate of fuel consumption.

items.name: large damaged tent
items.description: A family sized tent, very bulky but with plenty of space.  This tent is broken and can not be deployed.

items.name: lasagne
items.description: A very old type of pasta made with several layers of lasagne sheets alternated with cheese, sauces and meats.

items.name: raw lasagne pasta
items.description: A pasta sheet used in making lasagne.  It could be eaten raw if you're desperate, but is much better cooked.

items.name: handheld laser cannon
items.description: This is a laser cannon stripped from the barrel of a TX-5LR Cerberus laser turret that has been modified to use UPS power for firing.

items.name: TX-5LR Laser Cannon
items.description: If you see it - it is bug!

items.name: A7 laser rifle
items.description: A state-of-the-art laser rifle developed by the R&D outfit "Aerial Labs".  Initial performance rivaled Rivtech's finest, with rumors flying about corporate skulduggery.  Though the Cataclysm put that on the ash heap of history, this weapon can still do the same to your foes.

items.name: underbarrel laser sight
items.description: A visible-light laser that mounts under a firearm's barrel to enhance ease and speed of target acquisition.  Aside from increased weight, there are no drawbacks.

items.name: tube 40mm launcher
items.description: A simple, home-made grenade launcher.  Basically a tube with a pin firing mechanism to activate the grenade.

items.name: lawn dart
items.description: A large plastic dart made for outdoor games.

items.name: lawnmower
items.description: A motorized pushmower that seems to be broken.  You could take it apart if you had a wrench.

items.name: lead
items.description: A soft dull metal known since ancient times.  Due to its malleability it has a wide variety of uses including the manufacture of ammunition.

items.name: LW barrel extension
items.description: A Leadworks built in longer barrel increases the muzzle velocity of a firearm, contributing to both accuracy and damage.

items.name: LW heavy duty barrel
items.description: A Leadworks built in heavy duty barrel especially designed for prolonged shooting.  Increases damage output and weapon range.

items.name: leaf spring
items.description: A large, heavy-duty leaf spring.  Probably from some car or truck, and looks an awful lot like a bow.  You can barely bend it…

items.name: leather patch
items.description: A smallish patch of leather, could be used to make tough clothing.

items.name: boiled leather medium quadruped barding with caprison
items.description: A full barding for medium quadrupeds consisting of boiled leather and cloth undercovering.  This caparison is depicting a battle between a monstrous dragon and regal griffin.  You could put this on a friendly medium quadruped.

items.name: boiled leather small quadruped barding with caprison
items.description: A full barding for small quadrupeds consisting of boiled leather and cloth undercovering.  This caparison is depicting a battle between a monstrous dragon and regal griffin.  You could put this on a friendly small quadruped.

items.name: leather belt
items.description: A leather belt.  Useful for making your pair of pants fit.

items.name: pair of leather cat ears
items.description: A shiny pair of black cat ears on a headband.  It does nothing, but there's no reason not to look good even if no one's looking.

items.name: leather cat tail
items.description: A glossy black leather tail weighted down with tiny beads of plastic.  Sways behind you when you walk.

items.name: leather collar
items.description: A black leather 'collar' with a bell dangling from the front.  Don't worry, the bell is silent.

items.name: leather funnel
items.description: This is a small, leather funnel used to collect rainwater.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.

items.name: leather pouch
items.description: A bag stitched together from leather scraps.  Doesn't hold an awful lot but is easy to wear.

items.name: leather tarp
items.description: A large sheet of sewn leather that can be deployed instead of a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a butchery appliance as it does not soak in blood.  It's rolled and ready for carrying.

items.name: boiled leather medium quadruped barding with bones
items.description: Decorative bones affixed to leather medium quadruped barding to invoke fear in bandits and raiders and traders all!  You could put this on a friendly medium quadruped.

items.name: boiled leather small quadruped barding with bones
items.description: Decorative bones affixed to leather small quadruped barding to invoke fear in bandits and raiders and traders all!  You could put this on a friendly small quadruped.

items.name: pair of leather sandals
items.description: Sturdy leather hiking sandals with a heel strap.  Offers little in the way of protection, but keeps you cool during warmer months.

items.name: leech flower
items.description: The alien beauty of this indigo flower is betrayed by its disgustingly fleshy composition.  What from afar appear to be petals are but layered membranes of transparent veiny flesh, given color by a covering of blue iridescent ichor.  Even if it is certainly poisonous, it has a pleasant medicinal smell to it.

items.name: mutated leg
items.description: A malformed human leg.  This would be gross to eat, and probably cause mutations.

items.name: leg splint
items.description: A tool to help set bones and hold them in place.

items.name: pair of leg warmers
items.description: Snug, soft cloth sleeves to keep your legs warm.

items.name: pair of fur leggings
items.description: Snug fur sleeves to keep your legs warm.  Simple yet effective since prehistoric times.

items.name: pair of XL leg warmers
items.description: Large, soft, snug cloth sleeves to keep your exotic anatomy warm.

items.name: pair of fetlock furs
items.description: Snug fur sleeves to keep your fetlocks warm.

items.name: leg splint XL
items.description: A tool to help set bones and hold them in place.  It is specifically designed to fit Huge people.

items.name: leggings
items.description: Skin-tight nylon leggings, sometimes used when exercising, that keep your legs nice and warm.

items.name: pair of bronze greaves
items.description: A pair of bronze leg guards with a simple leather lining.

items.name: pair of hard leg guards
items.description: A pair of polyurethane leg guards with neoprene backing.

items.name: pair of steel leg guards
items.description: A full assembly of medieval leg protection.  Cuisses, poleyns, and greaves, with leather straps to secure each piece and connect it as part of a set.

items.name: pair of iron greaves
items.description: A pair of iron leg guards with a simple leather lining.

items.name: pair of paper leg guards
items.description: Leg guards made of stacked paper sheets held together with duct tape.

items.name: pair of scrap leg guards
items.description: A pair of leg guards made from scraps of metal secured by simple strings; the loose collection of plates provides decent but not the most convenient protection.

items.name: ankle ammo pouch
items.description: A small fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to your ankle which is capable of holding a single small magazine or speedloader close at hand.

items.name: leg ammo pouch
items.description: A fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to your leg and capable of holding two magazine close at hand.

items.name: pair of drop leg pouches
items.description: A set of pouches that can be worn on the thighs using buckled straps.  This variety is favored by the military.

items.name: LeMat revolver
items.description: A Pietta reproduction of the civil war era LeMat revolver, a rare and unusual cap & ball .44-caliber revolver.  While its original non-standard .42 or .35 caliber curbed its usefulness for the CSA army, this reproduction is offered in more prevalent .44 caliber.  Despite modern quality materials, the design is still rather delicate.

items.name: LeMat revolver shotgun
items.description: The Lemat revolver is unique in that its cylinder axis pin is also a fully functional 20ga percussion-primed smoothbore barrel.  It's irremovable.

items.name: lemon
items.description: Very sour citrus.  Can be eaten if you really want.

items.name: lemonade
items.description: Lemon juice mixed with water and sugar to dull the sourness.  Delicious and refreshing.

items.name: lemonade drink mix
items.description: Tangy yellow powder that smells strongly of lemons.  Can be mixed with water to make lemonade.

items.name: lemon-lime soda
items.description: Unlike cola this is caffeine free, however it is still carbonated and has plenty of sugar.  Not to mention a lemon-lime taste.

items.name: high-quality lens
items.description: A high-quality lens, useful for focusing or diffusing light.  Might be useful for starting a fire.

items.name: small high-quality lens
items.description: A small high-quality lens, useful for focusing or diffusing light.  Might be useful for crafting.

items.name: cooked lentils
items.description: Some delicious cooked lentils.  Humble but nutrient-rich.

items.name: leotard
items.description: A skin-tight spandex garment, covering the body from the groin to the shoulders.  With its deep scoop-cut back and high waist cuts, this garment is perfect for showcasing your physique on the stage.

items.name: lettuce
items.description: A crisp head of iceberg lettuce.

items.name: leverpostej
items.description: A traditional Danish pate.  Probably better if you spread it on some bread.

items.name: large pistol primer
items.description: Primer from a large caliber pistol round.

items.name: large rifle primer
items.description: Primer from a large caliber rifle round.

items.name: lifestraw
items.description: Set the lifestraw in suspect water, let sit for one minute then drink.  The two part filtration system will purify the water you drink.  Water taken from uncertain sources like a river may be dirty.

items.name: light plutonium battery
items.description: This battery uses a thin plutonium-244 rod to stabilize an exotic nanocompound, manufactured from repurposed plutonium fission cells.  It is universally compatible with all kinds of personal electronic devices.  Although it stores a huge amount of power, it cannot be recharged.

items.name: light battery
items.description: This is a light battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of small devices.

items.name: light bulb
items.description: A rather outdated light bulb used in all sorts of light equipment.

items.name: light detector
items.description: This is a photodiode on a chip, designed to convert incoming light to electrical energy for quantification.

items.name: light disposable battery
items.description: This is a light battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of small devices.  The battery's chemistry means that it has a very high capacity, but cannot be recharged.

items.name: emergency vehicle light (blue)
items.description: One of the blue-colored lights from the top of an emergency services vehicle.  When turned on, the lights rotate to shine in all directions.

items.name: emergency vehicle light (red)
items.description: One of the red-colored lights from the top of an emergency services vehicle.  When turned on, the lights rotate to shine in all directions.

items.name: lightweight replacement furniture
items.description: A set of lightweight composite grips and furniture that reduces a firearm's weight, and as a consequence, its handling and melee damage.

items.name: ultra-light plutonium battery
items.description: This battery uses a thin plutonium-244 rod to stabilize an exotic nanocompound, manufactured from repurposed plutonium fission cells.  It is universally compatible with small devices.  Although it stores a huge amount of power, it cannot be recharged.

items.name: ultra-light battery
items.description: This is a light battery cell designed for small size over everything else.  It retains its universal compatibility, though.

items.name: ultra-light disposable battery
items.description: This is a light battery cell designed for small size over everything else.  It retains its universal compatibility, though.  The battery's chemistry means that it has a very high capacity, but cannot be recharged.

items.name: light battery (high-capacity)
items.description: This is a high-capacity light battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of small devices.

items.name: lighter
items.description: This is a disposable plastic lighter.  A lighter must be carried to use various drugs, like cigarettes, or to light things like Molotov cocktails.  You can also use a lighter to light nearby items on fire.

items.name: lightstrip
items.description: This is a light-emitting circuit that has been wired directly to a battery.  It provides some weak light and can't be turned off until the battery dies.

items.name: lightstrip (inactive)
items.description: This is a light-emitting circuit that can be wired directly to a battery.  It provides some weak light and can't be turned off until the battery dies.

items.name: lilac bud
items.description: A lilac bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a lilac flower.

items.name: lilac
items.description: A lilac stalk with some petals.

items.name: lily bud
items.description: A lily bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a lily flower.

items.name: lily
items.description: A lily stalk with some petals.

items.name: chainmail sheet
items.description: This is a sheet of riveted chainmail.  With some skill, several of these sheets could be connected to make effective armor.

items.name: Linux t-shirt
items.description: A t-shirt with a picture of the Tux mascot on it.  Underneath it says "You wouldn't buy a car with the hood welded shut."

items.name: raw liver
items.description: The liver from an animal.  Although many dislike the texture, it's one of the more vitamin rich parts of the animal.  It is very good in sausages, but maybe a little less appetizing when cooked on its own.

items.name: cooked liver
items.description: Chock-full of B-Vitamins!  Cooked liver isn't all that bad, depending on how you feel about the texture, but this is probably the least fancy way to do it.

items.name: liver & onions
items.description: A classic way to serve liver.

items.name: livestock carrier
items.description: A heavy frame outfitted with tie-downs and attachment points for carrying cargo, with additional railings to keep a large animal in place.  It is meant to hold large animals for transport.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.

items.name: lightning link
items.description: Originally designed for the Colt SP-1, this 'reproduction' is intended to convert an AR-15 into a full-auto only rifle.  Once the necessary modifications are made and the link is in place, semi-auto is disabled and full-auto is enabled.  Reliability and precision suffer greatly due to questionable craftsmanship and lack of unobtainium SP-1 parts.

items.name: low quality crude oil
items.description: This is low quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis.  It still has some residual solvents in it so it needs to be purged in a vacuum oven, whipped over a heated surface, or distilled before it is safe to consume.

items.name: (ethanol) low quality crude oil
items.description: This is low quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis thats been diluted in ethanol and heated over a hotplate.  The next step would be to filter it through a buchner flask.

items.name: (ethanol) filtered low quality crude oil
items.description: This is low quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis thats been diluted in ethanol, heated over a hotplate, and filtered through a buchner flask.  The next step would be to run it through a rotovap.

items.name: filtered low quality crude oil
items.description: This is low quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis thats been diluted in ethanol, heated over a hotplate, filtered through a buchner flask, and all the ethanol recovered using a rotary evaporator.  It is ready for the distillation.

items.name: lobotomizer
items.description: This is a hand-forged collapsible tool that has two axe heads and sharp shovel-like tip on one end.  It can be used as a shovel, or you could chop some zombies with it instead.

items.name: small lock and key
items.description: A small lock, with a set of keys still inserted.

items.name: log
items.description: A large chunk of log, cut from a tree.  (a)ctivate a wood axe or wood saw to cut it into planks.

items.name: INCIDENT REPORT: IMMERSION-27A
items.description: A white piece of paper, with the logo of XEDRA printed on its upper left corner.  It seems to be an internal report of some kind.

items.name: loincloth
items.description: Rags stitched together and tied into a makeshift loincloth.  Covers your modesty, but not much else.

items.name: fur loincloth
items.description: A fur pelt tied into a loincloth.  Covers your modesty, but not much else.  Now you are a true barbarian warrior.

items.name: leather loincloth
items.description: Leather patches stitched together and tied into a makeshift loincloth.  Covers your modesty, but not much else.

items.name: wool loincloth
items.description: Bits of wool stitched together and tied into a makeshift loincloth.  Covers your modesty, but not much else.

items.name: pair of extra long white gloves
items.description: Long white costume gloves.

items.name: Long Island iced tea
items.description: A blend of incredibly strong-flavored liquors that somehow tastes like none of them.  It contains no tea, but the inclusion of cola gives it a tea-like color.

items.name: long knit scarf
items.description: A really long knitted cotton scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to loosen it if you get too warm.

items.name: long knit scarf (loose)
items.description: A really long knitted cotton scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to wear it tighter if you get too cold.

items.name: long patchwork scarf
items.description: A very long light cloth scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to loosen it if you get too warm.

items.name: long patchwork scarf (loose)
items.description: A very long light cloth scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to wear it tighter if you get too cold.

items.name: long pole
items.description: A stout, ten-foot pole.  Could be used similarly to a spear.  The Cataclysm gives fresh meaning to walking softly and carrying a big stick.

items.name: long underwear bottom
items.description: A pair of long underwear that help to maintain body temperature.

items.name: long underwear top
items.description: A long underwear top that helps to maintain body temperature.

items.name: sleeveless underwear top
items.description: A sleeveless underwear top that helps to maintain body temperature.

items.name: longbow
items.description: A six-foot wooden bow that takes a fair amount of strength to draw.  It can be used effectively by those of somewhat above-average strength.  Used mainly in medieval England in wartime, but pierces zombie hide just as well as chainmail.

items.name: flintlock rifle
items.description: Also called a Pennsylvania rifle, this long barreled rifled flintlock gun has signficantly increased accuracy at the cost of taking even longer to reload.

items.name: long-sleeved shirt
items.description: A long-sleeved cotton shirt.

items.name: longsword
items.description: This is a classic medieval sword, in between the lighter arming sword and later two-handed swords in size.  It requires a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.

items.name: longsword fake
items.description: This is a dull, cheaply-made replica of the classic medieval longsword.  It requires a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.

items.name: longsword replica
items.description: This is a classic medieval sword, in between the lighter arming sword and later two-handed swords in size.  You feel like the pommel could just snap off if you used it.

items.name: lotus flower
items.description: A lovely flower that grows on the surface of bodies of freshwater.  Traditionally connected with many Eastern cultures.

items.name: lotus bud
items.description: A lotus bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a lotus flower.

items.name: lotus
items.description: A lotus stalk with some petals.

items.name: lotus tea
items.description: A healthy beverage made from lotus flowers steeped in boiling water.

items.name: pair of lowtop tennis shoes
items.description: Lightweight shoes made of cloth and rubber.

items.name: pink tab
items.description: Tiny pink tabs resembling postage stamps, already dosed with some sort of drug.  Really only useful for entertainment.  Will cause hallucinations.

items.name: light survivor body armor
items.description: Lightweight, custom-built body armor made from Kevlar and tough fabric.  Mostly waterproof.

items.name: light survivor cargo pants
items.description: Lightweight, Kevlar armored cargo pants designed to hold as much as possible.  Strong and mostly waterproof.

items.name: light survivor suit
items.description: A lightweight, hand-built combination armor made from a cut-down bulletproof vest and a reinforced fabric jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

items.name: lucerne hammer
items.description: This is a versatile polearm with a spiked hammer head, a spike, and a hook attached to a long stick.

items.name: lucerne hammer fake
items.description: This is a cheap piece of crap imitation of a versatile polearm with a spiked hammer head, probably used for LARPing

items.name: lunch meat
items.description: Meat that has been cooked, preserved, and cut into thin slices for convenient sandwich construction.  It tastes fine cold.

items.name: piece of raw lung
items.description: A portion of lung from an animal.  It's spongy and pink, and spoils very quickly.  It can be a delicacy if properly prepared - but if improperly prepared, it's a chewy lump of flavorless connective tissue.

items.name: cooked piece of lung
items.description: Prepared in this way, it's a chewy grayish lump of flavorless connective tissue.  It doesn't look any tastier than it did raw, but the parasites are all cooked out.

items.name: lung provence
items.description: A delicious way to prepare lungs.

items.name: lutefisk
items.description: Lutefisk is preserved fish that has been dried in a lye solution.  Vile and soap-like yet highly nutritious, it is reminiscent of the afterbirth of a dog or the world's largest chunk of phlegm.

items.name: Leadworks magazine adapter
items.description: A bootleg adapter for permanently converting a firearm to accept proprietary Leadworks magazines.  Guaranteed to void your warranty.

items.name: Lycra patch
items.description: This is a small bolt of a synthetic fabric blended with stretchy Lycra fibers.  It could be used to make flexible yet strong clothing.  Stylish, but bad for the environment; at least you're recycling it.

items.name: lye
items.description: This is a liquid form of sodium hydroxide.  It is highly corrosive, handle with care.

items.name: lye powder
items.description: Powdered caustic soda.

items.name: M1014 shotgun
items.description: Benelli's first gas-operated shotgun, featuring dual pistons for enhanced reliability with various loads and a collapsible buttstock that reduces length by almost 8 inches.  Adopted in 1999 as the M1014 Joint Service Combat Shotgun, the Benelli M4 is one of the finest combat shotguns available.

items.name: Barrett M107A1
items.description: A large, shoulder-fired, .50 caliber anti-materiel rifle.  Its large size, recoil, and noise is offset by its damage and range.

items.name: Barrett magazine
items.description: Standard 10-round box magazine for a Barrett M107A1 anti-materiel rifle.

items.name: M110A1
items.description: A derivative of H&K's G28 with an aluminum upper receiver to meet US Army weight requirements.  It is a gas operated, rotating bolt rifle accurate to 1.5 MOA with standard ammunition.

items.name: M134D-H Minigun
items.description: The M134D-H Minigun is a (relatively) lightweight heavy rotary machine gun.  Its six barrels are rotated by an electric motor, powered by UPS or vehicle.  If you could find enough ammo for it, it would become a devastating weapon.

items.name: M14 makeshift magazine
items.description: An improvised 5-round straight single-stack box magazine consisting of little more than a bent sheet of steel held together by duct tape and hope, for use with M14 rifle.

items.name: M14 EBR-RI

items.name: M1911A1

items.name: BAR extended magazine
