items.description: This looks like a blueberry the size of your fist, but pinkish in color.  It has a strong but delicious aroma, but is clearly either mutated or of alien origin.

items.name: marloss gelatin
items.description: This looks like a handful of lemon-colored liquid which has taken a set, much like pre-Cataclysm Jello.  It has a strong but delicious aroma, but is clearly either mutated or of alien origin.

items.name: cyan scarf
items.description: A simple cloth scarf worn by Marloss Voices.  Wherever the Voices go, long sought peace soon follows, for better or for worse.

items.name: Marloss seed
items.description: This looks like a sunflower seed the size of your palm.  It has a strong but delicious aroma, but is clearly either mutated or of alien origin.  You could probably plant it.

items.name: marshmallows
items.description: A handful of squishy, fluffy, puffy, delicious marshmallows.

items.name: ballistic mask
items.description: A protective reinforced Kevlar mask that covers the face.  Provides excellent protection from ballistic threats.

items.name: firefighter PBA mask
items.description: A full-face mask commonly used by firefighters.  The protective breathing apparatus provides excellent protection from smoke, flame, and other dangers.  It must be prepared before use.

items.name: dust mask
items.description: A simple piece of cotton that straps over the mouth.  Provides a small amount of protection from airborne illness and dust.

items.name: filter mask
items.description: A mask that straps over your mouth and nose and filters air.  Protects from smoke, dust, and other contaminants quite well.  It must be prepared before use.

items.name: survivor firemask
items.description: A custom-built, Nomex-insulated gas mask that covers the face and eyes.  It provides excellent protection from heat, smoke, teargas, and shrapnel.  It must be prepared before use.

items.name: XL survivor firemask
items.description: A custom-built, Nomex-insulated gas mask that covers the face and eyes regardless of your state of mutation.  It provides excellent protection from heat, smoke, teargas, and shrapnel.  It must be prepared before use.

items.name: gas mask
items.description: A full gas mask that covers the face and eyes.  Provides excellent protection from smoke, teargas, and other contaminants.  It must be prepared before use.

items.name: XL gas mask
items.description: A rather roomy mask with filters attached, designed to accommodate exotic anatomy.  Provides excellent protection from smoke, teargas, and other contaminants.  It must be prepared before use.

items.name: Guy Fawkes mask
items.description: Remember, remember, the fifth of November.

items.name: survivor divemask
items.description: A custom-built, armored rebreather mask that covers the face and eyes.  It provides excellent protection from harm as well providing breathing gas while underwater.  Use it to turn it on.

items.name: survivor divemask (on)
items.description: A custom-built, armored rebreather mask that covers the face and eyes.  It provides excellent protection from harm as well providing breathing gas while underwater.  It is turned on, and continually consuming its filter.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: XL survivor divemask
items.description: A custom-built, armored rebreather mask that covers the face and eyes.  It provides excellent protection from harm as well providing breathing gas while underwater.  Use it to turn it on.

items.name: XL survivor divemask (on)
items.description: A custom-built, armored rebreather mask that covers the face and eyes regardless of your state of mutation.  It provides excellent protection from harm as well providing breathing gas while underwater.  It is turned on, and continually consuming its filter.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: hockey mask
items.description: A protective face mask made of thick plastic.  Commonly worn by hockey goalies.

items.name: heavy survivor mask
items.description: A custom-built, steel reinforced gas mask that covers the face and eyes.  Provides excellent protection from smoke, teargas, and shrapnel.  It must be prepared before use.

items.name: light survivor mask
items.description: A custom-built, reinforced gas mask that covers the face and eyes.  Provides excellent protection from smoke, teargas, and shrapnel.  It must be prepared before use.

items.name: rioter mask
items.description: This is a t-shirt with sleeves tied on the back.  These are usually worn by rioters to hide their identity.

items.name: ski mask
items.description: A warm wool mask that protects the head and face from cold.  It has a full face opening that can be adjusted to set how much is exposed.

items.name: ski mask (open)
items.description: A warm wool mask that protects the head and face from cold.  It has a full face opening that can be adjusted to set how much is exposed.

items.name: survivor mask
items.description: A custom-built, leather reinforced gas mask that covers the face and eyes.  Provides excellent protection from smoke, teargas, and shrapnel.  It must be prepared before use.

items.name: XL survivor mask
items.description: A custom-built, reinforced gas mask that covers the face and eyes regardless of your state of mutation.  Provides excellent protection from smoke, teargas, and shrapnel.  It must be prepared before use.

items.name: winter survivor mask
items.description: A custom-built, fur-trimmed gas mask that covers the face and eyes.  Quite warm, it still provides excellent protection from smoke, teargas, and shrapnel.  It must be prepared before use.

items.name: XL winter survivor mask
items.description: A custom-built, fur-trimmed gas mask that covers the face and eyes regardless of your state of mutation.  Quite warm, it still provides excellent protection from smoke, teargas, and shrapnel.  It must be prepared before use.

items.name: masonry saw (off)
items.description: This is a construction tool for cutting through concrete or other surfaces.  It runs on gasoline.  Using this item will cause it to turn on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon or a terrible chainsaw.

items.name: masonry saw (on)
items.description: This masonry saw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: masterkey shotgun
items.description: A minimalist pump action shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  It allows a total of four shotgun shells to be loaded and fired.

items.name: modified masterkey shotgun
items.description: A minimalist pump action shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  It allows a total of four shotgun shells to be loaded and fired.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and pump-action guns, if you so want.

items.name: match trigger
items.description: A precision weighted trigger assembly that slightly improves a firearm's accuracy.

items.name: match head bomb
items.description: This is a homemade bomb consisting of a bottle filled with match heads and equipped with a fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse; you will, of course, need a lighter in your inventory to do this.

items.name: match head bomb (lit)
items.description: This is a bottle filled with match heads and equipped with a fuse.  This one has been lit, and its fuse is rapidly burning down.  You may not want to hold onto it much longer.

items.name: matchbook
items.description: This is a small book of matches with a coarse strike surface on the outside flap.  Matches must be carried to use various drugs like cigarettes, or to light things like Molotov cocktails.  You can also use matches to light nearby items on fire.

items.name: aluminum ingot
items.description: A small aluminum ingot, standardized for further processing.  Light but durable, this could be cast into various shapes for construction or ground down to a powder, for more… high-profile applications.

items.name: cement
items.description: Portland is most likely long gone, but its memory persists in cement.  This ubiquitous binder can be used for all kinds of advanced masonry.  Just add water.

items.name: limestone
items.description: A handful of small chunks of limestone.  Useful for experiments at science fairs, but pretty useless as ammo.  Maybe something could be crafted from this stuff…

items.name: niter
items.description: A large crystal of niter, the mineral form of potassium nitrate.  It can be processed into saltpeter.

items.name: quicklime
items.description: The product of burning limestone, this white powder is a crucial ingredient in making cement.  That said, it is also extremely caustic and will cause severe burns to any tissue it comes in contact with.  This property could probably be exploited.

items.name: rhodonite
items.description: A chunk of rhodonite.  It has manganese dioxide covering and going through it in veins, which can be obtained using a chisel.

items.name: rock salt
items.description: A handful of rock salt crystals.  Could be refined into table salt.

items.name: sand
items.description: A handful of New England sand.  If you had a stoked furnace, you could turn it into glass.  Otherwise, it's only good for making cement.

items.name: limestone shard
items.description: A small shard of limestone.  Pretty flimsy and not much of a weapon, but its alkaline properties may yet find some use.

items.name: soil
items.description: A pile of loosely packed, slightly damp loamy soil.  This mixture of sand, silt and clay is ideal for growing plants.

items.name: zincite
items.description: A chunk of zincite.  Could be refined into zinc oxide, then into zinc by reduction with a source of carbon.

items.name: mattress
items.description: This is a single, or twin, sized mattress.

items.name: mayonnaise
items.description: A gloppy mix of egg, oil, and salt that is traditionally used to moisten sandwiches.

items.name: messenger bag
items.description: Light and easy to wear, but doesn't offer much storage.

items.name: spiced mead
items.description: Well-aged honey wine, spiced with a hint of hops.  Goes down bittersweet.

items.name: bone meal
items.description: This bone meal can be used to craft fertilizer and some other things.

items.name: tainted bone meal
items.description: This is a grayish bone meal made from rotten bones.

items.name: chitin powder
items.description: This chitin powder can be used to craft fertilizer and some other things.

items.name: chunk of meat
items.description: Freshly butchered meat.  You could eat it raw, but cooking it is better.

items.name: aspic
items.description: A dish in which meat or fish is set into a gelatin made from a meat or vegetable stock.

items.name: leech bark
items.description: Dry and tough bark matter harvested from an alien plant.  It is slightly translucent, and if placed against the light you can distinguish glistening blue veins running through it.

items.name: canned meat
items.description: Low-sodium preserved meat.  It was boiled and canned.  Contains most of the nutrition, but little of the savor of cooked meat.

items.name: cooked meat
items.description: This is a chunk of freshly cooked meat.  It's filling and nutritious, but unseasoned and a bit bland.

items.name: alien fronds
items.description: The fleshy fronds harvested from an alien plant.  Eating these membranous leaves and gut-like stems is likely a terrible idea, and yet they have a paradoxically pleasant and inviting sweet smell.  Might be non-vegan.

items.name: pickled meat
items.description: This is a serving of crisply brined and canned meat.  Tasty and nutritious.

items.name: salted meat slice
items.description: Meat slices cured in brine.  Salty but tasty in a pinch.

items.name: scrap of meat
items.description: This is a tiny scrap of edible meat.  It's not much, but it'll do in a pinch.

items.name: cooked scrap of meat
items.description: This is a tiny scrap of edible meat.  It's not much, but it'll do in a pinch.

items.name: smoked meat
items.description: Tasty meat that has been heavily smoked for preservation.  It could be further smoked to dehydrate it completely.

items.name: chunk of tainted meat
items.description: Meat that's obviously unhealthy.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.

items.name: medical gauze
items.description: This is decent sized piece of cotton, sterilized and sealed.  It's designed for medical purposes.

items.name: medical tape
items.description: A roll of medical tape, similar to duct tape.

items.name: medium plutonium battery
items.description: This battery uses a thin plutonium-244 rod to stabilize an exotic nanocompound, manufactured from repurposed plutonium fission cells.  It is universally compatible with all kinds of appliances and power tools.  Although it stores a huge amount of power, it cannot be recharged.

items.name: medium battery
items.description: This is a medium battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of appliances and power tools.

items.name: medium disposable battery
items.description: This is a medium battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of appliances and power tools.  The battery's chemistry means that it has a very high capacity, but cannot be recharged.

items.name: medium battery (high-capacity)
items.description: This is a high-capacity medium battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of appliances and power tools.

items.name: medium storage battery
items.description: A medium storage battery containing multiple lithium-ion cells.

items.name: 1900 hp gas turbine engine
items.description: A large gas turbine engine, usually used for military helicopters.  Known for its high rate of fuel consumption.

items.name: melatonin tablet
items.description: Over-the-counter melatonin supplements, commonly prescribed to treat sleep deprivation and to mitigate its effects.  One tablet a day combined with a good night's sleep will help you recover faster.

items.name: melon
items.description: A large and very sweet fruit.

items.name: melting point apparatus
items.description: This is basically a hot plate, with a metal housing attached.  The metal housing has a magnification viewport and a slot into which a capillary tube containing a crystallized sample is inserted.  The device lets you precisely measure the melting point of a crystal, a property very useful in identifying what it is and how pure it is.

items.name: memory banks module
items.description: Allows for storage and recovery of information.

items.name: mess kit
items.description: A self-contained camping mess kit, containing everything you might need for wilderness cooking.  This model relies on a battery-operated hotplate, rather than the more commonplace chemical-fueled Esbit stove.

items.name: mess tin
items.description: A compact military-style pan and tray, designed for heating food over a fire or portable stove.  It is shallower than a proper pot or pan, and lacks the integrated heating elements modern mess kits have.

items.name: meal tray
items.description: A stainless steel tray used for serving food in cafeterias, mess halls, or similar places.

items.name: metabolism
items.description: seeing this is a bug

items.name: metal RPG die
items.description: A metal die used to play various role-playing games

items.name: metal butchering rack
items.description: Metal butchering rack designed to hang a carcass in the air.  It is folded for easy transportation.

items.name: metal fileset
items.description: These tools are commonly used to remove small amounts of materials from the surface of metal objects.

items.name: metal funnel
items.description: This is a large metal funnel used to collect rainwater.  Less portable than plastic funnels, but collects more water.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.

items.name: metal smoking rack
items.description: A metal rack designed to smoke food for better preservation and taste.  It is folded for easy transportation.

items.name: metallic smoother
items.description: This metallic tool is most often used to smooth concrete, or mortar, in construction projects.

items.name: metal tank (60L)
items.description: A large metal tank for holding liquids.  Useful for crafting.

items.name: metal tank (2L)
items.description: A small metal tank for gas or liquids.  Useful for crafting.

items.name: low-grade methamphetamine
items.description: A profoundly addictive and powerful stimulant.  While extremely effective at enhancing alertness, it is hazardous to health and the risk of an adverse reaction is great.

items.name: Mexican hot chocolate
items.description: This semi-bitter chocolate drink made from cocoa, cinnamon, and chilies, traces its history to the Maya and Aztecs.  Perfect for a cold winter day.

items.name: Milkor MGL
items.description: The Milkor Multi-Grenade Launcher is designed to compensate for the drawback of single-shot grenade launchers by allowing sustained heavy firepower.  However, it is still slow to reload and must be used with careful planning.

items.name: microphone stand
items.description: A telescoping boom stand made of steel and painted black.  About 6' tall when full extended, or 3' when closed fully.  Has threads for a mic clip on one end.

items.name: microcentrifuge
items.description: This is a smaller, benchtop version of the larger furniture-sized centrifuge.  Don't be fooled by its portable scale; it's still a very powerful piece of equipment that can spin stuff really quickly.  It's not a toy!

items.name: XLR microphone
items.description: A typical microphone used to record or amplify voice.  Comes with a clip.  Has a 3-pin XLR connector on the bottom in order to connect to am amp.

items.name: microscope
items.description: A classic tool for the ages!  This hefty, durable piece of lab equipment makes small things look bigger.  Without electricity the light doesn't work, but the rest of it is surprisingly functional.  Unfortunately it's not useful for very much at the moment.

items.name: dissecting microscope
items.description: This microscope has less magnification than a standard one.  It's also stereoscopic and produces a neat 3d image of the surface.  It was typically used for doing dissections and other fine detail work on small creatures.  It still works pretty well with an added light source, but what would you do with it?

items.name: microwave
items.description: A home microwave, has probably seen its share of baked beans.  Good for scrap parts.

items.name: mi-go bio-gun
items.description: Fake gun that fires some sort of solidified organic matter at very high speed by unknown means of propulsion.

items.name: military mess kit
items.description: Military mess kit designed for long-range reconnaissance patrols deployed behind enemy lines.  All parts are made from thin sheet of aluminum / superalloy composite and are insulated with ceramic coating.  Relies on a battery-operated hotplate, rather than the smoke-producing chemical-fueled Esbit stove.  Compact, durable and lightweight.

items.name: military composite plating
items.description: A thick sheet of military grade armor, best bullet stopper you can stick on a vehicle.

items.name: military operations map
items.description: This is a printed topographical map of the local area.  Originally of military origin, it details the locations of evacuation centers and military facilities.  Using it will add points of interest to your map.

items.name: milk
items.description: Baby cow food, appropriated for adult humans.  Spoils rapidly.

items.name: shelf stable milk
items.description: This is milk that has been pasteurized at much higher temperatures than normal.  It tastes slightly different, but, unopened, will last far longer than regular milk.

items.name: sweet atomic coffee
items.description: Atomic coffee mixed into milk.  This serving of coffee has been created using an atomic coffee pot's FULL NUCLEAR brewing cycle.

items.name: sweet atomic coffee milk
items.description: Atomic coffee mixed into milk.  This serving of coffee has been created using an atomic coffee pot's FULL NUCLEAR brewing cycle.  Added sweetener for those who like it even sweeter.

items.name: coffee milk
items.description: Coffee mixed into milk.

items.name: sweet coffee milk
items.description: Coffee mixed into milk.  Added sweetener for those who like it sweet.

items.name: heavy cream
items.description: Cream that has been skimmed from the top of raw milk left to sit.

items.name: milk cream jar
items.description: This jar contains raw milk separated into cream.  It is sealed until you are ready to use it.

items.name: rising cream jar
items.description: This jar contains raw milk separating into cream.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

items.name: curdled milk
items.description: Milk that has been curdled with rennet.  It still needs to be salted and drained of whey.

items.name: evaporated milk
items.description: Milk that's had about 60% of its water removed prior to canning.

items.name: powdered milk
items.description: Dehydrated milk powder.  Mix with water to make drinkable milk.

items.name: raw milk
items.description: This is raw, unhomogenized and unpasteurized milk from a cow.  It couldn't be any fresher unless you drank it straight from the cow, which might upset it.  Depending on your dietary sensibilities, you might want to pasteurize or even boil this before drinking.

items.name: reconstituted milk
items.description: Baby cow food, appropriated for adult humans.  This milk has been reconstituted from a processed milk.  Spoils rapidly.

items.name: milk tea
items.description: Hot tea with cold milk.

items.name: sweet milk tea
items.description: Hot tea with cold milk and added sweetener.

items.name: milkshake
items.description: An all-natural cold beverage made with milk and sweeteners.  Tastes great when frozen.

items.name: deluxe milkshake
items.description: This milkshake has been enhanced with added sweeteners, and even has a cherry on top.  Tastes great, but is fairly awful for your health.

items.name: fast food milkshake
items.description: A milkshake made by freezing a premade mix.  Tastes better due to how much sugar is in it, but is bad for your health.

items.name: neural data
items.description:
Data stolen from a dead scientist memory banks.  Is the owner of these thoughts still hidden here, amidst the unreadable data; or are these just a collection of the precious moments of someone's life?

Whatever the case, the idea of perpetually keeping a part of you within a metallic pill makes you feel uncomfortable.

items.name: mind splicer kit
items.description: Surgical forceps, cables and a modified smartphone inside a small plastic pouch.  Assembled to steal the mind of some poor man, these are tools of the creepy high-tech sandman.

items.name: mining helmet
items.description: This is a mining helmet with a heavy-duty LED flashlight.  Using this will turn the flashlight on and provide light, assuming it is charged with batteries.

items.name: mining helmet (on)
items.description: This is a mining helmet with a heavy-duty LED flashlight.  The flashlight is turned on, and continually draining its batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: minifreezer
items.description: Compact version of a chest freezer, designed as a mobile solution for freezing food.  Provides insulation from the elements.

items.name: minifridge
items.description: A very small fridge for keeping food cool.  Provides some insulation from outside weather.

items.name: mininuke
items.description: This is an extremely powerful weapon, a portable nuclear bomb.  Use it to activate the timer.  You guess that the explosion would be large enough to take out a small house.

items.name: mininuke
items.description: This miniature nuclear bomb has a light blinking on the side, showing that it will soon explode.  You should probably get far, far away from it.

items.name: mininuke launcher
items.description: A powerful handheld launcher handcrafted from scrap.  Made to launch modified handheld nuclear weapons, it is an exceedingly powerful weapon.

items.name: modified mininuke
items.description: A heavily modified handheld nuclear device on a rocket.  Intended to be fired from a specialized launcher, it has been rigged to explode on impact instead of on a timer.  It can fly further than the explosion will reach, probably.

items.name: minireactor
items.description: A small portable plutonium reactor.  Handle with great care!

items.name: mini speargun
items.description: A small underwater fishing implement designed to fire a specialized type of spear using tension in a rubber band.  While highly effective when used underwater, it is nearly useless on dry land.

items.name: peppermint patty
items.description: A handful of soft chocolate-covered peppermint patties… yum!

items.name: hand mirror
items.description: A small hand mirror.

items.name: misc repair kit
items.description: This is a portable toolkit, consisting of a small carving knife for precise carving of replacement parts from raw materials, a wood saw for more heavy-duty wood cutting, and a patch of soft material for cleaning surfaces.  If supplied with duct tape, it can be used to repair certain items.

items.name: pair of mittens
items.description: A pair of warm mittens.  They are extremely cumbersome.

items.name: strong mixed alcohol
items.description: Strong alcoholic drinks, mixed with no regard for taste.

items.name: weak mixed alcohol
items.description: Weak alcoholic drinks, mixed with no regard for taste.

items.name: mixer
items.description: A device with faders, switches, and knobs that mixes input signal and sends it to two output XLR cables.  (left and right)

items.name: Mjoelnir
items.description:
A large hammer, forged from the heart of a dying star.  It bears the inscription:

Whosoever holds this hammer,
If he be worthy,
Shall possess the power to…
CRUSH!'

items.name: MK 23 MOD 0
items.description: Jokingly referred to as "The World's Only Crew-Served Pistol", this massive pistol was designed as a primary weapon for select "special operators".  Its cumbersome nature, the introduction of the derivative HK USP series and the logistics of getting .45 ACP ammunition in theater doomed this behemoth to US SOCOM armories.  Like the USP, the Mk 23 is a remarkably reliable gun; someone could probably take out a nuclear equipped walking tank with this in their holster.

items.name: SD-Memory card
items.description: A memory card, used.  Might be worth a look.

items.name: SD-Memory card (encrypted)
items.description: This memory card appears to have the firmware encryption set.  Hopefully it contains something worth encrypting.

items.name: Science SD-Memory card
items.description: This memory card appears to be related to 'XEDRA', and is certainly encrypted.  Looks *Interesting*, though…

items.name: SD-Memory card (clean)
items.description: This memory card is either unused or has been wiped clean.  You could use it to store your data, though!

items.name: pair of moccasins
items.description: Simple shoes made from animal pelts.

items.name: S&W Model 10
items.description: A six-shot revolver, produced since 1899 and known as the most popular handgun of the 20th century.  It has a swing-out cylinder for ease of reloading.

items.name: The Modern Tanner
items.description: An in-depth and easy to read guide that details a very modern take on the ancient art of leather tanning.

items.name: MBR vest (empty)
items.description: A Modular Bullet Resistant Vest.  It has pouches for extra armor inserts, but without them provides little more protection over a regular vest.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.

items.name: MBR vest (ceramic plates)
items.description: A Modular Bullet Resistant Vest.  Ceramic plates have been inserted to improve its protection, offering good resistance to bullets at the expense of being less durable than other plate options.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.

items.name: MBR vest (hard plates)
items.description: A Modular Bullet Resistant Vest.  Hardened steel plates have been inserted, greatly increasing its protection at the cost of a great deal of weight and loss of flexibility.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.

items.name: MBR vest (Kevlar plates)
items.description: A Modular Bullet Resistant Vest.  Kevlar plates have been inserted to improve its protection.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.

items.name: MBR vest (steel plating)
items.description: A Modular Bullet Resistant Vest.  Its armor pouches have steel plates in them; this improves protection, but makes the vest much heavier and encumbering.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.

items.name: MBR vest (superalloy)
items.description: A Modular Bullet Resistant Vest.  Its armor pouches have superalloy plating in them, giving it extra protection with marginal flexibility loss and additional weight.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.

items.name: molasses
items.description: An extremely sugary tar-like syrup, produced by repeatedly boiling the juice of sugarcane or sugar beets.  It has a slightly bitter aftertaste.

items.name: plastic mold
items.description: This is a plastic mold.  It could be shaped and used to craft items made of plastic.

items.name: MOLLE pack
items.description: The Modular Lightweight Load-carrying Equipment is an advanced military backpack.  Covered with pockets and straps, it strikes a fine balance between storage space and encumbrance.

items.name: Molotov cocktail
items.description: A bottle of flammable liquid with a rag inserted.  Use this item to light the rag.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  After lighting it, throw it to cause fires.

items.name: Molotov cocktail
items.description: A bottle of flammable liquid with a flaming rag stoppered in its neck.  Throwing it will shatter the bottle on impact and ignite a fireball.  Dropping it will set you on fire, so don't do that unless you want to burn to death.

items.name: cent
items.description: IF YOU ARE SEEING THIS IT IS A BUG.

items.name: money bundle
items.description: A bundle holding many 20 dollar bills, pretty useless now though.

items.name: newspaper page
items.description: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It was printed in the months leading up to the Cataclysm.  Most of the information on there is terribly trivial, or out of date, but one thing catches your eye briefly.

items.name: moonshine
items.description: Only the strongest, purest, good ol' fashioned hooch, distilled from corn and sugar.  Guaranteed to make you forget about the whole Cataclysm thing, or you get your vision back.

items.name: mop
items.description: This is an unwieldy mop.  Good for cleaning up spills.  Use to mop up any 'mess' you may have made.

items.name: cooked morel mushroom
items.description: A tasty cooked morel mushroom.

items.name: fried morel mushroom
items.description: A delicious serving of fried morsels of morel mushroom.

items.name: morningstar
items.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy, spiked iron ball on the end.  It deals devastating crushing damage, with a small amount of piercing to boot.

items.name: morningstar fake
items.description: A light, cheaply made replica of a medieval weapon that would normally consist of a wood handle with a heavy, spiked iron ball on the end.

items.name: morningstar replica
items.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy, spiked iron ball on the end.  That end feels lighter than it should.

items.name: morphine
items.description: A very strong semi-synthetic narcotic used to treat intense pain in hospital settings.  This injectable drug is very addictive.

items.name: adobe mortar
items.description: A thick, pasty mud, low in sand content to reduce crumbling once dry.  Used to glue larger, heavier pieces of mud and clay together.

items.name: mortar
items.description: Some mortar, ready to be used in building projects.

items.name: mortar and pestle
items.description: This is a simple combination of a small grindstone and a bowl-shaped stone.  Used for grinding grain, but time-consuming compared to more complex methods.

items.name: Mosin-Nagant M44
items.description: The Model 44 is the carbine sized variant of the standard 1891/30.  It has a shorter barrel, therefore it is weaker than the 1891/30, but easier to carry.

items.name: Mosin-Nagant 1891/30

items.name: phone book
items.description: This hefty volume contains the telephone numbers of individuals, businesses, and utilities in the nearby area, pretty useless during the apocalypse and all.

items.name: photo album
items.description: A leather album full of photos of somebody's family.  You don't know any of the people in them, but seeing these pictures still makes you think of happier times.

items.name: pickaxe
items.description: This is a large steel pickaxe, suitable for breaking up hard things or (with enough skill) hard targets.  Strike the earth!

items.name: pickelhaube
items.description: A spiked helmet once worn by German military officers.  The spike is very sharp.

items.name: pickle
items.description: A pickled cucumber.  Rather sour, but tastes good and lasts for a long time.

items.name: pickled egg
items.description: A pickled egg.  Rather salty, but tastes good and lasts for a long time.

items.name: fermenting pickle jar
items.description: This jar contains a batch of pickles set to ferment.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

items.name: locksmith kit
items.description: This is a locksmith's set of sturdy steel lock picks and torsion wrenches.  It is essential for silently and quickly opening locks, provided you have some mechanical skill.

items.name: fruit pie
items.description: A delicious baked pie with a sweet fruit filling.

items.name: maple pie
items.description: A sweet and delicious baked pie with pure maple syrup.

items.name: meat pie
items.description: A delicious baked pie with a delicious meat filling.

items.name: vegetable pie
items.description: A delicious baked pie with a delicious vegetable filling.

items.name: pike
items.description: This is a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft tipped with an iron spearhead.

items.name: copper pike
items.description: This is a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft tipped with a copper spearhead.

items.name: pike fake
items.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft tipped with an iron spearhead.

items.name: pike replica
items.description: This is a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft tipped with an iron spearhead.  The head seems to be pretty dull, and the whole thing feels poorly made.

items.name: pike pole
items.description: A durable tool consisting of a sturdy fiberglass shaft tipped with a small steel hook.

items.name: wooden pike
items.description: This is a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft with a fire hardened point.

items.name: pillow
items.description: A pillow to rest your head on when sleeping.

items.name: Ambien
items.description: A habit-forming tranquilizer with a variety of psychoactive side effects.  Used in the treatment of insomnia.  Its generic name is zolpidem tartrate.

items.name: pilot light
items.description: A pilot light from a gas-burning device, this particular one is a simple piezoelectric igniter.

items.name: pin reamer
items.description: Handheld pin reamers of this kind are used to enlarge existing holes, or remove any burs and such from them.

items.name: pine bough
items.description: A branch from a pine tree, oozing sticky sap and bristling with prickly needles.

items.name: pine nuts
items.description: A handful of tasty crunchy nuts from a pinecone.

items.name: pine needle tea
items.description: A fragrant and healthy beverage made from pine needles steeped in boiling water.

items.name: pine wine
items.description: A potent wine flavored with pine resin.  Bold and pungent, its biting taste and strong aroma takes some getting used to.

items.name: pineapple
items.description: A large, spiky pineapple.  A bit sour, though.

items.name: pinecone
items.description: A spiny pod from a pine tree.  Dry seeds rattle around inside when you shake it.

items.name: pipe
items.description: A steel pipe, makes a good melee weapon.  Useful in a few crafting recipes.

items.name: pipe cleaner
items.description: This is a tool designed to clean interior surface of pipes, bottles, and similar objects.  This one is thin enough to be used for cleaning firearm barrels from dirt and fouling.

items.name: pipe combination gun
items.description: A home-made triple-barreled firearm, one barrel chambered in .30-06 and two other for shotgun shells.  It is made from pipes and parts cannibalized from a double barrel shotgun.

items.name: double-barrel pipe shotgun
items.description: A home-made double-barreled shotgun.  It is simply two pipes attached to a stock, with a pair of hammers to strike the two rounds it holds.

items.name: glass pipe
items.description: This is a hand-blown glass pipe.  It's of the type most commonly used to smoke recreational substances.

items.name: 40mm pipe launcher
items.description: This is a home built launcher tube that can be attached to almost any weapon except handguns.  It allows a single 40mm grenade to be loaded and fired.

items.name: pipe shotgun
items.description: A home-made shotgun.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

items.name: tobacco pipe
items.description: This is a hand-carved wooden smoking pipe.  It's designed to facilitate consumption of fire cured tobacco leaves.

items.name: pistachios
items.description: A handful of nuts from a pistachio tree.

items.name: roasted pistachios
items.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a pistachio tree.

items.name: pistol bayonet
items.description: A pistol bayonet is a stabbing weapon that can be attached to the front of a handgun, allowing a melee attack to deal piercing damage.

items.name: flintlock pistol
items.description: A beautifully decorated flintlock pistol.  If using this doesn't make you feel a pirate, nothing will.

items.name: ergonomic grip
items.description: A set of ergonomic replacement furniture for a firearm improving handling.

items.name: pistol scope
items.description: A small scope intended for use on a handgun.  Increases weight but improves accuracy greatly.

items.name: pistol stock
items.description: An add-on stock for handguns considerably improving control of recoil.

items.name: pitchfork
items.description: An agricultural tool with long wooden shaft and four spikes.  Is used to lift hay.

items.name: cheese pizza
items.description: A delicious pizza with molten cheese on top.

items.name: meat pizza
items.description: A meat pizza, for all the carnivores out there.  Chock-full of minced meat and heavily seasoned.

items.name: supreme pizza
items.description: A supreme pizza with ALL the toppings.

items.name: vegetable pizza
items.description: A vegetarian pizza, with delicious tomato sauce and a fluffy crust.  Its smell brings back great memories.

items.name: plant fiber
items.description: Tough thin fiber, taken from a plant.  Can be used as thread.

items.name: fungal fluid sac
items.description: A fluid bladder from a fungus based lifeform.  Not very nutritious, but fine to eat anyway.

items.name: hydrogen canister
items.description: A canister of pressurized hydrogen so heavily compressed it has turned solid.  With proper equipment, it could be heated to plasma.

items.name: PPA-5
items.description: Portable Plasma Accelerator Model Five, developed by Lockheed Martin Corporation.  This device uses highly advanced capacitor banks to create a torus of superheated hydrogen plasma and accelerate it to incredible speed.  It was designed to take down heavy vehicles, and was expected to fully enter US Army service not long before the Cataclysm.

items.name: Boeing XM-P plasma rifle
items.description: Boeing developed the focused plasma weaponry together with DARPA.  It heats solid hydrogen to create plasma and envelops it with polymers to reduce blooming.  While powerful, it suffers from short range.  Powered by UPS.

items.name: vacuum-packed bag
items.description: This is a bag of vacuum-packed food.

items.name: plastic boat hull
items.description: A rigid plastic sheet that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats.  Then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.

items.name: kiddie bowl
items.description: A plastic bowl designed for use by children.

items.name: plastic tub
items.description: A big, square plastic bucket usually used for carrying ice cream.

items.name: plastic chunk
items.description: This is a piece of plastic.  It could be used to fabricate, repair, or reinforce plastic items.

items.name: plastic fork
items.description: A plastic disposable fork.  Great for picnic lunches in the post apocalyptic wasteland.

items.name: jack o'lantern
items.description: This is a plastic lantern that is painted to look like a pumpkin with a face.  It has a candle inside it, that can be replaced when burnt down.  It doesn't provide very much light, but it can burn for quite a long time.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.

items.name: spooky jack o'lantern
items.description: There is a thick LED candle inside the pumpkin face.  It doesn't provide very much light, but it can burn for quite a long time.  This candle is lit.  The face shifts.

items.name: plastic knife
items.description: A plastic butter knife.  It's actually a bit sharper than its metal counterpart, but that doesn't make it any more effective as a weapon.

items.name: plastic plate
items.description: A durable plastic plate, the sort you might use as patio dishware.

items.name: plastic flower pot
items.description: A cheap plastic pot used for planting.

items.name: plastic scrap
items.description: This is a tiny piece of plastic.  Useless on its own, but could be melted down if you gather enough.

items.name: plastic sheet
items.description: This is a large sheet of heavy flexible plastic, the sort that might have been used for commercial wrapping or for weather-sealing a home.

items.name: plastic shopping bag
items.description: A bag used to carry groceries home.

items.name: plastic dice
items.description: A six-sided plastic dice.

items.name: plastic spoon
items.description: A plastic disposable spoon.  Easier to bend than the metal variety.

items.name: kiddie spoon
items.description: A plastic spoon designed for use by children.

items.name: plastic straw
items.description: A plastic straw, for drinking things and making litter

items.name: underarm protector
items.description: A sturdy cotton plastron that protects much of the torso, the dominant shoulder, and underarm while fencing.

items.name: plastic chest protector
items.description: A rigid plastic plastron with molded cups to be worn by female fencers for protection while fencing.

items.name: platinum bracelet
items.description: A flawless platinum bracelet.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: platinum dental grill
items.description: Fake platinum-and-silver teeth.  They may be cheaper than fake gold teeth, but they're much more rare.  Fits horribly, but looks very shiny.

items.name: pair of platinum earrings
items.description: A pair of plain platinum earrings - if gold is getting boring, just use another rare metal.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: platinum grille
items.description: This is a metal grille with a layer of platinum plating, suitable for use as a catalyst for some chemical reactions.

items.name: platinum hairpin
items.description: The ultimate in esoteric, metal hair accessories, this hairpin is made from pure platinum.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: platinum locket
items.description: A small, platinum locket for storing photographs or other small objects.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: platinum necklace
items.description: A platinum necklace, with a small, empty heart frame hanging from a chain.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: platinum ring
items.description: A platinum ring, engraved with all manner of swirls and spirals.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: platinum
items.description: A soft shiny metal.  Before the apocalypse this would've been worth a small fortune but now its value is greatly diminished.

items.name: platinum watch
items.description: Flex on those gold-watch wearers with the rare, expensive and superior platinum watch.  This one is made from solid platinum.

items.name: book of plays
items.description: A collection of plays by various authors from around the world, including scripts by Wilde, Beckett, Checkov, and Shakespeare.

items.name: pliers
items.description: This is a basic pair of slip-joint pliers, able to handle basic mechanical work and pulling apart some ammunition cartridges.  Anything too complex will require a wrench.

items.name: plum
items.description: A handful of large, purple plums.  Healthy and good for your digestion.

items.name: professional plunger
items.description: This hollow plastic toilet plunger's bell compresses like an accordion.  It is efficient at its intended purpose, and complete rubbish as a weapon.

items.name: toilet plunger
items.description: A rubber-tipped tool for unclogging pipes, or a club for an immature survivor.

items.name: plutonium fuel cell
items.description: This power cell was designed to store enormous amounts of power, using plutonium-244 and now-irreplaceable compounds to make compact reactors more practical than ever.  Unfortunately it cannot be recharged by conventional means: expended cells had to be sent to a central reprocessing facility that almost certainly doesn't exist anymore.

items.name: watery plutonium slurry
items.description: Highly radioactive slurry.  It is probably best to get far away from this.

items.name: plutonium slurry
items.description: Highly radioactive slurry.  It is probably best to get far away from this.

items.name: pneumatic shotgun
items.description: A double-barreled pneumatic air shotgun handcrafted from scrap.  Though it's firepower is lacking compared to more conventional shotguns, this thing can still pack quite a punch.  That is, if your target is directly in front of you.

items.name: Pocket Guide to Firearm Safety
items.description: This pocket-sized leather-bound guide to firearm safety combines a wealth of concise information with simple to follow instructions and easy to read illustrations.

items.name: Pocket Guide to First Aid
items.description: This pocket-sized leather-bound guide to first aid combines a wealth of concise information with simple to follow instructions and easy to read illustrations.

items.name: Pocket Survival Guide
items.description: This pocket-sized leather-bound survival guide combines a wealth of concise information with simple to follow instructions and easy to read illustrations.

items.name: pocket watch
items.description: An old-fashioned pocket watch.  This one tells you the time and looks good doing it.  Can also be disassembled into some useful parts.

items.name: pocket knife
items.description: This is a small pocket knife.  It isn't great for combat, but it's better than nothing.  It's sharp enough to butcher with.

items.name: book of poetry
items.description: A collection of poetry by various authors from around the world, including writings by Dickinson, Goethe, Thoreau, and Yeats.

items.name: pointy stick
items.description: A simple wood pole with one end sharpened.

items.name: police duty belt
items.description: Black leather belt used by police officers.  It has several pouches and a holder for a baton.

items.name: electric polisher
items.description: An electric polisher which can be used to buff metal surfaces until they are reflective like a mirror.

items.name: polo shirt
items.description: A short-sleeved cotton shirt, slightly thicker than a t-shirt.

items.name: pomegranate
items.description: Under this pomegranate's spongy skin lies hundreds of fleshy seeds.

items.name: wool poncho
items.description: A simple wool garment worn over the torso.  Provides a bit of protection.

items.name: pool ball
items.description: A colorful, hard ball.  Essentially a rock.

items.name: pool cue
items.description: A hard-wood stick designed for hitting colorful balls around a felt table.  Truly, the coolest of sports.

items.name: soda can stove kit
items.description: This is an ultra-light alcohol-burning stove with simmer ring, crafted by hand from a couple of aluminum soda cans.  It comes with a 500 ml plastic bottle to hold concentrated alcohol fuel.

items.name: popcorn
items.description: Plain and unseasoned popcorn.  Not as tasty as other kinds, but healthier as a result.

items.name: salted popcorn
items.description: Popcorn with salt added for extra flavor.

items.name: buttered popcorn
items.description: Popcorn with a light covering of butter for extra flavor.

items.name: raw popcorn
items.description: A special variety of corn which could be used for making popcorn, after it's dried.  Unlike normal corn, it's not sweet and is more dry.

items.name: poppy bud
items.description: A poppy bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a mutated poppy flower.

items.name: poppy flower
items.description: A poppy stalk with some petals.

items.name: poppy painkiller
items.description: Potent opioid palliative produced by the refining of the mutated poppy.  Notably devoid of euphoric or sedative effects, as an opiate it may still be addictive.

items.name: poppy sleep
items.description: A potent sleep aid extracted from mutated poppy seeds.  Effective, but as an opiate, it may be addictive.

items.name: poppy cough syrup
items.description: Cough syrup made from mutated poppy.  Will make you sleepy.

items.name: pork and beans
items.description: Greasy Prospector improved pork and beans with hickory smoked pig fat chunks.

items.name: porkpie hat
items.description: A flat-topped hat with circular indent and a narrow brim.  Most popular in the 40s and 50s, still common among those in the mod scene, hipsters, and people named Heisenberg.

items.name: pork stick
items.description: Salty dried pork.  Tastes good, but it will make you thirsty.

items.name: handheld game system
items.description: This is a portable games console in working condition, with an LED-screen allowing you to play in the dark.  You can use it to play it for a little while, but this requires UPS.

items.name: portal generator
items.description: This is a rare, bizarre, and arcane device of an otherworldly nature.  It's giving you a headache just looking at it.  It is covered in alien markings.

items.name: mail carrier hat
items.description: A traditional mail carrier's cap, with the US postal service logo embroidered on the front above the plastic cap.  A symbol of a bygone world.

items.name: mail carrier shirt
items.description: A light blue button down shirt with a couple of pockets in front and the US postal service logo embroidered on it.

items.name: mail carrier shorts
items.description: A pair of dark blue shorts, the kind used by postal service workers.

items.name: pot
items.description: Useful for boiling water when cooking spaghetti and more.

items.name: canning pot
items.description: A very large 25 liter pot, primarily meant for canning food in glass jars via the water bath method, though it can cook normal foods just as well.  Canning foods with it will require a lot of water.  If you're only canning a couple of jars at a time, you'd fill it up with rocks or something to displace the water above the lids.

items.name: copper pot
items.description: Useful for boiling water when cooking spaghetti and more.  Made from copper, with a lining of tin to prevent metal from leaching into acidic foods.

items.name: pot helmet
items.description: A helmet made from a soup pot.  It's not very good protection, but it's better than nothing.

items.name: makeshift pot
items.description: A sheet of metal crudely hammered into a cooking pot.  Good enough to cook food and boil water, but not as useful as proper cookware.

items.name: makeshift copper pot
items.description: A cooking pot crudely hammered out of copper.  Good enough to cook food and boil water, but not as useful as proper cookware.

items.name: XL pot helmet
items.description: A huge makeshift helmet made from a canning pot.  For the truly desperate man-bear-pig.

items.name: raw potato
items.description: Mildly toxic and not very tasty raw.  When cooked, it is delicious.

items.name: baked potato
items.description: A delicious baked potato.  Got any sour cream?

items.name: potato masher
items.description: This tool can mash potatoes and soft root vegetables; it cannot do the twist.

items.name: autoclave pouch
items.description: This is a medical device that bears the approval of the FDA (Food and Drug Administration).  If used properly, these pouches can keep things sterile indefinitely.

items.name: powder candy sticks
items.description: Thin paper tubes of sweet & sour candy powder.  Who thinks of this stuff?

items.name: powdered egg
items.description: Whole fresh eggs, dehydrated into an easy to store powder.

items.name: power armor back holster
items.description: A heavy duty holster using a combination of clamps and rail interfaces to comfortably hold rifles, shotguns, smgs and even launchers of various sizes.  Designed to interface with a military exoskeleton.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

items.name: combat exoskeleton
items.description: These were the second wave of military combat exoskeleton, and got a lot of media attention, with popular Navy commercials featuring them heavily.  It consists of a muscle-boosting exoskeleton frame with overlayed segmented alloy plating.  Despite advancements over the original bulky 'tank suits', the wearer still cannot easily fit through narrow spaces, or sit down comfortably (and it ruins upholstery).  There is an integrated chemical resistant bodyglove that precludes wearing other clothing.

items.name: combat exoskeleton (active)
items.description: These were the second wave of military combat exoskeleton, and got a lot of media attention, with popular Navy commercials featuring them heavily.  It consists of a muscle-boosting exoskeleton frame with overlayed segmented alloy plating.  Despite advancements over the original bulky 'tank suits', the wearer still cannot easily fit through narrow spaces, or sit down comfortably (and it ruins upholstery).  There is an integrated chemical resistant bodyglove that precludes wearing other clothing.  It is currently turned on, activate it to turn it off.

items.name: power armor back scabbard
items.description: A set of clamps and fittings designed to accommodate a variety of large bladed weaponry.  Designed to interface with a military exoskeleton.  Activate to sheath/draw a sword/axe.

items.name: power armor chest rig
items.description: A set of compartments capable of carrying three magazines close at hand.  Designed to interface with a military exoskeleton.  Activate to store/retrieve your magazines.

items.name: power armor hauling frame
items.description: A heavy duty hauling frame designed to interface with military exoskeletons.

items.name: heavy combat exoskeleton
items.description: Colloquially known as a 'tank suit' in the media, these bulky exoskeletons, covered in thick segmented armor plates, were tested in military service a few years back and determined to be too heavy and expensive for regular use.  Now that it's in your hands, though, you have a massive suit of power armor capable of resisting almost any small arms fire and most other forms of attack.  On the other hand, it doubles your effective weight, and it's almost impossible not to bump into things.  There is an integrated chemical resistant bodyglove that precludes wearing other clothing.

items.name: heavy combat exoskeleton (active)
items.description: Colloquially known as a 'tank suit' in the media, these bulky exoskeletons, covered in thick segmented armor plates, were tested in military service a few years back and determined to be too heavy and expensive for regular use.  Now that it's in your hands, though, you have a massive suit of power armor capable of resisting almost any small arms fire and most other forms of attack.  On the other hand, it doubles your effective weight, and it's almost impossible not to bump into things.  There is an integrated chemical resistant bodyglove that precludes wearing other clothing.  It is currently turned on, activate it to turn it off.

items.name: environmental combat helmet
items.description: A fully enclosed combat helmet for hazardous environments, this was designed to fit with a powered exoskeleton, using cameras to expand visual range.  In practice, the cameras were unreliable and easily fouled.  The environmental controls function best with direct-skin contact.

items.name: environmental combat helmet (active)
items.description: A fully enclosed combat helmet for hazardous environments, this was designed to fit with a powered exoskeleton, using cameras to expand visual range.  In practice, the cameras were unreliable and easily fouled.  The environmental controls function best with direct-skin contact.

items.name: heavy environmental combat helmet
items.description: An extremely heavy-duty fully enclosed combat helmet for hazardous environments, this was designed to fit with a powered exoskeleton.  In the field, soldiers reported that the protection was not worth the awkward size and limited visuals.  The environmental controls function best with direct-skin contact.

items.name: heavy environmental combat helmet (active)
items.description: An extremely heavy-duty fully enclosed combat helmet for hazardous environments, this was designed to fit with a powered exoskeleton.  In the field, soldiers reported that the protection was not worth the awkward size and limited visuals.  The environmental controls function best with direct-skin contact.

items.name: light environmental combat helmet
items.description: This full-enclosure helmet was designed based on commercial diving equipment, in response to complaints that earlier designs were impossible to use in combat.  While still a little more restrictive than regular combat headgear - and frustrating should your nose itch - this one received far better reviews from soldiers.  Sadly, civilization ended before they could roll out in significant numbers.  The environmental controls function best with direct-skin contact.

items.name: light environmental combat helmet (active)
items.description: This full-enclosure helmet was designed based on commercial diving equipment, in response to complaints that earlier designs were impossible to use in combat.  While still a little more restrictive than regular combat headgear - and frustrating should your nose itch - this one received far better reviews from soldiers.  Sadly, civilization ended before they could roll out in significant numbers.  The environmental controls function best with direct-skin contact.

items.name: power armor holster
items.description: A heavy duty holster that uses a combination of seals and rail interfaces to comfortably hold various sizes of pistol or similar guns.  Designed to interface with a military exoskeleton.  Activate to holster/draw a small pistol.

items.name: field combat exoskeleton
items.description: The final iteration of military power armor before the fall of civilization, this type - a powered exoskeleton with high-tech segmented plating - was designed for actual widespread combat use and was seen on the front lines during the last days of the cataclysm.  Like the heavier suits, it is resistant to most modern weaponry, but it is light and maneuverable, and can fit into normal vehicles and doorways without fuss, a huge advantage over predecessors.  Unfortunately, the world ended before it could roll out in significant numbers.  There is an integrated chemical resistant bodyglove that precludes wearing other clothing.

items.name: field combat exoskeleton (active)
items.description: The final iteration of military power armor before the fall of civilization, this type - a powered exoskeleton with high-tech segmented plating - was designed for actual widespread combat use and was seen on the front lines during the last days of the cataclysm.  Like the heavier suits, it is resistant to most modern weaponry, but it is light and maneuverable, and can fit into normal vehicles and doorways without fuss, a huge advantage over predecessors.  Unfortunately, the world ended before it could roll out in significant numbers.  There is an integrated chemical resistant bodyglove that precludes wearing other clothing.  It is currently turned on, activate it to turn it off.

items.name: power armor scabbard
items.description: A set of clamps and fittings to accommodate a variety of swords and similar weaponry.  Designed to interface with a military exoskeleton.  Activate to sheathe/draw a sword.

items.name: power armor sheath
items.description: A set of clamps and fittings to accommodate a variety of knives and similar blades.  Designed to interface with a military exoskeleton.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.

items.name: power converter
items.description: A power supply unit.  Useful in lots of electronics recipes.

items.name: shooter's earmuffs
items.description: A pair of earmuffs favored by shooters.  Without batteries or when turned off they function like normal earmuffs and block all sound.  They will block sounds over a certain decibel amount when turned on.  The earmuffs are currently off.

items.name: shooter's earmuffs
items.description: A pair of earmuffs favored by shooters.  The earmuffs are turned on.  They will block sounds over a certain decibel amount, assuming it is charged with batteries.

items.name: Walther PPK magazine
items.description: A standard 8-round steel box magazine for the Walther PPK.

items.name: PPQ .40 S&W 10-round magazine
items.description: A 10 round steel box magazine for the Walther PPQ .40 S&W.

items.name: PPQ .40 S&W 12-round magazine
items.description: A 12 round steel box magazine for the Walther PPQ .40 S&W.

items.name: PPQ .40 S&W 14-round magazine
items.description: A 14 round steel box magazine for the Walther PPQ .40 S&W.

items.name: PPQ .45 ACP magazine
items.description: A 12 round steel box magazine for the Walther PPQ .45 ACP.

items.name: PPQ 9x19mm 10-round magazine
items.description: A 10 round steel box magazine for the Walther PPQ 9mm.

items.name: PPQ 9x19mm 15-round magazine
items.description: A 15 round steel box magazine for the Walther PPQ 9mm.

items.name: PPQ 9x19mm 17-round magazine
items.description: A 17 round steel box magazine for the Walther PPQ 9mm.

items.name: PPSh-41
items.description: The Soviet-made PPSh-41 is a mass-produced selective-fire submachine gun.  It has a relatively high rate of fire.

items.name: PPSh 71-round drum magazine
items.description: A high-capacity drum magazine for the PPSh-41.

items.name: PPSh 35-round magazine
items.description: A 35-round box magazine for the PPSh-41.

items.name: survival kit
items.description: The ultimate survival kit purchased either by the wealthy or the dedicated urban survivalist.  It contains tools and items to help you survive in case of an emergency.  Disassemble to get its contents.

items.name: Drink the Harvest
items.description: Canning foods doesn't have to stop with jam and pickles.  This book provides a plethora of juices that can be preserved.

items.name: hand press
items.description: This is a small hand press for hand loading firearm ammunition.  It comes with everything you need to start hand loading your own munitions.

items.name: makeshift shotshell press
items.description: This is a collection of items improvised for field reloading of shotshells.  A plank with a hole cut in the center, a medium-sized nail, and a selection of whittled dowels are used to seat wads, decap primers, and reprime (carefully!) hulls.  The opposite side of the plank has been shaped to allow for roll crimping of the plastic hulls.

items.name: pressure cooker
items.description: Useful for boiling water when cooking spaghetti and more.  This sealed pot is designed to cook food at higher pressures and temperatures.  Can also be used for pressure sensitive chemical reactions.

items.name: pressurized fuel tank
items.description: A pressurized 3L canister designed to feed a flamethrower.

items.name: pressurized chemical tank
items.description: A makeshift pressurized 2L canister designed to feed a makeshift chemical thrower.

items.name: pretzels
items.description: A salty treat of a snack.

items.name: priest's diary
items.description: A small book filled with journal entries in Latin.

items.name: stone adze
items.description: This is a stone adze, somewhat useful for smoothing wood objects.

items.name: stone axe
items.description: This is a stone with a narrow edge affixed to a stick.  It can chop wood, but requires much more effort than a modern axe.

items.name: stone hammer
items.description: This is a rock affixed to a stick, in the crude facsimile of a hammer.  It functions adequately as a hammer, but really can't compare to a proper one.

items.name: stone knife
items.description: This is a sharpened stone set into a hollowed handle.  Not nearly as usable as a proper knife, but it's better than nothing.

items.name: stone shovel
items.description: This is a flattened stone affixed to a stick.  It works passably well as a shovel but really can't compare to a real shovel.

items.name: processor board
items.description: A central processor unit, useful in advanced electronics crafting.

items.name: programmable autopilot
items.description: A computer system hooked up to the steering and engine of a vehicle to allow it to follow simple paths.

items.name: protein ration
items.description: SoyPelusa ran a highly successful crowdfunding campaign for this protein bar.  A person can live on one of these bars, three times a day, presumably forever.  After backers received their product, a single flaw was found: most consumers found starvation preferable to the flavor.  Warehouses of the product went unsold as the company went bankrupt, providing the perfect opportunity for FEMA to scoop them up and stock the evac shelters.  Now, you hold a piece of famous crowdfunding history in your hands.  How exciting.

items.name: protein drink
items.description: A thin slurry of refined protein mixed with water.  While quite nutritious, it is not particularly tasty.

items.name: protein powder
items.description: Raw, refined protein.  While quite nutritious, it is impossible to enjoy in its pure form, try adding water.

items.name: protein shake
items.description: A thick and tasty beverage made from pure refined protein and nutritious fruit.

items.name: fortified protein shake
items.description: A thick and tasty beverage made from pure refined protein and nutritious fruit.  It has been supplemented with extra vitamins and minerals

items.name: Prozac
items.description: A common and popular antidepressant.  It will elevate mood, and can profoundly affect the action of other drugs.  It is only rarely habit-forming, though adverse reactions are not uncommon.  Its generic name is fluoxetine.

items.name: Prussian blue tablet
items.description: Tablets containing oxidized ferrous ferrocyanide salts.  Capable of purging nuclear contaminants from the body if taken after radiation exposure.

items.name: bio lockpick
items.description: this a pseudo item

items.name: M203 array
items.description: An array of six M203 grenade launchers for use on the TALON UGV platform.

items.name: hockey puck
items.description: A heavy circular block of solid rubber, normally used for playing hockey.  You can throw it to cause some serious harm.

items.name: pudding
items.description: Sugary, fermented dairy.  A wonderful treat.

items.name: kinetic bullet puller
items.description: This is a tool used for properly disassembling firearm ammunition.

items.name: high-pressure pump
items.description: A complex mechanical pump capable of achieving high pressures.  Far beyond anything you could reasonably improvise.

items.name: pumpkin
items.description: A large vegetable, about the size of your head.  Not very tasty raw, but is great for cooking.

items.name: punch dagger
items.description: A short and sharp double-edged dagger made to be gripped in the palm, with the blade protruding between the fingers.

items.name: water purification tablet
items.description: Intended for the clarification and disinfection of unsafe drinking water, these halazone-based purification tablets remove dangerous contaminants using powerful chemicals.  The label says to use one tablet per unit of water.

items.name: purifier
items.description: A rare stem-cell treatment that causes mutations and other genetic defects to fade away.

items.name: purifier smart shot
items.description: An experimental stem cell treatment, offering limited control over which mutations are purified.  The liquid sloshes strangely inside of this syringe.

items.name: grape drink
items.description: A mass-produced grape flavored beverage of artificial origin.  Good for when you want something that tastes like fruit, but still don't care about your health.

items.name: purse
items.description: A bit cumbersome to wear, but provides some storage.

items.name: Beretta Px4 Storm
items.description: Lighter than Beretta's iconic 92 series of guns, the Px4 Storm was built by utilizing light-weight polymer construction with steel inserts.  Its shape was also optimized for concealed carry, while maintaining the reliability the 92 series is known for.

items.name: Beretta Px4 Storm .40 S&W
items.description: Lighter than Beretta's iconic 92 series of guns, the Px4 Storm was built by utilizing light-weight polymer construction with steel inserts.  Its shape was also optimized for concealed carry.  This one is chambered in .40 S&W.

items.name: Px4 .40 magazine
items.description: A magazine for the Px4 Storm chambered for .40 S&W.  It holds 14 rounds.

items.name: Px4 magazine
items.description: The standard magazine for the Beretta Px4, in 9x19mm.

items.name: quantum solar backpack (folded)
items.description: Personal portable charging system consisting of an array of quantum solar panels neatly folded in a form of a large backpack.  It can be worn as one, and has an integrated cable to plug it into a cable charger system.  Cutting edge technology.

items.name: quantum solar backpack (unfolded)
items.description: Unfolded array of portable quantum solar panels ready to push some power into an active cable charger system.

items.name: quarterstaff
items.description: A smooth and sturdy staff with a leather-wrapped grip.  Light and well-balanced, it is surprisingly easy to handle.

items.name: qiang
items.description: An ancient Chinese spear, typically with a tassel just below the spearhead.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the dao sabre, jian sword, and gun staff.

items.name: set of rotors
items.description: A set of rotors able to lift a small drone.

items.name: quesadilla
items.description: A tortilla filled with cheese and lightly grilled.

items.name: hemostatic powder
items.description: A powdered antihemorrhagic compound that reacts with blood to immediately form a gel-like substance that stops bleeding.

items.name: quiver
items.description: A leather quiver worn at the waist that can hold 20 arrows.  Activate to store arrows.

items.name: birchbark quiver
items.description: A quiver woven from strips of birch bark, worn at the waist, that can hold 20 arrows.  Activate to store arrows.

items.name: large quiver
items.description: A large leather quiver trimmed with metal, worn on the back, that can hold 60 arrows.  Historically used by horse archers, rather than foot archers, but neither of THEM had to fight zombies.  Activate to store arrows.

items.name: large birchbark quiver
items.description: A large quiver woven from strips of birchbark, worn on the back, that can hold 60 arrows.  Activate to store arrows.

items.name: red carpet
items.description: A roll of red carpet.

items.name: red paint
items.description: A can of red paint.

items.name: test tube rack
items.description: A plastic box with holes in it.  Not that exciting, unless you're desperate for a place to store a test tube.  Then it's great.

items.name: microcentrifuge tube tray
items.description: A plastic tray riddled with small holes, for storing microcentrifuge tubes.

items.name: radiation badge
items.description: A plastic badge with an embedded filmstrip.  The filmstrip changes color as it is exposed to radiation.  Wear on your lapel so you can notice if it changes.

items.name: radiation biomonitor
items.description: A small battery-powered biometric safety device worn on the wrist.  Activate to check your current level of radiation exposure.

items.name: radio (off)
items.description: This is a portable radio.  Using this radio turns it on.  It will pick up any nearby signals being broadcast and play them audibly.

items.name: Amateur Home Radio for Enthusiasts
items.description: A book about ham radio and citizen's band radio.  It contains numerous diagrams and illustrations explaining the science behind the electronics.

items.name: RC car
items.description: A remote-controlled car.  Fun for young and old alike.

items.name: radio car base
items.description: Generic radio car kit, you shouldn't see this.

items.name: radio car box
items.description: An RC car, with radio-control and batteries included!  Disassemble to unpack and enjoy.

items.name: RC car (on)
items.description: This remote-controlled car is on, and draining its batteries just like a real electric car!  Use a remote control to drive it around.

items.name: radio activation mod
items.description: This small piece of electronics can be attached to certain items and activate them after receiving a radio signal.

items.name: radio (on)
items.description: This portable radio is turned on, and continually draining its batteries.  It is playing the broadcast being sent from any nearby radio towers.

items.name: radio repeater mod
items.description: A system designed to convert a radio station into an autonomous repeater.

items.name: RC control
items.description: A remote control for RC cars, with joystick to steer the car and colorful buttons that don't seem to do anything.  Perhaps they were for the deluxe model?

items.name: rag
items.description: This is a largish piece of cloth, useful in crafting and possibly for staunching bleeding.

items.name: blood soaked rag
items.description: A large rag, drenched in blood.  It could be cleaned with boiling water.

items.name: Taurus Raging Bull
items.description: The Taurus Raging Bull is a 5-shot revolver chambered in .454 Casull.  It has impressive stopping power.

items.name: Taurus Raging Judge Magnum
items.description: The Taurus Raging Judge Magnum is a 6-shot revolver chambered in .454 Casull.  It can fire .410 shotshells and .45 Colt cartridges as well.

items.name: pouch
items.description: A makeshift bag, cobbled together from rags.  Really gets in the way, but provides a decent amount of storage.

items.name: rail laser sight
items.description: A small visible-light laser that mounts on a firearm's accessory rail to enhance ease and speed of target acquisition.  Aside from increased weight, there are no drawbacks.

items.name: side mount
items.description: This is a plastic mount for attaching a rail accessory, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any weapon, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on older guns.

items.name: small railroad track
items.description: A length of track, made from some planks and rails.

items.name: rapier
items.description: This is a thin sword with an ornate hand guard.  It looks like the preferred weapon of gentlemen and swashbucklers.  Light and quick, it makes any battle a stylish battle.

items.name: rapier fake
items.description: This is a blunted, cheap replica of a thin sword with an ornate hand guard.  It looks like the preferred weapon of gentlemen and swashbucklers.  Light and quick, it makes any battle a stylish battle.

items.name: raspberries
items.description: A sweet red berry.

items.name: ravioli
items.description: Meat encased in little dough satchels.  Tastes fine raw.

items.name: raw beans
items.description: Raw, uncooked beans.  They are mildly toxic in this form, but you could cook them to make them tasty.

items.name: burdocks
items.description: Burdock, a bitter thistle-like vegetable.  Can be eaten raw or cooked.

items.name: dandelions
items.description: A collection of freshly picked yellow dandelions.  In their current raw state they are quite bitter.

items.name: raw edamame
items.description: Light green raw edamame still in its pod, you should boil or freeze these, or you could eat them while they are still toxic.

items.name: raw pelt
items.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a fur-bearing animal.  It still has the fur attached.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.

items.name: raw human pelt
items.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a fur-bearing mutant human.  It still has the fur attached.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.

items.name: raw human skin
items.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a human.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.

items.name: raw hide
items.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from an animal.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.

items.name: raw lentils
items.description: Raw, uncooked lentils.  They could be cooked.

items.name: tainted pelt
items.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a fur-bearing unnatural creature.  It still has the fur attached and is poisonous.  You can cure it for storage and tanning.

items.name: tainted hide
items.description: A carefully folded poisonous raw skin harvested from an unnatural creature.  You can cure it for storage and tanning.

items.name: razor blade
items.description: A double-edged razor blade.

items.name: shaving razor
items.description: A razor blade on a comfortable handle.  Much easier to shave with than a loose razor.

items.name: razorclaw roe
items.description: A clump of razorclaw eggs.  A post-Cataclysm delicacy.

items.name: reach bow
items.description: A test item that is both a ranged weapon and a reach weapon

items.name: reading light
items.description: A little clip-on LED light, meant for reading books in the dark.

items.name: reading light (active)
items.description: A little clip-on LED light, meant for reading books in the dark.  This one is turned on.

items.name: rebar
items.description: A length of rebar, makes a nice melee weapon, and could be handy in constructing tougher walls and such.

items.name: rebar grate
