items.description: Interlocked sections of rebar that allows for light and effective reinforcement of vehicle sections.

items.name: rebar rail
items.description: A short piece of ferromagnetic rebar which has been straightened and sharpened on one end.  Could be used as a projectile by a sufficiently powerful electromagnetic weapon.

items.name: ferromagnetic rail rifle
items.description: A single-shot, electrically propelled, steel rail launcher handcrafted from scrap.  The hypervelocity metal stake that it fires is accelerated to the point of spontaneous combustion by a Lorentz force generated by electromagnetic induction, powered by a standard UPS.

items.name: rebreather mask
items.description: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  Use it to turn it on.

items.name: rebreather filter cartridge
items.description: A replacement filter cartridge for a rebreather.

items.name: rebreather mask (on)
items.description: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  It is turned on, and continually consuming its filter.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: XL rebreather mask
items.description: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  This model has been expanded substantially and can accommodate exotic anatomy.  Use it to turn it on.

items.name: XL rebreather mask (on)
items.description: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  This model has been expanded substantially and can accommodate exotic anatomy.  It is turned on, and continually consuming its filter.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: signal receiver
items.description: A module designed to receive many forms of signals.  Useful for crafting communications equipment.

items.name: recharging station
items.description: A universal recharging station designed to operate on vehicle power.  While on it will steadily charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.  The system can only be installed onto existing storage compartments, and is controlled from a dashboard or electronics control unit.

items.name: PE050 "Alpha": Preliminary Report
items.description: This sheaf of papers--dated two weeks before all this started--describes some new chemical formula, and its effects on human subjects.  It's stamped "APPROVED"…

items.name: lab journal-Dionne
items.description: This team logbook details several varieties of mutagenic experiments, focusing on those derived from various Earth fauna.  The team seems quite enthusiastic--if not eager--about their results.

items.name: The Fletcher's Friend
items.description: This hefty book is devoted to folks looking to handcraft their own arrows.  It starts with a hip and snappy disclaimer about the risks, both physical and legal, of using explosives and flammable materials.  Look for its companion, "The Bowyer's Buddy"!

items.name: computer printout
items.description: One side of this sheet is printed with a meaningless jumble of characters, but the other side shows a complicated, hand-drawn circuit diagram.

items.name: Augmentative Tech Review
items.description: This annual publication covers the various ways in which people use technology to improve their bodies.  There are a few in-depth and thoroughly illustrated articles on bionic systems, though they tend to use too much jargon.

items.name: The Bowyer's Buddy
items.description: This hefty book is dedicated to craftsfolk and outdoors-y types looking to make their own bows.  It recommends its companion volume "The Fletcher's Friend" for instructions on producing their ammunition.

items.name: The Handloader's Helper
items.description: Everything you could ever want to know about handloading ammunition, sealed with a… childproof cover.  Apparently a liability thing, because the chapter on explosive rounds covers them in excellent detail too.

items.name: Rivtech design binder
items.description: This Rivtech binder warns that "Unauthorized readers are our best test subjects." With good reason: it contains complete design specs and technical drawings for their entire line of products.

items.name: PE065 "Chimera": Best Practices
items.description: This sheaf of papers describes a new chemical formula in detail and supplies instructions for its use as some sort of… crowd-control catalyst?  That can't be right…

items.name: lab journal-Smythe
items.description: This team logbook details several varieties of mutagenic experiments, focusing on those derived from flesh contaminated with XE037.  The results look promising but the procurement methods seem awfully vague…

items.name: standpipe maintenance log
items.description: This binder details the scheduled maintenance for several plumbing systems throughout the facility.  However, some of the log sheets seem to be filled with… a chemical formula?

items.name: Friendly, Humane Fashion
items.description: An educational book detailing the uses of fake fur, as well as its benefits and disadvantages.  The prose is rather passionate, and a disclaimer on the cover proudly states that the book is printed and distributed by the Gryphon Animal Rights Organization.

items.name: lab journal-Gustav
items.description: This paper notebook is mostly full of boring logs, experimental observations and notes.  Mixed in, however, are musings on how to use the lab's vapor deposition machine to deposit amorphous carbon in a diamond-like form onto common metals.  The author's intended goal was a better non-stick frying pan, but you can think of a couple of better uses for it.

items.name: lab journal-Herrera
items.description: This hefty binder contains a multitude of diagrams and technical specifications for various electronic materials.  Some of the diagrams use symbols you've not seen before…

items.name: chemical reference-CLASSIFIED
items.description: This somewhat technical binder has several intimidating security warnings on the cover, yet guarantees unauthorized readers "permanent employment, for life".  It contains useful information on "basic" chemical projects like methamphetamine and heroin, along with briefing on things called "XE037" and "PE012".

items.name: lab journal-x-|xp
items.description: This damaged team logbook lacks (deliberately?) any identifying information, but still contains useful information on several types of mutagen and their development.

items.name: PE023 "Medical": Application and Findings
items.description: This binder of highly technical papers describes some new chemical formula, and its effects on human subjects.  It's stamped "APPROVED"…

items.name: The Streetfighter's Sidekick
items.description: A sizable how-to guide for making hand-to-hand combat weapons.  Though the processes are thoroughly detailed and several illustrations are provided, they rely heavily on technical jargon.  More for machinists-turned-weaponsmiths than streetfighters, really.

items.name: 2XI design binder-CLASSIFIED
items.description: This Doubletech Industries binder has several intimidating security warnings on the cover.  Probably because it contains complete design specs, technical drawings, and test results for their military-grade bionic implants.

items.name: 238-NK: Practicality Enhancement
items.description: The authors of this thoroughly researched and documented proposal make a very persuasive case for the adoption of spring-driven nuclear shells.  It's stamped "DENIED".

items.name: PE070 "Raptor": Proposal
items.description: This sheaf of papers is a highly speculative proposal for focusing "PE065".  Scribbled notes throughout seem to think that it might work, but that there's no time.

items.name: Best Practices for Compound Delivery
items.description: This internal manual details several varieties of mutagenic experiments, as well as describing the protocols used to concentrate mutagens for quicker results.  The authors recommend that researchers ensure that their subjects are well-fed and in good health, as the concentrated serums draw heavily on subjects' bodies.

items.name: recoil stock
items.description: A replacement stock designed to absorb perceived recoil.

items.name: RMES marksman system
items.description: This is the integral weapon system for the RMES exoskeleton mech-suit, a quiet and accurate marksman laser rifle.

items.name: corporate accounting ledger
items.description: If you knew what to look for something might stand out…

items.name: patient treatment records
items.description: A massive stack of medical records that contain every gory detail.

items.name: national weather transcripts
items.description: Old weather records are about as interesting as a rock.

items.name: recovery pump
items.description: A medium sized vacuum pump designed to recover solvent (hydrocarbons) from extracted essential oils.

items.name: recurve bow
items.description: A modern bow that curves away from the archer at the tips for increased power, which can be used effectively by those of somewhat above-average strength.  Good and easy to use, but nothing special.

items.name: red dot sight
items.description: Adds a red dot optic to the top of your gun, replacing the iron sights.  Increases accuracy and weight.

items.name: refillable lighter
items.description: This is a lighter featuring a flip top cover and refuelable tank.  A lighter must be carried to use various drugs, like cigarettes, or to light things like Molotov cocktails.  You can also use a lighter to light nearby items on fire.

items.name: refillable lighter
items.description: This is a lighter featuring a flip top cover and refuelable tank.  It is lit.

items.name: CRC-Merck Handbook, 4th edition
items.description: This huge hardbound book is a collection of reference data and formulae pertinent to many technical disciplines.  If poring over tables of chemical and physical data is your thing, this is the book for you.

items.name: Machinery's Handbook
items.description: This classic reference work contains extensive, dense chapters and tables on materials, metrology, toolmaking, gears, threading and more.  This recent edition includes extensive data on what were the latest techniques in additive manufacturing.  If you need to know how best complete a certain machining operation, the answer lies somewhere in these pages.

items.name: Physicians' Desk Reference
items.description: This hefty volume contains all the legally mandated information relevant to physicians for writing prescriptions, generously supported by the efforts and contributions of major pharmaceutical companies.  For the most part, it provides information identical to what is available on that of medication packaging inserts, and cannot match the completeness of digital pharmaceutical references like Medisoft.  At least it doesn't need power to be used.

items.name: Merck Veterinary Manual
items.description: This expansive text covers 'all domestic species and diseases in veterinary medicine worldwide'.  Should you need information regarding zoonotic diseases, off-label use of medication for animals, common dysfunctions and diseases of animals, or any other veterinary reference info, this is your book.  There are some interesting new chapters on animal cloning in this edition.

items.name: reflex bow
items.description: A bow with limbs that curve away from the archer near the riser for power.  Smaller than some bows, but decently powerful and quick.

items.name: reflex recurve bow
items.description: A modernized bow that combines the traits from both the reflex and the recurve bows, with both limbs and tips curving away from the archer, and reinforced with composite materials.  This dramatically increases the power and requires significant strength to draw the bow effectively, but can still be fired quickly.

items.name: refrigerant tank
items.description: A small tank containing some sort of refrigerant often used in devices such as freezers.  Hermetically sealed to prevent evaporation - cannot be opened without prior connection to compatible valve.

items.name: rehydrated fish
items.description: Reconstituted fish flakes, which are much more enjoyable to eat now that they have been rehydrated.

items.name: rehydrated fruit
items.description: Reconstituted fruit flakes, which are much more enjoyable to eat now that they have been rehydrated.

items.name: rehydrated meat
items.description: Reconstituted meat flakes, which are much more enjoyable to eat now that they have been rehydrated.

items.name: rehydrated vegetable
items.description: Reconstituted vegetable flakes, which are much more enjoyable to eat now that they have been rehydrated.

items.name: rehydration drink
items.description: A basic oral rehydration therapy drink.  It will rehydrate you faster than water, but it tastes kind of strange.

items.name: pane of reinforced glass
items.description: A small pane of glass strengthened with steel wiring.

items.name: sheet of reinforced glass
items.description: A large sheet of glass strengthened with steel wiring.

items.name: reinforced solar panel
items.description: A solar panel that has been covered with a pane of reinforced glass to protect the delicate solar cells from zombies or errant baseballs.  The glass causes this panel to produce slightly less power than a normal panel.  Useful for a vehicle.

items.name: upgraded reinforced solar panel
items.description: An upgraded solar panel that has been covered with a pane of reinforced glass to protect the delicate solar cells from zombies or errant baseballs.  The glass causes this panel to produce slightly less power than a normal upgraded panel.  Useful for a vehicle.

items.name: rein and tackle
items.description: A set of leather bindings to control a mountable creature.

items.name: 10mm Auto FMJ, reloaded
items.description: A jacketed 10mm Auto round.  The 10mm Auto cartridge is a rather powerful handgun round and the progenitor to the more popular .40 S&W.

items.name: .223 Remington, reloaded
items.description: .223 Remington ammunition with 36gr JHP bullets.  The .223 round has been very popular with civilian shooters for almost a century, finding use in a wide variety of weapons.  It generates lower pressure than 5.56 NATO leading to slightly decreased accuracy and recoil.

items.name: .22 CPHP, reloaded
items.description: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with 30gr copper-plated, hollow-point bullets.  Has a higher velocity and slightly more stopping power than lead round-nose ammunition, but armor will have a magnified effect on its already-low penetration.

items.name: .22 LR, reloaded
items.description: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with 40gr unjacketed bullets.  The .22LR round is extremely weak with very low stopping power, short range, and negligible recoil.  It is most useful for rifle training, and hunting small animals.

items.name: .270 Winchester JSP, reloaded
items.description: .270 Winchester ammunition with 130gr soft point bullets.  The .270 round was not initially successful, but over a few decades it became one of the most popular rifle cartridges for hunting and silhouette shooting.  It is a powerful round capable of taking down large targets with ease.

items.name: .30-06 Springfield, reloaded
items.description: .30-06 Springfield rounds with 165gr soft point bullets.  The .30-06 cartridge has excellent accuracy, range, and stopping power making it popular with hunters and snipers for well over a century.

items.name: .30-06 incendiary, reloaded
items.description: Armor piercing incendiary .30-06 M14A1 ammunition containing tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.  It penetrates all but the strongest body armor with ease.

items.name: .30-06 M2 AP, reloaded
items.description: Armor piercing .30-06 M2 ammunition with 168gr FMJ bullets.  It is an extremely powerful and accurate cartridge but pays for its armor penetration abilities with lowered damage.

items.name: .300 Winchester Magnum, reloaded
items.description: The .300 Winchester Magnum is extremely versatile and has been adopted by many shooting disciplines.  The cartridge has found use by hunters, military units, and law enforcement departments.  This one has been hand-reloaded.

items.name: .300 AAC Blackout, reloaded
items.description: .300 AAC Blackout is an intermediate cartridge that achieves ballistics similar to the 7.62x39 but allows use on the AR-15 platform.  The round is necked-up from the 5.56mm NATO, but feeds from a STANAG magazine.  It requires a specific barrel, so will not work in a standard M4 or similar carbine.  This one has been hand-reloaded.

items.name: .308 Winchester, reloaded
items.description: .308 Winchester ammunition with 168gr hollow point bullets.  The .308 round is one of the most popular hunting cartridges in the world due to its accuracy and power.

items.name: .32 ACP, reloaded
items.description: The .32 ACP was a popular handgun cartridge in the 20th century.  Not so powerful as the .38 or the 9x19mm though.

items.name: .357 Magnum FMJ, reloaded
items.description: Jacketed .357 magnum ammunition.  The .357 magnum round is derived from the earlier .38 special, with a marginally longer case and generating greater pressure.

items.name: .357 Magnum JHP, reloaded
items.description: Jacketed hollow point .357 magnum ammunition.  The .357 magnum round is derived from the earlier .38 special, with a marginally longer case and generating greater pressure.

items.name: .357 SIG FMJ, reloaded
items.description: Jacketed .357 SIG ammunition.  The .357 SIG round is a high velocity pistol cartridge, giving it a flatter trajectory than many handgun rounds.

items.name: .357 SIG JHP, reloaded
items.description: Jacketed hollow point .357 SIG ammunition.  The .357 SIG round is a high velocity pistol cartridge, giving it a flatter trajectory than many handgun rounds.

items.name: .380 ACP FMJ, reloaded
items.description: .380 ACP ammunition with a brass jacketed 95gr bullet.  Popular in pocket pistols for over a century, it is often considered the weakest caliber to consider carrying.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.

items.name: .380 ACP JHP, reloaded
items.description: .380 ACP ammunition with a 95gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  It is a popular round for small concealable backup pistols, and often the weakest recommended defensive caliber.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.

items.name: .380 ACP +P, reloaded
items.description: Overpressure .380 ACP ammunition with a 90gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  These defensive loadings are designed to maximize performance and tend to be more accurate than practice ammo.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.

items.name: .38 FMJ, reloaded
items.description: .38 Special ammunition with brass jacketed 130gr bullets.  The .38 Special round has been known from its inception for its accuracy and low recoil.

items.name: .38 Special, reloaded
items.description: .38 Special ammunition with 130gr FMJ bullets.  The .38 Special round was extremely common among US police forces during the 20th century.

items.name: .38 Super, reloaded
items.description: .38 Super ammunition with 90gr JHP bullets.  Designed in 1929, the .38 super cartridge was designed to penetrate body armor and vehicles.

items.name: .38 Super FMJ, reloaded
items.description: .38 Super ammunition with 147gr FMJ bullets.  The .38 Super round was developed from .38 ACP in the 1920s, designed to penetrate the body armor of the era.

items.name: .40 S&W FMJ, reloaded
items.description: .40 S&W ammunition with 180gr FMJ bullets.  Designed to retain the 10mm Auto cartridge's power with lower recoil, the .40 S&W round became popular for law enforcement and personal defense.

items.name: .40 S&W JHP, reloaded
items.description: .40 S&W ammunition with 135gr JHP bullets.  The .40 S&W round is a descended from the 10mm Auto cartridge and maintains most of its predecessor's strengths while reducing recoil.

items.name: .410 000 shot, reloaded
items.description: A .410 shell with 5 000 pellets.  Good for a hunting or combat load.

items.name: .44 Magnum FMJ, reloaded
items.description: A brass-jacketed variant of the .44 Magnum round.  This increases penetration at the cost of reduced damage from expansion.

items.name: .44 Magnum, reloaded
items.description: .44 magnum ammunition with 240gr JHP bullets.  The .44 magnum round is one of the most powerful handgun cartridges available.  It has excellent stopping power but suffers from extremely high recoil for a handgun round.

items.name: .454 Casull, reloaded
items.description: .454 Casull ammunition with 300gr jacketed soft point bullets.  The .454 Casull round is derived from .45 Long Colt with a stronger, lengthened case.  It is an exceptionally powerful cartridge with higher stopping power than many rifle rounds, although it suffers from extreme recoil making it unsuitable for most purposes.

items.name: .45-70 LFN cowboy, reloaded
items.description: .45-70 Government ammunition loaded with a 405 grain lead flat nose bullet to original specifications for safe use in antique firearms.  Quite a bit less powerful than modern ammo, but still packs a punch.  This one has been hand-loaded.

items.name: .45-70 +P penetrator, reloaded
items.description: .45-70 Government +P ammunition loaded with a 305 grain solid copper penetrator projectile.  Designed for maximum penetration through thick hide and bone while maintaining ideal wounding characteristics.  This one has been hand-loaded.

items.name: .45-70 SP, reloaded
items.description: .45-70 Government ammunition loaded with a 305 grain soft point round.  One of the oldest cartridges still in use, it is still a favorite for large game hunting at short ranges.  This one has been hand-loaded.

items.name: .45 FMJ, reloaded
items.description: .45 ACP ammunition with 230gr FMJ bullets.  Noted for its stopping power, the .45 ACP round has been common for almost 150 years.

items.name: .45 ACP JHP, reloaded
items.description: .45 ACP ammunition with 185gr JHP bullets.  The .45 ACP round was developed to replace the .38 Long Colt cartridge in the early 20th century.  It has good stopping power but above average recoil.

items.name: .45 ACP +P, reloaded
items.description: Overpressure .45 ACP ammunition with 200gr JHP bullets.  This +P ammunition has higher muzzle energy than typical loads leading to greater damage, accuracy and recoil.

items.name: .45 Colt JHP, reloaded
items.description: .45 Colt ammunition with 250gr jacketed hollow point bullets.  Originally designed for the Colt Single Action Army, and still used for modern reproduction revolvers.  Originally a black powder cartridge, modern loads can make this round competitive in the new era.

items.name: .460 Rowland FMJ, reloaded
items.description: A brass-jacketed variant of the .460 Rowland round.  This increases penetration slightly at the cost of reduced damage from expansion.

items.name: .460 Rowland, reloaded
items.description: .460 Rowland ammunition with 185gr JHP bullets.  The .460 Rowland round is designed to emulate hard-hitting .44 magnum in common autoloading pistols.  Like the .44, .460 Rowland has exceptional power - and recoil.  It is almost dimensionally identical to .45ACP, save for having a longer case and deeper seated bullets to prevent ammunition mix-ups.

items.name: 4.6x30mm, reloaded
items.description: 4.6x30mm ammunition with 31gr copper plated lead bullets.  The 4.6x30mm round was developed by H&K to compete with FN Herstal's 5.7x28mm cartridge.  It has low recoil, but no usual armor penetration due to using simple lead bullets rather than proper factory-made penetrator projectiles.

items.name: .500 S&W Magnum, reloaded
items.description: .500 S&W Magnum ammunition with 500gr bullets.  The .500 S&W Magnum round is a colossally powerful handgun cartridge capable of killing almost any target with one hit.  It has extremely high damage and recoil to match.

items.name: .50 BMG tracer, reloaded
items.description: A tracer variant of the powerful .50 BMG round.  Tracer rounds help to keep the weapon they are fired from on target at the risk of igniting flammable substances.  This one has been hand-reloaded.

items.name: .50 BMG Match, reloaded
items.description: .50 BMG ammunition with lead-cored FMJ bullets.  The .50 BMG is a very powerful rifle round designed for anti-aircraft use, later adapted to anti-vehicular and anti-personnel roles.  Its stupendous energy and armor piercing capabilities make it one of the most deadly rounds available, offset only by its drastic recoil and noise.

items.name: .50 BMG AP, reloaded
items.description: Variant of the .50 BMG round that uses a core hardened steel.  Penetration is increased, but damage is reduced.  This one has been hand-reloaded.

items.name: 5.45x39mm, reloaded
items.description: The 5.45x39mm was the standard ammunition for the AK series from 1974.  Its designers were inspired by the 5.56x45mm NATO cartridge.  This one has been hand-reloaded.

items.name: 5.45x39mm AP, reloaded
items.description: Armor piercing 5.45x39mm ammunition with hand-reloaded bullets containing a steel penetrator.  Developed in 1998 by the Russian military.

items.name: 5.56 NATO, reloaded
items.description: 5.56x45mm ammunition with a 62gr FMJ bullet containing a steel penetrator.  Its light weight, high accuracy, and manageable recoil lead to widespread use in the 20th century and it remains popular among militaries and civilians.

items.name: 5.56 NATO tracer, reloaded
items.description: This ammunition is a one-in-five mix of M855A1 and M856 tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.

items.name: 5.7x28mm, reloaded
items.description: 5.7x28mm ammunition with 31gr AP FMJ bullets.  The 5.7x28mm cartridge was designed by FN Herstal to replace the 9x19mm round in NATO use.  Although the project to replace 9x19mm Parabellum was effectively canceled the 5.7x28mm round has seen action in many conflicts and has proven to be reliable.  It has very low recoil but no usual armor penetration due to using simple lead bullets rather than proper factory-made penetrator projectiles.

items.name: 5x50mm flechette, reloaded
items.description: Designed to defeat modern body armor, the Rivtech 5x50mm flechette round features a biodegradable sabot and a single, fin-stabilized penetrator.  This one has been hand-reloaded.

items.name: .700 NX, reloaded
items.description: The .700 Nitro Express is a very powerful rifle round designed for long-range use.  Its stupendous accuracy and armor piercing capabilities make it one of the most deadly rounds available, offset only by its drastic recoil and noise.

items.name: 7.62x25mm, reloaded
items.description: A high-pressure commercial version of the 7.62x25mm cartridge, loaded with an 85 gr. FMJ bullet.  It is more powerful than the original.

items.name: 7.62x51mm, reloaded
items.description: A 7.62x51mm NATO round with a 147gr FMJ bullet.  It is a powerful rifle cartridge commonly used by hunters and military snipers because of its high accuracy and long range.

items.name: 7.62x51mm incendiary, reloaded
items.description: This ammunition is a one-in-five mix of M80 and M62 tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.

items.name: 7.62x54mmR, reloaded
items.description: 7.62x54mmR ammunition with 150gr FMJ bullets.  The 7.62x54mmR round is one of the oldest still in common use, primarily due to the popularity of the Mosin-Nagant rifle.  Although it has not been used by militaries for several decades it remains popular with civilians.  It is a powerful cartridge capable of killing most targets with one shot.

items.name: 7.62x39mm M43, reloaded
items.description: 7.62x39mm ammunition with 121.9gr bullets.  Developed in WW2 by the Soviet Union the 7.62x39mm round rapidly became extremely popular all over the world.  The bullet has poor wounding potential due to its stability, only beginning to yaw after 26cm.

items.name: 7.62x39mm M67, reloaded
items.description: 7.62x39mm M67 rounds with 123gr bullets.  The inadequate terminal ballistics of the M43 round led to the development of the M67 round in Yugoslavia in the 1960s.  It destabilizes much faster than M43 after hitting a target leading to greater damage.

items.name: 9x19mm JHP, reloaded
items.description: 9x19mm ammunition with a 116gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  JHP rounds have inferior penetration to FMJ rounds but their expansion slightly increases stopping power against unarmored targets and reduces overpenetration.

items.name: 9x19mm +P, reloaded
items.description: Overpressure 9x19mm ammunition.  The round's increased velocity results in superior accuracy and stopping power at the cost of higher recoil.

items.name: 9x19mm +P+, reloaded
items.description: A step beyond the high-pressure 9x19mm +P round, the +P+ has even higher internal pressure offering superior damage, accuracy, and penetration.

items.name: 9x19mm FMJ, reloaded
items.description: 9x19mm ammunition with a brass jacketed 115gr bullet.  It is a popular round for military, law enforcement, and civilian use even after almost 150 years.

items.name: 9x18mm, reloaded
items.description: 9x18 millimeter Makarov, an old Soviet pistol cartridge used mainly by the Makarov PM.  As the designation implies, it is a bit shorter in case length compared to 9mm Parabellum.  This one has been hand-reloaded.

items.name: 9x18mm +P+, reloaded
items.description: 9x18 millimeter Makarov, an old Soviet pistol cartridge used mainly by the Makarov PM.  This one has been hand-reloaded to generate higher internal pressure, boosting flight stability and damage.

items.name: 9x18mm FMJ, reloaded
items.description: 9x18 millimeter Makarov, an old Soviet pistol cartridge used mainly by the Makarov PM.  This brass-jacketed round increases penetration slightly, at the cost of reduced expansion.  This one has been hand-reloaded.

items.name: 00 shot, reloaded
items.description: A shell filled with metal pellets.  Extremely damaging, plus the spread makes it very accurate at short range.  Favored by SWAT forces.

items.name: birdshot, reloaded
items.description: Weak shotgun ammunition.  Designed for hunting birds and other small game, its applications in combat are very limited.

items.name: dragon's breath shell, reloaded
items.description: A shotgun shell filled with magnesium pellets or shards, used mostly as a distress flare or pyrotechnics tool.  When the round is fired, high temperature sparks and flames shoot out of the barrel, igniting everything in their path.

items.name: flechette shell, reloaded
items.description: A shotgun shell filled with tiny steel darts.  Extremely damaging, plus the spread makes it very accurate at short range.  Slices through most forms of armor with ease.

items.name: shotgun slug, reloaded
items.description: A heavy metal slug used with shotguns to give them the range capabilities of a rifle.  Extremely damaging but rather inaccurate.

items.name: Remington 700 .270 Win
items.description: A classic bolt action rifle chambered for .270 Winchester, very popular among hunters.  This is a CDL SF model with a forged, fluted, 416 stainless steel barrel threaded into the receiver and a recessed bolt face.  It has checkered walnut furniture and a recoil pad to reduce perceived recoil.

items.name: Remington 1100 competiton
items.description: This semi-automatic shotgun features a self compensating gas system that will feed a wide array of shells while also reducing recoil.  Introduced in 1963, it is favored by law enforcement, hunters and competition shooters, and has been the best-selling autoloading shotgun in U.S. history.  This is the nickel finished, teflon coated competition model, with a full length magazine tube and 30 inch barrel.

items.name: Remington 700 .30-06
items.description: A very popular and durable hunting or sniping rifle.  Popular among SWAT and US Marine snipers.  Highly damaging, but perhaps not as accurate as the competing Browning BLR.

items.name: Remington 870 Wingmaster
items.description: With over 10 million made, the Remington 870 is one of the most popular shotguns on the market, and finds use with hunters and law enforcement agencies alike thanks to its high accuracy and muzzle velocity.  This one is a 28 inch barreled model for hunting fowl and game.

items.name: Remington 870 MCS
items.description: This Remington 870 Modular Combat System shotgun is currently setup for breaching operations, with a 10 inch barrel and no stock.  It is small enough to carry as a secondary weapon, specifically to pop open any pesky doors you might come across.  The grip's design makes for controllable yet unpleasant recoil, and the barrel lacks any sights.

items.name: Remington 870 express
items.description: With over 10 million made, the Remington 870 is one of the most popular shotguns on the market, and finds use with hunters and law enforcement agencies alike thanks to its high accuracy and muzzle velocity.  This one is an 18.5 inch barreled defensive model.

items.name: remote vehicle controller
items.description: A remote controller for real cars.  Can turn onboard devices on and off.  Some cars can be driven remotely.

items.name: rennet
items.description: Enzymes used to curdle milk, for making cheese.  Traditionally made from the stomachs of ruminant animals.

items.name: repeating crossbow
items.description: A custom-made crossbow with a clever mechanism that loads and fires bolts in a single motion, it has a wooden magazine that holds 10 bolts.  Bolts fired from this weapon have a good chance of remaining intact for re-use.

items.name: plans for a radio repeater mod
items.description: Instructions on how to create a mod for a radio station terminal which converts the entire system into a repeater.

items.name: MATERIAL: T-SUBSTRATE
items.description: A white piece of paper, with the logo of XEDRA printed on its upper left corner.  It seems to be an internal report of some kind.

items.name: alien resin chunk
items.description: This is a shattered fragment of alien resin.  It looks a bit like a large piece of sea glass, frosted and gritty with the edges rounded off.  It is somewhat warm to the touch.

items.name: restaurant guide
items.description: This is glossy printed pamphlet that details dining establishments in the local area.  Printed by the Chamber of Commerce, it lists the addresses of all the best diners and bars.  Using it will add points of interest to your map.

items.name: .22 caliber conversion kit
items.description: Replacing several key parts of a 9x19mm, .38, .40, 5.7mm, 4.6mm, 7.62x39mm or .223 firearm converts it to a .22 firearm.  The conversion results in a slight reduction to accuracy.

items.name: .223 caliber conversion kit
items.description: This kit is used to convert a shotgun, 5.45x39mm, 7.62x39mm, .30-06, or .308 rifle to the popular, accurate, and lighter .223 caliber.  The conversion results in slight reductions to both accuracy and ammo capacity.

items.name: .308 caliber conversion kit
items.description: This kit is used to convert a shotgun or 7.62x39mm, .223 or .30-06 rifle to the popular and powerful .308 caliber.  The conversion results in reduced ammo capacity and a slight reduction to accuracy.

items.name: .45 caliber conversion kit
items.description: Replacing several key parts of a 9x19mm, .38, .40 or .44 firearm converts it to a .45 firearm.  The conversion results in a slight reduction to accuracy.

items.name: 4.6mm caliber conversion kit
items.description: A conversion kit produced by Heckler and Koch, used to convert .22, 9x19mm, or .38 firearms to their proprietary 4.6x30mm, a round designed for accuracy and armor penetration.

items.name: 5.7mm caliber conversion kit
items.description: A conversion kit produced by FN Herstal, used to convert .22, 9x19mm, or .38 firearms to their proprietary 5.7x28mm, a round designed for accuracy and armor penetration.

items.name: 9x19mm caliber conversion kit
items.description: Replacing several key parts of a 9x18mm, .38, .40, .44 or .45 firearm converts it to a 9x19mm firearm.  The conversion results in a slight reduction to accuracy.

items.name: .300 AAC Blackout AR-15 conversion kit
items.description: A complete AR-15 upper assembly with a .300 AAC Blackout barrel.

items.name: set of reverse-jointed legs
items.description: A set of reverse-jointed legs, like the ones found under a chicken walker.

items.name: shotgun revolver
items.description: A shotgun modified to use a revolver cylinder mechanism, it can hold 6 cartridges.

items.name: rhubarb
items.description: Sour stems of the rhubarb plant, often used in baking pies.

items.name: cooked rice
items.description: A hearty serving of cooked long-grain white rice.

items.name: pipe rifle: .22
items.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

items.name: pipe rifle: .223
items.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

items.name: pipe rifle: .30-06
items.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

items.name: handmade heavy carbine
items.description: A homemade lever-action magazine-fed smoothbore rifle.  While still a primitive pipe and 2x4 design, some minor improvements have been made, such as being able to accept G3 compatible magazines, and chambering the more powerful .308 rounds.

items.name: pipe rifle: .38 Special
items.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

items.name: pipe rifle: .40 S&W
items.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

items.name: pipe rifle: .44 Magnum
items.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

items.name: pipe rifle: .45
items.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

items.name: pipe rifle: 9x19mm
items.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

items.name: flintlock musket
items.description: For once, something *good* came back from the dead.  This ancient design lacks the fire-rate of modern weapons, but packs as much punch as the best of 'em and rewards the skilled shooter with easily-crafted ammunition.

items.name: rifle scope
items.description: A 3-18x44 rifle scope.  It is adjustable for windage and elevation in 1/10th mrad increments and is remarkably small and light for its magnification.

items.name: modified rifle scope
items.description: A 3-18x44 rifle scope.  It is adjustable for windage and elevation in 1/10th mrad increments and is remarkably small and light for its magnification.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and SMGs, if you so want.

items.name: rigid plastic sheet
items.description: A large, rigid sheet of translucent plastic, useful for all manner of things; from construction to art, or even junior snowboarding.

items.name: engagement ring
items.description: This ring is an intricate gold band, with a small cluster of diamonds set in the center.  Before the world broke down, this ring would've cost a small fortune.

items.name: purity ring
items.description: Also known as a promise ring, this ring is worn as a sign of chastity.  This one bears the inscription, "Love is patient."

items.name: signet ring
items.description: A gold and silver ring with a wide stamp attached to the band.  A long time ago, the stamp was legible, but now the pattern is too worn to discern its former use.

items.name: wedding ring
items.description: A flawless ring, ensnaring a diamond with twists of pure gold.  It's a constant reminder that the wearer is married.

items.name: RS1219 scope
items.description: An integral component of the RM11B rifle system, the RS1219 Accipiter digital scope provides auto-adjusting focal length, a user-selectable reticle, and an offset reflex sight for close objectives.

items.name: RK6S34 suppressor
items.description: A suppressor reduces the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm.  This RK6S34 Mustela is a rather advanced version integral to the RM11B rifle system.

items.name: RM103A automagnum
items.description: Considered overkill by many, the Rivtech M103A remains one of the most powerful sidearms ever developed.  Accepts stick magazines.

items.name: RM11B scout rifle
items.description: Intended to function as a long-range sharpshooter support weapon for the military, the Rivtech RM11B scout rifle was designed for durability and accuracy under less than ideal circumstances.  Its bullpup layout, integrated suppressor and digital scope, and two round burst mode allows it to deliver precise long-range takedowns, utilizing the proprietary Rivtech 8mm caseless round.  Accepts stick magazines.

items.name: RM120c shotgun
items.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM120c caseless pump-action shotgun was designed for hunting big game, with durability and ease of use as priorities.

items.name: RM121 aux shotgun
items.description: The Rivtech RM121 auxiliary weapon system is a magazine-fed semi-automatic caseless shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  Accepts RMSA10 box magazines.

items.name: modified RM121 aux shotgun
items.description: The Rivtech RM121 auxiliary weapon system is a magazine-fed semi-automatic caseless shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  Accepts RMSA10 box magazines.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols, if you so want.

items.name: RM13 combat armor
items.description: Internally powered by a maximum of ten plutonium fuel cells, this full-body suit of sleek black military armor represents the pinnacle of Rivtech's non-rigid powered armor technology.  Use it to turn it on.

items.name: RM13 combat armor (on)
items.description: Internally powered by a maximum of ten plutonium fuel cells, this full-body suit of sleek black military armor represents the pinnacle of Rivtech's non-rigid powered armor technology.  It is turned on, and continually draining power.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: RM20 autoshotgun
items.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM20 caseless automatic combat shotgun was designed with durability and overwhelming power in mind.

items.name: RM2000 submachine gun
items.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM2000 submachine gun was designed for durability and ease of carrying under less than ideal circumstances.  Accepts stick magazines.

items.name: RM228 PDW
items.description: Chambering the powerful 20x66mm caseless shotgun cartridge, the Rivtech RM228 PDW was designed for the civilian personal defense market with durability and ease of use as priorities.  While lauded for its small size and light weight, its hefty price tag kept it out of the reach of casual collectors.

items.name: RM298 HMG
items.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM298 heavy machine gun was designed for durability and extreme volume of sustained fire under the worst possible circumstances.  Accepts RMXB500 box and RMGD250 drum magazines.

items.name: RM450-2 fuel canister
items.description: A 2L pressurized steel canister with a valve designed for the RM451's feed system.

items.name: RM450-4 fuel canister
items.description: A 4L pressurized steel canister with a valve designed for the RM451's feed system.

items.name: RM451 flamethrower
items.description: A military-grade combat flamethrower designed by Rivtech, the RM451 flamethrower incorporates a cycling pressure rapid-feed fuel system with a high-speed piezoelectric igniter.  Solidly built with durability in mind, it serves as an incredibly destructive weapon in the right hands.

items.name: RM51 assault rifle
items.description: Originally produced for military use, the Rivtech RM51 assault rifle was designed for durability and ease of use under less than ideal circumstances, with its considerable bulk minimized by a compact and ergonomic layout.  Accepts box magazines.

items.name: RM614 LMG
items.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM614 light machine gun was designed for durability and extreme volume of sustained fire under the worst possible circumstances.  Accepts RMXB500 box and RMGD250 drum magazines.

items.name: RM802 grenade launcher
items.description: The Rivtech RM802 pump-action 40mm grenade launcher was designed to be a step ahead of single-shot grenade launchers by allowing sustained heavy firepower.  However, its capacity is fairly limited so it must be used with careful planning.

items.name: RM88 battle rifle
items.description: Originally produced for military use, the Rivtech RM88 battle rifle was designed for durability and extreme firepower under less than ideal circumstances, with a heavy ported barrel for maximum controllability.  Accepts box and RMGD250 drum magazines.

items.name: RM99 revolver
items.description: Considered overkill by some, the Rivtech M99 remains an exceedingly powerful addition to the arsenal of any gunslinger.

items.name: desiccated corpse
items.description: A dead body, badly mangled and desiccated.  It seems whatever killed him did so with a gigantic claw.

items.name: road map
items.description: This is a road map for the local area.  Listing information on civic sites like hospitals and police stations, it can be used to add points of interest to your map.

items.name: roasted coffee beans
items.description: Some roasted coffee beans, can be ground into powder.

items.name: robe
items.description: A loose-fitting outer garment with sleeves, and a mysterious amount of well-hidden pockets.

items.name: Hub 01 environmental suit
items.description: A lightweight environmental suit worn by Hub personnel in their rare forays aboveground.  Colored brown and blue, the white seal of Hub 01 is embroidered on both of its upper arms.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection.

items.name: Hub 01 jumpsuit
items.description: A brown jumpsuit worn by the staff of Hub 01.

items.name: prototype I/O recorder
items.description: This small transparent card was attached to the prototype robot's CPU.  It might contain the data the intercom spoke of.

items.name: robot driving unit
items.description: A set of servos, microcontrollers and other devices, together capable of driving an unmanned vehicle.  Its AI is not functional, but it should still have some sort of maintenance mode.

items.name: rock
items.description: A rock the size of a baseball.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and is also good for throwing at enemies.

items.name: stone pot
items.description: A large stone, roughly hollowed out into a pot.

items.name: quern
items.description: This is a simple hand-powered stone quern for grinding grain.

items.name: rock in a sock
items.description: A pair of nested socks filled with a stone.  A true weapon of despair.

items.name: pair of rollerblades
items.description: A pair of inline skates.  Very fast on flat floors, but they make it hard to move on rough terrain, take hits, or to dodge effectively.

items.name: pair of heelys (off)
items.description: A pair of sneakers with wheels, currently the wheels are hidden.

items.name: pair of heelys (on)
items.description: A pair of sneakers with wheels, currently the wheels are out.

items.name: pair of rollerskates
items.description: An old-fashioned pair of leather rollerskates with steel frames.  While quite fast on flat floors, they make it difficult to take hits or to move on rough terrain.

items.name: rolling paper
items.description: These are thin paper strips intended for the rolling of cigarettes.

items.name: rolling pin
items.description: A stout piece of hardwood, turned and sanded smooth, with rounded handles at the ends.  This timeless kitchen tool also doubles as a very effective club.

items.name: rollmat
items.description: This is a sheet of foam which can be rolled tightly for storage.  It insulates you from the floor, making it easier to sleep.  Use it to unroll and place on the ground.

items.name: root beer
items.description: Like cola, but without caffeine.  Still not that healthy.

items.name: long rope
items.description: A 30-foot (or about 9 m) long rope.  Useful for keeping yourself safe from falls.

items.name: short rope
items.description: A 6-foot (or about 180 cm) long piece of rope.  Too small to be of much use.

items.name: long cordage rope
items.description: A 30-foot (or about 9 m) long rough rope, woven from natural cordage.  Not strong enough to hold up to falls, but still useful for some things, such as suspending large corpses for butchering.

items.name: short cordage rope
items.description: A 6-foot (or about 180 cm) long piece of rough rope, woven from natural cordage.  Useful for some purposes, but not as strong or flexible as proper rope.

items.name: rose bud
items.description: A rose bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a rose flower.

items.name: rose
items.description: A rose stalk with some petals.

items.name: rose hips
items.description: The fruit of a pollinated rose flower.

items.name: rosin
items.description: This is a chunk of yellowish rosin, usable as a flux for soldering.

items.name: rotary evaporator
items.description: Just looking at this thing makes you feel like a proper mad scientist.  It's a series of glass tubes and round flasks, connected to a central motor and a heating element.  The heating element warms one flask, kept rotating by the motor, evaporating the contents. items.name: sewing kit
items.description: This is a plastic kit with a variety of needles, some plastic spools for thread, and a few other useful textile tools.  Use a sewing kit on an article of clothing to attempt to repair or reinforce that clothing.  This uses your tailoring skill.

items.name: fancy watch
items.description: A rather large and expensively made wristwatch.  Tells the time in elegantly wrought gold with silver detailing.  It's really the only timepiece suitable for someone of your exquisitely discerning tastes.

items.name: shark suit
items.description: A one piece chainmail suit used by scuba divers for protection against shark bites.  It comes with attached plastic helmet and booties.

items.name: faraday shark suit
items.description: A one piece chainmail suit used by scuba divers for protection against shark bites.  It has been conductively interconnected, protecting against electricity.

items.name: sharp rock
items.description: A rock with sharp edges, that can be used as a butchering tool, if nothing else is available.  Makes a passable melee weapon.

items.name: plastic shank
items.description: An oblong plastic trinket with the far end ground down into a stabbing point.

items.name: 1874 Sharps
items.description: A reproduction of an antique single-shot .45-70 rifle once used to hunt buffalo and other large game in the late 19th Century.  Highly accurate and powerful for the time, this one is made to handle modern smokeless ammunition.

items.name: shaving kit
items.description: This is a compact and lightweight shaving kit made for travelers.  You can use it to shave if it's supplied with soap.  It requires 1 unit of soap per use.

items.name: shears
items.description: This is a set of shears designed to obtain wool from sheep.

items.name: sheath
items.description: A leather sheath for holding knives and other small blades.  It is easy to use without much practice.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.

items.name: wooden shed stick
items.description: This is a short thin flat wooden stick, used as a tool while weaving cloth with a frame loom.

items.name: sheet
items.description: A large fabric sheet, could be used as a curtain or bedsheets; or cut up for a bunch of rags.

items.name: cotton sheet
items.description: A sheet of cotton fabric, suitable for making clothing.

items.name: patchwork cotton clothing parts
items.description: A selection of various clothing parts, sewn together from cotton patches in a patchwork fashion.  Suitable for making most clothing, though it's much less time-efficient than if using proper material sheets.

items.name: faux fur sheet
items.description: A sheet of fake synthetic colorful fur, suitable for making clothing.

items.name: patchwork faux fur clothing parts

items.name: felt sheet
items.description: A sheet of felt, suitable for making clothing.

items.name: patchwork felt clothing parts

items.name: Kevlar sheet
items.description: A sheet of Kevlar synthetic fabric, suitable for making bulletproof armor.  In this form, unlike rigid plates, it can be stitched.

items.name: Lycra sheet

items.name: patchwork Lycra clothing parts

items.name: neoprene sheet

items.name: patchwork neoprene clothing parts

items.name: Nomex sheet
items.description: A sheet of Nomex synthetic fabric, suitable for making heat-resistant clothing.

items.name: patchwork Nomex clothing parts

items.name: synthetic fabric sheet
items.description: A sheet of synthetic fabric, suitable for making clothing.

items.name: patchwork synthetic fabric clothing parts

items.name: shelter kit
items.description: This is a small shelter, made of sticks and skins.  Use it to place.

items.name: sheriff's shirt
items.description: A tan button-down shirt with long sleeves.

items.name: sherry
items.description: East India Solera.  A true drink of a British gentleman.  Sherry, Niles?

items.name: shillelagh
items.description: A stout knotty stick with a large knob at the top that has been left to cure in a chimney.  A traditional Irish weapon, the shillelagh was originally used for settling disputes in a gentlemanly manner.

items.name: shillelagh fake
items.description: A fake shillelagh massproduced as a souvenir for tourists.  This knotty stick has not been cured in a chimney like a traditional shillelagh but has had fake black soot painted on.

items.name: loaded stick
items.description: A stout knotty stick with a large knob at the top that has been left to cure in a chimney.  A traditional Irish weapon, the shillelagh was originally used for settling disputes in a gentlemanly manner.  The knob has been hollowed and filled with molten heavy metal to pack more of a punch.

items.name: shishkebab (off)
items.description: This is a large blade with a fuel pipe on the side, and a small tank and igniter built into the insulated hilt.  When filled with gasoline, the blade can be made scorching hot to singe enemies and light your way.  Use to ignite.

items.name: shishkebab (on)
items.description: This is a large blade with a fuel pipe on the side, and a small tank and igniter built into the insulated hilt.  The blade is glowing brightly.  Use to shut off the gas.

items.name: electrified épée
items.description: The modifications made to this fencing épée may not be sporting, but they might give you an edge in this final competition.  Extra effort has been made to insulate the grip and a high voltage stun gun has been attached to the guard, wired through the electronic scoring circuit to the tip.  Thrusting the sharpened tip into a foe and activating the momentary switch will deliver a painful electric shock.

items.name: electrified foil
items.description: The modifications made to this fencing foil may not be sporting, but they might give you an edge in this final competition.  Extra effort has been made to insulate the grip and a high voltage stun gun has been attached to the guard, wired through the electronic scoring circuit to the tip.  Thrusting the sharpened tip into a foe and activating the momentary switch will deliver a painful electric shock.

items.name: electrified saber
items.description: The modifications made to this fencing saber may not be sporting, but they might give you an edge in this final competition.  Extra effort has been made to insulate the grip and a high voltage stun gun has been attached to the guard, wired to the tip along the saber's groove.  Thrusting the sharpened tip into a foe and activating the momentary switch will deliver a painful electric shock.

items.name: powered quarterstaff
items.description: This is an ironshod quarterstaff that has a high-voltage stun gun built into the handle.  The stun gun is wired to the metal caps at either end of the staff, allowing you to zap a dangerous opponent should beating them senseless with it prove too hazardous.

items.name: tactical tonfa (off)
items.description: This is a reinforced plastic tonfa; the core is hollowed out and is filled with capacitors and a high-yield rechargeable storage battery.  When a switch on the handle is pressed, a high-voltage current is transmitted to the two electrodes mounted in the end of the tonfa, and by extension to anyone unfortunate enough to be in contact with them.  It also has a nifty flashlight, which is off at the moment.

items.name: tactical tonfa (on)
items.description: This is a reinforced plastic tonfa; the core is hollowed out and is filled with capacitors and a high-yield rechargeable storage battery.  When a switch on the handle is pressed, a high-voltage current is transmitted to the two electrodes mounted in the end of the weapon, and by extension to anyone unfortunate enough to be in contact with them.

items.name: pair of birchbark shoes
items.description: Simple shoes woven from strips of birch bark.  Not very comfortable, but better than going barefoot.

items.name: pair of bowling shoes
items.description: A pair of flat-soled shoes designed to give you a grip on slippery surfaces.

items.name: fast draw holster
items.description: A comfortable quick draw holster for small guns.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

items.name: short bow
items.description: Though not as powerful as the longbow, this bow is quicker and easier to draw, and can be used effectively by those of average strength.  Good for small game or the survivor on the go.

items.name: shorts
items.description: A pair of khaki shorts.

items.name: cargo shorts
items.description: A pair of shorts lined with pockets, offering decent storage.

items.name: denim shorts
items.description: A pair of denim shorts.  Thick and tough, they provide excellent protection from cuts.

items.name: 00 shot
items.description: A shell filled with metal pellets.  Extremely damaging, plus the spread makes it very accurate at short range.  Favored by SWAT forces.

items.name: shotgun beanbag
items.description: A beanbag round for shotguns, not deadly but designed to disable.

items.name: birdshot
items.description: Weak shotgun ammunition.  Designed for hunting birds and other small game, its applications in combat are very limited.

items.name: dragon's breath shell
items.description: A shotgun shell filled with magnesium pellets or shards, used mostly as a distress flare or pyrotechnics tool.  When the round is fired, high temperature sparks and flames shoot out of the barrel, igniting everything in their path.

items.name: flechette shell
items.description: A shotgun shell filled with tiny steel darts.  Extremely damaging, plus the spread makes it very accurate at short range.  Slices through most forms of armor with ease.

items.name: explosive slug
items.description: A shotgun shell shooting a small explosive.  Damaging, but rather inaccurate and short ranged.  Banned in several states.

items.name: shotgun hull
items.description: An empty hull from a shotgun shell.

items.name: buckshot paper cartridge
items.description: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of black powder and an equal volume of 00 buckshot.

items.name: birdshot paper cartridge
items.description: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of black powder and an equal volume of birdshot.  Used mostly for hunting small game or fowl.

items.name: pyrotechnic paper cartridge
items.description: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of black powder and an equal volume of flammable metals.  When fired, burning chunks of metal and sparks will shoot out of the barrel, igniting everything in their path.

items.name: .62 paper cartridge
items.description: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of black powder and a .605 inch lead ball.

items.name: 00 shot, scrap loaded
items.description: A shotgun shell filled with whatever was lying around.  They are more damaging than birdshot, but fairly inaccurate.

items.name: shotgun slug
items.description: A heavy metal slug used with shotguns to give them the range capabilities of a rifle.  Extremely damaging but rather inaccurate.

items.name: shotgun 6-round tube speedloader
items.description: A plastic tube with a sliding handle that can be used to quickly load 6 rounds into a shotgun's tube in a much shorter period of time than by hand.  It needs to interface with a chute to be used with any speed.

items.name: shotgun 8-round tube speedloader
items.description: A plastic tube with a sliding handle that can be used to quickly load 8 rounds into a shotgun's tube in a much shorter period of time than by hand.  It needs to interface with a chute to be used with any speed.

items.name: shotgun suppressor
items.description: A large suppressor designed to work with shotguns.  It's a lot more complex than a suppressor for a pistol or rifle.

items.name: shotshell belt
items.description: A non-disintegrating cloth ammo belt which can hold up to 20 shotgun shells.  Notably less reliable than metal ammo belts.

items.name: bearing shotcanister
items.description: This small paper canister resembling a crude shotshell is filled to the brim with handmade bearings, stabilizing its flight pattern a tiny bit.

items.name: flechette shotcanister
items.description: This small paper canister resembling a crude shotshell is filled to the brim with handmade flechettes, giving it some armor piercing capabilities.

items.name: pebble shotcanister
items.description: This small paper canister resembling a crude shotshell is filled to the brim with tiny pebbles.  Damage is pathetic but flight is much more stable than scrap.

items.name: scrap shotcanister
items.description: This small paper canister resembling a crude shotshell is filled to the brim with assorted pieces of scrap metal.

items.name: Winchester M37 .410
items.description: A single-shot break-action shotgun, chambered in .410 bore.  Designed as a lower-recoil alternative to 12 gauge shotguns, it is light and easy to manufacture.

items.name: double barrel shotgun
items.description: An old shotgun, possibly antique.  It is little more than a pair of barrels, a wood stock, and a hammer to strike the cartridges.

items.name: shotgun primer
items.description: Primer from a shotgun shell.

items.name: single barrel shotgun
items.description: An old shotgun, possibly antique.  It is little more than a barrel, a wood stock, and a hammer to strike the cartridge.  Its simple design keeps it both light and accurate.

items.name: shotgun trap
items.description: This is a simple tripwire is attached to the trigger of a loaded double-barreled shotgun.  When pulled, the shotgun fires.  Two shells are loaded; the first time the trigger is pulled, one or both shells may be discharged.

items.name: shoulder strap
items.description: A shoulder strap allows the rifle to be worn over your shoulders like a piece of clothing.  However, it offers no protection.

items.name: shovel
items.description: This is a digging tool.  Use it to dig pits adjacent to your location.

items.name: shrapnel
items.description: A twisted shard of jagged metal.

items.name: badminton shuttlecock
items.description: A high-drag projectile used in the sport of badminton.

items.name: sickle
items.description: This is an old-fashioned farming tool used to cut tall grass.  While it may be a massive curved blade on a handle, it is incredibly awkward to use for anything but its intended purpose.

items.name: wicker sieve
items.description: This is a primitive sieve constructed from woven strips of plant material.  Early sieves like this were used to sift grain, though the openings on this one are too small for that.

items.name: sieve
items.description: This is no mere strainer for noodles; it's a sieve used to separate particles of certain sizes.  You could use this to do a really good job sifting flour, remove dust and soil from grain, or perhaps conduct gradiation tests for any civil engineers you might know.  This one has been constructed from steel mesh.

items.name: SIG Pro .40 magazine
items.description: A compact and reliable magazine for use with the SIG Pro .40 pistol.

items.name: SIG 552
items.description: A compact selective fire automatic rifle designed for the Swiss military.  It features a three-round burst mode and an integrated folding stock.

items.name: SIG Pro .40
items.description: Originally marketed as a lightweight and compact alternative to older SIG handguns, the Pro .40 is popular among European police forces.

items.name: SIG Mosquito
items.description: A popular, small .22 LR pistol.  One of the many polymer frame pistols produced during the latter 20th-early 21st centuries; it has an underbarrel rail.

items.name: SIG Sauer P230
items.description: The SIG Sauer P230 is a small, semi-automatic handgun chambered in .32 ACP.  Due to its small dimensions, it was often carried as a backup weapon.

items.name: sights mount
items.description: This is a plastic mount for attaching a sight, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any weapon other than launchers and pistols, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on older guns.

items.name: launcher sights mount
items.description: This is a plastic mount for attaching a sight, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any launcher, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on rocket launchers.

items.name: pistol sights mount
items.description: This is a plastic mount for attaching a sight, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any pistol, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on pocket pistols.

items.name: signal flare
items.description: A heavy plastic cartridge made for use in flare guns.  It appears to be a modified 12 gauge shotgun shell.

items.name: chit
items.description: This is a slip of paper signed by the issuer.

items.name: SIG P230 magazine
items.description: A factory specification 8-round magazine for the SIG Sauer P230.

items.name: silver bracelet
items.description: A nice silver bracelet.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: pair of silver earrings
items.description: A pair of beautiful silver earrings.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: silver hairpin
items.description: A shiny, silver hairpin with a tiny bee engraved onto it.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: silver locket
items.description: A small, silver locket with a frame inside to store photographs or small objects.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: silver medal
items.description: A medal awarded for achieving second place in some event.  Before everything fell apart, this could be a source of pride for its owner.  Now it's just another shiny bauble.

items.name: silver necklace
items.description: A nice silver necklace.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: silver ring
items.description: A simple, silver ring.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: silver
items.description: A soft shiny metal.  Before the Cataclysm it was worth quite a bit but its value is now greatly diminished.

items.name: silver watch
items.description: An elegant silver watch, crafted from silver-plated stainless steel.  It's much cheaper than other metal watches, and more classy than an ordinary wristwatch.

items.name: sinew
items.description: A tough sinew cut from a corpse, usable as thread.

items.name: single malt whiskey
items.description: Only the finest whiskey straight from the bung.

items.name: single pot still Irish whiskey
items.description: A whiskey made from a mixed mash of malted and unmalted barley.

items.name: sippy cup
items.description: A plastic cup with a spill-proof lid, designed for use by children.

items.name: bone skewer
items.description: A thin skewer carved from bone.  Sadly, it won't make squirrel on a stick taste better.

items.name: ski jacket
items.description: An insulated, breathable hoodie made for alpine skiing.  Very warm, and with sizable pockets.

items.name: skirt
items.description: A short, breezy cotton skirt.  Easy to move in, but only has a single small pocket.

items.name: leather skirt
items.description: A very short leather skirt, clearly designed to look good, not be practical.

items.name: Skorpion Vz. 61 magazine
items.description: A standard 20-round magazine for the Skorpion Vz. 61, in .32 ACP.

items.name: Skorpion Vz. 82 magazine
items.description: A standard 20-round magazine for the Skorpion Vz. 82, in 9x18mm Makarov.

items.name: Skorpion Vz. 61
items.description: The Skorpion Vz. 61 is a Czechoslovak submachine gun from the 1950s, chambered in .32 ACP.

items.name: Skorpion Vz. 82
items.description: A version of the Skorpion submachine gun chambered in 9x18mm Makarov, with a slightly longer barrel than the original design.

items.name: SKS
items.description: Developed by the Soviets in 1945, this rifle was quickly replaced by the full-auto AK47.  However, due to its superb accuracy, low recoil and deployable integrated bayonet, this gun maintains immense popularity.

items.name: sleeping bag
items.description: A large sleeping bag that covers you head to toe.  This one is medium weight.

items.name: fur sleeping bag
items.description: A large sleeping bag lined with fur.  Who needs a tent?

items.name: rolled fur sleeping bag
items.description: A large sleeping bag lined with fur, rolled for transport.  It has a strap to carry it with.

items.name: rolled sleeping bag
items.description: A large sleeping bag rolled up for transport.  It has a strap to carry it with.

items.name: sleeveless duster
items.description: A rugged full-length duster that leaves your arms unencumbered.  Has plenty of storage space due to its many pockets.

items.name: sleeveless faux fur duster
items.description: A thick, sleeveless faux fur duster, falling below your knees.  Has many pockets for storing things.

items.name: sleeveless fur duster
items.description: A thick fur full-length duster without sleeves, leaving your arms unencumbered.  Has plenty of storage space due to its many pockets.

items.name: sleeveless leather duster
items.description: A thick leather full-length duster without sleeves, leaving your arms unencumbered.  Has plenty of storage space due to its many pockets.

items.name: sleeveless survivor duster
items.description: A custom Kevlar armored full-length duster without sleeves, covered with pouches and pockets.  Comfortable, durable, and great for storage.

items.name: sleeveless trenchcoat
items.description: A thin cotton trenchcoat that leaves your arms unencumbered.  Has plenty of storage space due to its many pockets.

items.name: sleeveless faux fur trenchcoat
items.description: A thick faux fur trenchcoat without sleeves.  Has plenty of storage space, and looks pretty good.

items.name: sleeveless fur trenchcoat
items.description: A thick fur trenchcoat without sleeves, leaving your arms unencumbered.  Has plenty of storage space due to its many pockets.

items.name: sleeveless leather trenchcoat
items.description: A thick leather trenchcoat without sleeves, leaving your arms unencumbered.  Has plenty of storage space due to its many pockets.

items.name: sleeveless survivor trenchcoat
items.description: A custom Kevlar armored trenchcoat without sleeves, covered with pouches and pockets.  Comfortable, durable, and great for storage.

items.name: sleeveless tunic
items.description: A sleeveless cloth garment that covers the torso and legs.

items.name: blob glob
items.description: A little hunk of glop that fell off a blob monster.  It doesn't seem hostile, but it does wiggle occasionally.

items.name: sling
items.description: A leather sling, easy to use and accurate.  It uses pebbles as ammunition.

items.name: sling pack
items.description: A simple single-sling backpack.  Easier to access than a normal backpack, but can't comfortably hold as much.

items.name: slingshot
items.description: A wooden slingshot, easy to use and accurate.  It uses pebbles as ammunition.

items.name: pair of slippers
items.description: Soft shoes that keep your feet warm.  Not suitable for running.

items.name: sloppy joe
items.description: A sandwich, consisting of ground meat and tomato sauce served on a hamburger bun.

items.name: small fire extinguisher
items.description: This is a hand held fire extinguisher containing a liter of highly compressed CO2 gas.  It would be useful for putting out adjacent fires.

items.name: small civilian helicopter rotors

A grad student or a robot (is there really any difference?) collects the distillate in fractions so that specific contents can be analyzed.  Going a few milliliters at a time, it would not be very effective to try to distill whiskey in this thing.

Its unique design allows for all 12 shells to be fired in under 3 seconds, as demonstrated by the ATF technical branch.

items.name: long string

items.name: short string

items.name: sugar
items.description: Sweet, sweet sugar.  Bad for your teeth and surprisingly not very tasty on its own.

items.name: sugar beet
items.description: This fleshy root is ripe and flowing with sugars; just takes some processing to extract them.

items.name: caramel
items.description: Some caramel.  Still bad for your health.

items.name: suit
items.description: A full-body cotton suit.  Makes the apocalypse a truly gentlemanly experience.

items.name: suitcase
items.description: A huge wheeled suitcase used mainly for transporting clothes and other possessions during trips, provides a decent amount of storage but hauling it around is neither fast nor comfortable.

items.name: suitcase
items.description: A mid-sized suitcase used mainly for transporting clothes and other possessions during trips, provides a decent amount of storage but hauling it around is not exactly comfortable.

items.name: sundress
items.description: A light and breezy cotton dress.  Though cool and comfortable to wear, it lacks any storage space.

items.name: sunflower
items.description: The top of a sunflower, with yellow pedals and some seeds that have yet to be eaten by animals.

items.name: pair of sunglasses
items.description: A pair of sunglasses, good for keeping the glare out of your eyes.

items.name: sun light
items.description: seeing this is a bug

items.name: superalloy medium quadruped armor
items.description: A thin mesh interwoven with superalloy plates and pouches for military working medium quadrupeds that covers from the dewlap to the croup, down to the elbows.  You could put this on a friendly medium quadruped.

items.name: superalloy small quadruped armor
items.description: A thin mesh interwoven with superalloy plates and pouches for military working small quadrupeds that covers from the dewlap to the croup, down to the elbows.  You could put this on a friendly small quadruped.

items.name: superglue
items.description: A tube of strong glue.  Used in many crafting recipes.

items.name: suppressor
items.description: A suppressor reduces the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection; a suppressor will bring the loudness of a report down to generally safe levels.

items.name: compact suppressor
items.description: A compact suppressor designed for pistols and best used with smaller calibers.

items.name: handmade carbine
items.description: A well-designed improvised lever-action carbine with a shortened barrel.  Accepting crude detachable magazines or STANAG magazines, this is one of the better homemade weapons.

items.name: homemade hand cannon
items.description: A large and heavy pistol evidently welded from scrap.  It's not pretty, but the .45 it's chambered with packs a serious punch.  Just watch out for the kick.

items.name: crude rocket launcher
items.description: An improvised, direct ignition launcher for home-made rockets.  Essentially, a thick-walled steel pipe, equipped with a pilot light, several batteries and a simple circuit board.  Effective only at medium range, barely.

items.name: handmade six-shooter
items.description: A homemade 6-shot revolver.  While it's not as good as the pre-Cataclysm manufactured weapons, it's a decent piece of work, all things considered.

items.name: Autobiography of a Mountain Man
items.description: An amusing historical novel filled with detailed descriptions of surviving in the wild, potentially containing great insights for an experienced outdoorsman.

items.name: survival kit
items.description: A small box filled with tools and items to help you survive in case of an emergency.  Disassemble to get its content.

items.name: survival kit box
items.description: An aluminum box that used to contain a small survival kit.  Can hold 1 liter of liquid.

items.name: survival marker
items.description: This is a sharpened piece of charcoal that is almost guaranteed to make your hands all covered in charcoal.  Use it to write something down.

items.name: Pocket Survival Cookbook
items.description: The smallest cookbook on the market, marketed exclusively to the outdoorsman.  Packs a surprising number of recipes for its tiny size.

items.name: STANAG makeshift magazine
items.description: An improvised 5-round straight single-stack box magazine consisting of little more than a bent sheet of steel held together by duct tape and hope, for use with STANAG compatible rifles.

items.name: makeshift STEN magazine
items.description: An improvised magazine that is mostly compatible with the STEN submachine gun, with a simplified feed system.

items.name: survivor utility belt
items.description: A custom-built leather utility belt covered with straps and pouches containing many useful hand tools and a sheath to carry a smaller blade.  Durable and carefully crafted to be comfortable to wear.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.

items.name: survivor belt
items.description: A custom-built leather utility belt covered with straps and pouches with a sheath to carry a smaller blade.  Durable and carefully crafted to be comfortable to wear.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.

items.name: survivor duffel bag
items.description: A custom-built heavy duffel bag.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.

items.name: survivor goggles
