items.description: A custom-built pair of armored goggles with tinted lenses.  Comfortable and built to last, they provide excellent protection from environmental dangers.

items.name: makeshift haircut kit
items.description: This is a kit with tools for cutting hair.

items.name: survivor hiking backpack
items.description: A custom-built backpack hiking.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.

items.name: survivor headlamp
items.description: This is a custom-made LED headlamp reinforced to be more durable and with a more efficient battery pack.  The adjustable strap allows it to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  Use it to turn it on.

items.name: survivor headlamp (on)
items.description: This is a custom-made LED headlamp reinforced to be more durable, and with a more efficient battery pack.  The adjustable strap allows it to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: survivor machete
items.description: This common gardening tool has been customized and rebalanced to improve its performance as a weapon.

items.name: survivor mess kit
items.description: A homemade mess kit, containing everything you might need for creating post-apocalyptic cuisine.  Powered by a lamp oil burner, it is composed of simple yet durable tools and materials.

items.name: survivor backpack
items.description: A custom-built backpack.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.

items.name: survivor rucksack
items.description: A custom-built heavy backpack.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.

items.name: survivor runner pack
items.description: A custom-built lightweight runner pack.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.

items.name: survivor telescope
items.description: A homemade collapsible telescope.  Too large and inaccurate to use as a weapon scope, but carrying this item in your inventory will double the distance that is mapped around you during your travels.

items.name: makeshift shaving kit
items.description: This is a makeshift shaving kit.  You can use it to shave if it's supplied with soap.  It requires 1 unit of soap per use.

items.name: Special 700
items.description: A rusty receiver, a R700 pattern barrel and half a broken crutch; all held together in the shape of a rifle with nothing more than glue, duct tape, and generous amounts of faith.

items.name: survivor suit
items.description: A hand-built combination armor made from a bulletproof vest and a reinforced leather jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

items.name: survivor harness
items.description: A custom-built light harness covered with pouches and including an integral tactical sling for a small rifle or other such weapon.  Durable and carefully crafted to be comfortable to wear.  Activate to holster/draw your weapon.

items.name: survivor's map
items.description: This is a hand-drawn map of the local area.  Whoever created it has marked down the locations of nearby supply sources including gun stores and gas stations.  Using it will add points of interest to your map.

items.name: survivor's note
items.description: A scrap of paper.  Something's written on it, scrawled in bad handwriting.

items.name: fish makizushi
items.description: Delicious slivers of thinly sliced raw fish wrapped in tasty sushi rice and rolled up in a healthy green vegetable.

items.name: meat temaki
items.description: Delicious slivers of raw meat wrapped in tasty sushi rice and rolled up in a healthy green vegetable.

items.name: sushi rice
items.description: A serving of sticky vinegared rice commonly used in sushi.

items.name: vegetable hosomaki
items.description: Delicious chopped vegetables wrapped in tasty sushi rice and rolled up in a healthy green vegetable.

items.name: S&W 22A magazine
items.description: A standard capacity magazine for the popular S&W 22A pistol.

items.name: S&W 629
items.description: A stainless steel, six-shot, double-action revolver with a matte black plastic handle manufactured by Smith & Wesson.  Though hardly the most powerful handgun in the world any more, it could still blow a zombie's head clean off.

items.name: S&W 22A
items.description: A popular .22 pistol.

items.name: S&W 500
items.description: The 5-shot Smith and Wesson 500 revolver fires the comparably-named .500 S&W Magnum.  It's an impressive weapon.

items.name: S&W 610
items.description: The Smith and Wesson 610 is a classic six-shooter revolver chambered for 10mm rounds, or for S&W's own .40 round.

items.name: S&W 619
items.description: A seven-round .38 revolver sold by Smith & Wesson.  It features a fixed rear sight and a reinforced frame.

items.name: swag bag
items.description: A large canvas sack, re-purposed for makeshift storage.  Goes well with a striped shirt and a domino mask.

items.name: swage and die set
items.description: These are a set of swages and dies for metalsmithing.  These loops and metal blocks are used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.

items.name: SWAT armor
items.description: A suit of black bulletproof armor with lots of pockets.  The word SWAT is emblazoned across the back.

items.name: sweater
items.description: A wool shirt.  Provides warmth.

items.name: sweatshirt
items.description: A thick cotton shirt.  Provides warmth and a bit of padding.

items.name: sweet sausage
items.description: A sweet and delicious sausage.  Better eat it fresh.

items.name: sweet water
items.description: Water with sugar or honey added.  Tastes okay.

items.name: raw sweetbread
items.description: Sweetbreads are the thymus or pancreas of an animal.  These are a delicacy, if prepared properly.

items.name: cooked sweetbread
items.description: Normally a delicacy, it needs a little… something.

items.name: Sweets for your Sweet Child
items.description: Sweets for your Sweet Child is the best selling cooking book to the parents of young children.  Every recipe uses oversized text, easy words and diagram instructions for children learning to cook with their parents.

items.name: pair of swim fins
items.description: A pair of rubber flippers worn on the feet which improve swimming speed while greatly impeding the wearer's ability to walk.

items.name: switchblade
items.description: This is a long and thin knife with a spring-loaded blade that rests inside the handle while not in use.

items.name: sword bayonet
items.description: A sword bayonet is a large slashing weapon that can be attached to the front of a firearm or crossbow converting it into a pike.

items.name: modified sword bayonet
items.description: A sword bayonet is a large slashing weapon that can be attached to the front of a firearm or crossbow converting it into a pike.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and SMGs, if you so want.

items.name: sword cane
items.description: A sword with a thin blade designed to be hidden inside a hollow cane.

items.name: crude sword
items.description: Several bits of thin scrap metal crudely beat into the semblance of an edge over a wooden sword.  The added weight is unbalanced, but the jagged edge offers a good bit of slashing power.

items.name: hand-forged sword
items.description: A simple, no-frills handmade sword.  Not accurate to any historical style, and the blade profile isn't as well-balanced as the real deal, but it's more than serviceable in the right hands.  It's just hefty enough to require a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.

items.name: nord
items.description: The nail sword, or nord for short.  This wooden sword has a dozen nails sticking at jagged angles from edge of the blade, making it much better at chopping than slashing.

items.name: 2-by-sword
items.description: A two by four with a cross guard and whittled down point; not much for slashing, but much better than your bare hands.

items.name: xiphos
items.description: A bronze sword of ancient Greek origin, wielded as a sidearm to the dory spear.

items.name: syringe
items.description: A medical syringe.  Used for administering intravenous drugs.

items.name: maple syrup
items.description: Boiling the sap of a maple tree has concentrated it into sweet, delicious maple syrup.

items.name: pair of tabi
items.description: A pair of black tabi, as worn with traditional Japanese clothes.

items.name: pair of gi tabi
items.description: A pair of white tabi, as used by martial arts practitioners.

items.name: McMillan TAC-50
items.description: A long-range anti-materiel and anti-personnel sniper rifle made by McMillan Firearms, serving the Canadian Army since 2000 as the C15, and the Navy Seals as the Mk 15 Mod 0.  This .50 caliber bolt-action rifle is capable of defeating light vehicles, radar installations and crew served weapons at extreme distances.  It notably holds the longest range confirmed sniper kill, as well as the 4th and 5th longest.

items.name: TAC-50 magazine
items.description: 5-round box magazine for McMillan TAC-50.

items.name: tactical full helmet
items.description: An all-encompassing black helmet that covers your entire face and neck, providing excellent protection from all sorts of damage.

items.name: tactical helmet
items.description: A lightweight black helmet that provides excellent protection from all sorts of damage.

items.name: taco
items.description: A traditional Mexican dish composed of a corn tortilla folded or rolled around a meat filling.

items.name: tac vest
items.description: This light vest is meant to carry your gear and ammunition comfortably distributed about your torso.  They are popular amongst law enforcement, but less so than combination tactical vests incorporating Kevlar.  Lightweight and easy to don, this vest can hold four magazines close at hand in its many pouches.

items.name: Traditional Japanese Kimono
items.description: An illustrated textbook on the crafting of Japanese traditional garb.

items.name: clothing designer's portfolio
items.description: A leather bound portfolio that once belonged to a clothing designer.  Filled with sketches and notes, a skilled tailor could learn a lot from this volume.

items.name: tailoring pattern set
items.description: This is a large set of tailoring patterns made from paper.  They're useful for making any kind of cloth or leather items from scratch, but are necessary for more advanced projects.

items.name: tailor's kit
items.description: This is a high quality kit consisting of a variety of needles, some plastic spools for thread, some small scissors, and an awl.  Use a tailor's kit to customize your clothing and armor.  This uses your tailoring skill.

items.name: tainted tornado
items.description: A frothing slurry of alcohol-soaked zombie flesh and rotten blood, it smells almost as bad as it looks.  Will make you mutate uncontrollably.

items.name: talking doll
items.description: This is a talking doll, meant for children.  Fortunately it still works, and you could unload the batteries out of it.

items.name: book of tall tales
items.description: An entertaining collection of early American folklore, featuring tales of larger than life individuals and their amazing adventures.

items.name: tallow
items.description: A smooth white block of cleaned and rendered animal fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

items.name: tainted tallow
items.description: A smooth grayish block of cleaned and rendered monster fat.  It will remain 'fresh' for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many projects.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.

items.name: tanbark
items.description: A sheet of tannin-rich bark from a tree, useful for tanning leather

items.name: tank top
items.description: A sleeveless cotton shirt.  Very easy to move in.

items.name: set of small tank tread
items.description: A set of small tank tread, like the one used by the "Beagle" mini-tank.

items.name: Beagle chassis
items.description: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the Beagle tank.

items.name: tanned hide
items.description: A folded sheet of leather made from carefully tanned animal hide.  Can be cut up or used as is.

items.name: tanned pelt
items.description: A folded sheet of leather made from carefully tanned animal hide, with the fur still intact.  Can be cut up or used as is.

items.name: tanning leather hide
items.description: A treated animal hide which is undergoing the chemical processes required to become leather.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.

items.name: tanning fur pelt
items.description: A treated animal pelt which is undergoing the chemical processes required to become fur.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.

items.name: tanto
items.description: Long Japanese knives like this more-modern remake were the samurai's backup weapon, before the advent of the larger wakizashi.  It's still a deadly blade, even if it's smaller than its more famous relatives.

items.name: tanto fake
items.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a long Japanese knife, typically used as a samurai's backup weapon.

items.name: tanto replica
items.description: Long Japanese knives like this more-modern remake were the samurai's backup weapon, before the advent of the larger wakizashi.  This one doesn't feel well-balanced

items.name: targeting module
items.description: This module integrates visual and proprioceptive information from peripheric sensors and outputs information necessary for accurate aiming.

items.name: tarpaulin
items.description: A plastic sheet with several grommets for securing it with rope or cord.  Useful for improvised rain protection.

items.name: tarp raincatcher
items.description: Some sticks and string with a tarpaulin to set up an improvised raincatcher.

items.name: Taurus Spectrum
items.description: A .380 subcompact pistol.  Designed for concealed carry and built from high-quality, durable materials.

items.name: Taurus Spectrum magazine
items.description: A compact, 6-round steel box magazine for use with the Taurus Spectrum.

items.name: Tavor TS12
items.description: This is a triple tube magazine fed, gas-operated bullpup shotgun of Israeli Weapon Industries make.  It is capable of loading 15 shells, all in a relatively small package.  Like many other modern IWI designs, this looks more like a sci-fi prop gun than a firearm.  An integral top rail is provided for mounting sights.

items.name: tazer
items.description: This is a high-powered stun gun.  Use this item to attempt to electrocute an adjacent enemy, damaging and temporarily paralyzing them.  Because the shock can actually jump through the air, it is difficult to miss.

items.name: TDI Vector magazine
items.description: A 30-round steel box magazine for use with the TDI Vector

items.name: tea
items.description: The beverage of gentlemen everywhere, made from applying hot water to leaves of the tea plant /Camellia sinensis/.

items.name: bark tea
items.description: Often regarded as folk medicine in some countries, bark tea tastes awful and tends to dry you out, but can help flush out stomach or other gut bugs.

items.name: tea leaf
items.description: Dried leaves of a tropical plant.  You can boil them into tea, or you can just eat them raw.  They aren't too filling though.

items.name: sweet tea
items.description: The beverage of gentlemen everywhere, made from applying hot water to leaves of the tea plant /Camellia sinensis/. Added sweetener for a better taste.

items.name: teapot
items.description: A small metal teapot.  Teatime wouldn't be complete without one.

items.name: tear gas payload
items.description: This is a dummy item used by tear gas hacks.  You should never see it outside of debug.

items.name: active tear gas payload
items.description: This is a dummy item used by tear gas hacks that just so happens to be counting down.  You should never see it outside of debug.

items.name: shredder
items.description: This menacing looking attachment is meant to be powered by a vehicle's engine.  Upon doing so, the circular blades of this device will rotate rapidly; anything in front of it is likely to be ripped to shreds.  It is sturdy enough to withstand multiple impacts, and is designed to detach if it would take a hit that would break it.

items.name: TEC-9
items.description: The TEC-9 is a machine pistol made of cheap polymers and machine stamped parts.  Its rise in popularity among criminals is largely due to its intimidating looks and low cost.

items.name: TEC-9 magazine
items.description: A cheap and somewhat unreliable 32-round steel box magazine for use with the TEC-9 SMG.

items.name: work pants
items.description: A pair of gray work pants.

items.name: work t-shirt
items.description: A gray work t-shirt with a small front pocket.

items.name: teddy bear
items.description: An old and half rotten teddy bear.  Looks like this one commemorates the grave of the child who once owned it.

items.name: teddy bear
items.description: A mass-produced plush teddy bear.  It is wearing a little red tshirt but no pants.

items.name: telescopic sight
items.description: A simple hand-crafted telescopic sight, essentially a small telescope with crosshairs.  Not as good as the ones made before the Cataclysm.  Increases weight but improves accuracy.

items.name: telescopic pistol sight
items.description: A simple telescopic sight intended for use on a handgun.  Increases weight but improves accuracy greatly.

items.name: teleport pad
items.description: This is a kit for a teleporter trap consisting of a teleporter and a solar cell that is triggered when stepped upon.

items.name: teleporter
items.description: This is an experimental device that will teleport you a short distance when activated.

items.name: telescoping umbrella
items.description: A telescoping umbrella which collapses down for easy storage, useful for keeping dry when wielded.

items.name: television
items.description: A large LCD television, full of delicious electronics.

items.name: sheet of tempered glass
items.description: A large, durable sheet of tempered glass, approximately six millimeters thick.  A common type of safety glass with the curious property of breaking into small, non-lethal pieces upon shattering.

items.name: nanofabricator template (silicon photonics)
items.description: A state-of-the-art optical storage system, containing the instruction set required for the fabrication of complex silicon photonic circuitry.  The data within was once clearly worth millions, but now, you are not sure if it's anything more than a fancy, high-tech paperweight.

items.name: tent
items.description: This is a small personal tent, it's just big enough to fit you comfortably.

items.name: tequila
items.description: A distilled alcoholic beverage made from a succulent plant with spiky leaves.  Don't eat the worm!  Wait, there's no worm in this bottle.

items.name: test tube
items.description: A 10ml laboratory cylindrical test tube, with a rubber stopper.

items.name: microcentrifuge tube
items.description: These plastic tubes, with little built in snap-caps, are a great way to store a tiny amount of liquid.  Great for jello shooters if 1mL is enough for a shot for you.  Cool people call these "eppies".

items.name: diet pill
items.description: Not very nutritious.  Warning: contains calories, unsuitable for breatharians.

items.name: Flaming Chunk of Steel +2
items.description: HOLY SHIT THIS THING IS ON FIRE

items.name: AAA Guide
items.description: A tourist-centric guide to points of interest throughout the country.  This particular copy is apparently the Anonymous Anarchist's Annual: the cover conceals a wealth of ways to help stick it to The Man, along with plenty of advice for avoiding police.

items.name: The Art of Japanese Armormaking
items.description: This in-depth and technical text details various forms of ancient Japanese armor crafting, and is well illustrated with lots of photos.

items.name: Arms and Armor of Imperial China
items.description: This textbook details the military history of ancient China, with a particular focus on the nature of historical arms and armor.  It also details some of the equipment used by other cultures that came into conflict with the empire over various dynasties.

items.name: Studies in Historic Armorsmithing
items.description: This in-depth and technical text details various forms of ancient European armor crafting, and is well illustrated with lots of photos.

items.name: lab journal-Curie
items.description: This lab notebook is filled with the collective discoveries and refinements of a research team dedicated to nuclear energy.  You don't think you're ready to start a second Cataclysm, but the general information provided might be useful…

items.name: Biodiesel: Renewable Fuel Resource
items.description: A large textbook for college students about biodiesel.

items.name: Advanced Economics
items.description: A college textbook on economics.

items.name: Engineering 301
items.description: A textbook on civil engineering and construction.

items.name: chemistry textbook
items.description: A college textbook on chemistry.

items.name: Principles of Advanced Programming
items.description: A heavy textbook dedicated to advanced-level software design, written for several different programming languages.

items.name: Electronic Circuit Theory
items.description: An advanced college textbook on circuit theory, design, and organization.

items.name: The Essential Oil Enthusiasts Handbook
items.description: A heavy hardback book explaining the process of essential oil making, with schematics for the equipment to do it.  Good luck, and don't blow yourself up!

items.name: DIY Compendium
items.description: A thick, hardbound book detailing countless projects for inventions that claim to improve all aspects of life.

items.name: A History of Firefighting
items.description: This in-depth and technical text details the history of firefighting from ancient times into the modern era, with a focus on the technology used to save lives.

items.name: First Responder Handbook
items.description: A hardbound book detailing advanced first aid techniques and field-expedient medical care.

items.name: Art and Science of Chemical Warfare
items.description: This in-depth and technical text covers the design, development, dissemination of, and defenses against various chemical weapons throughout the centuries.  The photographs the author chose make it a difficult read at times, though the information is top-notch.

items.name: Mechanical Mastery
items.description: An advanced guide on mechanics and welding, covering topics like "Grinding off rust" and "Making cursive E's".

items.name: Robots for Fun & Profit
items.description: A rare book on the design of robots, with lots of helpful step-by-step guides.

items.name: Principles of Effective Communication
items.description: A hardbound book devoted to being an effective and persuasive speaker.

items.name: Outdoor Survival Guide
items.description: A thick soft-cover book filled with vital information about surviving in the wild, aimed at the experienced backpacker.

items.name: Sewing Techniques for Designers
items.description: A massive, hardbound book full of a wealth of information for the professional clothing designer.

items.name: The Compleat Trapper
items.description: An in-depth book about trapping game animals, covering methods both modern and ancient.

items.name: The Swords of the Samurai
items.description: This in-depth and technical text details various forms of ancient Japanese sword smithing, and is well illustrated with step by step photo instructions.

items.name: The Historic Weaponsmith
items.description: This in-depth and technical text details various forms of ancient European weapon smithing, and is well illustrated with step by step photo instructions.

items.name: thawb
items.description: A long, loose-fitting robe with wide sleeves, a traditional Arab garment.

items.name: pair of thermal electric gloves
items.description: This is a pair of gloves with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

items.name: pair of thermal electric gloves (on)
items.description: This is a pair of gloves with internal battery-powered heating elements.  They are currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn them off.

items.name: thermal electric balaclava
items.description: This is a snug cloth mask with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

items.name: thermal electric balaclava (on)
items.description: This is a snug cloth mask with internal battery-powered heating elements.  It is are currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: thermal electric outfit
items.description: This suit of thin thermal underwear covers you from head to toe and is equipped with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

items.name: thermal electric outfit (on)
items.description: This suit of thin thermal underwear covers you from head to toe and is equipped with internal battery-powered heating elements.  It is currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: thermal shirt
items.description: A lightweight, form-fitting long-sleeved spandex undershirt that helps maintains body temperature.

items.name: pair of thermal electric socks
items.description: This is a pair of socks with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

items.name: pair of thermal electric socks (on)
items.description: This is a pair of socks with internal battery-powered heating elements.  They are currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn them off.

items.name: thermal electric suit
items.description: This is a full-body suit of thin thermal underwear equipped with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

items.name: thermal electric suit (on)
items.description: This is a full-body suit of thin thermal underwear equipped with internal battery-powered heating elements.  It is currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: thermometer
items.description: A plastic thermometer that can read the air temperature.

items.name: thermos
items.description: A Thermos brand vacuum flask.  Built for temperature retention, helps keep things hot or cold.  Contains 1L of liquid.

items.name: bimetal thermostat
items.description: A simple thermostat controlled by thermal expansion of a bimetal strip.

items.name: pair of thigh-high boots
items.description: Very long leather boots that reach past the knees.  Difficult to wear but extremely durable.

items.name: Thompson extended magazine
items.description: An extended 30-round magazine for the Thompson submachine gun.

items.name: Thompson drum magazine
items.description: A 50-round drum magazine for the Thompson submachine gun.  Made famous by gangsters, but the military preferred standard 20 and 30-round magazines due to greater reliability.

items.name: Thompson magazine
items.description: A standard 20-round magazine for the Thompson submachine gun.

items.name: Thompson makeshift magazine
items.description: An improvised 20-round straight single-stack box magazine consisting of little more than a bent sheet of steel held together by duct tape and hope, for use with the Thompson SMG.

items.name: Thorazine
items.description: Anti-psychotic medication.  Used to stabilize brain chemistry, it can arrest hallucinations and other symptoms of psychosis.  Carries a sedative effect.  Its generic name is chlorpromazine.

items.name: thread
items.description: A small quantity of thread that could be used to refill a sewing kit.

items.name: Kevlar thread
items.description: Some very durable Kevlar thread that would be particularly useful for making ballistic armor, though it's fine to use in place of normal thread too, in most cases.  Making armor-grade Kevlar sheets from this would need a particularly tight weave, and so would need some specialized machinery.

items.name: Nomex thread
items.description: Some heat-resistant Nomex thread that would be particularly useful for making heat protection gear, though it's fine to use in place of normal thread too, in most cases.

items.name: throwable fire extinguisher
items.description: This is a fire extinguisher in grenade form.  While not as effective as a regular fire extinguisher, you can use it from a distance.  It is activated by heat, so just throw it into the flames.

items.name: throwing axe
items.description: A lightweight hatchet made for throwing.  Its ineffective cutting edge and light weight makes it unsuitable for use as a tool.

items.name: throwing knife
items.description: A thin and flat knife made for throwing.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape makes it unsuitable for use as a tool.

items.name: throwing stick
items.description: A stick carved into a shape suitable for throwing at a target.  Not a boomerang, so don't expect it to return to your hand.

items.name: thyme
items.description: A stalk of thyme.  Smells delicious.

items.name: thyme oil
items.description: Some essential oil made from thyme, which can act as a mildly irritating antiseptic.

items.name: bow tie
items.description: A simple black bow tie.  Best worn with a suit.

items.name: clip-on tie
items.description: A clip-on necktie, with blue and silver stripes.  It's quick and easy to put on, and much better than the necktie.

items.name: necktie
items.description: An ordinary, green necktie.  It's more difficult to put on, but it takes real skill to do so.  Wearing a necktie is much better than wearing a clip-on tie.

items.name: skinny tie
items.description: A skinny black and white checkered necktie.

items.name: tie clip
items.description: A fancy silver tie clip, a great match for your skinny tie.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: tights
items.description: A snug cloth garment which clings tightly to the legs and feet to protect them from the cold.

items.name: pneumatic assault rifle
items.description: A multistroke pneumatic rifle handcrafted from scrap.  Be careful where you reload it, pumping air into the tank takes a few seconds.  It is pretty quiet and quite deadly.

items.name: tin powder
items.description: A fine gray powder composed of tin, usable for making solder and lining containers to prevent corrosion.

items.name: tin cup
items.description: An enameled tin cup.  Great for camping or for prison use; makes a wonderful sound when clanged along bars.

items.name: tin plate
items.description: A tin dinner plate, lightweight and clanky.

items.name: Whistle of Tindalos
items.description: Who is this Tindalos guy?

items.name: tinder
items.description: Flammable material, finely divided for easy combustion.

items.name: ember carrier
items.description: This is a small container for holding tinder, with holes punched in it to provide a controlled airflow.  It can nurture a smoldering ember for a long time, to start fires without modern tools.

items.name: ember carrier (lit)
items.description: This is a small container for holding tinder, with holes punched in it to provide a controlled airflow.  An ember is smoldering inside it, and can be used to start a campfire.

items.name: tinfoil hat
items.description: A sheet of aluminum foil that has been molded into a form-fitting hat.  Perfect for protecting yourself from the government, Illuminati, aliens, and THEM.

items.name: small welding tank
items.description: A compact steel cylinder designed for holding pressurized welding gases.  It is marked with several faded and now unreadable symbols.

items.name: toast-em
items.description: Dry toaster pastries usually coated with solid frosting and what luck!  These are strawberry flavored!

items.name: toast-em
items.description: Dry toaster pastries, usually coated with solid frosting.  These are blueberry flavored!

items.name: toast-em
items.description: Dry toaster pastries, usually coated with solid frosting.  Sadly, these are not.

items.name: toaster
items.description: A small two slice toaster, not much use as anything but spare parts

items.name: toaster pastry
items.description: A delicious fruit-filled pastry that you've cooked.  It even comes with frosting!

items.name: toaster pastry (uncooked)
items.description: A delicious fruit-filled pastry that you can cook in your toaster.  It even comes with frosting!  Cook it to make it tasty.

items.name: rolling tobacco
items.description:
Loose, fine-cut tobacco leaves.  Popular in Europe and among hipsters.  Highly addictive and hazardous to health.
Can either be rolled into a cigarette with some rolling papers or smoked through a pipe.

items.name: raw tobacco
items.description: Various parts of tobacco plant, full of nicotine.  They need to be dried to become smokable.

items.name: toettchen
items.description: A German lung dish.

items.name: tofu
items.description: Tofu, a soy protein crucial to East Asian cuisine.  It absorbs flavors very well and can be used as a meat alternative in many dishes.

items.name: fried tofu
items.description: Tofu, a soy protein crucial to East Asian cuisine.  It absorbs flavors very well and can be used as a meat alternative in many dishes.

items.name: tofu fried rice
items.description: Delicious tofu fried rice with vegetables.  Tasty and very filling.

items.name: tofu stirfry
items.description: A tofu stirfry with rice and a sweet bold flavor sure to be on your mind through these dark days.

items.name: toilet paper
items.description: A luxurious remnant of civilization.

items.name: Tokarev TT-33
items.description: The Tokarev TT-33 is an antique Russian semiautomatic pistol, famous for its durability, accuracy, and uncomfortable grip angle.  It was chambered for the 7.62x25mm due to the popularity of the C96 pistol among Russian revolutionaries.

items.name: Tokarev TT-33 magazine
items.description: Standard 8-round magazine for Tokarev TT-33.

items.name: tomato
items.description: Juicy red tomato.  It gained popularity in Italy after being brought back from the New World.

items.name: Thompson submachine gun
items.description: An American-made submachine gun developed during the very end of World War I, too late to see action.  Infamous during the 1920s for its use by gangsters, and was used during World War II before being mostly replaced with less-expensive alternatives.

items.name: tonfa
items.description: A hard plastic truncheon commonly employed by police.  Originally an Okinawan weapon, it consists of a stick with a perpendicular handle attached a third of the way down its length.

items.name: wooden tonfa
items.description: A stout wooden truncheon of the sort commonly employed by police.  Originally an Okinawan weapon, it consists of a stick with a perpendicular handle attached a third of the way down its length.

items.name: pair of metal tongs
items.description: These are long, metal tongs.  They are commonly used for cooking or in metalworking fabrication recipes.

items.name: ANFO charge
items.description: This is a large metal keg filled with ANFO pellets and equipped with a dynamite primer.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will then have twenty turns before it explodes and creates a large fireball.

items.name: active ANFO charge
items.description: This is a large metal keg filled with ANFO pellets and equipped with a dynamite primer.  The fuse has been lit - better run like hell!

items.name: tool belt
items.description: A common belt with pockets, loops and sheaths to store up to six tools or blades.  Widely used by handymen and electricians.

items.name: active black gunpowder bomb
items.description: This is a tin can filled to the brim with black gunpowder and with a lit fuse stuck inside of it.

items.name: improvised barrel bomb
items.description: This is a metal keg, filled with a lot of stable explosives.  Contains a volatile explosive core so 100 seconds after the fuse has been lit the charge detonates completely and delivers its entire destructive power to everything in sight.

items.name: active improvised barrel bomb
items.description: This is a metal keg, filled with a lot of stable explosives.  The fuse has been lit and once it ignites the primary explosive, the bomb will detonate and rain fire and steel on everything in sight.

items.name: RDX sand bomb
items.description: This is a steel pipe, containing a mixture of RDX and sand, the former propelling the latter into a deadly mist of vicious shrapnel.  Use this item to light the fuse.

items.name: active RDX sand bomb
items.description: This is a steel pipe, containing a mixture of RDX and sand, the former propelling the latter into a deadly mist of vicious shrapnel.  The fuse has been lit, so why are you still holding it?

items.name: rocket candy
items.description: A pear-shaped chunk of rocket candy obtained by heating saltpeter with sugar and casting the obtained liquid.  Can serve as a rocket fuel, but also as a smokescreen - if you lit the narrow end, you should be able to throw it before the flame reaches the broad end.

items.name: burning rocket candy
items.description: This is a chunk of rocket candy that has been lit on fire and burns with a loud hiss, spewing forth large amounts of smoke.

items.name: small improvised frag device
items.description: This is a home-made explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with stable explosives and scrap metal, equipped with a long fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Once you do it should explode in about 20 seconds.

items.name: small improvised frag device
items.description: This is a home-made explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with stable explosives and scrap metal, whose fuse has been lit, its final countdown starting.

items.name: toolbox
items.description: This is a stout metal box containing a complete tool kit suitable for most household maintenance and construction activities.

items.name: workshop toolbox
items.description: This is a stout metal box containing a complete tool kit suitable for most household maintenance and construction activities, as well as additional tools used in workshops for advanced fabrication jobs.

items.name: integrated toolset
items.description: Dummy item.  If you see this, then something went wrong.

items.name: extended toolset
items.description: Your toolset, protruding from your hands.  It can slice, dice, and make everything nice.

items.name: toothbrush
items.description: A plastic brush with soft bristles for cleaning your teeth.

items.name: top hat
items.description: The only hat for a gentleman.  Look exquisite while laughing in the face of danger!

items.name: torch
items.description: This is a large stick, wrapped in rags that are soaked with a flammable material.  When lit, produces a fair amount of light.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.

items.name: burnt out torch
items.description: A torch that has consumed all its fuel; it can be recrafted into another torch.

items.name: torch
items.description: This is a large stick, wrapped in rags that are soaked with a flammable material.  It is burning, producing plenty of light.

items.name: torso shotgun bandolier
items.description: A leather bandolier strapped around the torso for keeping shotgun shells close to hand.

items.name: corn tortilla
items.description: A round, thin flatbread made from finely ground corn flour.

items.name: touch fastener
items.description: This is a pair of cloth strips, one of which has tiny hooks and another has tiny loops.  Useful as a fastener for clothing and footwear.

items.name: leather touring suit
items.description: A thick leather body suit made for protection while riding motorcycles.  Light and very comfortable.

items.name: tourist table
items.description: Metal tourist table for off-road trips.  It is folded for easy transportation.

items.name: tourist guide
items.description: This is glossy printed pamphlet for tourists that details local hotels and attractions.

items.name: tourmaline
items.description: A sparkling tourmaline.

items.name: tourmaline dental grill
items.description: Fake teeth inlaid with tourmaline, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.

items.name: tourmaline and gold bracelet
items.description: A gold bracelet with sparkling tourmalines.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: tourmaline and gold cufflinks
items.description: A pair of cufflinks with inset tourmalines.

items.name: pair of tourmaline and gold earrings
items.description: A pair of shiny tourmaline and gold earrings.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: tourmaline and gold pendant necklace
items.description: A shiny, gold necklace adorned with a tourmaline pendant.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: tourmaline and gold ring
items.description: A gold ring with a tourmaline mounted on top of it.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: tourmaline and gold tiara
items.description: A shiny, gold tiara adorned with tourmalines.

items.name: tourmaline and platinum bracelet
items.description: A platinum bracelet with sparkling tourmalines.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: tourmaline and platinum cufflinks
items.description: A pair of cufflinks with inset tourmalines.

items.name: pair of tourmaline and platinum earrings
items.description: A pair of shiny tourmaline and platinum earrings.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: tourmaline and platinum pendant necklace
items.description: A shiny, platinum necklace adorned with a tourmaline pendant.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: tourmaline and platinum ring
items.description: A platinum ring with a tourmaline mounted on top of it.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: tourmaline and platinum tiara
items.description: A shiny, platinum tiara adorned with tourmalines.

items.name: tourmaline and silver bracelet
items.description: A silver bracelet with sparkling tourmalines.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: tourmaline and silver cufflinks
items.description: A pair of cufflinks with inset tourmalines.

items.name: pair of tourmaline and silver earrings
items.description: A pair of shiny tourmaline and silver earrings.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: tourmaline and silver pendant necklace
items.description: A shiny, silver necklace adorned with a tourmaline pendant.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: tourmaline and silver ring
items.description: A silver ring with a tourmaline mounted on top of it.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

items.name: tourmaline and silver tiara
items.description: A shiny, silver tiara adorned with tourmalines.

items.name: towel
items.description: This is a fluffy and large towel.  It could be used to dry yourself.  Any person that can travel the length and breadth of the apocalypse, rough it, slum it, struggle against terrible odds, win through and still know where their towel is, is clearly a force to be reckoned with.

items.name: towel hanger
items.description: A towel hanger with towels.

items.name: soiled towel
items.description: This is a large towel, covered in a thick, gooey liquid.  You'll need to wash it in some water to make it usable again.  Don't panic.

items.name: towel
items.description: This is a large, sopping wet towel.  If you wait a little bit, it should dry out.  Don't panic.

items.name: trail guide
items.description: This is a printed guide to the best local trails.  It has general details about the trails, trailhead amenities, suggestions for the best thru-hikes, and advice on interacting with local wildlife in a responsible and respectful manner.

items.name: tramadol
items.description: A painkiller used to manage moderate pain.  The effects last for several hours, but are relatively subdued for an opioid.

items.name: transponder circuit
items.description: A circuit designed to repeat a signal.  Useful for crafting communications equipment.

items.name: The Trapper's Companion
items.description: A folksy guide to trapping wild game using time-tested methods.  A bit in-depth for the beginner, it can provide a wealth of information to a knowledgeable trapper.

items.name: travelpack
items.description: A hiking pack used for short trips.

items.name: tree spile
items.description: A hollow metal cylinder which is inserted in a tree crust in order to slowly harvest its sap.  Can be used on a maple tree in between late winter and early spring to harvest maple sap.

items.name: trenchcoat
items.description: A thin cotton trenchcoat, lined with pockets.  Great for storage.

items.name: faux fur trenchcoat
items.description: A thick faux fur trenchcoat, lined with pockets.  Great for storage, and makes you the talk of the town.

items.name: fur trenchcoat
items.description: A thick fur trenchcoat, lined with pockets.  Great for storage.

items.name: leather trenchcoat
items.description: A thick leather trenchcoat, lined with pockets.  Great for storage.

items.name: survivor trenchcoat
items.description: A Kevlar armored custom trenchcoat, covered with pouches and pockets.  Comfortable, durable, and great for storage.

items.name: Elephant gun
items.description: A custom-made single shot rifle specially designed for the hunting of huge game.  You could obviously kill everything with this, EVERYTHING.  If you ever find enough ammo of course.

items.name: tricorne
items.description: A classic design, the "tricorne", or three-cornered hat, simply pins a large and floppy brim out of the way, though this example adds well-embroidered designs and is oiled against water.  Whether you're the "guvnah" of a settlement, or the captain of a post-apocalyptic crew, this is the hat for you.

items.name: hedge trimmer (off)
items.description: A cordless, double-sided, gasoline-powered hedge trimmer.  A long line of sharp-edged teeth extends from the engine; turning the trimmer on will make them rapidly vibrate.  The poor man's chainsaw as far as the zombies are concerned.

items.name: hedge trimmer (on)
items.description: A cordless, double-sided, gasoline-powered hedge trimmer.  It is currently on, ready to do some zombie topiary; use this item to turn it off.

items.name: triple-barrel 40mm launcher
items.description: A homemade triple-barrel 40mm grenade launcher.  Capable of launching all three grenades at once, it is extremely powerful for a homemade weapon.

items.name: triple sec
items.description: An orange flavored liquor used in many mixed drinks.

items.name: tripod chassis
items.description: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the tripod.

items.name: tripwire trap
items.description: This is some thin strong cable with some affixing tools on either end.  A tripwire trap must be placed across a doorway or other thin passage.  Its purpose is to trip up bypassers, causing them to stumble and possibly hurt themselves slightly.

items.name: trumpet
items.description: A brass trumpet with only a few dents here and there.

items.name: pair of swimming trunks
items.description: A pair of swimming trunks, with netting.

items.name: TS12 second magazine
items.description: The integrated second shotgun magazine of the Tavor TS12 which holds 5 shots.  It's irremovable.

items.name: TS12 third magazine
items.description: The integrated third shotgun magazine of the Tavor TS12 which holds 5 shots.  It's irremovable.

items.name: t-shirt
items.description: A short-sleeved cotton shirt.

items.name: t-shirt
items.description: A short-sleeved cotton shirt.

items.name: tour t-shirt
items.description: A short-sleeved cotton shirt.

items.name: tuba
items.description: A big ol' tuba.  Much easier to play when wearing.

items.name: tulip bud
items.description: A tulip bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a tulip flower.

items.name: tulip
items.description: A tulip stalk with some petals.

items.name: plastic tumbler
items.description: A durable plastic drinking vessel.  This one is made of clear acrylic and looks almost like glass.

items.name: tuned mechanism
items.description: A set of finely tuned internal components which increase the precision and reliably of a firearm.

items.name: tunic
items.description: A simple garment long enough to cover down to the knees.

items.name: rag tunic
items.description: A poorly made long tunic with a string tied around the waist to keep it all in place.

items.name: turban
items.description: Rags worn around the head.

items.name: turret interior chassis
items.description: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton of a turret.

items.name: turret control unit
items.description: A set of motor, camera, and various electronic modules banded together to allow for tracking targets, friend-or-foe identification, and firing the connected turret in full automatic mode.

items.name: turret mount
items.description: A universal mount for weapons intended to be installed as turrets.

items.name: tuxedo
items.description: A full-body tuxedo.  Makes the apocalypse feel a little more classy.

items.name: two-way radio
items.description: This is a radio with a transmitting unit.  You could use it to contact someone who also has one.  Unfortunately no one seems to use those nowadays…

items.name: tÖttchen
items.description: A German lung dish.

items.name: underslung shotgun
items.description: A short shotgun with 2 barrels, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  It allows two shotgun shells to be loaded and fired.

items.name: modified underslung shotgun
items.description: A short shotgun with 2 barrels, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  It allows two shotgun shells to be loaded and fired.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols, if you so want.

items.name: grenade launcher buttstock
items.description: A collapsible buttstock designed for the M320 grenade launcher.  When combined with this stock, the M320 can be used as a standalone weapon

items.name: ukulele
items.description: A small factory made ukulele.  Looks to be in working condition.

items.name: umbrella
items.description: An umbrella with a pointy end, useful for keeping dry when wielded.

items.name: UMP45 makeshift magazine
items.description: An improvised 20-round straight single-stack box magazine consisting of little more than a bent sheet of steel held together by duct tape and hope, for use with the UMP45 SMG.

items.name: UMP45 magazine
items.description: A standard 25-round box magazine for use with the H&K UMP45 SMG.

items.name: compression top
items.description: Nylon sportswear that clings to your chest and maintains body temperature.

items.name: compression shorts
items.description: Nylon sportswear that clings to your upper legs, aiding muscle tone and maintaining warmth.

items.name: bottom mount
items.description: This is a plastic mount for attaching an underbarrel accessory, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any weapon, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on older guns.

items.name: underbrush
items.description: Some underbrush, edible by ruminants only.  Seeing this item is a bug.

items.name: undershirt
items.description: A simple white undershirt.  Worn beneath your regular clothes, it provides a little extra warmth.

items.name: unfinished calcium carbide
items.description: The incomplete process of converting coal and lime into calcium carbide.  Useless in this state.

items.name: unfinished charcoal
items.description: The result of an interrupted charcoal making process.  Useless, except as fuel in a charcoal kiln.

items.name: union suit
items.description: A one-piece suit of full-body long underwear that helps to maintain body temperature.  It laces closed in the front.

items.name: unitard
items.description: A skin-tight spandex garment resembling a crew necked leotard combined with leggings.  Commonly used by gymnasts, dancers and equestrian vaulters, the unitard provides overall coverage with great flexibility.

items.name: upstest
items.description: Testmod for UPS drain on mods, this should never spawn, if you see this, it's a bug.  50x more UPS drain.

items.name: USB drive
items.description: A USB thumb drive.  Useful for holding software.

items.name: USP .45 magazine
items.description: A standard capacity magazine for use with the H&K USP handgun.

items.name: USP 9mm magazine
items.description: A factory specification 15-round box magazine for use with the dependable H&K USP 9x19mm pistol.

items.name: USP .45
items.description: A popular pistol, widely used among law enforcement.  Extensively tested for durability, it has been found to stay accurate even after being subjected to extreme abuse.

items.name: USP 9mm
items.description: A popular pistol, widely used among law enforcement.  Extensively tested for durability, it has been found to stay accurate even after being subjected to extreme abuse.

items.name: Uzi 9mm
items.description: The Uzi 9x19mm has enjoyed immense popularity, selling more units than any other submachine gun.  It is widely used as a personal defense weapon, or as a primary weapon by elite frontline forces.

items.name: UZI magazine
items.description: A standard 32-round steel box magazine for use with the UZI SMG.

items.name: V12 engine
items.description: A massive and extremely powerful V12 engine, usually built into high end sports cars.

items.name: V12 diesel engine
items.description: A massive and extremely powerful V12 engine, usually built into heavy trucks.

items.name: V29 laser pistol
items.description: This V29 laser pistol was one of the first handheld laser weapons.  It is larger than most traditional handguns, but displays no recoil whatsoever.

items.name: homemade laser pistol
items.description: This laser pistol was based on the V29 laser pistol designed in the mid-21st century.  While little more than duct tape and electronics, it runs on a standard UPS.

items.name: V-twin engine
items.description: A 2-cylinder 4-stroke combustion engine.

items.name: V6 engine
items.description: A powerful 6-cylinder combustion engine.

items.name: V6 diesel engine
items.description: A powerful 6-cylinder diesel engine.

items.name: V8 engine
items.description: A large and very powerful 8-cylinder combustion engine.

items.name: V8 diesel engine
items.description: A powerful 8-cylinder diesel engine.

items.name: airjack
items.description: An extendable metal pylon used to replace a portable jack.  If mounted to a vehicle, it could be used to lift it up.

items.name: motorcycle kickstand
items.description: A kickstand to keep the bike from falling over.  You could use this to lean it forward or backward to change a tire.

items.name: seed drill
items.description: An assembly of tubes, spikes, and wheels, that when dragged along the ground, allows a vehicle to plant seeds automatically in suitably tilled land.

items.name: advanced seed drill
items.description: An assembly of tubes, spikes, and wheels, that when dragged along the ground, allows a vehicle to plant seeds automatically in suitably tilled land.  This one is equipped with an electronic control system and will avoid damaging itself when used on untilled land.

items.name: plow
items.description: A heavy assembly of wheels and steel blades that turn up the ground.

items.name: reaper
items.description: An assembly of a blade, wheels, and a small lever for engaging/disengaging used to cut down crops prior to picking them up.

items.name: advanced reaper
items.description: An advanced electronic device used to cut down, collect and store crops.

items.name: rockwheel
items.description: A large and heavy jagged metal disc to dig trenches.

items.name: vehicle scoop
items.description: An assembly of motors and sheet metal that allows a vehicle to clean the road surface by removing debris and contaminants.

items.name: fancy table
items.description: A very fancy table from a very fancy RV.  If times were better it might be useful for something more than firewood.

items.name: small vacuum oven
items.description: A small 0.9 cubic foot vacuum oven used to purge residual solvents out of liquids and solid.  Looks kind of like a microwave.

items.name: finished small vacuum oven
items.description: A small vacuum oven filled with extract ready to package up for consumption.  WooHoo!

items.name: filled small vacuum oven
items.description: A small vacuum oven filled with extract ready to be purged of residual solvents.

items.name: small vacuum oven (on)
items.description: A small vacuum oven filled with extract currently purging out all residual solvents.  This process takes about 72hrs.

items.name: vacuum pump
items.description: A small belt driven mechanical pump capable of achieving a vacuum of -29.99 hg (50 microns).

items.name: vacuum pump (on)
items.description: A small belt driven mechanical pump capable of achieving a vacuum of -29.99 hg (50 microns).

items.name: vacuum sealer
items.description: This is a portable heat sealer unit with an air pump.  It's used for vacuum packing food to preserve it.

items.name: gamma globulin shot
items.description: This immunoglobulin booster contains concentrated antibodies prepared for intravenous injection to temporarily strengthen the immune system.  It is still in its original packaging.

items.name: blood draw kit
items.description: This is a kit for drawing blood, including a test tube for holding the sample.  Use this tool to draw blood, either from yourself or from a corpse you are standing on.

items.name: pair of leather vambraces
items.description: A pair of light leather arm guards, made for archery.

items.name: plant marrow
items.description: A nutrient rich chunk of plant matter, could be eaten raw or cooked.

items.name: vegetable aspic
items.description: A dish in which vegetables are set into a gelatin made from a plant stock.

items.name: canned veggy
items.description: This mushy pile of vegetable matter was boiled and canned in an earlier life.  Better eat it before it oozes through your fingers.

items.name: cooked plant marrow
items.description: A freshly cooked chunk of plant matter, tasty and nutritious.

items.name: pickled veggy
items.description: This is a serving of crisply brined and canned vegetable matter.  Tasty and nutritious.

items.name: vegetable salad
items.description: Salad with all kind of vegetables.

items.name: salted veggy chunk
items.description: Vegetable chunks pickled in a salt bath.  Goes well with burgers, if only you can find one.

items.name: alien fungus chunk
items.description: This is a chunk of fungal matter from some sort of alien mushroom creature.  Eating unfamiliar mushrooms is a bad idea.

items.name: wild vegetables
items.description: An assortment of edible-looking wild plants.  Most are quite bitter-tasting.  Some are inedible until cooked.

items.name: cooked wild vegetables
items.description: Cooked wild edible plants.  An interesting mix of flavors.

items.name: vehicle tracking device
items.description: A vehicle tracking device.  When installed on a vehicle it allows you track the vehicle.

items.name: vehicle controls
items.description: A set of various vehicle controls.  Useful for crafting.

items.name: dashboard
items.description: A vehicle instrument panel with various gauges and switches.  Useful for crafting.

items.name: wedding veil
items.description: A lacy white wedding veil.

items.name: utility vest
items.description: A light vest covered in pockets and straps for storage.

items.name: leather vest
items.description: A vest made from thick leather.  Offers excellent protection from cuts.

items.name: armored leather vest
items.description: An armored vest made from thick leather and metal plates.  Cumbersome, but offers excellent protection from harm.

items.name: mountable autoclave
items.description: This autoclave has been rigged to run off a vehicle power grid.

items.name: mountable autodoc
items.description: This autodoc has been rigged to run off a vehicle power grid.

items.name: mountable autodoc couch
items.description: This autodoc couch has been rigged to run off a vehicle power grid.

items.name: vibrator
items.description: This battery-devouring device is just the thing to knead the tension out and help you relax.  Use it to take a break and unwind.

items.name: long vine
items.description: A sturdy 30-foot (or about 9 m) long vine.  Could easily be used as a rope.  Strong enough to suspend a large corpse for butchering.

items.name: short vine
items.description: A sturdy 6-foot (or about 180 cm) long vine.  Too small to be of much use.

items.name: vinegar
items.description: Shockingly tart white vinegar.  This is what you get when you let your booze ferment too long.

items.name: The Vinegar Maker's Handbook
items.description: This book describes in detail all the ways that one can make vinegar.  You would have thought that there wasn't much to making vinegar, but the girth of this book tells you otherwise.

items.name: violin
items.description: A cheap, factory-made violin with a built-in holder for a bow.  Still produces a nice sound.

items.name: golden fiddle
items.description: A shiny golden fiddle, with a strange aura around it.  You feel like it once belonged to the best there's ever been.

items.name: Visions in Solitude
items.description: A small book detailing 'visions' a prisoner had on death row.

items.name: multivitamin
items.description: Essential dietary nutrients conveniently packaged in pill form.  An option of last resort when a balanced diet is not possible.  Excess use can cause hypervitaminosis.

items.name: vodka
items.description: A beverage of alcohol, water, and not much else.  In America, men make vodka, but in Soviet Russia, vodka makes the man.

items.name: voltmeter
items.description: This device has two probes that let you measure the electrical potential between two points.

items.name: vortex device
items.description: This is a small, hefty, boring looking machine.  Its weighted trapezoidal frame has a single on-off switch and a speed dial, and on top of it sits a rubber receptacle.  Pressing a test tube into the receptacle would, with power, rapidly shake and mix the contents of the test tube.  It's surprisingly fun to use.

items.name: vortex stone
items.description: This is a stone with spirals all over it, and holes around its perimeter.  Though it is fairly large, it weighs next to nothing.  Air seems to gather around it.

items.name: white paint
items.description: A can of white paint.

items.name: wooden table
items.description: A crude wooden table.

items.name: waffle iron
items.description: A waffle iron.  For making waffles.

items.name: waffle
items.description: Hey it's waffle time, it's waffle time.  Won't you have some waffles of mine?

items.name: waistcoat
items.description: An elegant waistcoat.  Ideal for those occasions when wearing only a shirt would be too casual and a suit would be just overdoing it.

items.name: wakizashi
items.description: This is a comparatively-common Japanese short sword.  Smaller and lighter than a katana, but still effective in combat.

items.name: wakizashi fake
items.description: This is a dull, cheap replica of the more common wakizashi.  Smaller and lighter than a katana, but still effective in combat.

items.name: wakizashi replica
items.description: This is a comparatively-common Japanese short sword.  There's something not quite right about this sword.

items.name: walnuts
items.description: A handful of raw hard nuts from a walnut tree.

items.name: roasted walnuts
items.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a walnut tree.

items.name: Walther CCP
items.description: The Walther CCP is a gas-delayed blowback semi-automatic pistol intended for the concealed carry consumer market.  Internally, it is nearly identical to the cult classic H&K P7.  Its fixed barrel design makes it potentially more accurate than many other pistols, though this may difficult to realize with its average trigger and short sight radius.

items.name: Walther P22
items.description: The Walther P22 is a blowback operated semi-automatic pistol.  It is about half the size of most Walthers.  It is made mostly with plastic, with the slide and key components being made of die-cast zinc alloy

items.name: Walther P38
items.description: The Walther P38 is a semi-automatic handgun adopted shortly before the second world war.  Developed due to the high production costs of its predecessor, the Luger P08, the P38 is also chambered in 9mm Parabellum.  This early DA/SA locked-breech design would introduce features later seen on more modern firearms such as the Beretta 92 series, and served Germany until 2004.

items.name: Walther PPK
items.description: One of the most famous handguns of the 20th century.  Your name is not Bond, but you might find this little gun still useful.

items.name: Walther PPQ .40 S&W
items.description: The Walther PPQ is a semi-automatic pistol originating from the Walther P99QA, and maintains compatibility with some of its predecessor's accessories.  This model is chambered in .40 S&W.

items.name: Walther PPQ .45 ACP
items.description: The Walther PPQ is a semi-automatic pistol originating from the Walther P99QA, and maintains compatibility with some of its predecessor's accessories.  This model is chambered in .45 ACP.

items.name: Walther PPQ 9mm
items.description: The Walther PPQ is a semi-automatic pistol originating from the Walther P99QA, and maintains compatibility with some of its predecessor's accessories.  This model is chambered in 9x19mm Parabellum.

items.name: war hammer
items.description: A medieval hammer made for battle.  Its odd shape and balance make it an excellent weapon, but an ineffective tool.

items.name: washing kit
items.description: A combination kit of a washboard and a scrubbing tool.  Everything you need to clean items after the apocalypse.

items.name: moonshine wash
items.description: Fermented, but not distilled moonshine.  Contains all the contaminants you don't want in your moonshine.

items.name: rum wash
items.description: Fermented, but not distilled rum.  No longer tastes sweet.

items.name: vodka wash
items.description: Fermented, but not distilled vodka.  No longer tastes sweet.

items.name: whiskey wash
items.description: Fermented, but not distilled whiskey.  No longer tastes sweet.

items.name: washboard
items.description: This is a wooden washboard.  You can use it to wash filthy clothing if it's supplied with cleansing agent.

items.name: washcloth
items.description: A piece of cloth that can be used for cleaning impervious surfaces.

items.name: washing machine
items.description: A very small washing machine designed for use in vehicles.

items.name: wasp sting
items.description: A six-inch stinger from a giant wasp.  Makes a poor melee weapon.

items.name: wastebread
items.description: Flour is a commodity these days and to deal with that, most survivors resort to mix it with leftovers of other ingredients and bake it all into bread.  It's filling, and that's what matters.

items.name: water
items.description: Water, the stuff of life, the best thirst-quencher available.  It would be safer to drink once purified.

items.name: acid water
items.description: Water collected during an acid rainstorm.  Don't drink it.  Boiling it concentrates the acid.

items.name: weak acid water
items.description: A mixture of rain and acid rain.  Don't drink it.  Boiling it concentrates the acid.

items.name: clean water
items.description: Fresh, clean water.  Truly the best thing to quench your thirst.

items.name: water faucet
items.description: A metal faucet that can be attached to a water tank for easy access.

items.name: water mill
items.description: A small water-powered mill that can convert starchy products into flour.  Can be placed via the construction menu.

items.name: mineral water
items.description: Fancy mineral water, so fancy it makes you feel fancy just holding it.

items.name: water purifier
items.description: This is a battery-powered device designed to purify drinking water.  Using this item on a container full of water will purify the contents.  It could be useful for water taken from uncertain sources like a river, as it may be non-potable.

items.name: sewage water
items.description: Turbid liquid from the sewers with awful stench.

items.name: water wheel
items.description: A water wheel.  Will slowly recharge the vehicle's electrical power when built over shallow moving water.

items.name: water cannon
items.description: A water cannon from a fire truck.  Mounted on a vehicle, it could be used to stop fires or "protesters".

items.name: watermelon
items.description: A fruit, bigger than your head.  It is very juicy!

items.name: firearm waterproofing
items.description: A set of seals and gaskets that will allow a firearm to operate reliably while submerged in water.

items.name: small waterskin
items.description: A small watertight leather bag with a carrying strap, can hold 1.5 liters of water.

items.name: waterskin
items.description: A watertight leather bag with a carrying strap, can hold 3 liters of water.

items.name: large waterskin
items.description: A large watertight leather bag with a carrying strap, can hold 5 liters of water.

items.name: wax
items.description: A large chunk of beeswax.  Not very tasty or nourishing, but okay in an emergency.

items.name: weak antibiotics
items.description: A broad-spectrum antibiotic used to suppress infections and prevent them from setting in.  It isn't strong enough to purge infections outright, but it boosts the body's resistance against them.  One dose lasts twelve hours.

items.name: atomic headlamp
items.description: This is a custom-made reinforced headlamp powered by the magic of nuclear decay, focused for more usable brightness.  The adjustable strap allows it to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  Use it to close the cover and hide the light.

items.name: atomic headlamp (covered)
items.description: This is a custom-made reinforced headlamp powered by the magic of nuclear decay, focused for more usable brightness.  The adjustable strap allows it to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  Use it to open the cover and show the light.

items.name: headlamp
items.description: This is an LED headlamp with an adjustable strap so as to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  Use it to turn it on.

items.name: headlamp (on)
items.description: This is an LED headlamp with an adjustable strap so as to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

items.name: wearable RX12 jet injector
items.description: This is a modified RX12 jet injector which can be worn on the body.  A label on the side warns against using more than two doses per hour.

items.name: Doppler Radar Turbo 2000
items.description: A briefcase with built-in laptop that looks like it's from the 80s.  Its vintage monochrome monitor displays a plethora of meteorological data.  No sign of the FLDSMDFR, however.

items.name: Weatherby Mark V
items.description: The Weatherby Mark V is one of the finest bolt action rifles.  Designed in 1955 by Roy Weatherby and Fred Jennie, it has a strong action designed to safely fire high-pressure cartridges.  These rifles were presented to celebrities as part of a marketing campaign.

items.name: webbing belt
items.description: A 2-inch nylon webbing belt commonly used by military forces.

items.name: marijuana
items.description: The dried flower buds and leaves harvested from a psychoactive variety of hemp plant.  Used to reduce nausea, stimulate appetite and elevate mood.  It can be habit-forming, and adverse reactions are possible.

items.name: newspaper page
items.description: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It was printed in the weeks leading up to the Cataclysm.  Most of the information on there is terribly trivial, or out of date, but one thing catches your eye briefly.

items.name: arc welder
items.description: This is a battery powered tool for welding metal pieces together using an electric arc.  It is an indispensable tool for construction or repair.

items.name: makeshift arc welder
items.description: This crude arc welder has been fashioned from a few small transformers, some wire, improvised electrode holder and complete disregard for personal safety.  While it's not as efficient as a factory welder, it will serve in a pinch.

items.name: Welding and Metallurgy
items.description: A rather technical textbook that illustrates the science and technique of becoming a better welder.

items.name: welding component kit
items.description: A set of components useful for constructing a full-featured welding station, complete with soldering capability.

items.name: welding mask
items.description: A plastic mask with a very dark visor, meant to protect the entire face while welding.  It also serves as somewhat good armor, but makes it hard to see.  Activate it to push it up your head.

items.name: crude welding mask
items.description: A crude welding mask made from shaped steel.  It's less dark than a proper welding mask, and therefore less difficult to see in, but also less protective when welding.  Activate it to push it up your head.

items.name: crude welding mask (raised)
items.description: A crude welding mask made from shaped steel.  It's less dark than a proper welding mask, and therefore less difficult to see in, but also less protective when welding.  Activate it to lower it over your face.

items.name: welding mask (raised)
items.description: A plastic mask with a very dark visor, meant to protect the entire face while welding.  It also serves as somewhat good armor, but makes it hard to see.  Activate it to lower it over your face.

items.name: vehicle welding rig
items.description: A welding rig made to run off a vehicle's storage battery.  It has a soldering iron attachment for delicate work, and a compartment to store your extra tools in.

items.name: welding tank
items.description: A large steel cylinder designed for holding pressurized welding gases.  It is marked with several faded and now unreadable symbols.

items.name: mechanical pump
items.description: A simple cast iron mechanical impeller pump.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.

items.name: wetsuit
items.description: A full-body neoprene wetsuit.

items.name: pair of swimming booties
items.description: A pair of neoprene swimming booties, with individual toes.

items.name: pair of swimming gloves
items.description: A pair of very flexible neoprene-silicone rubber gloves, suitable for underwater use.

items.name: wetsuit hood
items.description: A neoprene hood, commonly worn by divers.

items.name: spring suit
items.description: A long-sleeved spring wetsuit with pink color details and cleavage-enhancing, hip-accentuating construction.  Not as protective as a full-body suit, but also less restrictive.

items.name: wheat
items.description: Raw wheat, not very tasty.

items.name: wheel
items.description: A car wheel.

items.name: set of wheels
items.description: A set of four small wheels with tough rubber tires.

items.name: armored wheel
items.description: A wide military grade wheel.

items.name: wheelbarrow wheel
items.description: A small wheel from a common garden wheelbarrow.

items.name: bicycle wheel
items.description: A bicycle wheel.

items.name: off-road bicycle wheel
items.description: A wide, studded, bicycle wheel intended for off-road biking.

items.name: set of casters
items.description: A set of casters, like on a shopping cart.

items.name: metal wheel
items.description: A simple metal wheel.

items.name: motorbike wheel
items.description: A motorbike wheel.

items.name: off-road motorbike wheel
items.description: A motorbike wheel, studded for improved off-road performance.

items.name: heavy wheel hub assembly
items.description: A heavy metal assembly that allows bolting a wheel on a car.  Fit for a large car wheel.

items.name: light wheel mount
items.description: A piece of metal with holes suitable for a bike or motorbike wheel.

items.name: medium wheel hub assembly
items.description: A metal assembly that allows bolting a wheel on a car.  Fit for a car wheel.

items.name: rail wheel
items.description: A strong rail wheel.  A flange helps keep it on a rail, but makes it perform terribly when not on a rail.

items.name: pair of small rail wheels
items.description: A pair of small rail wheels.  It fits small railroad rails found in places like amusement parks.  Mostly for hobby purposes rather than transportation.

items.name: racing wheel
items.description: A wide, smooth wheel intended for racing.  The slick surface provides better speed on pavement but penalizes off-road speed.

items.name: small wheel
items.description: A pretty small wheel.  Probably from one of those Segway things.  It is not very menacing.

items.name: set of tricycle wheels
items.description: A set of hard plastic wheels with one larger than the other two.  Proudly made in the USA by Double Dango Productions.

items.name: pair of wheelchair wheels
items.description: A pair of wheels for a wheelchair.

items.name: wide wheel
items.description: A wide wheel.  \o/ This wide.

items.name: off-road wide wheel
items.description: A wide wheel.  \o/ This wide.  It's studded to provide better grip off-road at the cost of some performance on pavement.

items.name: wooden cart wheel
items.description: A wooden cart wheel, hand made.

items.name: banded wooden cart wheel
items.description: A wooden cart wheel with metal bands for durability, hand made.

items.name: whisk
items.description: Also known as a 'wire whip', this is a less effective weapon than it sounds.

items.name: whiskey
items.description: A distilled grain alcohol, made from, by, and for real Southern colonels!

items.name: whistle
items.description: A simple metal whistle, with a cord to wear it around your neck.

items.name: whistle multitool
items.description: A cheap gadget combining a whistle, thermometer, magnifying glass, and compass.

items.name: reinforced wide-angle headlight
items.description: A wide-angle vehicle headlight with a cage built around it to protect it from damage without reducing its effectiveness.

items.name: wild herbs
items.description: A tasty collection of wild herbs including violet, sassafras, mint, clover, purslane, fireweed, and burdock.

items.name: sealed wild yeast culture
items.description: Mixture of water, sugar and fruits with some naturally occuring yeast, that will eventually produce a more sizeable yeast culture.

items.name: willowbark
items.description: A sheet of bark taken from a willow tree.  Used in the production of aspirin.

items.name: Winchester Model 70
