items.description: The Winchester Model 70 is a bolt action sporting rifle.  It has an iconic place in American sporting culture and has been held in high regard by shooters since it was introduced in 1936.

items.name: 1887 bootleg shotgun
items.description: One of the first commercially successful repeating shotguns, the Winchester 1887 was specifically made lever-action at Winchester's request.  Though later overshadowed in success by pump designs, the 1887 remains popular today.  This one has a very short barrel, no stock, and would pair nicely with a motorcycle jacket and a Harley Davidson.

items.name: M1897 Trench Gun
items.description: The Winchester 1897 was one of the first commercially successful pump action shotguns.  In its 'trench' configuration it has become a heavily romanticized American icon of World War 1.  With its barrel shroud, bayonet lug and 17 inch bayonet, this shotgun is undeniably fearsome in appearance.  There aren't any more trenches to clear, so the next zombie infested town will have to suffice.

items.name: wind
items.description: seeing this is a bug

items.name: wind mill
items.description: A small wind-powered mill that can convert starchy products into flour.  Can be placed via the construction menu.

items.name: wind turbine
items.description: A small turbine that can convert wind into electric power.

items.name: barley wine
items.description: A strong ale.

items.name: Cabernet Sauvignon
items.description: The heavily disputed king of red wines.  Pairs well with red meats and pasta.

items.name: Chardonnay
items.description: America's most popular wine, and for good reason.

items.name: wine glass
items.description: A stemmed drinking glass that makes you feel very fancy when you drink from it.

items.name: marsala
items.description: A wine popularly used in dishes served in Italian restaurants.

items.name: marloss wine
items.description: Goopy white wine, made from the fruit of the marloss.

items.name: pinot noir
items.description: Prized by collectors and adored by critics, it is one of the rarer and more elegant wines.

items.name: Riesling
items.description: Sparkling white wine, made from the world's noblest grape.

items.name: vermouth
items.description: A soft wine with a pleasant herbal flavor and aroma.  It is a common cocktail ingredient, and can be used as a substitute for white wine.

items.name: Winemaking for Beginners
items.description: Winemaking, is an art form.  This book teaches you how to crayon within the lines.

items.name: pair of army winter gloves
items.description: A pair of padded gloves.  Favored by the military.

items.name: army winter jacket
items.description: A tough hooded jacket with lots of pockets, thickly padded for warmth.  Favored by the military.

items.name: army winter pants
items.description: A tough pair of pants lined with pockets, thickly padded for warmth.  Favored by the military.

items.name: wire
items.description: A length of thin, relatively stiff, steel wire.  Like the sort you find in wire fences.

items.name: barbed wire
items.description: A length of stiff wire, covered in sharp barbs.

items.name: steel mesh
items.description: A mat of woven fine steel wire, useful for dryer lint traps and reusable coffee filter baskets.  You could put these on a window to keep mosquitoes and other bugs out, but chainlink fencing will do these days.

items.name: folding wire stock
items.description: A folding wire stock which folds up very compactly but needs unfolding before use.  It's somewhat wobbly but is better than nothing at all.  Increases the time needed to wield the weapon.

items.name: withered plant
items.description: A dead plant.  Good for starting fires or making a pile of leaves to sleep on.

items.name: wolf suit
items.description: A full body fursuit in the form of an anthropomorphic wolf.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.

items.name: heavy wooden beam
items.description: An enormous beam of solid wood, very heavy and hard to lug around, but also very sturdy for construction.  You could saw or chop it into smaller pieces, like planks or panels.

items.name: wooden panel
items.description: A wide, thin wooden board - plywood, OSB, MDF, tongue-in-groove boards, or similar, already cut to shape.  These large flat boards are good for all kinds of construction, but for really big projects you'd need a proper sheet of uncut plywood or the like.

items.name: wooden armor kit
items.description: A bundle of two by fours prepared to be used as vehicle armor.

items.name: large wooden sheet
items.description: A standard 4x8 sheet of flat wood - usually plywood, OSB, or MDF.  Heavy and bulky, this is extremely useful for all manner of construction, but you might have to cut it to size before doing smaller projects.

items.name: wooden smoother
items.description: This large makeshift tool is used in smoothing concrete or mortar in construction projects.  You could also use it as an improvised head-basher.

items.name: wooden barrel
items.description: Traditionally made of white oak; these vessels are known for delivering delicious whiskey to the future.  It has a capacity of 100 liters.

items.name: wooden bead
items.description: This is a wooden bead.  It can be used to craft inscribable jewelry or create a beaded curtain door.

items.name: wooden greatbow
items.description: An extremely large and stiff longbow, made with enormous limbs and a thick string to take an immense amount of energy.  Takes incredible strength to draw.

items.name: wool hoodie
items.description: A wool hooded shirt.  It offers decent protection against the cold.  The front pocket offers both storage room and shelter for your hands.

items.name: wool staple
items.description: The natural cluster of wool fibers.  Could be processed to the felt patches or yarns.

items.name: wool suit
items.description: An encumbering wool suit covered in nice patterns.  It looks like full body armor but it only protects against cold, sadly.

items.name: workbench
items.description: A sturdy workbench built out of metal.  It is perfect for crafting large and heavy things.

items.name: Walther P22 magazine
items.description: A 10-round box magazine for the Walther P22.

items.name: wrapped radiation badge
items.description: This is a badge that detects radiation dosage sealed in a radiation-blocking bag.  Use it to remove it from the bag.

items.name: paper wrapper
items.description: Just a piece of butcher's paper.  Good for starting fires.

items.name: wrench
items.description: This is an adjustable crescent wrench.  It could be a decent melee weapon, and is used in many mechanics crafting recipes.

items.name: brace slingshot
items.description: A modern slingshot with a wrist brace, it is easy to use, accurate, and quite powerful.

items.name: wrist watch
items.description: A simple wristwatch on a plastic band.  Tells the time and has an alarm clock feature.

items.name: winter survivor suit
items.description: A warm and heavy hand-built combination armor made from a reinforced bulletproof vest and an insulated leather jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

items.name: X-Acto knife
items.description: This is a small, sharp knife, designed for making precise cuts for textiles or crafts.  It could cause decent damage, but is difficult to hit things with it.  Its small, sharp blade allows for precision strikes in the hands of the skilled.  It is too small to butcher corpses with.

items.name: Xanax
items.description: Anti-anxiety agent with a powerful sedative effect.  May cause dissociation and loss of memory.  It is dangerously addictive, and withdrawal from regular use should be gradual.  Its generic name is alprazolam.

items.name: large water wheel
items.description: A large water wheel with wooden supports.  Will recharge the vehicle's electrical power when built over shallow moving water.

items.name: large wind turbine
items.description: A large turbine that can convert wind into electric power.

items.name: extra-light frame
items.description: A small lightweight frame made from pipework.  Useful for crafting.

items.name: XL heavy survivor suit
items.description: A massive, heavy, hand-built combination armor made from a reinforced bulletproof vest and a metal-plated leather jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

items.name: XL Kevlar vest
items.description: A massive, hand-built Kevlar vest based on the design of existing bullet resistant vests.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.

items.name: XL survivor suit
items.description: A massive hand-built combination armor made from a bulletproof vest and a reinforced leather jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

items.name: yellow carpet
items.description: A roll of yellow carpet.

items.name: yellow paint
items.description: A can of yellow paint.

items.name: yarn
items.description: Wool yarn, could be used to knit wool clothing.

items.name: newspaper page
items.description: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It seems to date from a few years ago--amazing it has lasted this long.  Most of the information on there is terribly trivial, or out of date, but one thing catches your eye briefly.

items.name: yeast
items.description: A powder-like mix of cultured yeast, good for baking and brewing alike.

items.name: yogurt
items.description: Delicious fermented dairy.  It tastes of vanilla.

items.name: yoke and harness
items.description: A bar and harness to attach a creature to a wheeled vehicle, they then should be able to pull it.

items.name: yukata
items.description: An easy-to-wear, breezy robe secured with a sash.  Essentially Japanese pajamas.  Great for summer nights.

items.name: zentai
items.description: Short for 'zenshin taitsu', a zentai is a form fitting full body nylon and spandex garment.  Though it covers your face, you can see through the integrated hood.  With a couple of these and some friends and you could put on some kabuki.

items.name: zinc
items.description: A slightly brittle metal.  Apart from being an essential mineral that the body needs, it reacts readily with acids, alkalis and other non-metals.  It can be crushed to make zinc powder, used in the production of batteries, among other things.

items.name: long plastic zipper
items.description: A long zipper made from plastic, usually found on clothing.

items.name: short plastic zipper
items.description: A short zipper made from plastic, usually found on footwear or clothing pockets.

items.name: zubon
items.description: Plain white zubon for use in martial arts.

items.name: zucchini
items.description: A tasty summer squash.

items.name: flammenschwert (aus)
items.description: Ein großes zweihaendiges Schwert aus Deutschland, an dessen Klinge sich, unter Zufuehrung von Benzin, eine anhaltende Flamme erzeugen laesst.  Es ist eine sehr maechtige Waffe.
